a.example: I saw a small bird sitting on the old wooden fence.
a.exampleZh: 我看见一只小鸟停在旧木栅栏上。

abandon.example: They had to abandon the old car by the side of the road.
abandon.exampleZh: 他们不得不把旧车丢弃在路边。

ability.example: She has the ability to solve difficult problems quickly and carefully.
ability.exampleZh: 她有快速而仔细地解决难题的能力。

able.example: She is able to solve this difficult problem quickly.
able.exampleZh: 她能够很快解决这个难题。

abnormal.example: It is abnormal for him to be late for school.
abnormal.exampleZh: 他上学迟到是不正常的。

aboard.example: All passengers must be aboard the ship before it leaves the port.
aboard.exampleZh: 所有乘客必须在船离港前上船。

about.example: She told me about her trip to the small village.
about.exampleZh: 她给我讲了她去那个小村庄的旅行。

above.example: The bird flew above the trees and then landed on the roof.
above.exampleZh: 那只鸟飞到树木上方，然后落在屋顶上。

abroad.example: Many young people want to study abroad after they finish high school.
abroad.exampleZh: 很多年轻人高中毕业后想出国留学。

absence.example: His absence from the meeting made everyone wonder where he was.
absence.exampleZh: 他缺席会议，大家都想知道他在哪里。

absent.example: He was absent from school yesterday because he had a bad cold.
absent.exampleZh: 他昨天因为重感冒没去上学。

absolute.example: The king had absolute power over everyone in the land.
absolute.exampleZh: 国王对这片土地上的所有人拥有绝对权力。

absorb.example: Plants absorb water and sunlight through their leaves and grow well.
absorb.exampleZh: 植物通过叶子吸收水和阳光，并茁壮成长。

abstract.example: The idea is too abstract for most people to understand easily.
abstract.exampleZh: 这个想法太抽象，大多数人不容易理解。

abundant.example: Fresh fruit is abundant in this region during the hot summer months.
abundant.exampleZh: 在炎热的夏季，这个地区的新鲜水果非常丰富。

abuse.example: Some parents abuse their power and hurt their children at home.
abuse.exampleZh: 有些父母滥用权力，在家里伤害自己的孩子。

academic.example: Her academic work is very strong, and she hopes to teach at a university.
academic.exampleZh: 她的学术工作非常出色，她希望在一所大学任教。

academy.example: She studies music at a famous academy in London.
academy.exampleZh: 她在伦敦一所著名的学院学习音乐。

accelerate.example: The new train can accelerate quickly and save time for many people.
accelerate.exampleZh: 这列新火车能快速加速，为许多人节省时间。

accent.example: She speaks English with a strong accent, but everyone understands her easily.
accent.exampleZh: 她讲英语带有很重的口音，但每个人都能轻松听懂她。

accept.example: I accept your kind invitation and will come to dinner tomorrow.
accept.exampleZh: 我接受你的盛情邀请，明天会来吃晚饭。

acceptance.example: Her acceptance of the new plan made everyone in the team feel happy.
acceptance.exampleZh: 她对新计划的接受让团队里的每个人都感到高兴。

access.example: Students can get access to the library after six in the evening.
access.exampleZh: 学生晚上六点后可以进入图书馆。

accident.example: I saw a small accident on my way to school this morning.
accident.exampleZh: 今天早上我在去学校的路上看到了一起小事故。

accidental.example: The accidental meeting at the café led to a long friendship.
accidental.exampleZh: 在咖啡馆的偶然相遇促成了一段长久的友谊。

accommodate.example: This big room can accommodate up to twenty people for the meeting.
accommodate.exampleZh: 这个大房间最多可容纳二十人开会。

accommodation.example: The hotel provides comfortable accommodation for all its guests.
accommodation.exampleZh: 这家酒店为所有客人提供舒适的住处。

accompany.example: I will accompany my mother to the hospital tomorrow morning.
accompany.exampleZh: 明天早上我会陪我妈妈去医院。

accomplish.example: We worked hard and finally accomplished our goal before the deadline.
accomplish.exampleZh: 我们努力工作，终于在截止日期前实现了目标。

accord.example: They reached an accord after a long and friendly talk.
accord.exampleZh: 他们在长时间友好交谈后达成了一致。

accordance.example: We did the work in accordance with the rules.
accordance.exampleZh: 我们按照规则完成了这项工作。

accordingly.example: The weather was bad, so we changed our plans accordingly.
accordingly.exampleZh: 天气不好，因此我们相应地改变了计划。

account.example: I opened a new bank account and saved some money this month.
account.exampleZh: 我开了一个新的银行账户，这个月存了一些钱。

accountant.example: My sister is an accountant and she works in a small office.
accountant.exampleZh: 我姐姐是一名会计，她在一间小办公室工作。

accumulate.example: If you save a little money each day, it will accumulate over time.
accumulate.exampleZh: 如果你每天存一点钱，它就会随着时间积累起来。

accuracy.example: The accuracy of this test is very important for the doctor.
accuracy.exampleZh: 这项测试的准确性对医生非常重要。

accurate.example: Her report was accurate and helped us make the right choice.
accurate.exampleZh: 她的报告准确，帮助我们做出了正确的选择。

accuse.example: They accuse him of taking the money without any proof.
accuse.exampleZh: 他们没有任何证据就指责他拿了钱。

accustomed.example: She is accustomed to waking up early every morning.

ache.example: My legs ache after the long walk in the cold rain.
ache.exampleZh: 在冷雨中长途步行后，我的双腿酸痛。

achieve.example: You can achieve your goals if you work hard every day.
achieve.exampleZh: 如果你每天努力，你就能实现你的目标。

achievement.example: Winning the small race was a big achievement for the young boy.
achievement.exampleZh: 赢得那场小比赛对这个小男孩来说是一项很大的成就。

acid.example: The acid in the lemon made my tongue feel sharp and sour.
acid.exampleZh: 柠檬里的酸让我的舌头感到刺痛又发酸。

acknowledge.example: I must acknowledge that your help made my work much easier today.
acknowledge.exampleZh: 我必须承认，你的帮助让我今天的工作轻松多了。

acquaint.example: I will acquaint you with the new rules before you start work.
acquaint.exampleZh: 在你开始工作之前，我会让你熟悉新规则。

acquaintance.example: He is an old acquaintance of mine, and we often meet at the park.
acquaintance.exampleZh: 他是我的一个老熟人，我们经常在公园见面。

acquire.example: Children acquire language skills quickly when they play with others every day.
acquire.exampleZh: 孩子们每天和其他人一起玩时能很快学会语言技能。

acquisition.example: The company's acquisition of a small rival surprised many people.
acquisition.exampleZh: 这家公司收购一个小竞争对手让很多人感到惊讶。

acre.example: The farmer owns ten acres of land near the river.
acre.exampleZh: 这位农民在河边拥有十英亩土地。

across.example: We walked across the street to meet our friends at the small cafe.
across.exampleZh: 我们穿过街道去小咖啡馆见朋友。

act.example: We must act now to protect our city and help our friends.
act.exampleZh: 我们必须现在就行动起来，保护我们的城市并帮助我们的朋友。

action.example: His quick action saved the small child from danger.
action.exampleZh: 他的迅速行动使那个小孩脱离了危险。

active.example: She stays active by walking to school every day.
active.exampleZh: 她每天步行上学，保持活跃。

activity.example: The school plans many outdoor activities for students in spring.
activity.exampleZh: 学校计划在春天为学生安排许多户外活动。

actor.example: The actor on the stage spoke loudly and smiled at everyone.
actor.exampleZh: 舞台上的男演员大声说话，并对每个人微笑。

actress.example: The actress gave a wonderful performance in the new film last night.
actress.exampleZh: 这位女演员昨晚在新电影中献上了一场精彩的表演。

actual.example: The actual cost was higher than the estimate we received.
actual.exampleZh: 实际成本比我们收到的估价要高。

actually.example: I thought he was joking, but he was actually serious about it.
actually.exampleZh: 我以为他在开玩笑，但他实际上是认真的。

acute.example: She has an acute sense of smell and can find food easily.
acute.exampleZh: 她有敏锐的嗅觉，能轻易找到食物。

adapt.example: It is not easy to adapt to a new school.
adapt.exampleZh: 适应一所新学校并不容易。

addition.example: The new addition to our team brings fresh ideas and strong energy.
addition.exampleZh: 我们团队的新成员带来了新鲜的想法和强大的活力。

additional.example: We need an additional chair for the meeting room today.
additional.exampleZh: 我们今天会议室需要一把额外的椅子。

address.example: Please write your address on this form before you leave the office.
address.exampleZh: 请在离开办公室前把你的地址写在这张表格上。

adequate.example: The old computer is still adequate for my simple daily work.
adequate.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑对于我简单的日常工作仍然足够用。

adjective.example: The word happy is an adjective that describes how someone feels.
adjective.exampleZh: happy 这个词是形容词，用来描述某人的感受。

adjust.example: You can adjust the chair to make it more comfortable for you.
adjust.exampleZh: 你可以调整椅子，让它对你来说更舒服。

administration.example: The administration of the new school is simple and fair.
administration.exampleZh: 新学校的管理简单而公平。

admire.example: I really admire her courage when she faces difficult problems at work.
admire.exampleZh: 我真的很钦佩她在工作中面对困难问题时的勇气。

admission.example: The admission fee is five dollars for students and ten for adults.
admission.exampleZh: 学生入场费是五美元，成人是十美元。

admit.example: I must admit that I made a small mistake yesterday.
admit.exampleZh: 我必须承认我昨天犯了一个小错误。

adolescent.example: Many adolescent students need more sleep on school nights.
adolescent.exampleZh: 许多青少年学生在上学期间的晚上需要更多睡眠。

adopt.example: The company decided to adopt a new plan to save money.
adopt.exampleZh: 公司决定采用一项新计划来省钱。

adult.example: Every adult should know how to ask for help when they need it.
adult.exampleZh: 每个成年人都应该知道在需要时如何寻求帮助。

advance.example: Please advance the meeting to nine in the morning.
advance.exampleZh: 请把会议提前到上午九点。

advanced.example: This advanced machine helps workers finish their tasks much faster.
advanced.exampleZh: 这台先进的机器帮助工人更快地完成任务。

advantage.example: One big advantage of living here is the quiet streets.
advantage.exampleZh: 住在这里的一大好处是街道很安静。

adventure.example: Their trip to the mountains became a great adventure for everyone.
adventure.exampleZh: 他们的山间之行对每个人来说都成了一次很棒的冒险。

adverb.example: The word adverb is easy to learn and use in a sentence.
adverb.exampleZh: 副词这个词很容易学习，也容易在句子中使用。

advertise.example: Many small shops advertise their new products online every day.
advertise.exampleZh: 许多小商店每天在网上为新产品做广告。

advertisement.example: I saw a short advertisement for a new phone on television last night.
advertisement.exampleZh: 昨晚我在电视上看到一个新手机的短广告。

advice.example: My teacher gave me some good advice about studying for the exam.
advice.exampleZh: 我的老师给了我一些关于备考的好建议。

advisable.example: It is advisable to check the weather before you go hiking.
advisable.exampleZh: 去徒步之前查看天气是可取的。

advise.example: I advise you to see a doctor if you feel sick.
advise.exampleZh: 我建议你如果感到不舒服就去看医生。

advocate.example: She is a strong advocate for clean water in every community.
advocate.exampleZh: 她是每个社区清洁用水的大力倡导者。

affair.example: The whole affair was a simple mistake that anyone could make.
affair.exampleZh: 整件事只是一个任何人都可能犯的简单错误。

affect.example: The bad weather can affect our plans for the school trip.
affect.exampleZh: 恶劣天气可能会影响我们学校旅行的计划。

affection.example: She shows great affection for her little dog every day.
affection.exampleZh: 她每天对她的宠物狗表现出深厚的喜爱。

afford.example: We cannot afford a new car this year because prices are too high.
afford.exampleZh: 我们今年买不起新车，因为价格太高了。

afraid.example: She is afraid of the big dog in the park.
afraid.exampleZh: 她害怕公园里的那条大狗。

africa.example: Many people in Africa grow rice and corn for their families.
africa.exampleZh: 非洲的许多人种植稻米和玉米来养家。

african.example: My African friend teaches us simple songs about his home country.
african.exampleZh: 我的非洲朋友教我们唱关于他祖国的简单歌曲。

after.example: We went home after the movie ended and had dinner.
after.exampleZh: 电影结束后我们回家吃了晚饭。

afternoon.example: We will play football in the park this afternoon after school.
afternoon.exampleZh: 今天下午放学后我们要在公园踢足球。

afterward(s).example: We went home and ate dinner afterward.
afterward(s).exampleZh: 我们回家了，之后吃了晚饭。

again.example: Please try again tomorrow and I will help you with it.
again.exampleZh: 请明天再试一次，我会帮你处理它。

against.example: Many people spoke against the plan at the meeting yesterday.
against.exampleZh: 昨天许多人在会上发言反对这个计划。

age.example: She started to learn the piano at the age of six.

agency.example: The travel agency helped us book a cheap flight to Paris.
agency.exampleZh: 这家旅行社帮我们订了去巴黎的便宜机票。

agenda.example: The first item on our agenda is the new budget.
agenda.exampleZh: 我们议程上的第一项是新预算。

agent.example: The agent helped us buy the house quickly and without any trouble.
agent.exampleZh: 这位代理人帮我们很快买下了房子，而且没有任何麻烦。

aggressive.example: The aggressive dog barked loudly at every stranger who walked past the gate.
aggressive.exampleZh: 那只好斗的狗对每个走过大门的陌生人狂吠。

ago.example: I met my best friend three years ago at a small school.
ago.exampleZh: 三年前我在一所小学校认识了我最好的朋友。

agree.example: I agree with you and we can start the work now.
agree.exampleZh: 我同意你的看法，我们现在可以开始工作了。

agreement.example: We finally reached an agreement after a long and friendly talk.
agreement.exampleZh: 经过长时间友好的交谈，我们终于达成了协议。

agricultural.example: The agricultural land near our town is very good for growing corn.
agricultural.exampleZh: 我们镇附近的农业用地非常适合种玉米。

agriculture.example: Agriculture is important because it gives people food and jobs.
agriculture.exampleZh: 农业很重要，因为它为人们提供食物和就业机会。

ahead.example: We should look ahead and plan our trip for next week.
ahead.exampleZh: 我们应该向前看，并计划下周的旅行。

aid.example: The new teacher uses simple pictures as an aid in class.
aid.exampleZh: 新老师用简单的图片作为课堂上的辅助工具。

aim.example: Our aim is to help every student learn English with confidence and joy.
aim.exampleZh: 我们的目标是帮助每个学生自信而快乐地学习英语。

air.example: The fresh air in the mountains made everyone feel happy and relaxed.
air.exampleZh: 山里的新鲜空气让每个人都感到快乐和放松。

aircraft.example: The new aircraft can carry many people across the sea.
aircraft.exampleZh: 这架新飞机能载很多人飞越海洋。

airline.example: The airline lost my bag, so I called its office for help.
airline.exampleZh: 航空公司弄丢了我的包，所以我打电话给它的办公室求助。

airplane.example: The airplane flew high above the clouds on a sunny morning.
airplane.exampleZh: 在一个阳光明媚的早晨，飞机高高飞过云层。

airport.example: We arrived at the airport early and waited for our flight.
airport.exampleZh: 我们早早到达机场，等待我们的航班。

alarm.example: The fire alarm woke everyone up early this morning.
alarm.exampleZh: 今天早上火灾警报把大家都吵醒了。

album.example: She put all the old family photos into a new album.
album.exampleZh: 她把所有旧的家庭照片放进一本新相册里。

alcohol.example: He never drinks alcohol because he wants to stay healthy and keep a clear mind.
alcohol.exampleZh: 他从不喝酒，因为他想保持健康并保持头脑清醒。

alert.example: The guard stayed alert all night and watched the gate carefully.
alert.exampleZh: 警卫整夜保持警觉，并仔细看守大门。

alike.example: The two brothers look very much alike, so people often confuse them.
alike.exampleZh: 这两兄弟长得非常像，所以人们常常把他们弄混。

alive.example: The old tree is still alive after many cold winters.
alive.exampleZh: 这棵老树经历许多寒冬后仍然活着。

all.example: We all worked hard to finish the project before the end of the day.
all.exampleZh: 我们都努力工作，在一天结束前完成了这个项目。

allow.example: My parents allow me to play outside after I finish my homework.
allow.exampleZh: 我父母允许我完成作业后在外面玩。

allowance.example: My parents give me a small allowance every week to buy snacks.
allowance.exampleZh: 父母每周给我一点零用钱买零食。

ally.example: The small country became a close ally of its powerful neighbor.
ally.exampleZh: 这个小国成为了其强大邻国的亲密盟友。

almost.example: I almost missed the bus this morning because I woke up late.
almost.exampleZh: 今天早上我差点错过公交车，因为我起晚了。

alone.example: She lives alone in a small house near the quiet river.
alone.exampleZh: 她独自住在安静河边的一所小房子里。

along.example: We walked along the river and talked about our plans.
along.exampleZh: 我们沿着河边走，一边谈论我们的计划。

alongside.example: The small boat moved alongside the big ship in the harbor.
alongside.exampleZh: 小船在港口里沿着大船旁边移动。

aloud.example: Please read the letter aloud so everyone in the room can hear you.
aloud.exampleZh: 请大声读这封信，让房间里的每个人都能听到你。

alphabet.example: Children learn the alphabet before they start to read simple books.
alphabet.exampleZh: 孩子们在开始读简单的书之前先学习字母表。

already.example: I have already finished my homework and I am going to bed now.
already.exampleZh: 我已经完成作业，现在要去睡觉了。

also.example: She speaks English well and she can also speak French.
also.exampleZh: 她英语说得很好，而且也会说法语。

alter.example: They had to alter the old dress so it would fit her.
alter.exampleZh: 他们不得不改动那条旧裙子，好让它合她的身。

alternative.example: We need an alternative plan because the first one did not work.
alternative.exampleZh: 我们需要一个替代方案，因为第一个方案没有用。

although.example: Although it was raining, we decided to go for a walk outside.
although.exampleZh: 虽然当时在下雨，我们还是决定去外面散步。

altitude.example: The plane flew at a high altitude above the clouds.
altitude.exampleZh: 飞机在云层上方的高空飞行。

altogether.example: The trip altogether cost us about two hundred dollars.
altogether.exampleZh: 这次旅行总共花了我们大约两百美元。

aluminium.example: This light box is made of aluminium and it is very strong.
aluminium.exampleZh: 这个轻便的盒子是用铝制成的，而且非常坚固。

always.example: She always helps her friends when they need her.
always.exampleZh: 她总是在朋友需要帮助时帮助他们。

amateur.example: He is an amateur photographer who takes pictures on weekends.
amateur.exampleZh: 他是一名周末拍照的业余摄影师。

amaze.example: The magic show will amaze all the children in our town.
amaze.exampleZh: 这场魔术表演会让我们镇上所有的孩子感到惊叹。

amazing.example: The view from the top of the mountain was amazing.

ambassador.example: The ambassador met the president to discuss peace between the two countries.
ambassador.exampleZh: 大使会见了总统，讨论两国之间的和平问题。

ambition.example: Her ambition is to become a doctor and help people in need.
ambition.exampleZh: 她的抱负是成为一名医生，帮助有需要的人。

ambitious.example: She is ambitious and works hard every day to reach her goals.
ambitious.exampleZh: 她很有雄心，每天努力工作以实现目标。

ambulance.example: The ambulance arrived quickly and took the sick man to the hospital.
ambulance.exampleZh: 救护车很快到达，把生病的男子送到了医院。

america.example: Many people travel to America every year to see its beautiful cities.
america.exampleZh: 许多人每年去美国看它美丽的城市。

american.example: Many American students learn Chinese at school every year.
american.exampleZh: 许多美国学生每年在学校学习中文。

among.example: She found a small key among the old books on the shelf.
among.exampleZh: 她在书架上的旧书中间找到了一把小钥匙。

amount.example: The total amount of water in the bottle is two liters.
amount.exampleZh: 瓶子里水的总量是两升。

ample.example: We have ample time to finish the work before the sun goes down.
ample.exampleZh: 我们有足够的时间在太阳下山前完成这项工作。

amuse.example: The funny clown can amuse the children at the birthday party.
amuse.exampleZh: 那个有趣的小丑能在生日聚会上逗孩子们开心。

amusement.example: The park offers many kinds of amusement for children and adults.
amusement.exampleZh: 这个公园为儿童和成人提供了许多种娱乐。

analyse.example: We need to analyse the data before we make a final decision.
analyse.exampleZh: 我们需要在做出最终决定之前分析这些数据。

analysis.example: The teacher gave a clear analysis of the problem to the class.
analysis.exampleZh: 老师向全班对这个问题作了清晰的分析。

ancestor.example: My ancestor came to this country many years ago and worked hard.
ancestor.exampleZh: 我的祖先很多年前来到这个国家并努力工作。

anchor.exampleZh: 新闻主播坐在桌前，播报了晚间新闻。

ancient.example: The museum shows ancient tools and pottery from early human history.
ancient.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了早期人类历史上的古代工具和陶器。

angel.example: She is a kind angel who always helps people in need.
angel.exampleZh: 她是一个善良的天使，总是帮助有需要的人。

anger.example: His loud words filled her with anger, and she left the room quickly.
anger.exampleZh: 他大声的话语让她充满愤怒，她很快离开了房间。

angle.exampleZh: 从这个角度看，这个小房间显得比以前大得多也亮得多。

angry.example: My father was angry because I came home very late last night.
angry.exampleZh: 我父亲很生气，因为我昨晚很晚才回家。

animal.example: The zoo has many animals, and children love to watch them.
animal.exampleZh: 动物园里有很多动物，孩子们喜欢观看它们。

ankle.example: I hurt my ankle while playing basketball with my friends yesterday.
ankle.exampleZh: 昨天我和朋友们打篮球时伤了脚踝。

anniversary.example: My parents will celebrate their twentieth wedding anniversary with a small family dinner.
anniversary.exampleZh: 我父母将用一顿小型家庭晚餐庆祝他们的二十周年结婚纪念日。

announce.example: The school will announce the test results on Friday morning.
announce.exampleZh: 学校将在周五上午宣布考试结果。

annoy.example: Loud music late at night can annoy your neighbors very quickly.
annoy.exampleZh: 深夜大声放音乐很快就会惹恼你的邻居。

annual.example: The company holds an annual meeting for all its employees.
annual.exampleZh: 公司为所有员工举行年度会议。

another.example: I ate one apple and then I ate another one.
another.exampleZh: 我吃了一个苹果，然后又吃了一个。

answer.example: Please answer my question before you leave the room.
answer.exampleZh: 请在你离开房间之前回答我的问题。

ant.example: A small ant is carrying a piece of food to its nest.
ant.exampleZh: 一只小蚂蚁正把一块食物搬回巢穴。

antarctic.example: The Antarctic is very cold and few people live there all year.
antarctic.exampleZh: 南极地区非常寒冷，很少有人全年住在那里。

anticipate.example: We anticipate a busy day at the shop tomorrow.
anticipate.exampleZh: 我们预计明天店里会很忙。

anxiety.example: She felt a lot of anxiety before her first day at work.
anxiety.exampleZh: 她在第一天上班前感到非常焦虑。

anxious.example: She feels anxious before every exam, but she still studies hard.
anxious.exampleZh: 她每次考试前都感到焦虑，但她仍然努力学习。

any.example: Do you have any questions about the plan before we start?
any.exampleZh: 在我们开始之前，你对这个计划有什么问题吗？

anybody.example: Anybody can join this club if they pay the small fee.
anybody.exampleZh: 任何人只要支付少量费用就可以加入这个俱乐部。

anyhow.example: Anyhow, we can try again tomorrow if the weather is bad.
anyhow.exampleZh: 无论如何，如果天气不好，我们可以明天再试。

anyone.example: Anyone can learn to cook simple meals with a little practice.
anyone.exampleZh: 任何人只要稍加练习都能学会做简单的饭菜。

anything.example: You can ask me anything if you need help with your work.
anything.exampleZh: 如果你工作需要帮助，你可以问我任何事情。

anyway.example: I was tired, but I went to the party anyway.
anyway.exampleZh: 我很累，但还是去参加了聚会。

anywhere.example: You can sit anywhere you like in this small classroom.
anywhere.exampleZh: 你可以在这间小教室里坐在任何你喜欢的地方。

apart.example: The two houses stand far apart on the same quiet street.
apart.exampleZh: 这两栋房子在同一条安静的街道上相隔很远。

apartment.example: I live in a small apartment near the park with my dog.
apartment.exampleZh: 我和我的狗住在公园附近的一套小公寓里。

apologize.example: I want to apologize to you for being late this morning.
apologize.exampleZh: 我想为今天早上迟到向你道歉。

apology.example: He said sorry to his friend and offered a sincere apology for being late.
apology.exampleZh: 他向朋友说了对不起，并为迟到真诚地道了歉。

apparent.example: It was apparent that he did not want to go with us.
apparent.exampleZh: 很明显他不想和我们一起去。

apparently.example: Apparently, she is not coming to the party tonight.
apparently.exampleZh: 显然，她今晚不会来参加聚会。

appeal.example: The charity made an appeal for food and clothes after the flood.
appeal.exampleZh: 洪水过后，这家慈善机构呼吁人们捐赠食物和衣物。

appear.example: A small mistake may appear in the report from time to time.
appear.exampleZh: 报告中有时会出现一个小错误。

appearance.example: His sudden appearance at the door surprised everyone in the room.
appearance.exampleZh: 他突然出现在门口，让房间里的每个人都吃了一惊。

appetite.example: He lost his appetite after a long day at work.
appetite.exampleZh: 工作了一整天后，他失去了食欲。

applaud.example: The audience began to applaud loudly after the singer finished her song.
applaud.exampleZh: 歌手唱完歌后，观众开始大声鼓掌。

applause.example: The audience gave loud applause after the singer finished her beautiful song.
applause.exampleZh: 歌手唱完优美的歌曲后，观众报以热烈的掌声。

apple.example: I eat a red apple every day because it is sweet and healthy.
apple.exampleZh: 我每天吃一个红苹果，因为它又甜又健康。

appliance.example: We bought a new kitchen appliance to help us cook faster.
appliance.exampleZh: 我们买了一台新的厨房电器，帮助我们更快地做饭。

applicable.example: This rule is applicable to all students in our school.
applicable.exampleZh: 这条规则适用于我们学校的所有学生。

applicant.example: The applicant filled out the form and waited for a reply.
applicant.exampleZh: 申请人填好表格，然后等待回复。

application.example: She sent her application to the company before the deadline last week.
application.exampleZh: 她上周在截止日期前把申请交给了那家公司。

apply.example: You can apply for this job online before Friday.
apply.exampleZh: 你可以在周五之前在线申请这份工作。

appoint.example: The manager will appoint a new team leader next Monday morning.
appoint.exampleZh: 经理将在下周一上午任命一位新团队负责人。

appointment.example: She has an appointment with the doctor this afternoon.
appointment.exampleZh: 她今天下午和医生有个预约。

appreciate.example: I really appreciate your help with my work today.
appreciate.exampleZh: 我非常感激你今天帮我做工作。

approach.example: We need a new approach to solve this problem quickly.
approach.exampleZh: 我们需要一种新方法来快速解决这个问题。

appropriate.example: It is not appropriate to wear shorts to a formal meeting.
appropriate.exampleZh: 穿短裤参加正式会议是不恰当的。

approval.example: The manager gave his approval to the new plan yesterday.
approval.exampleZh: 经理昨天批准了新计划。

approve.example: My parents approve of my plan to study abroad next year.
approve.exampleZh: 我父母赞成我明年出国留学的计划。

approximate.example: The approximate cost of the trip is two hundred dollars.
approximate.exampleZh: 这次旅行的费用大约为两百美元。

approximately.example: The trip will take approximately two hours by train from here.
approximately.exampleZh: 从这里坐火车大约需要两个小时。

apron.example: My mother wears a clean apron when she cooks dinner in the kitchen.
apron.exampleZh: 我妈妈在厨房做晚饭时系着一条干净的围裙。

arbitrary.example: The manager made an arbitrary decision without asking anyone on the team.
arbitrary.exampleZh: 经理没有询问团队里的任何人就做出了一个专断的决定。

architect.example: The architect drew a simple house for the young family.
architect.exampleZh: 这位建筑师为这个年轻家庭画了一座简单的房子。

architecture.example: The old church shows a beautiful style of architecture from the past.
architecture.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂展现了过去一种美丽的建筑风格。

arctic.example: Polar bears live in the arctic and hunt seals on the ice.
arctic.exampleZh: 北极熊生活在北极，并在冰上捕猎海豹。

area.example: This area of the park is very quiet in the morning.
area.exampleZh: 公园的这一区域早晨非常安静。

argue.example: They often argue about small things at home.
argue.exampleZh: 他们经常在家里为小事争论。

argument.example: They had a serious argument about money, but they soon became friends again.
argument.exampleZh: 他们因为钱发生了激烈的争吵，但很快就又成了朋友。

arise.example: New problems often arise when people try to change old rules.
arise.exampleZh: 当人们试图改变旧规则时，新问题常常会出现。

arithmetic.example: My little sister learns arithmetic at school every day.
arithmetic.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天在学校学算术。

arm.example: She held the baby in her arms and smiled at him.
arm.exampleZh: 她把婴儿抱在怀里，对他微笑。

army.example: The army marched through the town early in the morning.
army.exampleZh: 军队一大早就穿过小镇。

around.example: We walked around the old town and took many photos.
around.exampleZh: 我们在老城区四处走走，拍了很多照片。

arrange.example: I will arrange the chairs and tables for the meeting tomorrow.
arrange.exampleZh: 我会为明天的会议安排桌椅。

arrangement.example: We made an arrangement to meet at the park after school.
arrangement.exampleZh: 我们安排放学后在公园见面。

arrest.example: The police will arrest the man who stole my bike.
arrest.exampleZh: 警察将逮捕那个偷了我自行车的人。

arrival.example: The arrival of the train was delayed by heavy snow this morning.
arrival.exampleZh: 今天早上，火车因大雪而延迟到达。

arrive.example: We will arrive at the station before the train leaves.
arrive.exampleZh: 我们会在火车出发前到达车站。

arrow.example: The hunter shot an arrow at the deer in the forest.
arrow.exampleZh: 猎人在森林里向那只鹿射了一箭。

art.example: She studies art at school and loves to paint every day.
art.exampleZh: 她在学校学习艺术，并且喜欢每天画画。

article.example: I read an interesting article about healthy food in the newspaper yesterday.
article.exampleZh: 我昨天在报纸上读了一篇关于健康食物的有趣文章。

artificial.example: Artificial flowers look real but they need no water.
artificial.exampleZh: 人造花看起来像真的，但它们不需要浇水。

artist.example: The young artist painted a beautiful picture of the sea.
artist.exampleZh: 这位年轻的艺术家画了一幅美丽的海景画。

artistic.example: She has an artistic way of drawing simple things from daily life.
artistic.exampleZh: 她有一种艺术化的方式，能把日常生活中的简单事物画出来。

as.example: As I was walking home, I saw a small dog.
as.exampleZh: 当我走回家时，我看到一只小狗。

ash.example: After the fire, only a thin layer of ash remained on the ground.
ash.exampleZh: 火灾过后，地上只剩下一层薄薄的灰。

ashamed.example: She felt ashamed because she had lied to her best friend.
ashamed.exampleZh: 她因为对最好的朋友撒了谎而感到惭愧。

asia.example: Many people from Asia visit this city every year to see its famous old temples.
asia.exampleZh: 许多来自亚洲的人每年都来这座城市参观它著名的古老寺庙。

asian.example: My Asian friend lives in New York and studies English with me.
asian.exampleZh: 我的亚洲朋友住在纽约，和我一起学英语。

aside.example: She stepped aside to let the old man pass through the door.
aside.exampleZh: 她走到旁边，让那位老人通过那扇门。

ask.example: I will ask my teacher for help after class tomorrow.
ask.exampleZh: 我明天课后会向老师求助。

asleep.example: The baby is asleep in his bed after a long day.
asleep.exampleZh: 宝宝在漫长的一天后睡在他的床上。

aspect.example: One important aspect of learning a language is daily practice.
aspect.exampleZh: 学习语言的一个重要方面是每日练习。

assemble.example: The workers assemble the new machines in the large factory every morning.
assemble.exampleZh: 工人们每天早上在大工厂里装配新机器。

assembly.example: The workers finished the assembly of the machine before noon.
assembly.exampleZh: 工人们在中午前完成了这台机器的装配。

assess.example: We need to assess the risks before we make a final decision.
assess.exampleZh: 在做最终决定之前，我们需要评估这些风险。

asset.example: A good reputation is a valuable asset for any company.
asset.exampleZh: 良好的声誉对任何公司来说都是宝贵的资产。

assign.example: The teacher will assign a new task to each student tomorrow.
assign.exampleZh: 老师明天会给每个学生布置一项新任务。

assignment.example: Our teacher gave us a difficult assignment before the weekend.
assignment.exampleZh: 我们的老师在周末前给我们布置了一项难做的作业。

assist.example: I can assist you with your homework after dinner tonight.
assist.exampleZh: 今晚晚饭后我可以帮你做作业。

assistance.example: I asked my friend for assistance when I moved to a new apartment.
assistance.exampleZh: 我搬进新公寓时向朋友求助。

assistant.example: The assistant helped me find the right file in the office today.
assistant.exampleZh: 助手今天帮我在办公室找到了正确的文件。

associate.example: I associate this song with my happy summer days at the beach.
associate.exampleZh: 我把这首歌和我在海滩上快乐的夏日时光联系在一起。

association.example: She joined a local art association to meet new people and learn more.
association.exampleZh: 她加入了一个当地的艺术协会，以结识新朋友并学习更多。

assume.example: Do not assume that everyone will agree with your plan.
assume.exampleZh: 不要假定每个人都会同意你的计划。

assumption.example: Your assumption about the meeting time was wrong, so we arrived too early.
assumption.exampleZh: 你对会议时间的假设错了，所以我们到得太早了。

assure.example: The doctor assured me that the test results were normal.
assure.exampleZh: 医生向我保证检查结果正常。

astonish.example: The magician's final trick will astonish everyone in the room tonight.
astonish.exampleZh: 魔术师最后的戏法会让今晚房间里的每个人感到惊讶。

astronaut.example: The astronaut floats in space and looks at Earth.
astronaut.exampleZh: 宇航员在太空中漂浮，并看着地球。

astronomy.example: My brother studies astronomy at college and often watches the stars at night.
astronomy.exampleZh: 我哥哥在大学学习天文学，而且经常在晚上看星星。

at.example: I will meet you at the library after school today.
at.exampleZh: 我今天放学后在图书馆见你。

athlete.example: The young athlete trains hard every day to win a medal.
athlete.exampleZh: 这位年轻运动员每天刻苦训练，为了赢得一枚奖牌。

athletic.example: My brother is very athletic and plays football and basketball every weekend.
athletic.exampleZh: 我弟弟非常健壮，每个周末都踢足球和打篮球。

atlantic.example: The Atlantic Ocean is very deep and wide.

atmosphere.example: The restaurant had a warm and friendly atmosphere that made everyone feel welcome.
atmosphere.exampleZh: 这家餐厅有着温暖友好的气氛，让每个人都感到受欢迎。

atom.example: An atom is the smallest unit of a chemical element.
atom.exampleZh: 原子是化学元素的最小单位。

atomic.example: The atomic bomb changed the world in a very serious way.
atomic.exampleZh: 原子弹以一种非常严重的方式改变了世界。

attach.example: Please attach a copy of your ID to the form before you send it.
attach.exampleZh: 请把身份证复印件附在表格上，然后再寄出。

attachment.example: She felt a strong attachment to her old house and garden.
attachment.exampleZh: 她对那栋老房子和花园有着强烈的依恋。

attack.example: The dog may attack strangers if it feels afraid.
attack.exampleZh: 如果感到害怕，这只狗可能会攻击陌生人。

attain.example: With hard work and patience, you can attain your goals in life.
attain.exampleZh: 只要努力和耐心，你就能在生活中实现你的目标。

attempt.example: I will attempt to fix the old bike this afternoon.
attempt.exampleZh: 我今天下午会尝试修理那辆旧自行车。

attend.example: I will attend the meeting tomorrow morning with my manager.
attend.exampleZh: 明天早上我将和经理一起参加这个会议。

attention.example: Please pay attention to the teacher when she speaks in class.
attention.exampleZh: 老师上课讲话时，请注意听讲。

attitude.example: She has a positive attitude toward her work and her daily life.
attitude.exampleZh: 她对工作和日常生活都抱有积极的态度。

attract.example: The new park will attract many families with young children this summer.
attract.exampleZh: 这座新公园今年夏天会吸引许多有小孩的家庭。

attraction.example: The new museum is a popular attraction for visitors in our city.
attraction.exampleZh: 这座新博物馆是我们城市里游客们喜爱的一个热门景点。

attractive.example: She is a very attractive person and everyone likes her.
attractive.exampleZh: 她是一个非常有吸引力的人，大家都喜欢她。

audience.example: The audience clapped loudly after the singer finished her last song.
audience.exampleZh: 歌手唱完最后一首歌后，观众热烈鼓掌。

audio.example: The audio quality of this new speaker is very clear and strong.
audio.exampleZh: 这个新音箱的音频质量非常清晰且强劲。

august.example: We will take a short family trip to the beach in August.
august.exampleZh: 我们将在八月去海滩进行一次短途家庭旅行。

aunt.example: My aunt lives in a small house near the river.
aunt.exampleZh: 我的姑母住在河边的一所小房子里。

australia.example: Australia is a large country with many beautiful beaches and friendly people.
australia.exampleZh: 澳大利亚是一个拥有许多美丽海滩和友好人民的大国。

australian.example: My Australian friend teaches English at a small school near the beach.
australian.exampleZh: 我的澳大利亚朋友在海滩附近的一所小学校教英语。

authentic.example: This old painting looks authentic, and the museum will test it carefully.
authentic.exampleZh: 这幅旧画看起来像真迹，博物馆会仔细检测它。

author.example: The author wrote a short book about life in a small village.
author.exampleZh: 这位作者写了一本关于小村庄生活的短书。

authority.example: The local authority is responsible for keeping our streets clean and safe.
authority.exampleZh: 当地当局负责保持我们的街道清洁和安全。

auto.example: My father drives his old auto to work every morning.
auto.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上开他的旧汽车去上班。

automatic.example: The automatic door opened as soon as I walked near it.
automatic.exampleZh: 我一走近，那扇自动门就开了。

automobile.example: My father drives an old automobile to work every day.
automobile.exampleZh: 我父亲每天开一辆旧汽车上班。

autumn.example: The leaves turn red and gold in autumn every year.
autumn.exampleZh: 每年秋天树叶会变成红色和金色。

auxiliary.example: The auxiliary nurse helped the doctor care for the patients.
auxiliary.exampleZh: 辅助护士帮助医生照顾病人。

available.example: This book is available at the school library for all students.

avenue.example: The new avenue will connect the park to the city center.
avenue.exampleZh: 这条新大道将把公园与市中心连接起来。

average.example: The average temperature in this city is about twenty degrees.
average.exampleZh: 这座城市平均气温大约是二十度。

aviation.example: My uncle works in aviation and often travels to different countries.
aviation.exampleZh: 我的叔叔从事航空工作，经常去不同的国家。

avoid.example: You should avoid eating too much sugar every day.
avoid.exampleZh: 你应该避免每天吃太多糖。

await.example: We await your reply and hope to hear from you soon.

award.exampleZh: 她去年因在学校里的勤奋努力而获得了一个奖项。

aware.example: I am aware of the problem and I will fix it soon.

away.example: Please put your toys away before you go out to play.

awful.example: The weather was awful, so we stayed home and watched a movie.
awful.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们待在家里看了一部电影。

awkward.example: It was an awkward moment when he forgot her name.

baby.exampleZh: 婴儿正在窗边的一张小床上安静地睡觉。

bachelor.example: My uncle is still a bachelor and lives alone in a small apartment.
bachelor.exampleZh: 我叔叔仍然是个单身汉，独自住在一间小公寓里。

back.example: Please put the book back on the shelf after you read it.
back.exampleZh: 请你看完书后把它放回书架上。

background.example: Her background in teaching helped her understand the needs of young students.
background.exampleZh: 她的教学背景帮助她理解年轻学生的需求。

backward.example: The old computer is too backward to run this new program.
backward.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑太落后，无法运行这个新程序。

bacon.example: She cooked some bacon and eggs for breakfast this morning.
bacon.exampleZh: 今天早上她做了咸肉和鸡蛋当早餐。

bacteria.example: Some bacteria can make people sick if food is not kept clean.
bacteria.exampleZh: 如果食物没有保持干净，一些细菌会让人生病。

bad.example: The bad weather made us stay at home all day.
bad.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气让我们一整天都待在家里。

badly.example: He hurt his leg badly and could not walk for two weeks.
badly.exampleZh: 他腿伤得很重，两周不能走路。

badminton.example: I play badminton with my friends in the park every Sunday morning.
badminton.exampleZh: 我每个星期天早上都和朋友在公园里打羽毛球。

bag.example: She put the apples in a paper bag and left the store.
bag.exampleZh: 她把苹果装进纸袋里，然后离开了商店。

baggage.example: Please keep your baggage with you at all times in the airport.
baggage.exampleZh: 请在机场里始终把行李带在身边。

bake.example: I like to bake bread with my mother on Sunday morning.
bake.exampleZh: 我喜欢在周日早上和妈妈一起烤面包。

baker.example: The baker gets up early every morning to make fresh bread for us.
baker.exampleZh: 这位面包师每天早上早起为我们做新鲜面包。

bakery.example: I bought a fresh loaf of bread at the bakery this morning.
bakery.exampleZh: 今天早上我在面包店买了一条新鲜面包。

balance.example: She lost her balance and fell, but quickly stood up again.
balance.exampleZh: 她失去平衡摔倒了，但很快又站了起来。

balcony.example: She stood on the balcony and watched the sunset over the quiet town.
balcony.exampleZh: 她站在阳台上，看着夕阳落在安静的小镇上空。

ball.example: The children played with a red ball in the park after school.
ball.exampleZh: 放学后孩子们在公园里玩一个红色的球。

ballet.example: My sister takes ballet classes every Saturday morning at the community center.
ballet.exampleZh: 我妹妹每周六上午在社区中心上芭蕾舞课。

balloon.example: The little boy held a red balloon in his hand at the park.
balloon.exampleZh: 小男孩在公园里手里拿着一个红气球。

bamboo.example: Many people use bamboo to build simple houses in some warm places.
bamboo.exampleZh: 在一些温暖的地方，许多人用竹子建造简易房屋。

ban.example: The school bans phones in class to help students focus.
ban.exampleZh: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机，以帮助学生集中注意力。

banana.example: I eat a banana every morning before I go to school.
banana.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前吃一根香蕉。

band.example: My friend plays guitar in a small band on weekends.
band.exampleZh: 我的朋友周末在一个小乐队里弹吉他。

bang.example: She closed the door with a loud bang and woke the baby.
bang.exampleZh: 她砰地一声关上门，吵醒了婴儿。

bank.example: I put my money in the bank near my house every month.
bank.exampleZh: 我每个月都把钱存进我家附近的银行。

bankrupt.example: The company went bankrupt after sales fell sharply last year.
bankrupt.exampleZh: 去年销售额大幅下降后，这家公司破产了。

banner.example: They hung a large banner across the street for the school festival.
banner.exampleZh: 他们为学校庆典在街道上悬挂了一条大横幅。

bar.example: The new law will bar people from smoking inside the bar.
bar.exampleZh: 新法律将禁止人们在酒吧内吸烟。

barbecue.example: We had a barbecue in the park with our friends last Saturday.
barbecue.exampleZh: 上周六我们和朋友们在公园里烧烤。

barber.example: The barber cut my hair quickly and did a very good job.
barber.exampleZh: 理发师很快地给我剪了头发，而且做得很好。

bare.example: The little boy ran across the hot sand with bare feet.
bare.exampleZh: 那个小男孩光着脚跑过滚烫的沙滩。

barely.example: I could barely hear him over the noise.
barely.exampleZh: 在噪音中我几乎听不见他说话。

bargain.example: I bought this coat at a bargain price yesterday.
bargain.exampleZh: 我昨天以低价买了这件外套。

bark.example: The dog will bark loudly at the stranger near the gate.
bark.exampleZh: 那只狗会对大门附近的陌生人大声吠叫。

barn.example: The farmer put the hay in the old barn before the rain came.
barn.exampleZh: 农夫在下雨前把干草放进了旧谷仓。

barrel.example: He filled the barrel with water and carried it to the house.
barrel.exampleZh: 他把桶装满水，然后把它搬到了房子里。

barrier.example: The fence is a barrier that keeps the animals safe.
barrier.exampleZh: 这道栅栏是一道保护动物安全的屏障。

base.example: The company based its new office in a small town near the river.
base.exampleZh: 公司把新办公室设在一座靠近河边的小镇上。

basic.example: A basic phone can make calls and send short messages.
basic.exampleZh: 一部基础手机可以打电话和发送短信。

basically.example: This book is basically about how people learn new languages.
basically.exampleZh: 这本书基本上是讲人们如何学习新语言的。

basin.example: The river flows through a large basin before it reaches the sea.
basin.exampleZh: 这条河流经一个大盆地后流入大海。

basis.example: This plan is a good basis for our future work.
basis.exampleZh: 这个计划是我们未来工作的良好基础。

basket.example: She put the fresh apples into a large basket on the table.
basket.exampleZh: 她把新鲜的苹果放进桌上的一个大篮子里。

basketball.example: My brother plays basketball with his friends after school every day.
basketball.exampleZh: 我哥哥每天放学后和他的朋友们打篮球。

bat.example: He hit the ball with a wooden bat and ran to first base.
bat.exampleZh: 他用木制球棒击球，然后跑向一垒。

bath.example: I take a warm bath every night before I go to bed.
bath.exampleZh: 我每天晚上睡觉前都会洗个热水澡。

bathe.example: I like to bathe my dog in the warm water after a long walk.
bathe.exampleZh: 我喜欢在长时间散步后用温水给我的狗洗澡。

bathroom.example: Please turn off the light in the bathroom before you leave the house.
bathroom.exampleZh: 离开房子前，请关掉浴室里的灯。

battery.example: I put a new battery in my toy car this morning.
battery.exampleZh: 今天早上我把一块新电池放进了我的玩具车里。

battle.example: The soldiers won a hard battle and came home safe.
battle.exampleZh: 士兵们赢得了一场艰苦的战役，安全回家了。

bay.example: We sat by the bay and watched the small boats go home.
bay.exampleZh: 我们坐在海湾边，看着小船回家。

be.example: I want to be a good teacher when I grow up.
be.exampleZh: 我长大后想成为一名好老师。

beach.example: We walked along the beach and watched the sun go down.
beach.exampleZh: 我们沿着海滩散步，看着太阳落下。

beam.example: The old wooden beam above the door was strong and safe.
beam.exampleZh: 门上方那根旧木梁又结实又安全。

bean.example: My mother puts a bean in the soup and it tastes good.
bean.exampleZh: 我妈妈在汤里放了一颗豆，味道很好。

bear.example: I cannot bear the loud noise from the street at night.
bear.exampleZh: 我无法忍受夜里街上嘈杂的噪音。

beard.example: My grandfather has a long white beard and often tells us funny stories.
beard.exampleZh: 我祖父留着长长的白胡子，常常给我们讲有趣的故事。

beast.example: The wild beast ran through the dark forest and scared the children.
beast.exampleZh: 那只野兽跑过黑暗的森林，吓坏了孩子们。

beat.example: Our team beat the strong home side by two goals last night.
beat.exampleZh: 我们队昨晚以两球击败了强大的主队。

beautiful.example: She took many beautiful photos of the flowers in our garden.
beautiful.exampleZh: 她在我们的花园里拍了许多美丽的花的照片。

beauty.example: She is a woman of great beauty and quiet strength.
beauty.exampleZh: 她是一位非常美丽且内心安静坚强的女性。

because.example: I stayed home because it was raining and I felt tired.
because.exampleZh: 我待在家里，因为下雨了而且我觉得累。

become.example: She wants to become a doctor after she finishes school next year.
become.exampleZh: 她想在明年完成学业后成为一名医生。

bed.example: I put a soft blanket on my bed before I go to sleep.
bed.exampleZh: 我睡觉前在床上铺了一条柔软的毯子。

bedroom.example: I sleep in my bedroom every night after I finish my homework.
bedroom.exampleZh: 我每天晚上做完作业后在我的卧室睡觉。

bee.example: A busy bee flies from flower to flower in the garden.
bee.exampleZh: 一只忙碌的蜜蜂在花园里从一朵花飞到另一朵花。

beef.example: I bought some fresh beef and vegetables for dinner tonight.
beef.exampleZh: 我今晚买了些新鲜牛肉和蔬菜做晚饭。

beer.example: My father likes to drink a cold beer after work on hot days.
beer.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢在炎热的日子下班后喝一杯冰啤酒。

before.example: Please wash your hands before you eat dinner with us.
before.exampleZh: 请在我们一起吃晚饭前洗手。

beforehand.example: Please tell me your plan beforehand so I can help you prepare.
beforehand.exampleZh: 请事先告诉我你的计划，这样我才能帮你做准备。

beg.example: She had to beg her boss for one more day off.
beg.exampleZh: 她不得不恳求老板再给她一天假。

beggar.example: The poor beggar asked me for some food on the cold street.
beggar.exampleZh: 那个可怜的乞丐在寒冷的街上向我要了一些食物。

begin.example: We will begin the meeting at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.
begin.exampleZh: 我们明天早上九点开始开会。

beginning.example: The beginning of the movie was slow, but the ending was exciting.
beginning.exampleZh: 电影的开头很慢，但结局很精彩。

behalf.example: She spoke on behalf of all the students at the meeting today.
behalf.exampleZh: 她今天在会议上代表所有学生发言。

behave.example: Children should behave well when they visit their grandparents at the weekend.
behave.exampleZh: 孩子们在周末去看望祖父母时应该表现得很好。

behavior.example: His behavior in class was very good today.
behavior.exampleZh: 他今天在课堂上的表现很好。

behind.example: The small boy hid behind the big tree during the game.
behind.exampleZh: 那个小男孩在游戏时躲在大树后面。

being.example: Every living being needs clean water and fresh air to stay healthy.
being.exampleZh: 每一个生物都需要干净的水和新鲜的空气来保持健康。

belief.example: Her belief in hard work helped her finish the difficult task.
belief.exampleZh: 她对努力工作的信念帮助她完成了这项艰巨的任务。

believe.example: I believe you can finish this easy job before dinner today.
believe.exampleZh: 我相信你能在今天晚饭前完成这份简单的工作。

bell.example: The teacher rings the bell when the class is over.

belong.example: These books belong to my sister and she reads them every day.
belong.exampleZh: 这些书属于我妹妹，她每天都读它们。

below.example: Please write your name below the line on this page.
below.exampleZh: 请在这页的横线下方写上你的名字。

belt.example: He wore a brown leather belt with his blue jeans every day.
belt.exampleZh: 他每天都系着一条棕色皮带配蓝色牛仔裤。

bench.example: We sat on a wooden bench in the park and ate lunch.
bench.exampleZh: 我们坐在公园的一条木长凳上吃了午饭。

bend.example: Please bend your knees slowly when you lift that heavy box.
bend.exampleZh: 请你抬起那个重箱子时慢慢弯曲膝盖。

beneath.example: The cat is sleeping beneath the old wooden table in the kitchen.
beneath.exampleZh: 猫正在厨房里那张旧木桌下睡觉。

beneficial.example: Regular exercise is beneficial to both your body and your mind.
beneficial.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的身体和心理都有益。

benefit.example: Regular exercise can benefit your health in many simple ways.
benefit.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能以许多简单的方式有益于你的健康。

bent.example: The old metal gate is bent and will not close properly.
bent.exampleZh: 那扇旧金属门弯了，关不严。

beside.example: She sat beside me on the bench and we talked for a while.
beside.exampleZh: 她坐在长椅上我旁边，我们聊了一会儿。

besides.example: Besides English, she also speaks French and a little Spanish.
besides.exampleZh: 除了英语，她还会说法语和一点西班牙语。

best.example: This is the best book I have read this year.
best.exampleZh: 这是我今年读过的最好的书。

bet.example: I bet ten dollars that our team will win the game today.
bet.exampleZh: 我赌十美元我们队今天会赢这场比赛。

betray.example: I will never betray my best friend even for money.
betray.exampleZh: 我永远不会为了钱背叛我最好的朋友。

better.example: We can do better if we work together and share our ideas.
better.exampleZh: 如果我们一起合作并分享想法，我们能做得更好。

between.example: The small park lies between the school and the library.
between.exampleZh: 这个小公园位于学校和图书馆之间。

beyond.example: The river flows beyond the hills and into a wide green valley.
beyond.exampleZh: 这条河流过群山之外，流入一片宽阔的绿色山谷。

bible.example: My grandmother reads the Bible every morning before she starts her day.
bible.exampleZh: 我奶奶每天早上开始一天之前都会读圣经。

bicycle.example: I ride my bicycle to school every day with my best friend.
bicycle.exampleZh: 我每天和我最好的朋友骑自行车去上学。

bid.example: She made a low bid for the old house at the auction.
bid.exampleZh: 她在拍卖会上为那栋老房子出了一个低价。

big.example: They live in a big house near the park with their two children.
big.exampleZh: 他们和两个孩子在公园附近住在一所大房子里。

bike.example: I ride my bike to the park every sunny Saturday morning.
bike.exampleZh: 我每个晴朗的星期六早上都骑自行车去公园。

bill.example: Please pay the bill before we leave the restaurant tonight.
bill.exampleZh: 请在我们今晚离开餐厅前付账单。

billion.example: The company spent one billion dollars on a new project last year.
billion.exampleZh: 公司去年在一个新项目上花了十亿美元。

bind.example: Please bind these old papers together before you put them in the box.
bind.exampleZh: 请把这些旧文件捆在一起，然后再放进箱子里。

biology.example: She studies biology at school because she wants to understand living things.
biology.exampleZh: 她在学校学习生物学，因为她想了解生物。

bird.example: I saw a small bird singing in the tree near my house.
bird.exampleZh: 我看见一只小鸟在我家附近的树上唱歌。

birth.example: She gave birth to a healthy baby boy last night.
birth.exampleZh: 她昨晚生了一个健康的男婴。

birthday.example: My birthday is in May and we always have a small family dinner.
birthday.exampleZh: 我的生日在五月，我们总会吃一顿小小的家庭晚餐。

biscuit.example: I ate a biscuit with my tea before I went to school.
biscuit.exampleZh: 我在去学校之前喝茶时吃了一块饼干。

bit.example: She gave me a bit of bread for the little bird.
bit.exampleZh: 她给了我一点面包喂那只小鸟。

bite.example: The dog may bite you if you try to take its food away.
bite.exampleZh: 如果你试图拿走它的食物，那只狗可能会咬你。

bitter.example: The medicine is so bitter that the child will not take it.
bitter.exampleZh: 这药太苦了，孩子不肯吃。

black.example: She wore a black coat to the party last night.
black.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一件黑色外套去参加聚会。

blackboard.example: The teacher wrote our new English words on the blackboard this morning.
blackboard.exampleZh: 今天早上老师在黑板上写了我们的新英语单词。

blade.example: He cleaned the sharp blade before cutting the bread.
blade.exampleZh: 他在切面包前把锋利的刀刃擦干净了。

blame.example: You should not blame other people for your own mistakes.
blame.exampleZh: 你不应该因为自己的错误而责备别人。

blank.example: Please write your name in the blank space on this form.
blank.exampleZh: 请在这张表格的空白处写上你的名字。

blanket.example: She put a warm blanket on the bed before sleep.
blanket.exampleZh: 她在睡前把一条暖和的毛毯放在床上。

blast.example: The blast broke every window in the old house on our street.
blast.exampleZh: 爆炸震碎了我们街上那栋老房子的每扇窗户。

bleed.example: The cut on his hand began to bleed after he fell down.
bleed.exampleZh: 他摔倒后，手上的伤口开始流血。

blend.example: You can blend the fruit and milk to make a healthy drink.
blend.exampleZh: 你可以把水果和牛奶混合，做成一杯健康的饮品。

bless.example: May God bless you and your family with health and happiness.
bless.exampleZh: 愿上帝保佑你和你的家人健康幸福。

blind.example: The bright light can blind you if you look at it directly.
blind.exampleZh: 如果直视那道强光，它会使你失明。

block.example: A fallen tree can block the narrow road after a storm.
block.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，一棵倒下的树会堵塞这条狭窄的道路。

blood.example: The doctor said his blood was healthy after the test.
blood.exampleZh: 医生说检查后他的血液是健康的。

bloody.example: The bloody knife fell on the floor after the fight.
bloody.exampleZh: 那把带血的刀在打斗后掉到了地板上。

bloom.example: In spring, the flowers bloom and the whole garden looks bright and beautiful.
bloom.exampleZh: 春天，花儿盛开，整个花园看起来明亮而美丽。

blossom.example: The small tree will blossom with pink flowers in early spring.
blossom.exampleZh: 这棵小树将在早春开出粉色的花。

blow.example: The strong wind blows the leaves across the quiet street every afternoon.
blow.exampleZh: 强风每天下午把树叶吹过安静的街道。

blue.example: She wore a blue dress and smiled at everyone in the room.
blue.exampleZh: 她穿着一条蓝色连衣裙，对着房间里的每个人微笑。

board.example: The board met this morning to discuss the new school budget.
board.exampleZh: 董事会今天上午开会讨论新的学校预算。

boast.example: He likes to boast about his new car to his friends.
boast.exampleZh: 他喜欢向朋友们炫耀他的新车。

boat.example: We took a small boat across the lake early this morning.
boat.exampleZh: 今天一大早我们乘小船穿过了湖面。

body.example: The main body of the report is short and easy to read.
body.exampleZh: 这份报告的主体很短，容易阅读。

boil.example: Please boil the water for five minutes before you make the tea.
boil.exampleZh: 请把水煮沸五分钟，然后再泡茶。

boiler.example: The old boiler in our basement makes a loud noise every cold night.
boiler.exampleZh: 我们地下室里的旧锅炉在每个寒冷的夜晚都会发出很大的噪音。

bold.example: She made a bold choice to speak in front of the whole class.
bold.exampleZh: 她做了一个大胆的选择，在全班面前发言。

bomb.example: The old bomb was found in the field near our school.
bomb.exampleZh: 那颗旧炸弹在我们学校附近的田里被发现。

bond.example: A strong bond between parents and children makes family life happier.
bond.exampleZh: 父母与孩子之间牢固的纽带让家庭生活更幸福。

bone.example: The dog found a big bone in the garden and buried it.
bone.exampleZh: 那只狗在花园里找到一根大骨头，并把它埋了起来。

book.example: I want to book a room for two nights in this hotel.
book.exampleZh: 我想在这家酒店预订一个房间住两晚。

boom.example: The small town saw a boom in new shops last year.
boom.exampleZh: 这个小镇去年新商店激增，出现了繁荣景象。

boot.example: I left my boots by the door after a long walk in the rain.
boot.exampleZh: 在雨中走了很久后，我把靴子留在门边。

border.example: The river forms a natural border between the two small countries.
border.exampleZh: 这条河形成了两个小国之间的天然边界。

bore.example: Long speeches always bore me, so I try to leave the room early.
bore.exampleZh: 冗长的演讲总是让我厌烦，所以我尽量早点离开房间。

born.example: She was born in a small town near the sea.
born.exampleZh: 她出生在海边的一个小镇。

borrow.example: I need to borrow a book from the school library today.
borrow.exampleZh: 我今天需要从学校图书馆借一本书。

boss.example: My boss asked me to finish the report before Friday this week.
boss.exampleZh: 我的老板让我本周五前完成这份报告。

both.example: Both of my sisters like to read books before bed.
both.exampleZh: 我的两个姐妹都喜欢在睡前看书。

bother.example: Please do not bother your sister while she is studying for her exam.
bother.exampleZh: 请不要在你妹妹为考试学习时打扰她。

bottle.example: I put a cold bottle of water in my bag before school.
bottle.exampleZh: 上学前，我把一瓶冷水放进了包里。

bottom.example: The keys are at the bottom of my old brown bag.
bottom.exampleZh: 钥匙在我那个旧棕色包的底部。

bounce.example: The ball will bounce high off the wall and come back to me.
bounce.exampleZh: 球会从墙上高高弹起，然后回到我这儿。

bound.example: The train is bound for the city and will leave at noon.
bound.exampleZh: 这列火车开往那座城市，将在中午出发。

boundary.example: The river forms a natural boundary between the two small villages.
boundary.exampleZh: 这条河形成了两个小村庄之间的天然边界。

bow.example: She gave a polite bow and then left the room quietly.
bow.exampleZh: 她礼貌地鞠了一躬，然后安静地离开了房间。

bowl.example: She put the fresh fruit into a large bowl on the kitchen table.
bowl.exampleZh: 她把新鲜水果放进厨房桌子上的一个大碗里。

box.example: She put the old books in a big box and carried it home.
box.exampleZh: 她把那些旧书放进一个大箱子里，然后把它搬回了家。

boy.example: The boy likes to play football with his friends after school.
boy.exampleZh: 这个男孩喜欢放学后和朋友们一起踢足球。

boycott.example: Many people boycott the store because its products are too expensive.
boycott.exampleZh: 许多人抵制这家商店，因为它的产品太贵了。

boyfriend.example: My sister says her boyfriend is very kind and funny.
boyfriend.exampleZh: 我姐姐说她的男朋友非常善良又有趣。

brain.example: Your brain helps you think, learn new things, and remember old memories.
brain.exampleZh: 你的大脑帮助你思考、学习新事物并记住往事。

brake.example: Please press the brake gently before the car stops at the red light.
brake.exampleZh: 请在汽车在红灯前停下之前轻轻踩刹车。

branch.example: The bank opened a new branch in our town last week.
branch.exampleZh: 银行上周在我们镇上开了一家新分行。

brand.example: This brand of coffee is popular among young people in our city.
brand.exampleZh: 这个品牌的咖啡在我们城市的年轻人中很受欢迎。

brass.example: The old band played music on brass instruments at the school concert.
brass.exampleZh: 那支老乐队在学校音乐会上用铜管乐器演奏音乐。

brave.example: The brave boy helped the small dog out of the cold river.
brave.exampleZh: 那个勇敢的男孩帮助小狗从冰冷的河里出来。

bread.example: I bought fresh bread at the store and shared it with my family.
bread.exampleZh: 我在商店买了新鲜面包，并和家人一起分享。

breadth.example: The breadth of her knowledge surprised everyone in the room.
breadth.exampleZh: 她知识的广度让房间里的每个人都很惊讶。

break.example: We took a short break after the long meeting this morning.
break.exampleZh: 今天上午的长会结束后，我们短暂休息了一下。

breakfast.example: I eat a healthy breakfast with eggs and milk every morning before school.
breakfast.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前吃鸡蛋和牛奶的健康早餐。

breast.example: The mother held her baby gently against her breast.
breast.exampleZh: 母亲轻轻地把婴儿抱在胸前。

breath.example: I took a deep breath and felt much better after the long walk.
breath.exampleZh: 长途步行后，我深吸了一口气，感觉好多了。

breathe.example: Please breathe slowly and deeply while you sit quietly in the chair.
breathe.exampleZh: 请坐在椅子上安静地慢慢深呼吸。

breed.example: Farmers breed cows and sheep for milk and meat.
breed.exampleZh: 农民饲养奶牛和绵羊以获取牛奶和肉。

breeze.example: A cool breeze came through the open window and touched my face.
breeze.exampleZh: 一阵凉爽的微风穿过敞开的窗户，拂过我的脸。

brick.example: The worker used a heavy brick to build the garden wall.
brick.exampleZh: 工人用一块沉重的砖来砌花园的墙。

bridge.example: We walked across the old bridge and looked at the river below.
bridge.exampleZh: 我们走过那座旧桥，看着下面的河水。

brief.example: The manager gave a brief talk about the new plan.
brief.exampleZh: 经理就新计划做了简短发言。

bright.example: The bright sun made the whole room warm and happy this morning.
bright.exampleZh: 今天早上明亮的太阳让整个房间温暖又愉快。

brilliant.example: She had a brilliant idea to help the team finish the work early.
brilliant.exampleZh: 她有一个绝妙的主意，能帮助团队提前完成工作。

bring.example: Please bring your notebook to class tomorrow morning.
bring.exampleZh: 请明天早上把笔记本带到课堂上来。

broad.example: The teacher gave a broad overview of the topic to the class.
broad.exampleZh: 老师给全班同学对这个话题做了一个广泛的概述。

broadcast.example: The radio station will broadcast the concert live tonight for all listeners.
broadcast.exampleZh: 广播电台今晚将为所有听众现场直播这场音乐会。

broom.example: Please use the broom to sweep the dry leaves off the floor.
broom.exampleZh: 请用扫帚把地板上的干叶子扫掉。

brother.example: My brother and I play football in the park every Sunday.
brother.exampleZh: 我和我哥哥每周日都在公园踢足球。

brow.example: She raised one brow when she heard the strange news.
brow.exampleZh: 她听到那个奇怪的消息时挑起了一边眉毛。

brown.example: The brown dog sleeps under the old wooden table in the garden.
brown.exampleZh: 那只棕色的狗在花园里的旧木桌下睡觉。

brush.example: She used a small brush to paint the wall blue.
brush.exampleZh: 她用一把小刷子把墙刷成蓝色。

bubble.example: A small bubble rose slowly to the top of the water.
bubble.exampleZh: 一个小气泡慢慢升到了水面。

bucket.example: She filled the bucket with water from the well.

budget.example: We need to make a budget for our food this month.
budget.exampleZh: 我们需要为这个月的食物做一份预算。

build.example: They plan to build a new school near the park next year.
build.exampleZh: 他们计划明年在公园附近建一所新学校。

building.example: The new building on our street is very tall and bright.
building.exampleZh: 我们街上的那栋新大楼又高又亮。

bulb.example: I changed the broken bulb in the kitchen before dinner.
bulb.exampleZh: 我在晚饭前换了厨房里坏掉的灯泡。

bulk.example: The bulk of the work is done, so we can go home now.
bulk.exampleZh: 大部分工作已经完成，所以我们现在可以回家了。

bullet.example: The police found a bullet near the broken window last night.
bullet.exampleZh: 警察昨晚在破碎的窗户附近发现了一颗子弹。

bump.example: I saw a small bump on my arm after the fall.
bump.exampleZh: 摔倒后我看到手臂上有个小肿块。

bunch.example: She gave me a bunch of red flowers for my birthday.
bunch.exampleZh: 她在我生日时送给我一束红花。

bundle.example: She put the old clothes in a bundle on the table.
bundle.exampleZh: 她把旧衣服打成包放在桌子上。

burden.example: The extra work became a heavy burden for the small team.
burden.exampleZh: 额外的工作成了这个小团队的沉重负担。

burn.example: Be careful with the hot pan or you may burn your hand.
burn.exampleZh: 小心那个热锅，否则你可能会烫伤手。

burst.example: The old pipe burst last night and water flooded our kitchen floor.
burst.exampleZh: 昨晚旧水管爆裂，水淹了我们家厨房地板。

bury.example: The old dog likes to bury its bone in the soft garden soil.
bury.exampleZh: 那只老狗喜欢把骨头埋在松软的花园土壤里。

bus.example: I take the bus to school every morning with my sister.
bus.exampleZh: 我每天早上和妹妹一起坐公共汽车去学校。

bush.example: A small bird hid in the bush near my garden.
bush.exampleZh: 一只小鸟藏在我花园附近的灌木丛里。

business.example: My father runs a small business and works hard every day.
business.exampleZh: 我父亲经营一家小公司，每天努力工作。

busy.example: My mother is very busy today, so I will help her cook dinner.
busy.exampleZh: 我妈妈今天很忙，所以我会帮她做饭。

but.example: I wanted to go out, but it started to rain.
but.exampleZh: 我想出去，但是开始下雨了。

butcher.example: The butcher cut the meat into small pieces for us.
butcher.exampleZh: 屠夫把肉切成小块给我们。

butter.example: She puts some butter on her warm bread every morning before school.
butter.exampleZh: 她每天早上上学前都会在热面包上放一些黄油。

butterfly.example: A colorful butterfly landed on the flower in our garden.
butterfly.exampleZh: 一只色彩斑斓的蝴蝶落在了我们花园里的花上。

button.example: Please press the red button to start the machine now.
button.exampleZh: 请现在按下红色按钮启动机器。

buy.example: I want to buy some fresh fruit for my family today.
buy.exampleZh: 我今天想给家人买一些新鲜水果。

by.example: The letter was written by my sister and sent by mail.
by.exampleZh: 这封信是我妹妹写的，并通过邮寄寄出。

cabbage.example: My mother cooks cabbage with some pork for dinner every Friday.
cabbage.exampleZh: 我妈妈每周五晚餐会用一些猪肉煮卷心菜。

cabin.example: We stayed in a small wooden cabin near the lake last summer.
cabin.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们住在湖边一间小木屋里。

cabinet.example: She kept the clean cups in the kitchen cabinet near the sink.
cabinet.exampleZh: 她把干净的杯子放在水槽附近的厨房橱柜里。

cable.example: They laid a new cable under the sea to connect the two islands.
cable.exampleZh: 他们铺设了一条新的海底电缆，把两座岛屿连接起来。

cafe.example: We met at a small cafe near the station and talked for an hour.
cafe.exampleZh: 我们在车站附近的一家小咖啡馆见面，聊了一个小时。

cafeteria.example: We usually eat lunch in the school cafeteria at noon.
cafeteria.exampleZh: 我们中午通常在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。

cage.example: The bird is singing in a small cage near the window.
cage.exampleZh: 那只鸟正在窗边的一个小笼子里唱歌。

cake.example: My mother made a big cake for my birthday party last week.
cake.exampleZh: 我妈妈上周为我的生日聚会做了一个大蛋糕。

calculate.example: We need to calculate the total cost before we buy the tickets.
calculate.exampleZh: 我们需要在买票前计算总费用。

calendar.example: I wrote the meeting on my calendar so I would not forget it.
calendar.exampleZh: 我把会议写在日历上，以免忘记。

call.example: I will call you when I get home after work.
call.exampleZh: 我下班到家后会给你打电话。

calm.example: Please stay calm and take a few slow deep breaths.
calm.exampleZh: 请保持平静，慢慢深呼吸几次。

camel.example: The camel walked slowly across the hot desert with a heavy load.
camel.exampleZh: 骆驼驮着重物在炎热的沙漠中慢慢行走。

camera.example: I bought a new camera to take pictures on our trip.
camera.exampleZh: 我买了一台新相机，用来在我们的旅行中拍照。

camp.example: We set up our camp near the river and cooked dinner together.
camp.exampleZh: 我们在河边搭起营地，并一起做了晚饭。

campaign.example: The school started a campaign to help poor children in the city.
campaign.exampleZh: 学校发起了一场帮助城市贫困儿童的运动。

campus.example: Students often walk around the campus after their classes end in the afternoon.
campus.exampleZh: 学生们经常在下午下课后在校园里散步。

can.example: I can open the can and put the fruit in it.
can.exampleZh: 我能打开罐头并把水果放进去。

canal.example: The old canal runs through the city and brings water to nearby farms.
canal.exampleZh: 这条古老的运河穿过城市，为附近的农场送水。

cancel.example: I had to cancel my flight because the weather was very bad.
cancel.exampleZh: 因为天气非常糟糕，我不得不取消我的航班。

cancer.example: Smoking can cause cancer, so it is important to stay away from cigarettes.
cancer.exampleZh: 吸烟可能导致癌症，因此远离香烟很重要。

candidate.example: She is a strong candidate for the job, and everyone likes her.
candidate.exampleZh: 她是这份工作的有力候选人，大家都很喜欢她。

candle.example: She lit a candle and put it on the table.
candle.exampleZh: 她点燃了一支蜡烛，把它放在桌上。

candy.example: The little boy eats one piece of candy after dinner every day.
candy.exampleZh: 这个小男孩每天晚饭后吃一块糖果。

canteen.example: We eat lunch in the school canteen every day at noon.
canteen.exampleZh: 我们每天中午在学校食堂吃午饭。

canvas.example: The artist painted a bright blue sea on a large canvas.
canvas.exampleZh: 那位艺术家在一块大画布上画了一片湛蓝的大海。

cap.example: He put a cap on his head before going outside.
cap.exampleZh: 他出门前把一顶帽子戴在头上。

capable.example: She is a capable worker and can solve most problems quickly.
capable.exampleZh: 她是一位能干的员工，能迅速解决大多数问题。

capacity.example: The room has a large capacity and can hold many people.
capacity.exampleZh: 这个房间容量很大，可以容纳很多人。

capital.example: Beijing is the capital of China and a very large city.
capital.exampleZh: 北京是中国的首都，也是一座非常大的城市。

captain.example: The captain told his team to stay calm and keep trying.
captain.exampleZh: 队长告诉他的团队保持冷静并继续努力。

capture.example: The police worked hard to capture the thief near the old market.
capture.exampleZh: 警方努力在旧市场附近抓获了那个小偷。

car.example: My father drives his new car to work every morning before eight.
car.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上八点前开着他的新车去上班。

carbon.example: Carbon is an important element that is found in all living things.
carbon.exampleZh: 碳是一种重要的元素，存在于所有生物中。

card.example: I gave him my card and asked him to call me tomorrow.
card.exampleZh: 我把名片给了他，并请他明天给我打电话。

care.example: I care about my family, and I take good care of them.
care.exampleZh: 我关心我的家人，并且好好照顾他们。

career.example: She wants a career in science because she loves asking questions.
career.exampleZh: 她想要一份科学领域的职业，因为她喜欢提问。

careful.example: Please be careful when you cross the busy street.
careful.exampleZh: 过繁忙的街道时请小心。

careless.example: He made a careless mistake and lost his keys again.
careless.exampleZh: 他犯了一个粗心的错误，又把钥匙弄丢了。

cargo.example: The ship carried a large cargo of rice to the small island.
cargo.exampleZh: 这艘船载着一大批大米运往那座小岛。

carpet.example: The cat is sleeping on the soft carpet in the living room.
carpet.exampleZh: 那只猫正在客厅柔软的地毯上睡觉。

carriage.example: The old carriage moved slowly along the quiet country road.
carriage.exampleZh: 那辆旧马车沿着安静的乡间小路缓慢前行。

carrier.example: The airline is a major carrier and flies to many countries.
carrier.exampleZh: 这家航空公司是一家主要承运商，飞往许多国家。

carrot.example: My mother puts a carrot in the soup and it tastes sweet.
carrot.exampleZh: 我妈妈在汤里放了一根胡萝卜，味道很甜。

carry.example: She always carries a small notebook to write down new ideas.
carry.exampleZh: 她总是随身携带一个小笔记本，用来记下新的想法。

cart.example: The farmer put the apples in a cart and pulled it home.
cart.exampleZh: 农民把苹果放进大车，然后把它拉回家。

case.example: This is a serious case, so we must act very carefully.
case.exampleZh: 这是一个严重的案件，所以我们必须非常小心地行动。

cash.example: I paid for the groceries in cash at the store yesterday.
cash.exampleZh: 我昨天在商店用现金付了食品杂货的钱。

cassette.example: I found an old cassette in a box under my bed.
cassette.exampleZh: 我在床底下的一个盒子里找到了一盘旧磁带。

cast.example: The director will cast a young actor in the new film.
cast.exampleZh: 导演将在这部新电影中选一位年轻演员。

castle.example: The old castle stands on a hill near the river.
castle.exampleZh: 那座古老的城堡矗立在河边的山上。

casual.example: It was a casual meeting, so we did not wear formal clothes.
casual.exampleZh: 那是一次非正式的会面，所以我们没有穿正式的衣服。

cat.example: The cat is sleeping on the warm sofa in the living room.
cat.exampleZh: 这只猫正在客厅里温暖的沙发上睡觉。

catalog.example: The librarian gave me a catalog of all the new books.
catalog.exampleZh: 图书管理员给了我一本所有新书的目录。

catch.example: I ran fast to catch the bus before it left the station.
catch.exampleZh: 我跑得很快，想赶在公交车离开车站前赶上它。

category.example: This book belongs to a different category from the others on the shelf.
category.exampleZh: 这本书属于与书架上其他书不同的类别。

cattle.example: The farmer keeps many cattle on his small farm.
cattle.exampleZh: 这个农民在他的小农场里养了许多牛。

cause.example: The heavy rain was the cause of the flood in our town.
cause.exampleZh: 大雨是我们镇上洪水的原因。

cave.example: We found a dark cave near the river while walking in the woods.
cave.exampleZh: 我们在树林里散步时在河边发现了一个黑暗的山洞。

cease.example: The loud noise did not cease until late at night.
cease.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音直到深夜才停止。

ceiling.example: The ceiling of the old room was very high.
ceiling.exampleZh: 那个旧房间的天花板很高。

celebrate.example: We celebrate her birthday with a small party at home.
celebrate.exampleZh: 我们在家里办一个小派对庆祝她的生日。

cell.example: A cell is the smallest living part of the human body.
cell.exampleZh: 细胞是人体最小的生命组成部分。

cellar.example: The old farmer kept potatoes and apples in the cold cellar under his house.
cellar.exampleZh: 这位老农夫把土豆和苹果存放在房子下面的冷地窖里。

cement.example: The workers mixed cement with water to build a strong wall.
cement.exampleZh: 工人们把水泥和水混合，筑起了一堵坚固的墙。

cent.example: I found a shiny cent on the floor near my school.
cent.exampleZh: 我在学校附近的地板上找到了一枚闪闪发光的分币。

center.example: She put the flowers in the center of the table.

century.example: The old church was built in the nineteenth century and still stands today.
century.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂建于十九世纪，至今仍然矗立。

ceremony.example: The wedding ceremony was short, and all the guests were very happy.
ceremony.exampleZh: 婚礼仪式很短，所有客人都非常开心。

certain.example: I am certain that she will come to the party tonight.
certain.exampleZh: 我确定她今晚会来参加聚会。

certainly.example: He will certainly come to the party with us tonight.
certainly.exampleZh: 他今晚肯定会和我们一起去参加聚会。

certificate.example: She received a certificate after she finished the training course last week.
certificate.exampleZh: 她上周完成培训课程后收到了一张证书。

chain.example: The old dog was tied to a chain in the yard.
chain.exampleZh: 那只老狗被拴在院子里的链子上。

chair.example: Please put the old wooden chair back in the corner of the room.
chair.exampleZh: 请把旧木椅放回房间的角落里。

chairman.example: The chairman opened the meeting and welcomed everyone to the new office.
chairman.exampleZh: 主席宣布会议开始，并欢迎所有人来到新办公室。

chalk.example: The teacher wrote the new word on the board with white chalk.
chalk.exampleZh: 老师用白粉笔在黑板上写下了那个新单词。

challenge.example: Learning a new language is a big challenge for many people.
challenge.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言对许多人来说是一个巨大的挑战。

chamber.example: The old building has a small chamber where the council meets.
chamber.exampleZh: 这座老建筑里有一个小会议室，委员会在那里开会。

champion.example: The young champion thanked his coach and family after the big race.
champion.exampleZh: 这位年轻的冠军在大赛后感谢了他的教练和家人。

chance.example: I had a chance to see my old friend at the park today.
chance.exampleZh: 今天我在公园有机会见到我的老朋友。

change.example: I need to change my wet clothes before we go out.
change.exampleZh: 我需要在出门前换掉我的湿衣服。

channel.example: This TV channel shows many interesting programs for children every day.
channel.exampleZh: 这个电视频道每天播放许多有趣的儿童节目。

chapter.example: This book has ten chapters, and each chapter tells a different story.
chapter.exampleZh: 这本书有十章，每一章都讲述一个不同的故事。

character.example: Her honest character made everyone in the small town trust her completely.
character.exampleZh: 她诚实的性格让小镇上的每个人都完全信任她。

characteristic.example: Honesty is an important characteristic of a good friend.
characteristic.exampleZh: 诚实是好朋友的一个重要特征。

charge.example: The hotel will charge us extra if we check out late today.
charge.exampleZh: 如果我们今天晚退房，酒店会向我们额外收费。

charity.example: She gave some money to charity to help poor children in her town.
charity.exampleZh: 她给慈善机构捐了一些钱，帮助镇上的贫困儿童。

chart.example: The teacher drew a simple chart to show our test scores.
chart.exampleZh: 老师画了一张简单的图表来展示我们的考试成绩。

chase.example: The dog likes to chase the ball around the yard every morning.
chase.exampleZh: 那只狗喜欢每天早上在院子里追球。

chat.example: We often chat with our neighbors in the garden after dinner.
chat.exampleZh: 晚饭后我们常在花园里和邻居聊天。

cheap.example: This cheap shirt looks nice but it did not last long.
cheap.exampleZh: 这件便宜的衬衫看起来不错，但没穿多久。

cheat.example: You should never cheat on a test because it is wrong.
cheat.exampleZh: 你绝不应该在考试中作弊，因为这是错误的。

check.example: Please check your answers carefully before you hand in the test.
check.exampleZh: 请在交试卷前仔细检查你的答案。

cheek.example: The little boy touched his cheek and smiled at his mother.
cheek.exampleZh: 小男孩摸了摸自己的脸蛋，对妈妈笑了。

cheer.example: The fans cheer loudly when their team scores a goal.
cheer.exampleZh: 当他们的球队进球时，球迷们大声欢呼。

cheese.example: I like to put some cheese on my bread for lunch.
cheese.exampleZh: 我喜欢午餐时在面包上放一些奶酪。

chemical.example: The factory makes chemical products for cleaning and farming.
chemical.exampleZh: 这家工厂生产用于清洁和农业的化学产品。

chemist.example: The chemist works in a small shop and sells medicine to local families.
chemist.exampleZh: 这位药剂师在一家小店里工作，向当地家庭出售药品。

chemistry.example: They have good chemistry and work well together every day.
chemistry.exampleZh: 他们很有默契，每天合作得很好。

cheque.example: I paid the rent by cheque because I had no cash.
cheque.exampleZh: 我用支票付了房租，因为我没有现金。

chess.example: My brother and I often play chess after dinner on weekends.
chess.exampleZh: 我和弟弟经常在周末晚饭后下国际象棋。

chest.example: He opened the wooden chest and found old letters inside.
chest.exampleZh: 他打开木箱，在里面发现了旧信件。

chew.example: Please chew your food slowly before you swallow it.
chew.exampleZh: 请慢慢咀嚼食物再咽下去。

chicken.example: My mother cooked chicken and rice for dinner last night.
chicken.exampleZh: 昨晚我妈妈做了鸡肉和米饭当晚餐。

chief.example: The chief doctor asked us to wait outside the small room.
chief.exampleZh: 主任医生让我们在小房间外等候。

child.example: The child is playing with a small red ball in the garden.
child.exampleZh: 那个小孩正在花园里玩一个红色的小球。

childhood.example: My childhood was happy because I played outside with my friends every day.
childhood.exampleZh: 我的童年很快乐，因为我每天和朋友们在外面玩。

chip.example: There is a small chip in the glass cup on the table.
chip.exampleZh: 桌上的玻璃杯上有一个小缺口。

chocolate.example: I bought a chocolate bar and shared it with my little brother.
chocolate.exampleZh: 我买了一块巧克力，和我的小弟弟一起分享。

choice.example: You have a choice between tea and coffee this morning.
choice.exampleZh: 今天早上你可以选择茶或咖啡。

choke.example: The thick smoke began to choke everyone in the small room.
choke.exampleZh: 浓烟开始让这个小房间里的每个人窒息。

choose.example: You can choose any book you like from this small shelf.
choose.exampleZh: 你可以从这个小书架上选择任何你喜欢的书。

chop.example: She used a sharp knife to chop the onions into small pieces.
chop.exampleZh: 她用一把锋利的刀把洋葱切成小块。

christ.example: Christ taught people to love one another and to forgive their enemies.
christ.exampleZh: 基督教导人们彼此相爱并宽恕他们的敌人。

christian.example: My Christian friend goes to church every Sunday with his family.
christian.exampleZh: 我的基督徒朋友每个星期天都和家人一起去教堂。

christmas.example: We visit our grandparents every Christmas and eat a big dinner together.
christmas.exampleZh: 我们每年圣诞节都去看望祖父母，并一起吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。

church.example: The old church stands near the river and many people visit it every Sunday.
church.exampleZh: 那座古老的教堂坐落在河边，每周日都有很多人来参观。

cigar.example: My grandfather likes to sit on the porch and smoke a cigar after dinner.
cigar.exampleZh: 我爷爷喜欢晚饭后坐在门廊上抽一支雪茄。

cigarette.example: He put a cigarette in his mouth and lit it with a match.
cigarette.exampleZh: 他把一支香烟放进嘴里，并用火柴点燃了它。

cinema.example: We went to the cinema last night and watched a funny movie.
cinema.exampleZh: 我们昨晚去了电影院，看了一部有趣的电影。

circle.example: The children sat in a circle and sang songs together.
circle.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐成一个圆圈，一起唱歌。

circuit.example: The race car drove around the circuit three times.
circuit.exampleZh: 赛车绕赛道行驶了三圈。

circular.example: The table is circular, and the manager sent a circular about the meeting.
circular.exampleZh: 这张桌子是圆形的，经理发了一份关于会议的通知。

circulate.example: News about the new store circulated quickly around the small town.
circulate.exampleZh: 关于这家新店的消息在小镇里迅速传开了。

circumstance.example: Under these circumstances, we should stay calm and think carefully.
circumstance.exampleZh: 在这种情况下，我们应该保持冷静并仔细思考。

citizen.example: Every citizen should follow the law and help keep the city clean.
citizen.exampleZh: 每位公民都应遵守法律，并帮助保持城市清洁。

city.example: I live in a big city with many parks and busy streets.
city.exampleZh: 我住在一个有许多公园和繁忙街道的大城市里。

civil.example: Every citizen should know their civil rights and duties under the law.
civil.exampleZh: 每个公民都应该了解法律赋予自己的公民权利和义务。

civilian.example: The soldier helped the civilians leave the dangerous area safely.
civilian.exampleZh: 士兵帮助平民安全地离开了危险地区。

civilize.example: Teachers help civilize young children by teaching them good manners.
civilize.exampleZh: 老师通过教孩子们礼貌来帮助他们变得文明。

claim.example: She claims that she saw the whole accident clearly.
claim.exampleZh: 她声称她清楚地看到了整个事故。

clap.example: The children clapped their hands and sang a happy song together at the party.
clap.exampleZh: 孩子们在聚会上拍着手，一起唱了一首欢快的歌。

clarify.example: Please clarify your question so everyone can understand it.
clarify.exampleZh: 请把你的问题澄清一下，让每个人都能听懂。

class.example: Our class has twenty students and we all like our new teacher.
class.exampleZh: 我们班有二十名学生，我们都喜欢我们的新老师。

classical.example: I enjoy listening to classical music while I study in the evening.
classical.exampleZh: 我晚上学习的时候喜欢听古典音乐。

classification.example: The classification of these plants helps students learn them faster.
classification.exampleZh: 对这些植物进行分类有助于学生更快地认识它们。

classify.example: We classify the books by subject so students can find them easily.
classify.exampleZh: 我们按学科给这些书分类，这样学生就能轻松找到它们。

classmate.example: My classmate sits next to me and helps me with math.
classmate.exampleZh: 我的同班同学坐在我旁边，还帮我学数学。

classroom.example: The students are reading books quietly in the classroom.
classroom.exampleZh: 学生们正在教室里安静地读书。

claw.example: The cat used its sharp claw to catch the small fish.
claw.exampleZh: 那只猫用锋利的爪子抓住了那条小鱼。

clay.example: The children made small cups and bowls from wet clay.
clay.exampleZh: 孩子们用湿黏土做了小杯子和碗。

clean.example: Please clean the kitchen table before we eat dinner tonight.
clean.exampleZh: 请在我们今晚吃晚饭前把厨房桌子擦干净。

clear.example: The water in the lake is so clear that we can see the fish.
clear.exampleZh: 湖里的水非常清澈，我们能看到鱼。

clerk.example: The clerk at the front desk helped me find my room key.
clerk.exampleZh: 前台的职员帮我找到了房间钥匙。

clever.example: She is a clever girl and she learns new things very fast.
clever.exampleZh: 她是个聪明的女孩，学新东西非常快。

click.example: Click the blue button to save your work.
click.exampleZh: 点击蓝色按钮来保存你的工作。

client.example: The lawyer met his client early this morning to discuss the new case.
client.exampleZh: 律师今天一早见了他的委托人，讨论这个新案子。

cliff.example: The old house stands near the edge of a high cliff.
cliff.exampleZh: 那座老房子坐落在高高的悬崖边上。

climate.example: The climate here is warm and wet all year round.
climate.exampleZh: 这里的气候全年温暖湿润。

climb.example: The children like to climb the big tree behind their house.
climb.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢爬他们房子后面的那棵大树。

clinic.example: The new clinic near my home is open every day.
clinic.exampleZh: 我家附近的新诊所每天都开门。

clock.example: There is a big clock on the wall in our classroom.
clock.exampleZh: 我们教室的墙上有一个大钟。

close.example: Please close the door and come sit close to me.
close.exampleZh: 请关上门，然后过来坐在我旁边。

cloth.example: Please use a clean cloth to wipe the table after dinner.
cloth.exampleZh: 晚饭后请用一块干净的布擦桌子。

clothes.example: She washes her clothes every Sunday morning before going out.
clothes.exampleZh: 她每个星期天早上出门前都会洗衣服。

clothing.example: She spends a lot of money on warm clothing for winter.
clothing.exampleZh: 她花很多钱买冬天穿的保暖衣物。

cloud.example: Dark cloud covered the sky before the rain began.
cloud.exampleZh: 下雨前，乌云遮住了天空。

club.example: He joined the local tennis club last month and plays there every weekend.
club.exampleZh: 他上个月加入了当地的网球俱乐部，每个周末都在那里打球。

clue.example: The police found an important clue near the old house.
clue.exampleZh: 警察在那座老房子附近发现了一条重要线索。

clutch.example: She had to clutch the rail tightly as the bus turned the corner.
clutch.exampleZh: 公交车转弯时，她不得不紧紧抓住扶手。

coach.example: Our new coach helps the young players train hard every day.
coach.exampleZh: 我们的新教练帮助年轻球员每天刻苦训练。

coal.example: The old train still burns coal to make steam.
coal.exampleZh: 那列老火车仍然烧煤来产生蒸汽。

coarse.example: The old table has a coarse surface that feels rough under your hand.
coarse.exampleZh: 这张旧桌子表面粗糙，摸起来很不平滑。

coast.example: We walked along the coast and watched the big waves.
coast.exampleZh: 我们沿着海岸散步，看着大浪。

coat.example: She put on a warm coat and walked to the bus stop.
coat.exampleZh: 她穿上暖和的外套，走向公交车站。

cock.example: The old cock wakes everyone up early every morning on the farm.
cock.exampleZh: 农场里那只老公鸡每天早上把大家都叫醒。

code.example: The secret code lets you open the door.
code.exampleZh: 这个密码可以让你打开这扇门。

coffee.example: I drink a cup of hot coffee every morning before work.
coffee.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都喝一杯热咖啡。

coil.example: She bought a coil of rope for the boat.
coil.exampleZh: 她为这条船买了一卷绳子。

coin.example: The old man put a coin into the machine and waited.
coin.exampleZh: 老人把一枚硬币放进机器里，然后等待着。

cold.example: The cold winter wind made everyone stay inside the warm house all day.
cold.exampleZh: 寒冷的冬风让大家整天都待在温暖的房子里。

collapse.example: The old bridge may collapse if heavy trucks keep crossing it.
collapse.exampleZh: 如果重型卡车继续从这座旧桥上通过，它可能会倒塌。

collar.example: The dog wore a red collar around its neck.
collar.exampleZh: 那只狗的脖子上戴着一个红色项圈。

colleague.example: I often eat lunch with a colleague from my office.
colleague.exampleZh: 我经常和办公室的一位同事一起吃午饭。

collect.example: She likes to collect old stamps from different countries.
collect.exampleZh: 她喜欢收集来自不同国家的旧邮票。

collection.example: My collection of old coins is small but very special to me.
collection.exampleZh: 我收藏的旧硬币不多，但对我来说非常特别。

collective.example: We must work together because our collective effort will solve this problem quickly.
collective.exampleZh: 我们必须齐心协力，因为我们的共同努力会很快解决这个问题。

college.example: My brother studies computer science at a small college near our home.
college.exampleZh: 我哥哥在我们家附近的一所小学院里学习计算机科学。

collision.example: The two cars had a bad collision on the icy road this morning.
collision.exampleZh: 今天早上两辆车在结冰的路上发生了严重的碰撞。

colony.example: The ants built a large colony under the old tree.
colony.exampleZh: 蚂蚁在老树下建立了一个大群体。

color.example: Blue is my favorite color, so I painted the walls blue.
color.exampleZh: 蓝色是我最喜欢的颜色，所以我把墙刷成了蓝色。

column.example: The old stone column in the square stands very tall.
column.exampleZh: 广场上那根古老的石柱非常高。

comb.example: She combed her hair and put the comb in her bag.
comb.exampleZh: 她梳了梳头发，然后把梳子放进包里。

combine.example: If you combine the two teams, they will work much better.
combine.exampleZh: 如果你把这两个团队合并起来，他们会运作得好得多。

come.example: Please come to my house after school today.

comedy.example: I like comedy because it makes me laugh after a long day.
comedy.exampleZh: 我喜欢喜剧，因为它能让我在漫长的一天后开怀大笑。
