comfort.example: Her kind words gave me great comfort when I was sad.
comfort.exampleZh: 我难过时，她亲切的话语给了我极大的安慰。

comfortable.example: This new chair is very comfortable for long hours of study.
comfortable.exampleZh: 这把新椅子长时间学习坐着很舒服。

command.example: The general can command his soldiers and he knows the plan well.
command.exampleZh: 将军能够指挥他的士兵，而且他很了解这个计划。

comment.example: She left a short comment under the photo and everyone liked it.
comment.exampleZh: 她在照片下留了一条简短的评论，大家都很喜欢。

commerce.example: Online commerce makes it easy for small shops to reach new customers.
commerce.exampleZh: 网络商业让小商店很容易接触到新客户。

commercial.example: The new commercial district has many shops and restaurants.
commercial.exampleZh: 新的商业区有许多商店和餐馆。

commission.example: The government set up a commission to study the problem of air pollution.
commission.exampleZh: 政府成立了一个委员会来研究空气污染问题。

commit.example: He promised not to commit the same mistake again.
commit.exampleZh: 他承诺不再犯同样的错误。

commitment.example: Her commitment to the project helped the whole team finish on time.
commitment.exampleZh: 她对项目的投入帮助整个团队按时完成了工作。

committee.example: The committee will meet on Monday to discuss the new plan.
committee.exampleZh: 委员会将于周一开会讨论这项新计划。

common.example: This is a common problem for many young people today.
common.exampleZh: 这是如今许多年轻人常见的问题。

communicate.example: We use email to communicate with our customers every day.
communicate.exampleZh: 我们每天用电子邮件与客户沟通。

communication.example: Good communication between parents and teachers helps children do better in school.
communication.exampleZh: 家长和老师之间的良好沟通能帮助孩子在学校表现更好。

communism.example: Many people in that country believe communism can build a fair society.
communism.exampleZh: 那个国家的许多人相信共产主义能够建立一个公平的社会。

communist.example: My grandfather was a communist and he worked hard for the poor.
communist.exampleZh: 我的祖父是一名共产党员，他为穷人努力工作。

community.example: Our community works together to keep the park clean and safe.
community.exampleZh: 我们的社区齐心协力保持公园的清洁与安全。

companion.example: My dog is my best companion on long walks.
companion.exampleZh: 我的狗是我长途散步时最好的伙伴。

company.example: My father works for a small company in the city.
company.exampleZh: 我父亲在城里一家小公司工作。

compare.example: Let us compare the two pictures and see how they differ.
compare.exampleZh: 让我们比较这两幅图，看看它们有什么不同。

comparison.example: This comparison shows that the two plans are very different.
comparison.exampleZh: 这一比较表明这两个计划非常不同。

compass.example: He used a compass to find the right way home.
compass.exampleZh: 他用指南针找到了回家的正确方向。

compete.example: Small shops often compete with big stores for the same customers.
compete.exampleZh: 小店常常和大商店争夺相同的顾客。

competent.example: She is a competent teacher who helps every student learn with care.
competent.exampleZh: 她是一位能胜任的老师，用心帮助每个学生学习。

competition.example: The competition between the two teams was very close this year.
competition.exampleZh: 今年这两支队伍之间的竞争非常接近。

competitive.example: The job market is very competitive for young people today.
competitive.exampleZh: 如今就业市场对年轻人来说竞争非常激烈。

competitor.example: Our main competitor sells the same shoes for a lower price.
competitor.exampleZh: 我们的主要竞争对手以更低的价格出售同样的鞋子。

complain.example: Many customers complain about the slow service in this restaurant.
complain.exampleZh: 很多顾客抱怨这家餐厅服务太慢。

complaint.example: The customer made a complaint about the cold food at the restaurant.
complaint.exampleZh: 这位顾客就餐厅里凉了的饭菜提出了投诉。

complete.example: We need a complete list of all the students in this class.
complete.exampleZh: 我们需要一份这个班所有学生的完整名单。

complex.example: The new hospital is a large complex with many modern buildings.
complex.exampleZh: 新医院是一个拥有许多现代建筑的大型建筑群。

complicated.example: This math problem is too complicated for young students.
complicated.exampleZh: 这道数学题对年轻学生来说太复杂了。

component.example: Each component of this machine is small and easy to replace.
component.exampleZh: 这台机器的每个部件都很小，而且容易更换。

compose.example: The team is composed of five students and two teachers.
compose.exampleZh: 这个团队由五名学生和两名教师组成。

composition.example: The composition of this painting is simple but very beautiful.
composition.exampleZh: 这幅画的构图简单却非常优美。

compound.example: Water is a simple compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
compound.exampleZh: 水是一种由氢和氧组成的简单化合物。

comprehension.example: Reading every day can improve your comprehension of difficult texts.
comprehension.exampleZh: 每天阅读可以提高你对难懂文章的理解力。

comprehensive.example: The report gives a comprehensive view of the city's air and water problems.
comprehensive.exampleZh: 这份报告全面介绍了这座城市的空气和水问题。

compress.example: You can compress the files into one small folder before sending them.
compress.exampleZh: 你可以先把这些文件压缩成一个小的文件夹再发送。

comprise.example: The team comprises five students from different countries.
comprise.exampleZh: 这个团队由来自不同国家的五名学生组成。

compromise.example: After a long talk, both sides made a compromise to solve the problem.
compromise.exampleZh: 经过长时间交谈，双方达成妥协来解决问题。

compulsory.example: In some countries, military service is compulsory for young men.
compulsory.exampleZh: 在一些国家，服兵役对年轻男子是强制性的。

compute.example: We can compute the total cost with a simple formula.
compute.exampleZh: 我们可以用一个简单的公式计算总成本。

computer.example: I use my computer every day to check email and do homework.
computer.exampleZh: 我每天用电脑查邮件和做作业。

comrade.example: My comrade helped me carry the heavy box up the stairs.
comrade.exampleZh: 我的同伴帮我把那个沉重的箱子抬上了楼梯。

conceal.example: She tried to conceal the letter under a pile of old books.
conceal.exampleZh: 她试图把那封信藏在一堆旧书下面。

concede.example: He finally conceded that his plan was not good enough.
concede.exampleZh: 他最终勉强承认自己的计划不够好。

concentrate.example: I cannot concentrate on my homework when the television is on.
concentrate.exampleZh: 电视机开着的时候，我无法专心做作业。

concept.example: The concept of time is hard for young children to understand.
concept.exampleZh: 时间这个概念对年幼的孩子来说很难理解。

concern.example: This problem concerns everyone in the company.
concern.exampleZh: 这个问题关系到公司里的每一个人。

concerning.example: I have a question concerning the new class schedule.
concerning.exampleZh: 我有一个关于新课程安排的问题。

concert.example: We went to a concert in the park last night.
concert.exampleZh: 昨晚我们去公园听了一场音乐会。

conclude.example: From these facts, we can conclude that he is telling the truth.
conclude.exampleZh: 从这些事实我们可以断定他在说真话。

conclusion.example: After the long discussion, we finally reached the same conclusion.
conclusion.exampleZh: 经过长时间讨论后，我们最终得出了相同的结论。

concrete.example: The teacher gave us a concrete example to help us understand the rule.
concrete.exampleZh: 老师给了我们一个具体的例子来帮助我们理解这条规则。

condemn.example: Many people condemned the plan because it would hurt poor families.
condemn.exampleZh: 许多人谴责这个计划，因为它会伤害贫困家庭。

condition.example: The old house is in very bad condition.

conduct.example: The teacher will conduct a simple test in class tomorrow.
conduct.exampleZh: 老师明天将在课堂上进行一次简单的测验。

conductor.example: The conductor raised his hands and the whole orchestra became quiet.
conductor.exampleZh: 指挥举起双手，整个乐团都安静了下来。

conference.example: She went to a conference in Beijing last week with her manager.
conference.exampleZh: 上周她和经理去北京参加了一个会议。

confess.example: He finally confessed that he had taken the money from the drawer.
confess.exampleZh: 他终于承认自己从抽屉里拿了那笔钱。

confidence.example: She speaks English with great confidence in front of the whole class.
confidence.exampleZh: 她在全班同学面前非常自信地说英语。

confident.example: She feels confident about the test because she studied hard.
confident.exampleZh: 她对这次考试很有信心，因为她努力学习了。

confirm.example: Please confirm your address before we send the package.
confirm.exampleZh: 在我们寄出包裹之前，请确认你的地址。

conflict.example: There is a serious conflict between the two teams about the new plan.
conflict.exampleZh: 两个团队在关于新计划的问题上存在严重冲突。

confront.example: We must confront our problems before they get worse.
confront.exampleZh: 我们必须在问题变得更糟之前面对它们。

confuse.example: The two maps look so similar that they often confuse me.
confuse.exampleZh: 这两张地图看起来太相似了，常常使我困惑。

confusion.example: There was some confusion about the time of the meeting.
confusion.exampleZh: 关于会议的时间，大家有些困惑。

congratulate.example: I want to congratulate you on passing your driving test.
congratulate.exampleZh: 我想祝贺你通过了驾照考试。

congratulation.example: We sent him a card of congratulation when he won the prize.
congratulation.exampleZh: 他获奖时，我们给他寄了一张祝贺卡。

congress.example: The congress meets every year to discuss important national issues.
congress.exampleZh: 代表大会每年召开一次，讨论重要的国家问题。

connect.example: Please connect your laptop to the printer before you start the report.
connect.exampleZh: 开始写报告前，请先把你的笔记本电脑连接到打印机上。

connection.example: There is a strong connection between good sleep and good health.
connection.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠与健康之间有着密切的联系。

conquer.example: She worked hard to conquer her fear of speaking in public.
conquer.exampleZh: 她努力克服了当众讲话的恐惧。

conquest.example: The king's conquest of the city took only three days.
conquest.exampleZh: 国王征服这座城市只用了三天。

conscience.example: My conscience would not let me lie to my best friend.
conscience.exampleZh: 我的良心不允许我对最好的朋友说谎。

conscious.example: She was conscious of the cold wind on her face.
conscious.exampleZh: 她意识到冷风吹在脸上。

consciousness.example: Losing consciousness during sleep is normal, but dreams can still feel real.
consciousness.exampleZh: 睡眠中失去意识是正常的，但梦境仍可能感觉很真实。

consent.example: Her parents gave their consent before she joined the school trip.
consent.exampleZh: 她参加学校旅行前，父母表示了同意。

consequence.example: Every choice has a consequence, so think carefully before you act.
consequence.exampleZh: 每个选择都有后果，所以行动前要仔细思考。

consequently.example: It rained hard, and consequently the game was cancelled.
consequently.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此比赛取消了。

conservation.example: Water conservation is important for every family in the city.
conservation.exampleZh: 节约用水对城里的每个家庭都很重要。

conservative.example: My grandfather is very conservative and does not like change.
conservative.exampleZh: 我爷爷非常保守，不喜欢改变。

consider.example: We should consider all the facts before making a decision.
consider.exampleZh: 在做决定之前，我们应该考虑所有事实。

considerable.example: The company spent a considerable amount of money on the new project.
considerable.exampleZh: 公司在这个新项目上花费了相当大的一笔钱。

considerate.example: She is very considerate and always helps her friends with their heavy bags.
considerate.exampleZh: 她非常体贴，总是帮朋友们提重包。

consideration.example: Please give careful consideration to this plan before you make a decision.
consideration.exampleZh: 在做决定之前，请仔细考虑一下这个计划。

consist.example: The team consists of five students and two teachers from our school.
consist.exampleZh: 这个团队由我们学校的五名学生和两名老师组成。

consistent.example: Her work is consistent and always of high quality.
consistent.exampleZh: 她的工作始终如一，质量一直很高。

constant.example: The baby needs constant care from her parents day and night.
constant.exampleZh: 这个婴儿日夜需要父母不断的照顾。

constituent.example: The voters in my district are the most important constituents of a representative.
constituent.exampleZh: 我所在选区的选民是代表最重要的组成部分。

constitute.example: These five states together constitute the largest part of the country.
constitute.exampleZh: 这五个州共同构成了该国最大的一部分。

constitution.example: The new constitution gives every citizen the right to vote freely.
constitution.exampleZh: 新宪法赋予每位公民自由投票的权利。

construct.example: The city plans to construct a new bridge across the river next year.
construct.exampleZh: 市政府计划明年在河上建造一座新桥。

construction.example: The construction of the new bridge will take two years.
construction.exampleZh: 这座新桥的建造将需要两年时间。

consult.example: You should consult your teacher before you choose these new courses.
consult.exampleZh: 在选择这些新课程之前，你应该请教你的老师。

consultant.example: The company hired a consultant to help them improve their sales.
consultant.exampleZh: 公司聘请了一位顾问来帮助他们提高销售额。

consume.example: Cars consume a lot of fuel when they drive in heavy traffic.
consume.exampleZh: 汽车在拥堵路段行驶时会消耗大量燃料。

consumption.example: The consumption of electricity in our city rises every summer.
consumption.exampleZh: 我们城市的电力消耗每年夏天都会上升。

contact.example: Please contact me by email if you have any questions.
contact.exampleZh: 如果你有任何问题，请通过电子邮件与我联系。

contain.example: This box can contain all the books on the desk.
contain.exampleZh: 这个箱子能装下书桌上的所有书。

container.example: Please put the fresh fruit in this clean container.
container.exampleZh: 请把新鲜水果放进这个干净的容器里。

contemporary.example: This museum shows contemporary art from Asia and Europe.
contemporary.exampleZh: 这座博物馆展出亚洲和欧洲的当代艺术。

content.example: She read the content of the letter and felt happy about it.
content.exampleZh: 她读了信的内容，并为此感到高兴。

contest.example: She won the singing contest last year and became famous.
contest.exampleZh: 她去年赢得了那场歌唱比赛并因此出名。

context.example: You can guess the meaning of the word from its context.
context.exampleZh: 你可以根据上下文猜出这个词的意思。

continent.example: Africa is the second largest continent in the world.
continent.exampleZh: 非洲是世界上第二大洲。

continual.example: His continual questions made it hard for the teacher to finish the lesson.
continual.exampleZh: 他频繁的提问让老师很难把课上完。

continue.example: Please continue reading the book until you reach the last page.
continue.exampleZh: 请继续读这本书，直到你读到最后一页。

continuous.example: The machine makes a continuous noise all day long.
continuous.exampleZh: 这台机器整天发出连续不断的噪音。

contract.example: The company signed a new contract with a local supplier last week.
contract.exampleZh: 公司上周与一家本地供应商签订了一份新合同。

contradict.example: His actions contradict what he said at the meeting yesterday.
contradict.exampleZh: 他的行为与他在昨天会议上说的话相矛盾。

contrast.example: The contrast between the two sisters is clear: one is quiet and the other is loud.
contrast.exampleZh: 两姐妹之间的对比很明显：一个安静，另一个吵闹。

contribute.example: Everyone can contribute a little money to help the poor children go to school.
contribute.exampleZh: 每个人都可以捐一点钱来帮助贫困儿童上学。

contribution.example: Her contribution to the project helped the whole team finish on time.
contribution.exampleZh: 她对这个项目的贡献帮助整个团队按时完成了任务。

control.example: She cannot control her anger when her children fight over toys.
control.exampleZh: 当孩子们为玩具争吵时，她无法控制自己的怒气。

controversy.example: The new school rule caused a lot of controversy among parents and teachers.
controversy.exampleZh: 新的校规在家长和老师中引起了很大的争论。

convenience.example: Online shopping is a great convenience for people who are very busy.
convenience.exampleZh: 网上购物对非常忙碌的人来说是一大便利。

convenient.example: It is very convenient to have a small shop near my home.
convenient.exampleZh: 我家附近有一家小商店，非常方便。

convention.example: It is a convention in many countries to shake hands when you meet someone.
convention.exampleZh: 在许多国家，见面时握手是一种惯例。

conventional.example: My father prefers conventional cooking to modern frozen meals.
conventional.exampleZh: 我父亲更喜欢传统的烹饪方式，而不是现代的冷冻餐。

conversation.example: I had a long conversation with my teacher about my future plans.
conversation.exampleZh: 我和老师就我的未来计划进行了一次长谈。

conversely.example: He works hard, and conversely, his brother never does any work.
conversely.exampleZh: 他工作很努力，反过来，他弟弟却从不做任何工作。

conversion.example: The conversion of our old barn into a small house took three months.
conversion.exampleZh: 把我们旧谷仓改建成一栋小房子花了三个月。

convert.example: You can convert this old room into a small study.
convert.exampleZh: 你可以把这个旧房间改造成一间小书房。

convey.example: Her smile can convey more than a thousand words.
convey.exampleZh: 她的微笑能传达的信息胜过千言万语。

convict.example: The judge will convict him if the evidence is strong enough.
convict.exampleZh: 如果证据足够充分，法官将宣判他有罪。

conviction.example: She spoke with deep conviction about the need for change.
conviction.exampleZh: 她满怀确信地谈到变革的必要性。

convince.example: She tried hard to convince her parents to let her go.
convince.exampleZh: 她努力说服父母让她去。

cook.example: My mother likes to cook fish for the family on Sundays.
cook.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢在星期天为家人做鱼。

cookie.example: My sister baked a chocolate chip cookie for me after school.
cookie.exampleZh: 放学后我姐姐给我烤了一块巧克力豆曲奇饼。

cool.example: After the long run, the cool water felt good on my face.
cool.exampleZh: 长跑之后，凉水敷在脸上感觉很舒服。

cooperate.example: The two teams must cooperate closely to finish the project on time.
cooperate.exampleZh: 两个团队必须紧密合作，才能按时完成这个项目。

cooperative.example: The two teams were very cooperative and finished the project on time.
cooperative.exampleZh: 两个团队非常合作，按时完成了项目。

coordinate.example: We need to coordinate our plans with the rest of the team.
coordinate.exampleZh: 我们需要与团队其他成员协调我们的计划。

cop.example: The cop stopped the car and asked the driver for his license.
cop.exampleZh: 警察拦下那辆车，要求司机出示驾照。

cope.example: She finds it hard to cope with all the work alone.
cope.exampleZh: 她觉得自己很难独自应付所有的工作。

copy.example: Please make a copy of this page and give it to me.
copy.exampleZh: 请把这一页复印一份给我。

copyright.example: The writer owns the copyright to all her books.
copyright.exampleZh: 这位作家拥有她所有书籍的版权。

cord.example: He tied the box with a strong cord before carrying it upstairs.
cord.exampleZh: 他上楼前用一根结实的绳子把箱子捆好。

core.example: The core of the problem is a simple lack of trust.
core.exampleZh: 问题的核心仅仅是缺乏信任。

corn.example: We grow corn and wheat on our small family farm.
corn.exampleZh: 我们在自家的小农场里种植玉米和小麦。

corner.example: The little cat is sleeping in the corner of the room.
corner.exampleZh: 那只小猫正在房间的角落里睡觉。

corporate.example: She works in a large corporate office in the city center.
corporate.exampleZh: 她在市中心一家大型公司的办公室工作。

corporation.example: My father works for a large corporation in the city center.
corporation.exampleZh: 我父亲在市中心的一家大公司工作。

correct.example: Please correct your mistakes before you hand in the homework.
correct.exampleZh: 请在交作业之前改正你的错误。

correction.example: The teacher made a small correction to my spelling mistake.
correction.exampleZh: 老师对我的拼写错误做了一处小修改。

correspond.example: These two lists do not correspond, so we need to check them again.
correspond.exampleZh: 这两份清单不一致，所以我们需要再核对一遍。

correspondence.example: Our correspondence about the trip lasted for several weeks.
correspondence.exampleZh: 我们关于这次旅行的通信持续了好几周。

corridor.example: She walked down the long corridor to find her office.
corridor.exampleZh: 她沿着长长的走廊走去寻找她的办公室。

cost.example: The repair cost more than we expected, but the car runs well now.
cost.exampleZh: 维修费用比我们预期的要高，但这辆车现在开得很好。

costly.example: Buying a new car can be very costly for a young family.
costly.exampleZh: 买一辆新车对一个年轻家庭来说可能非常昂贵。

cottage.example: My grandmother lives in a small cottage near the lake.
cottage.exampleZh: 我祖母住在湖边的一座小屋里。

cotton.example: This shirt is made of soft cotton and feels very comfortable.
cotton.exampleZh: 这件衬衫是柔软棉布做的，穿起来很舒服。

cough.example: My son has a bad cough, so he stays home from school today.
cough.exampleZh: 我儿子咳嗽得厉害，所以他今天待在家里没去上学。

could.example: Could you please help me carry this heavy box upstairs?
could.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这个沉重的箱子搬上楼吗？

council.example: The city council met on Monday to discuss the new park.
council.exampleZh: 市议会星期一开会讨论新公园的事。

counsel.example: My teacher gave me good counsel about choosing a job.
counsel.exampleZh: 我的老师就选择工作给了我有益的忠告。

count.example: Please count the books on the desk and tell me the total number.
count.exampleZh: 请数一下桌子上的书，然后告诉我总数。

counter.example: She put the money on the counter and walked out of the bank.
counter.exampleZh: 她把钱放在柜台上，然后走出了银行。

country.example: My country is very large and has many beautiful cities and farms.
country.exampleZh: 我的国家很大，有许多美丽的城市和农场。

countryside.example: My grandparents live in the countryside and grow their own vegetables.
countryside.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在乡下，自己种蔬菜。

county.example: She lives in a small county near the river.
county.exampleZh: 她住在河边的一个小县里。

couple.example: A young couple lives next door with their two small children.
couple.exampleZh: 一对年轻夫妇带着两个小孩住在隔壁。

courage.example: It takes courage to speak the truth in front of many people.
courage.exampleZh: 在很多人面前说出真相需要勇气。

course.example: This course is hard, but I am learning a lot from it.
course.exampleZh: 这门课程很难，但我从中学到了很多。

court.example: The small court in the old town is quiet and cool in summer.
court.exampleZh: 老城区里那个小庭院在夏天既安静又凉爽。

courtyard.example: The children are playing games in the courtyard behind the old house.
courtyard.exampleZh: 孩子们正在老房子后面的庭院里玩游戏。

cousin.example: My cousin lives in another city and visits us every summer.
cousin.exampleZh: 我的表弟住在另一个城市，每年夏天都来看我们。

cover.example: Snow covered the whole town last night, so the roads are closed today.
cover.exampleZh: 昨晚大雪覆盖了整个小镇，所以今天道路封闭了。

cow.example: The cow gives us fresh milk every morning on the farm.
cow.exampleZh: 农场里的那头奶牛每天早上都给我们提供新鲜的牛奶。

crack.example: The old cup cracked when it fell on the hard floor.
crack.exampleZh: 旧杯子掉在坚硬的地板上时裂开了。

craft.example: She learned the craft of making paper flowers from her grandmother.
craft.exampleZh: 她从祖母那里学会了制作纸花的工艺。

crane.example: A tall crane lifted the heavy boxes onto the truck.
crane.exampleZh: 一台高高的起重机把沉重的箱子吊上了卡车。

crash.example: The computer will crash if you open too many programs at once.
crash.exampleZh: 如果你同时打开太多程序，电脑就会崩溃。

crawl.example: The baby can crawl across the floor to reach her toys.
crawl.exampleZh: 婴儿能爬过地板去够她的玩具。

crazy.example: My brother is crazy about football and watches every match.
crazy.exampleZh: 我哥哥对足球很着迷，每场比赛都看。

cream.example: She put fresh cream and sugar in her morning coffee.
cream.exampleZh: 她在早晨的咖啡里加了新鲜奶油和糖。

create.example: Her words created a lot of trouble for the whole team.
create.exampleZh: 她的话给整个团队造成了很多麻烦。

creation.example: The creation of this beautiful garden took many years of hard work.
creation.exampleZh: 这座美丽花园的创作花了许多年的辛勤劳动。

creative.example: She has a creative way of solving small problems at home.
creative.exampleZh: 她有一种创造性的方法来解决家里的小问题。

creature.example: The small creature lives under the old tree near our house.
creature.exampleZh: 那个小生物住在我们家附近的那棵老树下。

credit.example: I credit my success to hard work and help from my friends.
credit.exampleZh: 我把我的成功归功于努力工作和朋友们的帮助。

creep.example: The cat likes to creep quietly through the tall grass.
creep.exampleZh: 这只猫喜欢悄悄地穿过高高的草丛。

crew.example: The whole crew worked hard to keep the ship clean and safe.
crew.exampleZh: 全体船员努力工作，保持船上的清洁与安全。

crime.example: The police are trying to find out who committed the crime.
crime.exampleZh: 警方正在努力查明是谁犯了这项罪行。

criminal.example: The police caught the criminal near the bank last night.
criminal.exampleZh: 警方昨晚在银行附近抓住了那个罪犯。

crisis.example: The country is facing a serious economic crisis this year.
crisis.exampleZh: 这个国家今年正面临一场严重的经济危机。

critic.example: The film critic wrote a short review of the new movie.
critic.exampleZh: 这位电影评论家为这部新电影写了一篇简短的影评。

critical.example: Clear thinking is critical when you make a big decision.
critical.exampleZh: 当你做出重大决定时，清晰的思考是至关重要的。

criticism.example: His criticism of the plan was fair and helped us improve it.
criticism.exampleZh: 他对这个计划的批评是公正的，帮助我们改进了它。

criticize.example: My teacher criticized my essay because it was too short.
criticize.exampleZh: 老师批评我的文章，因为文章太短了。

crop.example: The heavy rain destroyed most of the corn crop this year.
crop.exampleZh: 这场大雨毁掉了今年大部分的玉米收成。

cross.example: Look both ways before you cross the busy street near the school.
cross.exampleZh: 在学校附近穿过那条繁忙的马路之前，要先看看两边。

crowd.example: A large crowd gathered in the square to watch the street performers.
crowd.exampleZh: 一大群人聚集在广场上看街头艺人的表演。

crown.example: The queen wore a golden crown on her head at the ceremony.
crown.exampleZh: 仪式上，女王头戴一顶金色的王冠。

crucial.example: Sleep is crucial for good health, especially for young children.
crucial.exampleZh: 睡眠对健康至关重要，对幼儿尤其如此。

crude.example: This crude oil must be cleaned before we can use it.
crude.exampleZh: 这种原油必须经过净化才能使用。

cruel.example: It is cruel to leave a small dog alone all day.
cruel.exampleZh: 把一只小狗整天独自留在家里是很残忍的。

cruise.example: They plan to cruise around the islands on a small boat next summer.
cruise.exampleZh: 他们计划明年夏天乘小船游览这些岛屿。

crush.example: The heavy machine can crush the rocks into small pieces.
crush.exampleZh: 这台重型机器能把岩石压碎成小块。

cry.example: The baby began to cry when she dropped her toy on the floor.
cry.exampleZh: 婴儿把玩具掉到地上时开始哭了起来。

crystal.example: She keeps a small crystal on her desk because it is beautiful.
crystal.exampleZh: 她的书桌上放着一小块水晶，因为它很美。

cube.example: The box is shaped like a cube with six equal square faces.
cube.exampleZh: 这个盒子的形状像一个立方体，有六个相等的正方形面。

cue.example: When the teacher coughed, it was a cue for us to stand up.
cue.exampleZh: 老师咳嗽了一声，就是提示我们站起来。

cultivate.example: Farmers cultivate rice in the fields every spring.
cultivate.exampleZh: 农民每年春天在田里种植水稻。

culture.example: She loves learning about Chinese culture and history at school every week.
culture.exampleZh: 她喜欢每周在学校了解中国的文化和历史。

cup.example: She poured a cup of hot tea for her guest.
cup.exampleZh: 她为客人倒了一杯热茶。

cupboard.example: The plates and cups are in the kitchen cupboard.
cupboard.exampleZh: 盘子和杯子在厨房的碗碟橱里。

cure.example: The new drug can cure this serious disease in a few weeks.
cure.exampleZh: 这种新药能在几周内治好这种严重的疾病。

curiosity.example: The children looked at the old box with great curiosity.
curiosity.exampleZh: 孩子们非常好奇地看着那个旧箱子。

curious.example: The curious child kept asking questions about every animal in the zoo.
curious.exampleZh: 那个好奇的孩子不停地问关于动物园里每种动物的问题。

currency.example: The country's currency lost value quickly during the crisis.
currency.exampleZh: 危机期间，该国的货币迅速贬值。

current.example: The current of the river is very strong after the heavy rain.
current.exampleZh: 大雨过后，河水的流速非常急。

curriculum.example: The school has a new curriculum for students in grades one to six.
curriculum.exampleZh: 学校为一至六年级的学生制定了新的课程。

curse.example: He was so angry that he began to curse loudly at the broken machine.
curse.exampleZh: 他气得开始对着那台坏掉的机器大声咒骂。

curtain.example: She opened the curtains in the morning to let the sunlight into the room.
curtain.exampleZh: 早上她拉开窗帘，让阳光照进房间。

curve.example: The road makes a sharp curve near the old bridge.
curve.exampleZh: 这条路在旧桥附近形成一个急弯。

cushion.example: I put a soft cushion on the old wooden chair.
cushion.exampleZh: 我在那把旧木椅上放了一个柔软的坐垫。

custom.example: It is a local custom to eat dumplings during the Spring Festival.
custom.exampleZh: 春节期间吃饺子是当地的风俗。

customer.example: The shop gives every customer a small gift on their birthday.
customer.exampleZh: 这家店在每位顾客生日时送一份小礼物。

customs.example: We had to show our bags to customs at the airport.
customs.exampleZh: 在机场，我们不得不把行李给海关检查。

cut.example: The doctor cleaned the small cut on my hand and put a bandage on it.
cut.exampleZh: 医生清洗了我手上那个小伤口，然后贴上了创可贴。

cycle.example: I ride my cycle to school every morning and come back in the afternoon.
cycle.exampleZh: 我每天早上骑自行车去学校，下午再骑回来。

daily.example: I read the daily news before I start my work.
daily.exampleZh: 我在开始工作前阅读每日新闻。

dairy.example: We buy milk and cheese at the local dairy every week.
dairy.exampleZh: 我们每周都在当地的乳品店买牛奶和奶酪。

dam.example: The old dam across the river holds back a lot of water.
dam.exampleZh: 河上的那座旧水坝拦住了大量的水。

damage.example: The storm caused serious damage to many homes in the small town.
damage.exampleZh: 这场风暴给小镇上的许多房屋造成了严重破坏。

damp.example: My clothes still feel damp after hanging outside all day.
damp.exampleZh: 我的衣服在外面挂了一整天，摸起来还是有点潮湿。

dance.example: We like to dance together at the party every Friday night.
dance.exampleZh: 我们喜欢每周五晚上在派对上一起跳舞。

danger.example: The sign warns people of the danger near the river.
danger.exampleZh: 这个标志提醒人们注意河边的危险。

dangerous.example: It is dangerous to swim in this river because the water is deep.
dangerous.exampleZh: 在这条河里游泳很危险，因为水很深。

dare.example: I don't dare to tell my parents about this problem.
dare.exampleZh: 我不敢把这个问题告诉我的父母。

dark.example: The room was very dark, so we turned on a light.
dark.exampleZh: 房间很暗，所以我们打开了一盏灯。

darling.example: She is my darling and I love her very much.
darling.exampleZh: 她是我的心上人，我非常爱她。

dash.example: He made a dash for the bus and jumped on just in time.
dash.exampleZh: 他朝公交车猛冲过去，刚好及时跳上了车。

data.example: The data show that most students prefer online classes.
data.exampleZh: 这些数据显示大多数学生更喜欢在线课程。

database.example: The school keeps all student records in a large database.
database.exampleZh: 学校把所有学生记录保存在一个大型数据库里。

date.example: Please write the date on your paper before you start the test.
date.exampleZh: 请在开始考试前把日期写在试卷上。

daughter.example: My daughter likes to read books before she goes to bed.
daughter.exampleZh: 我的女儿喜欢在睡前看书。

dawn.example: We left the house at dawn and walked to the station.
dawn.exampleZh: 我们黎明时离开家，步行去了车站。

day.example: I work eight hours a day, but Sunday is my rest day.
day.exampleZh: 我每天工作八小时，但星期天是我的休息日。

daylight.example: The room is bright because daylight comes in through the large window.
daylight.exampleZh: 房间很明亮，因为日光从大窗户照进来。

dead.example: The old tree in our garden is dead and has no leaves.
dead.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵老树已经死了，没有叶子。

deadline.example: I need to finish this report before the deadline on Friday.
deadline.exampleZh: 我需要在周五的最后期限前完成这份报告。

deadly.example: The snake's bite can be deadly if you do not get help quickly.
deadly.exampleZh: 如果你不尽快寻求帮助，这种蛇的咬伤可能会致命。

deaf.example: The old man is deaf in one ear and cannot hear the phone.
deaf.exampleZh: 那位老人一只耳朵聋了，听不见电话铃声。

deal.example: We had to deal with several problems during the busy week.
deal.exampleZh: 在忙碌的一周里，我们不得不处理好几个问题。

dear.example: Dear, please do not worry about the cost of my dear old coat.
dear.exampleZh: 亲爱的，请不要担心我这件珍爱的旧外套的价格。

death.example: His death was very sad news for the whole family and all his friends.
death.exampleZh: 他的死对整个家庭和他所有的朋友来说都是令人悲痛的消息。

debate.example: The two sides will debate the new plan in class tomorrow.
debate.exampleZh: 双方明天将在课堂上辩论这项新计划。

debt.example: He worked two jobs to pay off his debt.
debt.exampleZh: 他打两份工来还清债务。

decade.example: She has lived in this small town for over a decade.
decade.exampleZh: 她在这个小镇生活了十多年。

decay.example: Old fruit will decay quickly if you leave it in a warm room.
decay.exampleZh: 如果你把旧水果放在温暖的房间里，它会很快腐烂。

deceive.example: Do not let his kind words deceive you.
deceive.exampleZh: 不要让他那番好话骗了你。

decent.example: He is a decent man who always helps his neighbors.
decent.exampleZh: 他是个正派人，总是帮助邻居。

decide.example: We must decide where to go for our holiday this year.
decide.exampleZh: 我们必须决定今年去哪里度假。

decision.example: She made a quick decision and never felt sorry about it.
decision.exampleZh: 她很快做出了决定，而且从未为此感到后悔。

decisive.example: Her decisive answer ended the long discussion and everyone agreed with her.
decisive.exampleZh: 她果断的回答结束了漫长的讨论，大家都同意她的看法。

deck.example: The children sat on the deck and watched the small boats go by.
deck.exampleZh: 孩子们坐在甲板上，看着小船驶过。

declare.example: The government will declare a new holiday next week.
declare.exampleZh: 政府将在下周宣布一个新的假日。

decline.example: The number of students in this school has declined in recent years.
decline.exampleZh: 这所学校的学生人数近年来有所下降。

decorate.example: We will decorate the living room with flowers before the party.
decorate.exampleZh: 我们会在派对前用鲜花装饰客厅。

decoration.example: The children made paper decorations for the classroom walls before the holiday party.
decoration.exampleZh: 孩子们在假期聚会前做了纸装饰品来装饰教室的墙壁。

decrease.example: The number of cars on this road will decrease after the new bridge opens.
decrease.exampleZh: 新桥开通后，这条路上的汽车数量将会减少。

dedicate.example: She decided to dedicate her life to helping children in poor villages.
dedicate.exampleZh: 她决定把一生奉献给帮助贫困村庄的孩子。

deduce.example: From these clues we can deduce the answer easily.
deduce.exampleZh: 根据这些线索，我们可以轻松推断出答案。

deed.example: His brave deed saved the little boy from the cold river.
deed.exampleZh: 他勇敢的行为把那个小男孩从冰冷的河水中救了出来。

deep.example: The lake is deep and the water is very cold.

deeply.example: She was deeply moved by the kind words from her old friends.
deeply.exampleZh: 她被老朋友们温暖的话语深深打动了。

deer.example: We saw a deer in the forest near our house yesterday.
deer.exampleZh: 昨天我们在家附近的森林里看到了一只鹿。

defeat.example: Our team worked hard and did not let one small mistake defeat us.
defeat.exampleZh: 我们队努力拼搏，没有让一个小错误击败我们。

defect.example: The main defect of this old phone is its very short battery life.
defect.exampleZh: 这部旧手机的主要缺点是电池续航时间太短。

defend.example: The soldiers will defend the city against the enemy.
defend.exampleZh: 士兵们将保卫这座城市抵御敌人。

defense.example: The soldiers built a strong defense around the city before the attack.
defense.exampleZh: 士兵们在进攻前在城市周围建立了坚固的防御。

define.example: Please define the word clearly so everyone in class can understand it.
define.exampleZh: 请清楚地给这个词下定义，好让班上每个人都能理解。

definite.example: We need a definite answer before we make the final plan.
definite.exampleZh: 在制定最终计划之前，我们需要一个明确的答复。

definitely.example: I will definitely come to your party on Saturday night.
definitely.exampleZh: 星期六晚上我一定会来参加你的聚会。

definition.example: The teacher gave a clear definition of the new word.
definition.exampleZh: 老师给这个新单词下了一个清晰的定义。

degree.example: The water temperature is thirty degrees today, so it feels quite warm.
degree.exampleZh: 今天水温是三十度，所以感觉相当暖和。

delay.example: Heavy rain delayed our flight by three hours yesterday.
delay.exampleZh: 昨天的暴雨使我们的航班延误了三个小时。

delegate.example: The manager will delegate the task to a trusted team member.
delegate.exampleZh: 经理会把这项任务委派给一位值得信任的团队成员。

deliberate.example: Her deliberate choice of words made the whole room go quiet.
deliberate.exampleZh: 她刻意斟酌的用词让整个房间都安静了下来。

delicate.example: The delicate glass cup broke when it fell off the table.
delicate.exampleZh: 那个精致的玻璃杯从桌上掉下来时碎了。

delicious.example: The soup at this small restaurant is really delicious.
delicious.exampleZh: 这家小餐馆的汤真的很美味。

delight.example: The children shouted with delight when they saw the snow.
delight.exampleZh: 孩子们看到雪时高兴得欢呼起来。

deliver.example: The postman will deliver the letter to your house tomorrow morning.
deliver.exampleZh: 邮递员明天早上会把信送到你家。

delivery.example: The delivery of the package was late because of the heavy snow.
delivery.exampleZh: 由于大雪，包裹的递送迟了。

demand.example: Many customers demand better service from the hotel.
demand.exampleZh: 许多顾客要求酒店提供更好的服务。

democracy.example: In a democracy, people choose their leaders by voting.
democracy.exampleZh: 在民主国家，人们通过投票来选择领导人。

democratic.example: Our school holds a democratic vote to choose the class leader every year.
democratic.exampleZh: 我们学校每年举行民主投票来选出班长。

demonstrate.example: The teacher demonstrated the experiment to the class before the students tried it.
demonstrate.exampleZh: 老师在学生们尝试之前向全班演示了这个实验。

denial.example: His denial of the mistake surprised everyone at the meeting.
denial.exampleZh: 他对这个错误的否认让会上所有人都感到惊讶。

dense.example: The forest is so dense that sunlight cannot reach the ground.
dense.exampleZh: 这片森林非常茂密，阳光照不到地面。

density.example: The density of this wood is higher than that of water.
density.exampleZh: 这种木头的密度比水高。

dental.example: I have a dental appointment tomorrow morning at the clinic near my home.
dental.exampleZh: 我明天上午在家附近的诊所有一个牙科预约。

dentist.example: I have a toothache, so I will see the dentist tomorrow morning.
dentist.exampleZh: 我牙疼，所以明天早上我要去看牙医。

deny.example: She denied taking the money from the drawer.
deny.exampleZh: 她否认从抽屉里拿了钱。

depart.example: The train will depart from the station at eight tomorrow morning.
depart.exampleZh: 火车将于明天早上八点从车站出发。

department.example: My mother works in the sales department of a small company.
department.exampleZh: 我妈妈在一家小公司的销售部工作。

departure.example: His sudden departure from the meeting surprised all of us.
departure.exampleZh: 他突然离开会议，让我们所有人都感到意外。

depend.example: Many small shops depend on local customers to stay open.
depend.exampleZh: 许多小商店依靠本地顾客来维持营业。

dependent.example: Children are still dependent on their parents for food and money.
dependent.exampleZh: 孩子们在食物和金钱上仍然依赖父母。

depict.example: The book depicts life in a small village many years ago.
depict.exampleZh: 这本书描绘了许多年前一个小村庄里的生活。

deposit.example: I will deposit some money in the bank today.
deposit.exampleZh: 我今天要在银行存一些钱。

depress.example: The bad weather and sad news began to depress everyone in the small town.
depress.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气和悲伤的消息开始让小镇上的每个人都感到沮丧。

depression.example: After losing his job, he fell into a deep depression.
depression.exampleZh: 失业后，他陷入了深深的沮丧之中。

depth.example: The depth of the lake makes it hard to see the bottom.
depth.exampleZh: 这个湖的深度让人很难看到湖底。

deputy.example: The manager sent his deputy to attend the meeting in his place.
deputy.exampleZh: 经理派他的副手代替他出席会议。

derive.example: We can derive great pleasure from reading good books.
derive.exampleZh: 我们可以从阅读好书中获得极大的乐趣。

descend.example: Thick fog began to descend on the valley as night fell.
descend.exampleZh: 夜幕降临时，浓雾开始笼罩山谷。

describe.example: Can you describe the man you saw last night?
describe.exampleZh: 你能描述一下昨晚你看到的那个男人吗？

description.example: The police asked me to give a short description of the missing car.
description.exampleZh: 警察让我简短描述一下那辆失踪的汽车。

desert.example: They left him alone in the desert and never came back.
desert.exampleZh: 他们把他一个人丢在沙漠里，再也没有回来。

deserve.example: Good students deserve praise from their teachers after hard work.
deserve.exampleZh: 努力之后，好学生应该得到老师的表扬。

design.example: She will design a new dress for the show next week.
design.exampleZh: 她将为下周的演出设计一条新裙子。

designate.example: The manager will designate a safe place for the meeting.
designate.exampleZh: 经理将指定一个安全的地方开会。

desirable.example: A quiet home near the park is desirable for a young family.
desirable.exampleZh: 对年轻家庭来说，公园附近安静的家是令人向往的。

desire.example: She has a strong desire to travel and see the world.
desire.exampleZh: 她有一个强烈的愿望，想去旅行看看世界。

desk.example: I put my books on the desk and sit down.
desk.exampleZh: 我把书放在书桌上，然后坐下。

despair.example: After losing his job, he fell into deep despair and stopped seeing friends.
despair.exampleZh: 失业后，他陷入深深的绝望，不再和朋友见面。

desperate.example: The lost hikers were desperate for water after two days in the desert.
desperate.exampleZh: 迷失的徒步者在沙漠中走了两天后极度渴望水。

despite.example: Despite the heavy rain, the children played happily in the garden.
despite.exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，孩子们还是在花园里开心地玩耍。

dessert.example: We had ice cream for dessert after the big dinner last night.
dessert.exampleZh: 昨晚吃完丰盛的晚餐后，我们吃了冰淇淋作为甜点。

destination.example: After a long flight, we finally arrived at our destination.
destination.exampleZh: 经过长途飞行，我们终于到达了目的地。

destroy.example: The fire destroyed the old house in one hour.
destroy.exampleZh: 大火在一小时内摧毁了那座老房子。

destruction.example: The storm caused great destruction to many homes in the small town.
destruction.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨给小镇上的许多房屋造成了巨大的破坏。

detail.example: Please give me more detail about your plan for the trip.
detail.exampleZh: 请多告诉我一些关于你旅行计划的细节。

detect.example: She quickly detected a small mistake in the report and fixed it.
detect.exampleZh: 她很快发现报告中的一个小错误，并把它改正了。

detection.example: Early detection of the disease helps patients get better care.
detection.exampleZh: 疾病的早期发觉有助于患者获得更好的治疗。

determination.example: Her determination to learn English helped her pass the difficult exam.
determination.exampleZh: 她学好英语的决心帮助她通过了那场困难的考试。

determine.example: We must determine the cause of the problem before we can fix it.
determine.exampleZh: 我们必须先确定问题的原因，才能把它修好。

develop.example: They plan to develop a new app for young users.
develop.exampleZh: 他们计划为年轻用户开发一款新应用。

development.example: The rapid development of the city brought new jobs and better roads.
development.exampleZh: 这座城市的快速发展带来了新的就业机会和更好的道路。

device.example: This small device helps you measure the temperature of water.
device.exampleZh: 这个小装置可以帮你测量水温。

devil.example: The old story says a devil lives in that dark cave.
devil.exampleZh: 这个古老的故事说，那个黑暗的洞穴里住着一个魔鬼。

devise.example: The team devised a simple plan to save more water.
devise.exampleZh: 团队想出了一个节约更多用水的简单方案。

devote.example: She devotes two hours every evening to helping her children with homework.
devote.exampleZh: 她每天晚上拿出两个小时帮助孩子们做作业。

diagram.example: The teacher drew a simple diagram to show how water moves through plants.
diagram.exampleZh: 老师画了一张简单的示意图，展示水如何穿过植物。

dial.example: Please dial the number on the dial and wait for an answer.
dial.exampleZh: 请在拨号盘上拨这个号码，然后等待接听。

diamond.example: She wore a diamond ring on her finger at the party.
diamond.exampleZh: 她在派对上手指上戴着一枚钻石戒指。

diary.example: I write in my diary every night before I go to bed.
diary.exampleZh: 我每天晚上睡觉前都会在日记本上写日记。

dictate.example: The teacher dictated a short text for us to write down.
dictate.exampleZh: 老师口授了一段短文让我们写下来。

dictator.example: The dictator ruled the small country for over twenty years.
dictator.exampleZh: 那个独裁者统治这个小国二十多年。

die.example: My old dog died last winter, and we still miss him.
die.exampleZh: 我的老狗去年冬天死了，我们仍然很想念他。

diet.example: My doctor says a healthy diet and daily exercise will keep me strong.
diet.exampleZh: 我的医生说，健康的饮食和每天锻炼会让我保持强壮。

differ.example: My answer may differ from yours, but both are fine.
differ.exampleZh: 我的答案可能与你的不同，但两个都可以。

difference.example: There is a big difference between the two answers.
difference.exampleZh: 这两个答案之间有很大的差别。

different.example: My brother and I have different ideas about how to spend the weekend.
different.exampleZh: 我和哥哥对于如何度过周末有不同的想法。

difficult.example: This English test is very difficult for me.
difficult.exampleZh: 这次英语考试对我来说很难。

difficulty.example: I had some difficulty finding the right answer to this question.
difficulty.exampleZh: 我找到这个问题的正确答案有些困难。

dig.example: They had to dig a deep hole in the garden to find water.
dig.exampleZh: 他们不得不在花园里挖一个深洞来找水。

digest.example: It takes time to digest all the new information from the meeting.
digest.exampleZh: 消化会议上所有的新信息需要时间。

digital.example: The clock on my desk shows the time in digital numbers.
digital.exampleZh: 我桌上的钟用数字显示时间。

dignity.example: She accepted the award with quiet dignity and thanked everyone who helped her.
dignity.exampleZh: 她以平静的尊严接受了这个奖项，并感谢了所有帮助过她的人。

dilemma.example: She faced a real dilemma when both job offers arrived on the same day.
dilemma.exampleZh: 当两份工作邀请在同一天到来时，她陷入了真正的两难困境。

dimension.example: We need to measure the dimensions of this room before buying new furniture.
dimension.exampleZh: 买新家具之前，我们需要量一下这个房间的尺寸。

diminish.example: The noise began to diminish after the workers turned off the machines.
diminish.exampleZh: 工人们关掉机器后，噪音开始减小。

dine.example: We often dine at a small restaurant near our office after work.
dine.exampleZh: 我们下班后常在办公室附近的一家小餐馆进餐。

dinner.example: We usually eat dinner together at seven every evening.
dinner.exampleZh: 我们通常每天晚上七点一起吃晚餐。

dip.example: She dipped her bread into the hot soup and smiled.
dip.exampleZh: 她把面包浸入热汤里，笑了。

direct.example: The teacher gave us direct instructions before the exam started.
direct.exampleZh: 考试开始前，老师给了我们直接的指示。

direction.example: Please read the directions on the box before you take the medicine.
direction.exampleZh: 请在你服药前阅读盒子上的用法说明。

directly.example: The school is directly across from the park, so we walk there.
directly.exampleZh: 学校就在公园的正对面，所以我们走路去那里。

director.example: The director told the new team members to start work on Monday.
director.exampleZh: 主任让新团队成员星期一开始工作。

directory.example: She looked up the phone number in the local directory.
directory.exampleZh: 她在本地姓名地址录里查到了那个电话号码。

dirt.example: After the long walk, his shoes were covered with dirt and mud.
dirt.exampleZh: 长途步行后，他的鞋上沾满了污物和泥。

dirty.example: His dirty shoes made marks all over the clean floor.
dirty.exampleZh: 他的脏鞋子在干净的地板上到处留下了印记。

disabled.example: The building has a special entrance for disabled people.
disabled.exampleZh: 这栋楼为残疾人设有专门的入口。

disadvantage.example: One disadvantage of this plan is that it costs too much money.
disadvantage.exampleZh: 这个计划的一个缺点是要花太多钱。

disagree.example: I disagree with my brother about which movie we should watch tonight.
disagree.exampleZh: 关于今晚该看哪部电影，我和我弟弟意见不合。

disappear.example: The sun went down and the light slowly disappeared from the sky.
disappear.exampleZh: 太阳落下后，天空中的光慢慢消失了。

disappoint.example: I hope the movie will not disappoint you.
disappoint.exampleZh: 我希望这部电影不会让你失望。

disaster.example: The storm was a disaster for the small village.
disaster.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨对这个小村庄来说是一场灾难。

discard.example: Please discard the old newspapers before you clean the room.
discard.exampleZh: 打扫房间之前，请把旧报纸丢掉。

discharge.example: The factory must not discharge dirty water into the river.
discharge.exampleZh: 这家工厂不得将污水排入河中。

discipline.example: Good teachers use discipline and patience to help students learn.
discipline.exampleZh: 好老师用纪律和耐心帮助学生成长。

disclose.example: The company refused to disclose the details of the new plan.
disclose.exampleZh: 公司拒绝透露这项新计划的细节。

discount.example: The store gave me a small discount on the shoes.
discount.exampleZh: 那家店给我这双鞋打了一点折扣。

discourage.example: Do not let one small failure discourage you from trying again.
discourage.exampleZh: 不要因为一次小小的失败就灰心而不再尝试。

discover.example: Scientists discover new things about the ocean every year.
discover.exampleZh: 科学家们每年都会发现关于海洋的新事物。

discovery.example: The discovery of the new planet made many scientists very happy.
discovery.exampleZh: 这颗新行星的发现让许多科学家非常高兴。

discuss.example: Let's discuss the plan together before we start the work.
discuss.exampleZh: 我们开始工作前一起讨论一下这个计划吧。

discussion.example: We had a long discussion about the new plan after lunch.
discussion.exampleZh: 午饭过后，我们就新计划进行了长时间的讨论。

disease.example: The doctor said his disease is not serious and he can go home soon.
disease.exampleZh: 医生说他的病不严重，他很快就能回家。

disguise.example: She wore a wig to disguise herself at the party.
disguise.exampleZh: 她在聚会上戴了假发来伪装自己。

disgust.example: She turned away in disgust when she saw the dirty kitchen floor.
disgust.exampleZh: 当她看到脏兮兮的厨房地板时，厌恶地转过身去。

dish.example: Please wash the dishes after dinner and put them on the shelf.
dish.exampleZh: 晚饭后请把餐具洗好并放到架子上。

dislike.example: I really dislike getting up early on cold winter mornings.
dislike.exampleZh: 我真的很不喜欢在寒冷的冬天早晨早起。

dismiss.example: The manager decided to dismiss two workers who often came late.
dismiss.exampleZh: 经理决定解雇两名经常迟到的工人。

disorder.example: The heavy storm left the whole town in complete disorder.
disorder.exampleZh: 这场大风暴让整个小镇陷入了彻底的混乱。

display.example: The new phone has a large display and it looks very clear.
display.exampleZh: 这款新手机有一个大显示屏，看起来很清晰。

dispute.example: The two sides continue to dispute the cause of the accident.
dispute.exampleZh: 双方继续就事故原因争论不休。

dissolve.example: Stir the sugar until it dissolves completely in the hot water.
dissolve.exampleZh: 搅拌糖，直到它完全溶解在热水里。

distance.example: The distance between the two towns is about ten miles.
distance.exampleZh: 这两个城镇之间的距离大约是十英里。

distant.example: She lives in a distant city and rarely visits her family.
distant.exampleZh: 她住在一座遥远的城市，很少去看望家人。

distinct.example: The two sisters have distinct voices, so I can tell them apart.
distinct.exampleZh: 这对姐妹的声音截然不同，所以我能分辨出她们。

distinction.example: There is a clear distinction between the two plans for the city.
distinction.exampleZh: 这两个城市建设方案之间存在明显的区别。

distinguish.example: It is hard to distinguish the twins because they look exactly the same.
distinguish.exampleZh: 很难区分这对双胞胎，因为他们长得一模一样。

distress.example: The loss of her old dog caused her great distress.
distress.exampleZh: 老狗的死让她非常痛苦。

distribute.example: The teacher will distribute the books to all the students tomorrow.
distribute.exampleZh: 老师明天会把书分发给所有学生。

distribution.example: The distribution of food to the villagers began early this morning.
distribution.exampleZh: 向村民分发食物的活动今天一早就开始了。

district.example: Our school is in a quiet district near the river.
district.exampleZh: 我们学校位于河边一个安静的区域。

disturb.example: Please do not disturb me while I am working in my room.
disturb.exampleZh: 我在房间工作时请不要打扰我。

ditch.example: The farmer dug a deep ditch along the edge of his field.
ditch.exampleZh: 农民沿着田边挖了一条深沟。

dive.example: The player made a quick dive to catch the low ball.
dive.exampleZh: 那名球员迅速俯身扑救，接住了那个低球。

diverse.example: Our school has students from diverse countries and cultures.
diverse.exampleZh: 我们学校有来自不同国家和文化的学生。

diversion.example: The road was closed, so we took a short diversion through the next town.
diversion.exampleZh: 道路封闭了，所以我们绕道穿过邻近的城镇走了一小段。

divide.example: We divide the class into four small groups for the game.
divide.exampleZh: 我们为了游戏把这个班分成四个小组。

division.example: The teacher explained division to the class using a simple example.
division.exampleZh: 老师用一个简单的例子向全班讲解了除法。

divorce.example: Her parents went through a divorce last year, but they are still good friends.
divorce.exampleZh: 她的父母去年离了婚，但他们仍然是好朋友。

do.example: I do my homework every day after school with my sister.
do.exampleZh: 我每天放学后和姐姐一起做作业。

dock.example: The small boat will dock at the old harbor before noon.
dock.exampleZh: 小船将在中午前停靠在旧港口。

doctor.example: My mother told me to see a doctor because I felt sick.
doctor.exampleZh: 我妈妈让我去看医生，因为我感觉不舒服。

document.example: Please keep every important document in a safe place.
document.exampleZh: 请把每一份重要文件都放在安全的地方。

dog.example: The dog runs in the park with my little sister every morning.
dog.exampleZh: 每天早上，那只狗和我妹妹一起在公园里跑。

doll.example: The little girl holds her doll and smiles at everyone.
doll.exampleZh: 小女孩抱着她的洋娃娃，对每个人微笑。

dollar.example: This book costs one dollar, so I can buy it today.
dollar.exampleZh: 这本书一美元，所以我今天可以买下它。

domestic.example: They bought some domestic appliances for their new house last week.
domestic.exampleZh: 他们上周为新房子买了一些家用电器。

dominant.example: The dominant team scored three goals in the first half.
dominant.exampleZh: 那支占优势的球队在上半场攻入了三个球。

dominate.example: Tall office buildings dominate the skyline of this busy modern city.
dominate.exampleZh: 高耸的写字楼耸立在这座繁忙现代城市的天际线上，十分醒目。

donate.example: Every year he donates money and old clothes to help poor families.
donate.exampleZh: 每年他都捐钱和旧衣服来帮助贫困家庭。

door.example: She opened the door and let the dog run into the garden.
door.exampleZh: 她打开门，让狗跑进花园里。

dormitory.example: The new students share a small dormitory near the school gate.
dormitory.exampleZh: 新生们合住学校大门附近的一间小宿舍。

dose.example: The doctor said I should take one dose of this medicine after dinner.
dose.exampleZh: 医生说我应该在晚饭后服用一剂这种药。

dot.example: There is a small red dot on the map.

double.example: The price of the room is double what we paid last year.
double.exampleZh: 这个房间的价格是我们去年所付的两倍。

doubt.example: I doubt he will come to the party tonight.
doubt.exampleZh: 我怀疑他今晚不会来参加聚会。

doubtful.example: I am doubtful that he will come to the party tonight.
doubtful.exampleZh: 我怀疑他今晚不会来参加聚会。

down.example: She looked down at her shoes and said nothing.
down.exampleZh: 她低头看着自己的鞋子，什么也没说。

downstairs.example: She went downstairs to get a glass of water for her mother.
downstairs.exampleZh: 她下楼去给她妈妈拿一杯水。

downward.example: The downward path led us safely to the small village below.
downward.exampleZh: 这条向下的路把我们安全地带到了下面的小村庄。

dozen.example: She bought a dozen eggs and two bottles of milk at the store.
dozen.exampleZh: 她在商店买了一打鸡蛋和两瓶牛奶。

draft.example: She wrote a first draft of the report before the meeting.
draft.exampleZh: 她在会议前写了报告的第一稿。

drag.example: He had to drag the heavy box across the floor to the door.
drag.exampleZh: 他不得不把那个沉重的箱子拖过地板，一直拖到门口。

dragon.example: My little sister drew a big green dragon on the wall.
dragon.exampleZh: 我妹妹在墙上画了一条绿色的大龙。

drain.example: Heavy repairs drained all the money from their small savings account.
drain.exampleZh: 繁重的维修耗尽了他们小额储蓄账户里的所有钱。

drama.example: The drama at school today was more exciting than any movie.
drama.exampleZh: 今天学校里发生的戏剧性事件比任何电影都精彩。

dramatic.example: The market saw a dramatic change in prices this year.
dramatic.exampleZh: 今年市场价格发生了戏剧性的变化。

draw.example: The little girl likes to draw pictures of her cat every day.
draw.exampleZh: 这个小女孩喜欢每天画她那只猫的画。

drawer.example: She put the clean socks in the top drawer of her dress.
drawer.exampleZh: 她把干净的袜子放进她衣柜最上面的抽屉里。

drawing.example: She is drawing a picture of her cat in the garden.
drawing.exampleZh: 她正在花园里画一张她的猫的画。

dream.example: Her dream is to become a teacher, and she works hard every day.
dream.exampleZh: 她的梦想是成为一名老师，她每天都在努力。

dress.example: She wears a blue dress to work and dresses her little sister every morning.
dress.exampleZh: 她穿一条蓝色连衣裙去上班，每天早上还给妹妹穿衣服。

drift.example: The small boat began to drift slowly away from the shore.
drift.exampleZh: 小船开始慢慢漂离岸边。

drill.example: The teacher will drill the students on new words every morning.
drill.exampleZh: 老师每天早上都会训练学生记新单词。

drink.example: I drink a cup of hot tea every morning before work.
drink.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前喝一杯热茶。

drip.example: The old pipe drips water onto the floor every night.
drip.exampleZh: 那根旧水管每天晚上都在往地板上滴水。

drive.example: He likes to drive his car to work every morning.
drive.exampleZh: 他喜欢每天早上开车去上班。

driver.example: The driver stopped the car in front of the small bank.
driver.exampleZh: 司机把车停在了那家小银行前面。

drop.example: Don't drop the glass or it will break into small pieces.
drop.exampleZh: 别把玻璃杯掉下来，不然它会碎成小片。

drought.example: The long drought made it hard for farmers to grow food that year.
drought.exampleZh: 那场长期干旱使农民当年很难种出粮食。

drown.example: The heavy rain drowned the small garden and all the flowers.
drown.exampleZh: 大雨淹没了小花园和所有的花。

drug.example: The doctor gave him a drug to help with the pain.
drug.exampleZh: 医生给了他一种药来缓解疼痛。

drum.example: He played the drum loudly during the school music show last night.
drum.exampleZh: 昨晚学校音乐演出时，他把鼓敲得很响。

drunk.example: He was too drunk to drive home, so he took a taxi.
drunk.exampleZh: 他醉得没法开车回家，所以坐了出租车。

dry.example: The hot sun will dry your wet clothes very quickly.
dry.exampleZh: 炎热的太阳会很快把你的湿衣服晒干。

duck.example: The little duck swam across the pond with her baby ducks.
duck.exampleZh: 那只小母鸭带着她的小鸭子游过了池塘。

due.example: The rent is due at the end of each month.

dull.example: The long meeting was dull, so many people fell asleep.
dull.exampleZh: 这场漫长的会议很枯燥，所以很多人都睡着了。

dumb.example: The poor dumb child could not tell us his name.
dumb.exampleZh: 那个可怜的哑孩子无法告诉我们他的名字。

dump.example: They dump the old chairs and tables behind the school building.
dump.exampleZh: 他们把旧的桌椅丢弃在学校大楼后面。

durable.example: This durable bag has lasted me for over five years.
durable.exampleZh: 这个耐用的包我已经用了五年多。

during.example: I read two books during the summer holiday.
during.exampleZh: 我在暑假期间读了两本书。

dusk.example: The children came home from the park at dusk.
dusk.exampleZh: 孩子们黄昏时从公园回家了。

dust.example: The old books were covered with dust after many years in the attic.
dust.exampleZh: 那些旧书在阁楼里放了很多年，上面落满了灰尘。

duty.example: It is your duty to help your parents at home.
duty.exampleZh: 在家帮助父母是你的责任。

dwell.example: She does not dwell on her past mistakes.
dwell.exampleZh: 她不会老是纠结于过去的错误。

dynamic.example: The city has a dynamic music scene that young people love.
dynamic.exampleZh: 这座城市有一个年轻人喜爱的充满活力的音乐圈。

eager.example: The children are eager to open their gifts on Christmas morning.
eager.exampleZh: 孩子们热切地想在圣诞节早上打开礼物。

eagle.example: An eagle flies high above the mountains and looks for small animals to eat.
eagle.exampleZh: 一只鹰在群山上空高高飞翔，寻找小动物来吃。

ear.example: My left ear hurts a little after I swim in the cold water.
ear.exampleZh: 在冷水里游泳后，我的左耳有点疼。

early.example: I get up early every morning to catch the first bus.
early.exampleZh: 我每天早上很早起床去赶第一班公交车。

earn.example: He works hard every day to earn enough money for his family.
earn.exampleZh: 他每天努力工作，为家人挣足够的钱。

earnest.example: She gave an earnest answer to every question from the students.
earnest.exampleZh: 她对学生们提出的每一个问题都作了认真的回答。

earth.example: The earth goes around the sun once every year.
earth.exampleZh: 地球每年绕太阳转一圈。

earthquake.example: The earthquake broke many windows and some old houses in our small town.
earthquake.exampleZh: 这次地震震坏了我们小镇上的许多窗户和一些老房子。

ease.example: She finished the hard test with ease.
ease.exampleZh: 她轻松地完成了那场困难的考试。

east.example: The sun rises in the east every morning.
east.exampleZh: 太阳每天早晨从东方升起。

eastern.example: The eastern part of the country is warmer and has many beautiful beaches.
eastern.exampleZh: 这个国家的东部地区更温暖，有许多美丽的海滩。

eastward.example: The river flows eastward through the quiet valley toward the sea.
eastward.exampleZh: 这条河向东流经安静的山谷，流向大海。

easy.example: This easy book is good for young children.
easy.exampleZh: 这本简单的书适合小孩子阅读。

eat.example: We eat rice and vegetables together at home every evening.
eat.exampleZh: 我们每天晚上在家一起吃米饭和蔬菜。

echo.example: Her voice echoed through the empty hall.
echo.exampleZh: 她的声音在空荡荡的大厅里回荡。

ecology.example: She studies ecology at university and wants to protect wild animals.
ecology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习生态学，想要保护野生动物。

economic.example: The country is facing serious economic problems this year.
economic.exampleZh: 这个国家今年正面临严重的经济问题。

economical.example: This small car is very economical on fuel for daily city driving.
economical.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车在日常城市驾驶中非常省油。

economics.example: She studies economics at university and wants to work in a bank.
economics.exampleZh: 她在大学学习经济学，想在一家银行工作。

economist.example: The economist said prices will go up next year.
economist.exampleZh: 这位经济学家表示明年物价会上涨。

economy.example: The country's economy is growing slowly but steadily this year.
economy.exampleZh: 这个国家的经济今年在缓慢但稳定地增长。

edge.example: She stood at the edge of the lake and watched the small boat leave.
edge.exampleZh: 她站在湖边，看着小船离开。

edit.example: She will edit the video before we show it to the class.
edit.exampleZh: 在我们把视频给全班看之前，她会先剪辑它。

edition.example: This is the newest edition of our English dictionary.
edition.exampleZh: 这是我们英语词典的最新版本。

editor.example: The editor read my story and asked for a few small changes.
editor.exampleZh: 编辑读了我的故事，并要求做几处小改动。

editorial.example: The newspaper published an editorial about the new school policy.
editorial.exampleZh: 报纸发表了一篇关于新学校政策的社论。

educate.example: Teachers educate children to be kind and honest.
educate.exampleZh: 老师教育孩子们要善良诚实。

education.example: Her parents believe that education is the best gift for a child.
education.exampleZh: 她的父母认为教育是给孩子最好的礼物。

educational.example: The museum offers many educational programs for children and their parents.
educational.exampleZh: 这家博物馆为儿童及其家长提供了许多有教育意义的项目。

effect.example: The new rule had a big effect on how we work every day.
effect.exampleZh: 这项新规定对我们每天的工作方式有很大影响。

effective.example: This new medicine is very effective against the common cold.
effective.exampleZh: 这种新药对普通感冒非常有效。

efficient.example: She is an efficient worker who always finishes her tasks on time.
efficient.exampleZh: 她是一位效率很高的员工，总能按时完成任务。

effort.example: She made a real effort to finish the work on time.
effort.exampleZh: 她为了按时完成工作付出了真正的努力。

egg.example: I eat two eggs for breakfast every morning.
egg.exampleZh: 我每天早上吃两个鸡蛋当早餐。

eight.example: My little sister is eight years old and loves to draw.

eighteen.example: My sister is eighteen years old and she studies at a big school.
eighteen.exampleZh: 我姐姐十八岁，她在一所大学校学习。

eighth.example: She finished eighth in the race and won a small prize.
eighth.exampleZh: 她在比赛中获得第八名，赢得了一份小奖品。

either.example: You can take either of the two books; I don't need them.
either.exampleZh: 这两本书你拿哪一本都行，我都不需要。

elaborate.example: She gave an elaborate explanation of the plan to the whole team.
elaborate.exampleZh: 她向整个团队详细说明了这个计划。

elastic.example: This rubber band is very elastic, so it can stretch a long way.
elastic.exampleZh: 这根橡皮筋很有弹性，所以能拉得很长。

elbow.example: She hurt her elbow when she fell off the bike yesterday.
elbow.exampleZh: 她昨天从自行车上摔下来时伤到了肘部。

elder.example: My elder sister often helps me with my homework after school.
elder.exampleZh: 我姐姐经常在放学后帮我做作业。

elderly.example: The elderly woman needs help carrying her heavy bags up the stairs.
elderly.exampleZh: 那位年长的女士需要别人帮她把沉重的包提上楼梯。

elect.example: The students will elect a new class leader next week.
elect.exampleZh: 学生们下周将选举一位新的班长。

election.example: The election will be held next month, and everyone can vote.
election.exampleZh: 选举将在下个月举行，每个人都可以投票。

electric.example: This electric car is quiet and easy to drive in the city.
electric.exampleZh: 这辆电动汽车很安静，在城市里开起来也很容易。

electrical.example: He works as an electrical engineer and repairs machines in the factory.
electrical.exampleZh: 他是一名电气工程师，在工厂里修理机器。

electrician.example: The electrician came to our house to fix the broken lights.
electrician.exampleZh: 电工来我们家修坏掉的灯。

electricity.example: We use electricity to light our homes and run machines.
electricity.exampleZh: 我们用电来照亮家里并驱动机器。

electron.example: In a science class, we learned that an electron is very small.
electron.exampleZh: 在科学课上，我们学到电子非常小。

electronic.example: My electronic watch keeps very good time every single day.
electronic.exampleZh: 我的电子手表每天都走得很准。

elegant.example: Her elegant dress made her stand out at the party.
elegant.exampleZh: 她优雅的裙子让她在聚会上很出众。

element.example: Water is made of two elements, hydrogen and oxygen.
element.exampleZh: 水由两种元素组成，即氢和氧。

elementary.example: We learn basic math in elementary school.
elementary.exampleZh: 我们在小学学习基础数学。

elephant.example: The elephant drank water from the river with its long trunk.
elephant.exampleZh: 大象用长长的鼻子在河里喝水。

elevate.example: The new coach helped elevate the team to a higher level this year.
elevate.exampleZh: 新教练帮助球队在今年提升到了更高的水平。

elevator.example: We took the elevator to the tenth floor of the tall building.
elevator.exampleZh: 我们乘电梯到了那栋高楼第十层。

eleven.example: There are eleven students in the small classroom today.
eleven.exampleZh: 今天这间小教室里有十一名学生。

eleventh.example: My birthday is on the eleventh day of May this year.
eleventh.exampleZh: 今年我的生日在五月十一日。

eliminate.example: We must eliminate the bad habits that make our work slow and difficult.
eliminate.exampleZh: 我们必须消除那些让工作变得缓慢而困难的坏习惯。

else.example: If you do not like this one, please choose something else.
else.exampleZh: 如果你不喜欢这个，请选择其他东西。

elsewhere.example: She looked everywhere for her keys but they were elsewhere.
elsewhere.exampleZh: 她到处找钥匙，但钥匙在别处。

embarrass.example: Don't embarrass her by asking about her exam results in front of everyone.
embarrass.exampleZh: 不要当着大家的面问她考试结果，这会让她很难堪。

embassy.example: She went to the embassy to get a visa for her trip.
embassy.exampleZh: 她去大使馆办理旅行签证。

embrace.example: She learned to embrace change and soon felt much happier at work.
embrace.exampleZh: 她学会了欣然接受变化，很快在工作中感到快乐多了。

emerge.example: New problems emerge when the old rules stop working.
emerge.exampleZh: 当旧规则不再奏效时，新问题就会浮现。

emergency.example: In an emergency, call the police and stay calm.
emergency.exampleZh: 遇到紧急情况时，打电话报警并保持冷静。

emission.example: The factory must reduce its harmful gas emissions to protect the air.
emission.exampleZh: 工厂必须减少有害气体排放以保护空气。

emit.example: The old car emits a lot of black smoke every morning.
emit.exampleZh: 那辆旧车每天早上排放大量黑烟。

emotion.example: She could not hide the strong emotion in her voice.
emotion.exampleZh: 她无法掩饰声音中强烈的情感。

emotional.example: She wrote an emotional letter to her old friend.
emotional.exampleZh: 她给老朋友写了一封充满感情的信。

emperor.example: The emperor lived in a large palace with his many servants.
emperor.exampleZh: 这位皇帝和他的许多仆从住在一座巨大的宫殿里。

emphasis.example: The teacher put great emphasis on reading every day.
emphasis.exampleZh: 老师特别强调每天阅读的重要性。

emphasize.example: Teachers often emphasize the most important points before a big exam.
emphasize.exampleZh: 老师们常在大考前强调最重要的知识点。

empire.example: The Roman empire was very large and lasted for many years.
empire.exampleZh: 罗马帝国幅员辽阔，延续了很多年。

employ.example: We plan to employ two new teachers next month.
employ.exampleZh: 我们计划下个月雇用两名新老师。

employee.example: The company gives every new employee a computer and a desk.
employee.exampleZh: 公司给每位新员工一台电脑和一张桌子。

employer.example: My employer gives all the workers a free lunch every Friday.
employer.exampleZh: 我的雇主每周五给所有员工提供免费午餐。

employment.example: He found employment at a small shop near his home.
employment.exampleZh: 他在家附近的一家小店找到了工作。

empty.example: Please empty the water from this bottle before you fill it again.
empty.exampleZh: 请在你重新装满这个瓶子之前把它里面的水倒空。

enable.example: This new app enables students to study English at home.
enable.exampleZh: 这个新应用使学生能够在家学习英语。

encounter.example: We had a chance encounter with an old friend at the station.
encounter.exampleZh: 我们在车站偶然遇到了一位老朋友。

encourage.example: My parents always encourage me to try new things.
encourage.exampleZh: 我的父母总是鼓励我尝试新事物。

end.example: We waited at the end of the long line for tickets.
end.exampleZh: 我们在长长的购票队伍末端等候。

ending.example: The movie had a happy ending, so everyone left the theater smiling.
ending.exampleZh: 这部电影有个快乐的结局，所以每个人离开影院时都面带微笑。

endless.example: The long road seemed endless as we walked through the desert.
endless.exampleZh: 当我们穿过沙漠时，那条长路似乎没有尽头。

endow.example: The school was endowed with money to help poor students.
endow.exampleZh: 这所学校获得捐款，用来帮助贫困学生。

endurance.example: Her endurance helped her finish the long race without stopping.
endurance.exampleZh: 她的忍耐力帮助她不停歇地跑完了那场长跑。

endure.example: She had to endure the cold weather for three long days.
endure.exampleZh: 她不得不忍受三天的寒冷天气。

enemy.example: He has many enemies at work, but he still tries to be kind.
enemy.exampleZh: 他在工作中有很多敌人，但他仍然努力保持友善。

energetic.example: The energetic children ran around the park all afternoon.
energetic.exampleZh: 那些精力充沛的孩子整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。

energy.example: The children have a lot of energy after their long morning nap.
energy.exampleZh: 孩子们上午睡了很久，现在精力充沛。

enforce.example: The police must enforce the law and keep everyone safe.
enforce.exampleZh: 警察必须执行法律，保障每个人的安全。

engage.example: The teacher used games to engage her students in the lesson.
engage.exampleZh: 老师用游戏让学生们投入到课程中。

engagement.example: Their engagement was announced at a small family dinner last week.
engagement.exampleZh: 他们的订婚消息是在上周的一次小型家庭聚餐上宣布的。

engine.example: The engine of the old car stopped working on the way home.
engine.exampleZh: 那辆旧车的发动机在回家路上停止了工作。

engineer.example: My father is an engineer and he works in a big factory.
engineer.exampleZh: 我父亲是一名工程师，他在一家大工厂工作。

engineering.example: My brother studies engineering at a large university in the north.
engineering.exampleZh: 我哥哥在北方的一所大型大学学习工程学。

enhance.example: Good lighting can enhance the beauty of a small room.
enhance.exampleZh: 良好的照明可以提升小房间的美感。

enjoy.example: I really enjoy reading books in the park on sunny days.
enjoy.exampleZh: 我很喜欢在晴天去公园读书。

enjoyable.example: The picnic by the lake was very enjoyable for the whole family.
enjoyable.exampleZh: 湖边野餐让全家人感到非常愉快。

enlarge.example: We plan to enlarge the photo and put it on the wall.
enlarge.exampleZh: 我们打算把这张照片放大后挂在墙上。

enormous.example: The elephant is an enormous animal with a long nose.
enormous.exampleZh: 大象是一种长着长鼻子的庞大动物。

enough.example: We have enough food for everyone at the party tonight.
enough.exampleZh: 我们有足够的食物供今晚聚会上的每个人吃。

enquire.example: I will enquire about the train times at the station.
enquire.exampleZh: 我会在车站询问火车时刻。

enquiry.example: I made an enquiry at the front desk about the train times.
enquiry.exampleZh: 我在前台询问了火车的时刻。

ensure.example: We must check the door to ensure that it is locked.
ensure.exampleZh: 我们必须检查门，以确保它是锁好的。

enter.example: Please knock on the door before you enter the meeting room.
enter.exampleZh: 进入会议室前请先敲门。

enterprise.example: She works for a large enterprise and enjoys her job.
enterprise.exampleZh: 她在一家大型企业工作，并且很喜欢这份工作。

entertain.example: We will entertain some friends at home this weekend.
entertain.exampleZh: 这个周末我们会在家里招待一些朋友。

entertainment.example: Music and movies are popular forms of entertainment for young people.
entertainment.exampleZh: 音乐和电影是年轻人常见的娱乐形式。

enthusiasm.example: Her enthusiasm for music made everyone in the class want to learn.
enthusiasm.exampleZh: 她对音乐的热情让班上每个人都想学习。

enthusiastic.example: The students were very enthusiastic about the school trip to the museum.
enthusiastic.exampleZh: 学生们对去博物馆的学校旅行非常热情。

entire.example: She spent the entire day cleaning the whole house.
entire.exampleZh: 她花了一整天时间打扫整栋房子。

entirely.example: I entirely forgot about the meeting this morning.
entirely.exampleZh: 我完全忘了今天上午的会议。

entitle.example: This ticket entitles you to a free drink at the show.
entitle.exampleZh: 这张票让你有权在演出时免费领取一杯饮料。

entity.example: Each entity in the database has its own name and number.
entity.exampleZh: 数据库中的每个实体都有自己的名称和编号。

entrance.example: We waited for her at the main entrance of the school.

entry.example: The main entry to the building is on the left side.
entry.exampleZh: 这栋大楼的主要入口在左侧。

envelope.example: She put the letter in an envelope and mailed it.
envelope.exampleZh: 她把信放进信封里，然后寄了出去。

environment.example: We should all work together to protect the environment around us.
environment.exampleZh: 我们都应该共同努力保护我们周围的环境。

environmental.example: We must protect the environmental health of our city.
environmental.exampleZh: 我们必须保护我们城市的环境健康。

envy.example: I envy her ability to stay calm during difficult times.
envy.exampleZh: 我羡慕她在困难时期保持冷静的能力。

equal.example: All students should have equal chances to ask questions in class.
equal.exampleZh: 所有学生在课堂上都应该有平等的提问机会。

equality.example: We believe that equality between all people is very important in our school.
equality.exampleZh: 我们相信，在学校里所有人之间的平等非常重要。

equally.example: All the students worked equally hard on the group project last week.
equally.exampleZh: 上周所有学生在这个小组项目上都同样努力。

equation.example: We solved the equation together in class today.
equation.exampleZh: 我们今天在课上一起解了这个方程。

equip.example: The school will equip every classroom with a new computer this year.
equip.exampleZh: 学校今年将为每间教室配备一台新电脑。

equipment.example: The school bought new equipment for the science lab.
equipment.exampleZh: 学校为科学实验室购买了新设备。

equivalent.example: One mile is equivalent to about 1.6 kilometers.

era.example: The internet changed the way we live in this new era.
era.exampleZh: 互联网在这个新时代改变了我们的生活方式。

erect.example: The workers will erect a new fence around the garden tomorrow.
erect.exampleZh: 工人们明天将在花园周围竖起一道新栅栏。

erosion.example: Wind and water can cause serious erosion of the soil.
erosion.exampleZh: 风和雨水会造成土壤的严重侵蚀。

error.example: This small error in the report caused a big problem.
error.exampleZh: 报告中的这个小错误引发了一个大问题。

erupt.example: The volcano could erupt at any time, so the villagers left the area.
erupt.exampleZh: 这座火山随时可能喷发，所以村民们离开了这个地区。

escape.example: The bird tried to escape from its cage but could not.
escape.exampleZh: 那只鸟试图从笼子里逃走，但没能成功。

especially.example: I love fruit, especially apples and oranges in summer.
especially.exampleZh: 我喜欢水果，尤其是夏天的苹果和橙子。

essay.example: She wrote a short essay about her summer holiday for the school magazine.
essay.exampleZh: 她为校刊写了一篇关于暑假生活的短文。

essence.example: The essence of her idea is simple and clear.
essence.exampleZh: 她这个想法的本质简单明了。

essential.example: Water is essential for life, so we must drink enough every day.
essential.exampleZh: 水对生命来说必不可少，所以我们每天都必须喝足够的水。

establish.example: The school was established in 1950 and now has over 800 students.
establish.exampleZh: 这所学校建于1950年，现在有800多名学生。

establishment.example: The establishment of the new school took two years.
establishment.exampleZh: 这所新学校的建立花了两年时间。

estate.example: My uncle left a small estate to his two children.
estate.exampleZh: 我叔叔把一小笔遗产留给了他的两个孩子。

estimate.example: We estimate that the trip will take about three hours by car.
estimate.exampleZh: 我们估计开车这趟旅行大约需要三个小时。

ethics.example: The professor teaches ethics to students who want to work in medicine.
ethics.exampleZh: 这位教授给想从事医学工作的学生讲授伦理学。

ethnic.example: This city is famous for its many ethnic restaurants and markets.
ethnic.exampleZh: 这座城市以众多异族风味的餐馆和市场而闻名。

european.example: My European friends like to travel by train in summer.
european.exampleZh: 我的欧洲朋友们喜欢在夏天乘火车旅行。

evaluate.example: Teachers evaluate our work at the end of every term.
evaluate.exampleZh: 老师在每学期末评估我们的作业。

evaluation.example: The teacher's evaluation of my work was fair and helpful.
evaluation.exampleZh: 老师对我作业的评价既公正又有帮助。

even.example: The road is even, so it is easy to ride a bike here.
even.exampleZh: 这条路很平坦，所以在这里骑自行车很容易。

evening.example: We often take a walk after dinner in the evening.
evening.exampleZh: 我们经常在晚上晚饭后散步。

event.example: The school event was a big success for everyone.
event.exampleZh: 这次学校活动对每个人来说都非常成功。

eventually.example: After many tries, he eventually found the key under the old sofa.
eventually.exampleZh: 试了很多次之后，他终于在旧沙发下面找到了钥匙。

ever.example: This is the best movie I have ever seen in my life.
ever.exampleZh: 这是我这辈子看过的最好的电影。

every.example: Every student in the class has a new book.
every.exampleZh: 班上的每个学生都有一本新书。

everybody.example: Everybody in our class likes the new teacher very much.
everybody.exampleZh: 我们班上每个人都很喜欢这位新老师。

everyday.example: Reading the news is part of my everyday morning routine.
everyday.exampleZh: 读新闻是我每天早晨的日常习惯。

everyone.example: Everyone in my class likes the new teacher very much.
everyone.exampleZh: 我们班每个人都很喜欢这位新老师。

everything.example: She told me everything about her trip to the old town.
everything.exampleZh: 她把去老城旅行的一切都告诉了我。

everywhere.example: There are small shops everywhere in this old town.
everywhere.exampleZh: 这座老城里到处都是小商店。

evidence.example: The police found new evidence that helped them solve the case quickly.
evidence.exampleZh: 警方找到了新证据，这帮助他们很快破了案。

evident.example: It is evident that she enjoys teaching the young children.
evident.exampleZh: 很明显，她喜欢教这些小孩子。

evidently.example: He was evidently very tired after the long train journey.
evidently.exampleZh: 长途火车旅行之后，他显然非常疲惫。

evil.example: The evil king wanted to take all the land from the poor farmers.
evil.exampleZh: 那个邪恶的国王想夺走贫苦农民的所有土地。

evolution.example: The evolution of language takes many years.
evolution.exampleZh: 语言的演变需要很多年。

evolve.example: Small changes in our habits evolve into big results over time.
evolve.exampleZh: 我们习惯中的小改变会随着时间逐步发展成巨大的成果。

exact.example: Please give me the exact time of the meeting tomorrow morning.
exact.exampleZh: 请告诉我明天上午会议的确切时间。

exaggerate.example: He likes to exaggerate the size of the fish he catches.

exam.example: I have a math exam tomorrow, so I need to study tonight.
exam.exampleZh: 我明天有一场数学考试，所以今晚需要学习。

examination.example: The doctor gave him a careful examination and said he was healthy.
examination.exampleZh: 医生给他做了仔细的检查，说他很健康。

examine.example: The doctor examined my eyes and said I needed glasses.
examine.exampleZh: 医生检查了我的眼睛，说我需要戴眼镜。

example.example: This is a good example of how small daily habits can change a person's life.
example.exampleZh: 这是一个很好的例子，说明日常小习惯如何能改变一个人的生活。

exceed.example: Our sales this year exceed last year's total by a large amount.
exceed.exampleZh: 我们今年的销售额大幅超过了去年的总额。

excellent.example: She is an excellent teacher and all her students love her class.
excellent.exampleZh: 她是一位优秀的老师，所有学生都喜欢她的课。

except.example: Everyone in my class went to the party except Tom and his sister.
except.exampleZh: 我们班除了汤姆和他妹妹，其他人都去参加了聚会。

exception.example: Everyone must follow the rule, and no one is an exception.
exception.exampleZh: 每个人都必须遵守规则，没有人是例外。

exceptional.example: Her work on the project was exceptional and the whole team praised it.
exceptional.exampleZh: 她在这个项目上的表现非常出色，整个团队都称赞她。

excess.example: Eating too much sugar leads to an excess of fat in the body.
excess.exampleZh: 吃太多糖会导致体内脂肪过量。

excessive.example: The teacher said excessive noise in the classroom makes it hard for others to learn.
excessive.exampleZh: 老师说教室里过分的吵闹会让其他人很难学习。

exchange.example: We often exchange small gifts with our friends at Christmas.
exchange.exampleZh: 圣诞节时我们经常和朋友们互换小礼物。

excite.example: The good news excited all the students in our class.
excite.exampleZh: 这个好消息让我们班上所有的学生都很兴奋。

excitement.example: The children jumped up and down with excitement when they saw the snow.
excitement.exampleZh: 孩子们看到雪时兴奋得跳上跳下。

exciting.example: The football game was very exciting for all the young students.
exciting.exampleZh: 这场足球比赛对所有年轻学生来说都非常令人兴奋。

exclaim.example: She exclaimed in surprise when she saw the big gift.
exclaim.exampleZh: 她看到那份大礼物时惊讶地叫了起来。

exclude.example: The teacher decided to exclude him from the team.
exclude.exampleZh: 老师决定把他排除在队伍之外。

exclusive.example: This club is exclusive and only a few members can join it.
exclusive.exampleZh: 这家俱乐部是排他性的，只有少数会员才能加入。

excuse.example: Please excuse me for being late; my car broke down on the way.
excuse.exampleZh: 请原谅我迟到了，我的车在路上抛锚了。

execute.example: The judge said they will execute the plan and then execute the prisoner.
execute.exampleZh: 法官说他们会执行这个计划，然后处死那名囚犯。

executive.example: The executive made a quick decision about the new project.
executive.exampleZh: 这位主管对新项目做出了快速决定。

exercise.example: Regular exercise keeps your body strong and your mind clear.
exercise.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能让你的身体强壮、头脑清晰。

exhaust.example: The long trip exhausted the children, and the old car's exhaust was very loud.
exhaust.exampleZh: 长途旅行使孩子们筋疲力尽，那辆旧车的排气声也很响。

exhibit.example: The museum will exhibit many old paintings from China next month.
exhibit.exampleZh: 博物馆下个月将展出许多来自中国的古老画作。

exhibition.example: We went to an art exhibition in the city last weekend.
exhibition.exampleZh: 上周末我们去了城里的一场艺术展览。

exile.example: The writer spent ten years in exile before returning to his own country.
exile.exampleZh: 这位作家流亡十年后才回到自己的国家。

exist.example: Many people believe that life may exist on other planets.
exist.exampleZh: 许多人相信其他星球上可能存在生命。

existence.example: The existence of water on this planet makes life possible.
existence.exampleZh: 这颗星球上水的存在使生命成为可能。

exit.example: Please use the back exit when you leave the building.

expand.example: Heat makes the metal expand, so the bridge needs small gaps.
expand.exampleZh: 热量会使金属膨胀，所以桥梁需要留出小的缝隙。

expansion.example: The company's rapid expansion created many new jobs in our town.
expansion.exampleZh: 公司的快速扩张在我们镇上创造了许多新工作岗位。

expect.example: I expect the bus will come soon.
expect.exampleZh: 我预计公交车很快就会来。

expectation.example: Her parents have high expectations for her future.
expectation.exampleZh: 她的父母对她的未来抱有很高的期望。

expense.example: The trip was fun, but the travel expenses were too high for us.
expense.exampleZh: 这次旅行很有趣，但旅费对我们来说太高了。

expensive.example: This watch is too expensive for me to buy today.
expensive.exampleZh: 这块手表太贵了，我今天买不起。

experience.example: She has many years of experience in teaching young children.
experience.exampleZh: 她在教幼儿方面有多年经验。

experiment.example: We did a simple experiment in the science class yesterday.
experiment.exampleZh: 我们昨天在科学课上做了一个简单的实验。

experimental.example: The scientists are testing an experimental drug on a small group of patients.
experimental.exampleZh: 科学家正在一小群病人身上测试一种实验性药物。

expert.example: She is an expert in computer science and teaches at a famous university.
expert.exampleZh: 她是计算机科学方面的专家，在一所著名大学任教。

expertise.example: Her expertise in computer science helped the team solve the problem quickly.
expertise.exampleZh: 她在计算机科学方面的专长帮助团队迅速解决了问题。

explain.example: Let me explain the rules to you before we start the game.
explain.exampleZh: 在我们开始游戏之前，让我向你解释一下规则。

explanation.example: Her explanation of the problem was clear and easy to understand.
explanation.exampleZh: 她对问题的解释清晰易懂。

explode.example: The old car exploded with a loud noise on the quiet street.
explode.exampleZh: 那辆旧车在安静的街道上发出一声巨响爆炸了。

exploit.example: Some companies exploit young workers by making them work long hours.
exploit.exampleZh: 一些公司通过让年轻工人长时间工作来剥削他们。

exploration.example: Their exploration of the deep cave took three days and nights.
exploration.exampleZh: 他们对这个深洞的勘探花了三天三夜。

explore.example: We plan to explore the old forest near our town this summer.
explore.exampleZh: 我们计划今年夏天去探索小镇附近的古老森林。

explosion.example: The explosion broke several windows in the old building.
explosion.exampleZh: 那次爆炸震碎了那栋旧楼的几扇窗户。

explosive.example: The news caused an explosive reaction from the angry crowd outside.
explosive.exampleZh: 这个消息在门外愤怒的人群中引起了爆炸性的反应。

export.example: China exports many goods to other countries every year.
export.exampleZh: 中国每年向其他国家出口许多商品。

expose.example: The news report tried to expose the truth behind the accident.
expose.exampleZh: 这篇新闻报道试图揭露事故背后的真相。

exposure.example: Too much exposure to the sun can harm your skin.
exposure.exampleZh: 过度暴露在阳光下会伤害你的皮肤。

express.example: She could not express her feelings in words, so she smiled.
express.exampleZh: 她无法用语言表达自己的感情，所以她笑了笑。

expression.example: Her sad expression told me that something was wrong.
expression.exampleZh: 她难过的表情告诉我出事了。

extend.example: They plan to extend the meeting until five today because of the new plan.
extend.exampleZh: 由于新计划，他们打算把会议延长到今天五点。
