extension.example: The hotel added a new extension with ten more rooms.
extension.exampleZh: 酒店新建了一个扩建部分，增加了十个房间。

extensive.example: The city has extensive parks and many people walk there every day.
extensive.exampleZh: 这座城市有大片公园，很多人每天都在那里散步。

extent.example: To some extent, I understand why she made that choice.
extent.exampleZh: 在某种程度上，我理解她为什么做出那个选择。

external.example: The external door was locked, so we used the side entrance.
external.exampleZh: 外面的门锁着，所以我们走了侧门。

extra.example: The hotel charges extra for breakfast, so we usually eat outside.
extra.exampleZh: 酒店早餐要额外收费，所以我们通常在外面吃。

extraordinary.example: She has an extraordinary memory and can remember every name.
extraordinary.exampleZh: 她的记忆力非凡，能记住每一个名字。

extreme.example: The weather in the desert is extreme, with hot days and cold nights.
extreme.exampleZh: 沙漠里的天气很极端，白天很热，夜晚很冷。

extremely.example: The test was extremely hard, so many students could not finish it.
extremely.exampleZh: 这次考试极其难，所以很多学生没能做完。

eye.example: She closed her eyes and listened to the soft music.
eye.exampleZh: 她闭上眼睛，听着轻柔的音乐。

eyebrow.example: She raised one eyebrow when she heard the strange question.
eyebrow.exampleZh: 听到那个奇怪的问题时，她挑起了一边眉毛。

eyesight.example: Good eyesight is important when you learn to drive a car.
eyesight.exampleZh: 学开车时，良好的视力很重要。

fabric.example: The soft fabric of this shirt feels very comfortable in summer.
fabric.exampleZh: 这件衬衫的柔软布料在夏天穿起来很舒服。

face.example: She washed her face and went to face the busy day.
face.exampleZh: 她洗了脸，然后去面对忙碌的一天。

facial.example: She washed her facial skin with warm water every morning.
facial.exampleZh: 她每天早上用温水洗脸上的皮肤。

facilitate.example: Good roads facilitate travel between small towns and big cities.
facilitate.exampleZh: 良好的道路使小城镇与大都市之间的出行更加便利。

facility.example: This school has a new sports facility for all the students.
facility.exampleZh: 这所学校为全体学生新建了一个体育设施。

fact.example: The fact is that he never told us the truth.
fact.exampleZh: 事实是他从未告诉我们真相。

factor.example: Cost is an important factor when we choose a new car.
factor.exampleZh: 当我们选择新车时，价格是一个重要因素。

factory.example: My father works in a large factory near our home.
factory.exampleZh: 我父亲在我们家附近的一家大工厂工作。

faculty.example: She has a remarkable faculty for learning new languages quickly.
faculty.exampleZh: 她有迅速学会新语言的非凡才能。

fade.example: The color of my old shirt will fade after many washes.
fade.exampleZh: 我的旧衬衫洗多次后会褪色。

fail.example: If you do not study, you will fail the test tomorrow.
fail.exampleZh: 如果你不学习，明天的考试你就会不及格。

failure.example: His failure to answer the question made the teacher angry.
failure.exampleZh: 他没能回答出这个问题，这让老师很生气。

faint.example: She felt faint in the hot room and sat down quickly.
faint.exampleZh: 她在闷热的房间里感到头晕，于是赶紧坐下。

fair.example: We must be fair to everyone and give them a real chance.
fair.exampleZh: 我们必须对每个人公平，给他们一个真正的机会。

fairly.example: The teacher treats all her students fairly and never picks favourites.
fairly.exampleZh: 这位老师公平地对待所有学生，从不偏爱谁。

fairy.example: The little girl said a fairy lived in the garden behind her house.
fairy.exampleZh: 那个小女孩说一位仙女住在她家后面的花园里。

faith.example: She has great faith in her younger brother.

faithful.example: A faithful friend will always stand by you through hard times.
faithful.exampleZh: 忠诚的朋友在艰难时刻总会支持你。

fake.example: She wore a fake smile and said nothing about the broken vase.
fake.exampleZh: 她假装笑了笑，对打碎的花瓶只字未提。

fall.example: Leaves fall from the trees in autumn, and the water falls fast.
fall.exampleZh: 秋天叶子从树上落下，水也流得很快。

false.example: His answer was false, so the teacher asked him to try again.
false.exampleZh: 他的答案是错的，所以老师让他再试一次。

fame.example: His fame grew quickly after the song became popular around the world.
fame.exampleZh: 这首歌在全球流行之后，他的名声迅速增长。

familiar.example: This street looks familiar to me because I grew up here.
familiar.exampleZh: 这条街对我来说很熟悉，因为我在这里长大。

family.example: My family likes to eat dinner together every evening.
family.exampleZh: 我的家人喜欢每天晚上一起吃晚饭。

famine.example: The long war left the country in famine and many children were very hungry.
famine.exampleZh: 漫长的战争使这个国家陷入饥荒，许多孩子非常饥饿。

famous.example: This city is famous for its beautiful old bridges.
famous.exampleZh: 这座城市以其美丽的古老桥梁而闻名。

fan.example: The fan sat in the front row and waved a small paper fan.
fan.exampleZh: 那个球迷坐在前排，挥动着一把小纸扇。

fancy.example: I fancy a cup of tea after this long walk.
fancy.exampleZh: 走了这么远的路，我想喝杯茶。

fantastic.example: The view from the top of the hill was fantastic.
fantastic.exampleZh: 从山顶看到的景色好极了。

fantasy.example: She likes fantasy books because they take her to amazing new worlds.
fantasy.exampleZh: 她喜欢奇幻小说，因为它们能把她带入奇妙的新世界。

far.example: The station is not far from my new house.
far.exampleZh: 车站离我的新房子不远。

fare.example: The bus fare is two dollars, so I walk to work.
fare.exampleZh: 公交车费是两美元，所以我步行去上班。

farewell.example: We said farewell to our teacher at the station this morning.
farewell.exampleZh: 今天早上我们在车站向老师告别。

farm.example: My uncle lives on a small farm and grows rice there.
farm.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在一个小农场里，在那里种水稻。

farmer.example: The old farmer works hard in his field every day.
farmer.exampleZh: 这位老农民每天都在田里辛勤劳动。

farther.example: The bank is farther from my house than the school.
farther.exampleZh: 银行比学校离我家更远。

fascinate.example: The stars in the night sky fascinate my little brother very much.
fascinate.exampleZh: 夜空中的星星让我弟弟非常着迷。

fashion.example: She always wears clothes in a very simple fashion.
fashion.exampleZh: 她穿衣服总是采用非常朴素的方式。

fashionable.example: She always wears fashionable clothes to work.
fashionable.exampleZh: 她上班总是穿时髦的衣服。

fast.example: He is a fast runner and never eats breakfast because he fasts.
fast.exampleZh: 他是个跑得很快的人，而且从不吃早餐，因为他禁食。

fasten.example: Please fasten your seat belt before the plane takes off.
fasten.exampleZh: 请在飞机起飞前系好安全带。

fat.example: Too much fat in your food can make you fat.
fat.exampleZh: 食物中脂肪过多会让你变胖。

fatal.example: The car crash was fatal, and nobody in the small car survived.
fatal.exampleZh: 那场车祸是致命的，小车里没有人幸存。

fate.example: She believed that fate had brought them together.
fate.exampleZh: 她相信是命运把他们带到了一起。

father.example: My father teaches me how to ride a bike every weekend.
father.exampleZh: 我父亲每个周末都教我骑自行车。

fatigue.example: After a long day at work, she felt a deep fatigue.
fatigue.exampleZh: 工作了一整天后，她感到深深的疲劳。

fault.example: It is not your fault that the old machine stopped working.
fault.exampleZh: 那台旧机器停了不是你的过错。

faulty.example: The washing machine is faulty, so we cannot use it today.
faulty.exampleZh: 这台洗衣机有故障，所以我们今天不能使用它。

favor.example: I asked my friend for a favor, and she kindly helped me.
favor.exampleZh: 我请朋友帮个忙，她很热心地帮助了我。

favorable.example: The weather was favorable for our trip to the beach.
favorable.exampleZh: 天气对我们的海滩之行很有利。

favorite.example: My favorite color is blue, and I wear it almost every day.
favorite.exampleZh: 我最喜爱的颜色是蓝色，我几乎每天都穿这个颜色。

fax.example: Please fax the signed contract to our office this afternoon.
fax.exampleZh: 请今天下午把签好的合同传真到我们办公室。

fear.example: Many people fear failure, but fear can also keep us safe.
fear.exampleZh: 许多人害怕失败，但恐惧也能保护我们的安全。

feasible.example: It is not feasible to finish this work in one day.
feasible.exampleZh: 一天之内完成这项工作是不可行的。

feast.example: The family had a big feast to celebrate the New Year together.
feast.exampleZh: 一家人举办了一场盛大的宴会，一起庆祝新年。

feather.example: The bird has soft blue feathers on its small head.
feather.exampleZh: 这只鸟的小脑袋上长着柔软的蓝色羽毛。

feature.example: The new phone has a camera with many useful features.
feature.exampleZh: 这款新手机的摄像头有许多实用的功能。

february.example: My birthday is in February, and it is usually very cold then.
february.exampleZh: 我的生日在二月，那时通常很冷。

federal.example: The federal government makes rules that every state must follow.
federal.exampleZh: 联邦政府制定的规则每个州都必须遵守。

fee.example: The lawyer charged a high fee for his help with the case.
fee.exampleZh: 律师为协助处理这个案子收取了很高的费用。

feed.example: My mother feeds the birds in the garden every morning.
feed.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上在花园里喂鸟。

feedback.example: The teacher gave me useful feedback on my English homework.
feedback.exampleZh: 老师对我的英语作业给出了有用的反馈。

feel.example: I feel happy when I see my friends at school.
feel.exampleZh: 我在学校看到朋友时感到很快乐。

feeling.example: I have a strange feeling in my stomach this morning.
feeling.exampleZh: 今天早上我的胃里有一种奇怪的感觉。

fellow.example: He is a friendly fellow who always helps his neighbors.
fellow.exampleZh: 他是个友善的家伙，总是帮助邻居。

female.example: The female doctor spoke kindly to the young child.
female.exampleZh: 那位女医生和蔼地对那个小孩说话。

fence.example: My father built a wooden fence around our small garden last summer.
fence.exampleZh: 去年夏天，我父亲在我们的小花园周围建了一道木栅栏。

festival.example: The whole family comes together to celebrate the Spring Festival every year.
festival.exampleZh: 每年全家人都会聚在一起庆祝春节。

fetch.example: Could you fetch me a glass of water from the kitchen?
fetch.exampleZh: 你能去厨房给我拿一杯水来吗？

fever.example: The little boy has a high fever and must stay in bed today.
fever.exampleZh: 这个小男孩发高烧，今天必须躺在床上休息。

few.example: Only a few students came to class early this morning.
few.exampleZh: 今天早上只有少数学生早早来到教室。

fiber.example: Eating more fiber helps your body stay healthy and strong.
fiber.exampleZh: 多吃纤维有助于身体保持健康和强壮。

fiction.example: This book is a work of fiction, not a true story.
fiction.exampleZh: 这本书是一部小说，不是真实的故事。

field.example: The children are playing in the green field behind the old school.
field.exampleZh: 孩子们正在旧学校后面的绿色田野里玩耍。

fierce.example: The fierce dog barked loudly at the strangers near the gate.
fierce.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗对着大门附近的陌生人狂吠。

fifteen.example: My sister is fifteen years old and she loves to read books.
fifteen.exampleZh: 我妹妹十五岁，她喜欢读书。

fifth.example: My office is on the fifth floor of that building.
fifth.exampleZh: 我的办公室在那栋楼的五楼。

fifty.example: My grandfather has lived in this small town for fifty years.
fifty.exampleZh: 我的祖父在这个小镇上住了五十年。

fight.example: Two brothers often fight over small things, but they still love each other.
fight.exampleZh: 两兄弟常常为小事打架，但他们依然彼此相爱。

figure.example: The figure in the painting looks like a famous person.
figure.exampleZh: 画中的那个人物看起来像一位名人。

file.example: I saved the report in a new file on my computer.
file.exampleZh: 我把报告保存在电脑上的一个新文件里。

fill.example: Please fill the glass with water before you put it on the table.
fill.exampleZh: 请把杯子装满水，再把它放到桌子上。

film.example: We watched a funny film about a small dog last night.
film.exampleZh: 我们昨晚看了一部关于一只小狗的有趣电影。

filter.example: Please use a filter to clean the water before you drink it.
filter.exampleZh: 喝水前请用过滤器把水净化一下。

final.example: This is the final game of the season, so we must win.
final.exampleZh: 这是本赛季的最后一场比赛，所以我们必须赢。

finally.example: After three long hours, the bus finally arrived at the station.
finally.exampleZh: 经过漫长的三个小时后，公共汽车终于到站了。

finance.example: My father works in finance and helps small companies find the money they need.
finance.exampleZh: 我父亲从事金融工作，帮助小公司找到所需的资金。

financial.example: The company is in serious financial trouble after losing its biggest customer.
financial.exampleZh: 这家公司在失去最大客户后陷入了严重的财务困境。

find.example: I hope we can find the missing keys before dinner.
find.exampleZh: 我希望我们能在晚饭前找到丢失的钥匙。

finding.example: The new finding may help doctors treat this common disease.
finding.exampleZh: 这一新发现可能有助于医生治疗这种常见疾病。

fine.example: The weather is fine today, so we can walk to the park.
fine.exampleZh: 今天天气很好，我们可以步行去公园。

finger.example: She cut her finger on a sharp piece of glass.
finger.exampleZh: 她被一块锋利的玻璃割伤了手指。

finish.example: I will finish my homework before dinner tonight.
finish.exampleZh: 我今晚会在晚饭前完成作业。

fire.example: We made a fire in the garden and cooked dinner.
fire.exampleZh: 我们在花园里生了一堆火并做晚饭。

fireman.example: The fireman quickly carried the child out of the burning house.
fireman.exampleZh: 消防员迅速把孩子从燃烧的房子里抱了出来。

firm.example: She works for a small firm and has firm beliefs.
firm.exampleZh: 她在一家小公司工作，并且信念坚定。

first.example: This is my first time visiting the city, so everything looks new.
first.exampleZh: 这是我第一次来这座城市，所以一切看起来都很新鲜。

fish.example: We often fish in the river near our small village on sunny days.
fish.exampleZh: 天气晴朗的时候，我们常常在小村庄附近的河里钓鱼。

fisherman.example: The old fisherman goes to the sea early every morning.
fisherman.exampleZh: 那位老渔民每天清晨都出海。

fishing.example: My father goes fishing every Sunday morning at the lake near our house.
fishing.exampleZh: 我父亲每个星期天早上都去我们家附近的湖边钓鱼。

fit.example: This jacket does not fit me well, so I will try another size.
fit.exampleZh: 这件夹克不太适合我，所以我打算试另一个尺码。

fitness.example: Regular exercise is important for your fitness and your health.
fitness.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的体能和健康都很重要。

five.example: My little sister is five years old and she starts school today.
five.exampleZh: 我的小妹妹五岁了，她今天开始上学。

fix.example: Can you fix my bike before we go to the park?
fix.exampleZh: 我们去公园之前你能把我的自行车修好吗？

flag.example: The flag of our country is red and has five stars.
flag.exampleZh: 我们国家的旗帜是红色的，上面有五颗星。

flame.example: The flame of the campfire kept us warm all night.
flame.exampleZh: 篝火的火焰让我们整夜都感到温暖。

flash.example: A bright flash of light came from the camera.
flash.exampleZh: 相机里发出一道明亮的闪光。

flat.example: The land near the river is flat and good for farming.
flat.exampleZh: 河边的土地很平坦，适合耕种。

flavor.example: This soup has a rich flavor, so please add a little salt.
flavor.exampleZh: 这汤味道很浓，请再加一点盐。

flee.example: The family had to flee their home when the fire spread quickly.
flee.exampleZh: 火势迅速蔓延时，这家人不得不逃离家园。

fleet.example: The country sent a large fleet of ships to protect the coast.
fleet.exampleZh: 这个国家派出了一支庞大的舰队来保护海岸。

flesh.example: The knife cut deep into the flesh of the fruit.
flesh.exampleZh: 刀深深地切进了果肉里。

flexibility.example: Yoga helps me keep flexibility in my body as I get older.
flexibility.exampleZh: 随着年龄增长，瑜伽帮助我保持身体的灵活性。

flexible.example: A flexible person can change plans when something unexpected happens.
flexible.exampleZh: 灵活的人在遇到意外情况时能够改变计划。

flight.example: Our flight to Beijing was delayed because of the heavy snow.
flight.exampleZh: 我们飞往北京的航班因大雪延误了。

float.example: A red leaf floats slowly on the quiet water.
float.exampleZh: 一片红叶在平静的水面上缓缓漂浮。

flock.example: A flock of birds flew over the lake this morning.
flock.exampleZh: 今天早晨一群鸟飞过了湖面。

flood.example: The heavy rain caused a flood that covered the whole village.
flood.exampleZh: 大雨引发了一场洪水，淹没了整个村庄。

floor.example: The children sat on the floor and played with their toys.
floor.exampleZh: 孩子们坐在地板上玩玩具。

flour.example: My mother needs some flour to make bread for our family.
flour.exampleZh: 我妈妈需要一些面粉来为我们家做面包。

flourish.example: Small shops flourish when the streets are clean and safe.
flourish.exampleZh: 当街道干净又安全时，小商铺就会兴旺起来。

flow.example: The river flows slowly through the small town and into the sea.
flow.exampleZh: 这条河缓缓流经这个小镇，然后流入大海。

flower.example: She put a beautiful red flower in the small vase on the table.
flower.exampleZh: 她把一朵美丽的红花插进桌上的小花瓶里。

flu.example: I stayed home from school last week because I had the flu.
flu.exampleZh: 上周我因为得了流行性感冒而待在家里没去学校。

fluctuate.example: Prices fluctuate a lot during the holiday season.
fluctuate.exampleZh: 假期期间价格波动很大。

fluent.example: She speaks fluent English and often helps her friends with their homework.
fluent.exampleZh: 她说一口流利的英语，经常帮助朋友们做作业。

fluid.example: The doctor told him to drink more fluids and get some rest.
fluid.exampleZh: 医生告诉他多喝些液体并休息一下。

flush.example: Her face began to flush when the teacher praised her in class.
flush.exampleZh: 老师在课堂上表扬她时，她的脸开始变红。

fly.example: A fly can fly through the open window and out again.
fly.exampleZh: 一只苍蝇能飞过开着的窗户再飞出去。

focus.example: She needs to focus on her studies before the exam next week.
focus.exampleZh: 她需要在下周考试前集中精力学习。

fog.example: The fog was so thick that we could not see the road.
fog.exampleZh: 雾太浓了，我们看不见路。

fold.example: She will fold the clean clothes and put them in the box.
fold.exampleZh: 她将把干净的衣服折叠好，放进盒子里。

folk.example: I love to listen to old folk songs from my hometown.
folk.exampleZh: 我喜欢听家乡的古老民歌。

follow.example: Please follow me and I will show you the way.
follow.exampleZh: 请跟着我，我来给你指路。

following.example: The following day, we went back to school and saw all our friends.
following.exampleZh: 第二天，我们回到学校，见到了所有的朋友。

fond.example: She is very fond of her little dog and walks it every morning.
fond.exampleZh: 她非常喜爱她的小狗，每天早上都带它去散步。

food.example: We buy fresh food at the market every Saturday morning.
food.exampleZh: 我们每周六早上在市场买新鲜食物。

fool.example: It is not kind to fool your friends with that silly joke.
fool.exampleZh: 用那个愚蠢的玩笑愚弄朋友是不友善的。

foolish.example: It was foolish of him to leave his bag open on the bus.
foolish.exampleZh: 他把包敞着放在公交车上，真是愚蠢。

foot.example: My left foot hurts after the long walk.
foot.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，我的左脚疼。

football.example: My brother plays football with his friends every Sunday afternoon.
football.exampleZh: 我哥哥每个星期天下午都和朋友们踢足球。

footstep.example: I heard his footsteps on the stairs late at night.
footstep.exampleZh: 深夜里我听到他在楼梯上的脚步声。

for.example: I made this cake for you because you like sweet food.
for.exampleZh: 我为你做了这个蛋糕，因为你觉得甜食好吃。

forbid.example: My parents forbid me to play computer games late at night.
forbid.exampleZh: 我父母禁止我在深夜玩电脑游戏。

force.example: The police used force to stop the crowd from entering the building.
force.exampleZh: 警方使用武力阻止人群进入大楼。

forecast.example: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow morning.
forecast.exampleZh: 天气预报说明天早上会下雨。

forehead.example: She put her hand on his forehead to check for a fever.
forehead.exampleZh: 她把手放在他的额头上，看看他有没有发烧。

foreign.example: She likes to learn about foreign countries and their cultures.
foreign.exampleZh: 她喜欢了解外国和它们的文化。

foreigner.example: The foreigner asked me for directions to the train station.
foreigner.exampleZh: 这位外国人向我询问去火车站的路。

forest.example: The children got lost in the forest and could not find their way home.
forest.exampleZh: 孩子们在森林里迷了路，找不到回家的路。

forever.example: I will always remember the happy days we spent together forever.
forever.exampleZh: 我会永远记得我们一起度过的快乐时光。

forget.example: I always forget my keys when I leave the house in a hurry.
forget.exampleZh: 我每次匆忙出门时总是忘记带钥匙。

forgive.example: Please forgive me for being late this morning.
forgive.exampleZh: 请原谅我今天早上迟到了。

fork.example: Please put a clean fork and a knife beside my plate.
fork.exampleZh: 请在我的盘子旁边放一把干净的叉子和一把刀。

form.example: Please fill in this form with your name and address.
form.exampleZh: 请在这张表格上填写你的姓名和地址。

formal.example: You should wear formal clothes to the meeting tomorrow.
formal.exampleZh: 你明天开会应该穿正式的衣服。

format.example: Please change the format of this file before you send it to the team.
format.exampleZh: 请你先把这份文件的格式改好，再发送给团队。

formation.example: The formation of ice on the lake takes only one cold night.
formation.exampleZh: 湖面上冰的形成只需要一个寒冷的夜晚。

former.example: The former teacher now works at a small library near the school.
former.exampleZh: 这位以前的老师现在在学校附近的一家小图书馆工作。

formula.example: The scientist wrote a simple formula on the board for his students.
formula.exampleZh: 科学家在黑板上为学生们写了一个简单的公式。

forth.example: She stepped forth from the crowd and asked a simple question.
forth.exampleZh: 她从人群中向前走出，问了一个简单的问题。

fortnight.example: We will go on a trip to the mountains for a fortnight next month.
fortnight.exampleZh: 下个月我们将去山里旅行两个星期。

fortunate.example: I feel fortunate to have such kind friends and a happy family.
fortunate.exampleZh: 我感到幸运，能有这么友善的朋友和一个幸福的家庭。

fortunately.example: Fortunately, we found the last two tickets for the show.
fortunately.exampleZh: 幸运的是，我们找到了这场演出的最后两张票。

fortune.example: Good fortune brought him a new job and many kind friends.
fortune.exampleZh: 好运给他带来了一份新工作和许多友善的朋友。

forty.example: My grandmother lives on the forty-second floor of a tall building.
forty.exampleZh: 我的祖母住在一栋高楼的第四十二层。

forward.example: Please move your seat forward so we can all see the screen.
forward.exampleZh: 请把你的座位向前移，这样我们都能看到屏幕。

fossil.example: Scientists found a very old fossil in the rocks near the river.
fossil.exampleZh: 科学家在河边的岩石中发现了一块非常古老的化石。

foster.example: The school tries to foster a love of reading in every child.
foster.exampleZh: 学校努力培养每个孩子对阅读的热爱。

found.example: They founded a small school in their village last year.
found.exampleZh: 他们去年在村里创办了一所小学校。

foundation.example: Trust is the foundation of every good friendship.
foundation.exampleZh: 信任是每一段良好友谊的基础。

founder.example: The founder of the company started the business in a small room.
founder.exampleZh: 这家公司的创始人是在一个小房间里开始创业的。

fountain.example: The children played near the fountain in the park all afternoon.
fountain.exampleZh: 孩子们整个下午都在公园的喷泉旁玩耍。

four.example: My little sister is four years old and she loves red apples.
four.exampleZh: 我妹妹四岁了，她喜欢红苹果。

fourteen.example: My sister is fourteen years old and she loves playing basketball.
fourteen.exampleZh: 我妹妹十四岁，她喜欢打篮球。

fourth.example: My office is on the fourth floor of that old building.
fourth.exampleZh: 我的办公室在那栋旧楼的四楼。

fox.example: The fox ran across the field and hid behind a big tree.
fox.exampleZh: 那只狐狸跑过田野，躲到了一棵大树后面。

fraction.example: Only a small fraction of the students came to the extra class.
fraction.exampleZh: 只有一小部分学生来上了这节额外的课。

fragment.example: The glass fell to the floor and broke into small fragments.
fragment.exampleZh: 玻璃杯掉到地上，摔成了小碎片。

frame.example: The police tried to frame him for a crime he did not commit.
frame.exampleZh: 警方试图陷害他，让他为一桩他并未犯下的罪行负责。

framework.example: The new framework helps teachers plan their lessons more clearly.
framework.exampleZh: 这个新框架帮助教师更清晰地规划课程。

frank.example: She was frank with me about the problems in our team.
frank.exampleZh: 她坦率地跟我谈了团队里的问题。

free.example: The museum is free for students, but you must free your bag before you enter.
free.exampleZh: 博物馆对学生免费，但你进去前必须把包寄存出来。

freedom.example: Everyone here has the freedom to say what they think.
freedom.exampleZh: 这里的每个人都有说出自己想法的自由。

freeze.example: The water in the small pond will freeze when the weather gets cold.
freeze.exampleZh: 天气变冷时，小池塘里的水会结冰。

freight.example: The freight from the factory arrived at the port this morning.
freight.exampleZh: 来自工厂的货物今天早上到达了港口。

frequency.example: The frequency of rain here is high in summer.
frequency.exampleZh: 这里夏天降雨的频率很高。

frequent.example: She makes frequent trips to the library to study for her exams.
frequent.exampleZh: 她频繁地去图书馆为考试复习。

fresh.example: I bought some fresh fruit and vegetables from the local market this morning.
fresh.exampleZh: 今天早上我从当地市场买了一些新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

friction.example: There was some friction between the two teams during the meeting.
friction.exampleZh: 会议期间两个团队之间出现了一些摩擦。

friday.example: We will meet again this Friday to talk about the new plan.
friday.exampleZh: 这个星期五我们会再见面，讨论新的计划。

friend.example: My best friend lives near my house and we walk to school together.
friend.exampleZh: 我最好的朋友住在我家附近，我们一起走路去上学。

friendly.example: Our new neighbors are very friendly and often help us in the garden.
friendly.exampleZh: 我们的新邻居非常友好，经常在花园里帮助我们。

friendship.example: True friendship is built on trust and honest communication between two people.
friendship.exampleZh: 真正的友谊建立在两个人之间的信任和坦诚沟通之上。

frighten.example: The loud noise might frighten the small children in the room.
frighten.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音可能会吓到房间里的孩子们。

frog.example: A small green frog jumped into the pond near our house yesterday.
frog.exampleZh: 昨天一只绿色的小青蛙跳进了我们家附近的池塘里。

from.example: She walked home from the station in about ten minutes.
from.exampleZh: 她从车站走回家大约用了十分钟。

front.example: Please wait for me in front of the school gate.
front.exampleZh: 请在学校大门前面等我。

frontier.example: The internet is still a new frontier for many older people.
frontier.exampleZh: 对许多老年人来说，互联网仍然是一个新领域。

frost.example: The grass was white with frost this morning.
frost.exampleZh: 今天早上草地上结满了白霜。

frown.example: My father began to frown when he saw my low test score.
frown.exampleZh: 我父亲看到我考试分数低时开始皱眉头。

fruit.example: Fresh fruit and vegetables are good for your health every day.
fruit.exampleZh: 新鲜水果和蔬菜每天对你的健康有益。

fruitful.example: Working together every day was a fruitful way to finish the project.
fruitful.exampleZh: 每天一起合作是完成这个项目富有成效的方式。

frustrate.example: The many delays frustrated the workers and slowed down the whole project.
frustrate.exampleZh: 多次延误使工人们感到沮丧，也拖慢了整个项目的进度。

fry.example: My mother likes to fry eggs in the morning.
fry.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢在早上煎鸡蛋。

fuel.example: This car needs less fuel than the old one.
fuel.exampleZh: 这辆车比那辆旧车需要的燃料更少。

fulfill.example: She worked hard to fulfill her dream of becoming a teacher.
fulfill.exampleZh: 她努力工作，实现了当老师的梦想。

full.example: The glass is full of cold water, so please drink it slowly.
full.exampleZh: 杯子里装满了凉水，所以请慢慢喝。

fun.example: We had a lot of fun at the party last night.
fun.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在聚会上玩得很开心。

function.example: The function of this small button is to start the machine.
function.exampleZh: 这个小按钮的功能是启动机器。

fund.example: The school used the fund to buy new books for the library.
fund.exampleZh: 学校用这笔资金为图书馆购买了新书。

fundamental.example: Water is fundamental to all life on this planet.
fundamental.exampleZh: 水是这颗星球上一切生命的基础。

funeral.example: Many people came to the funeral to say goodbye to their old friend.
funeral.exampleZh: 许多人来参加葬礼，向他们的老朋友告别。

funny.example: The funny little dog makes everyone in our class laugh every day.
funny.exampleZh: 那只滑稽的小狗让我们班上每个人每天都笑。

fur.example: The cat has soft white fur and big green eyes.
fur.exampleZh: 这只猫有柔软的白毛和绿色的大眼睛。

furious.example: My father was furious when he saw the broken window.
furious.exampleZh: 我父亲看到破碎的窗户时非常愤怒。

furnish.example: They will furnish the new apartment with a sofa and two beds.
furnish.exampleZh: 他们会用一张沙发和两张床来布置新公寓。

furniture.example: We bought new furniture for the living room last week.
furniture.exampleZh: 上周我们为客厅买了新家具。

further.example: We need to further discuss this plan before making a final decision.
further.exampleZh: 在做最终决定之前，我们需要进一步讨论这个计划。

furthermore.example: The room is small and clean; furthermore, it is very close to the station.
furthermore.exampleZh: 房间虽小但很干净，而且离车站很近。

future.example: She is saving money now for a better future for her children.
future.exampleZh: 她现在存钱，是为了孩子们有更好的未来。

gain.example: She worked hard to gain more experience in her new job.
gain.exampleZh: 她努力工作，在新工作中获得更多经验。

galaxy.example: Our teacher showed us a picture of a distant galaxy last week.
galaxy.exampleZh: 上周老师给我们看了一张遥远星系的图片。

gallery.example: We spent the whole afternoon walking through the art gallery downtown.
gallery.exampleZh: 我们在市中心的美术馆里逛了一整个下午。

gallon.example: We bought two gallons of milk for the party on Saturday.
gallon.exampleZh: 我们为周六的聚会买了两加仑牛奶。

gamble.example: He likes to gamble on card games with his friends.
gamble.exampleZh: 他喜欢和朋友们玩牌赌博。

game.example: The children are playing a fun game in the park after school.
game.exampleZh: 放学后孩子们正在公园里玩一个有趣的游戏。

gang.example: A gang of kids was playing football in the park after school.
gang.exampleZh: 放学后，一帮孩子在公园里踢足球。

gap.example: The gap between the two houses is too small for a car.
gap.exampleZh: 两栋房子之间的间隙太小，汽车开不过去。

garage.example: My father keeps his old car in the garage.
garage.exampleZh: 我父亲把他的旧车停在车库里。

garbage.example: Please put the garbage in the bin outside the door.
garbage.exampleZh: 请把垃圾放到门外的垃圾桶里。

garden.example: My grandmother grows tomatoes and flowers in her small garden.
garden.exampleZh: 我奶奶在她的小花园里种西红柿和花。

garlic.example: My mother puts garlic in almost every dish she cooks.
garlic.exampleZh: 我妈妈几乎每道菜都会放蒜。

gas.example: Please turn off the gas before you leave the house.
gas.exampleZh: 离开房子之前请关掉煤气。

gasoline.example: The car stopped because it ran out of gasoline on the road.
gasoline.exampleZh: 汽车停在路上，因为汽油用完了。

gate.example: Please close the gate before the dog runs out.
gate.exampleZh: 请在大狗跑出去之前关上大门。

gather.example: We gather in the park every Sunday to play football together.
gather.exampleZh: 我们每个星期天都在公园聚集，一起踢足球。

gaze.example: She stopped to gaze at the stars for a long moment.
gaze.exampleZh: 她停下来凝视星空好一会儿。

gear.example: He changed gear before driving up the steep hill.
gear.exampleZh: 他在开上陡坡之前换了挡。

gender.example: Please write your name and gender on this form.
gender.exampleZh: 请在这张表格上写下你的姓名和性别。

gene.example: Each gene in your body helps decide how you grow and look.
gene.exampleZh: 你身体里的每个基因都有助于决定你的生长方式和外貌。

general.example: The general idea is easy to understand, but the details are hard.
general.exampleZh: 总的想法很容易理解，但细节很难。

generally.example: People generally eat more slowly when they are talking with friends.
generally.exampleZh: 人们和朋友聊天时通常吃得更慢。

generate.example: The new factory will generate many jobs for people in our town.
generate.exampleZh: 这家新工厂将为我们镇上的人们产生许多就业岗位。

generation.example: This generation of students uses computers every day at school.
generation.exampleZh: 这一代学生每天在学校都使用电脑。

generator.example: The old generator in the basement still makes enough power for the whole house.
generator.exampleZh: 地下室里的那台旧发电机仍然能为整栋房子提供足够的电力。

generous.example: My generous neighbor often shares her fresh garden vegetables with us.
generous.exampleZh: 我慷慨的邻居经常和我们分享她菜园里的新鲜蔬菜。

genetic.example: Genetic tests can show if a person has a higher risk of some diseases.
genetic.exampleZh: 基因检测可以显示一个人是否更容易患上某些疾病。

genius.example: She is a genius at solving difficult math problems quickly.
genius.exampleZh: 她是个能快速解决数学难题的天才。

gentle.example: The gentle wind moved the small leaves on the tree.
gentle.exampleZh: 轻柔的风吹动了树上的小叶子。

gentleman.example: The gentleman opened the door for the old lady and smiled kindly.
gentleman.exampleZh: 那位先生为老太太开门，并友善地微笑。

genuine.example: Her smile was genuine, and everyone liked her at once.
genuine.exampleZh: 她的微笑是真诚的，大家立刻都喜欢上了她。

geography.example: In school, we study geography to learn about countries, rivers and mountains.
geography.exampleZh: 在学校里，我们学习地理，了解国家、河流和山脉。

geometry.example: I like geometry because shapes and angles are easy to draw.
geometry.exampleZh: 我喜欢几何，因为形状和角度很容易画。

germ.example: Wash your hands well because germs can spread quickly from person to person.
germ.exampleZh: 要好好洗手，因为细菌很容易在人与人之间传播。

german.example: My German friend speaks English and Chinese very well.
german.exampleZh: 我的德国朋友英语和中文都说得很好。

germany.example: My uncle lives in Germany and teaches English at a small school.
germany.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在德国，在一所小学校教英语。

gesture.example: He made a gesture with his hand to get my attention.
gesture.exampleZh: 他用手做了个手势来引起我的注意。

get.example: You can get a cold drink from the shop near the station.
get.exampleZh: 你可以从车站附近的那家商店买到一杯冷饮。

ghost.example: She says she saw a ghost in the old house last night.
ghost.exampleZh: 她说她昨晚在那座老房子里看见了一个鬼。

giant.example: The giant tree in our garden is taller than the house.
giant.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵巨大的树比房子还高。

gift.example: She gave me a small gift on my birthday.
gift.exampleZh: 她在我生日那天送了我一份小礼物。

gifted.example: She is a gifted singer and can sing many difficult songs.
gifted.exampleZh: 她是一位有天赋的歌手，能唱很多难度高的歌曲。

girl.example: The girl next door likes to play basketball with her friends.
girl.exampleZh: 隔壁的女孩喜欢和朋友们一起打篮球。

give.example: I will give my old books to the school library tomorrow.
give.exampleZh: 我明天会把我的旧书送给学校图书馆。

glad.example: I am very glad to see you and your family again today.
glad.exampleZh: 今天再次见到你和你的家人，我非常高兴。

glance.example: I took a quick glance at the clock and left.

glass.example: She poured cold water into a clean glass and drank it.
glass.exampleZh: 她把冷水倒进一个干净的玻璃杯里，然后喝了下去。

glimpse.example: I caught a quick glimpse of the sea from the train window.
glimpse.exampleZh: 我从火车车窗匆匆瞥见了大海。

global.example: The company has a global plan to help more people find clean water.
global.exampleZh: 该公司有一个全球性的计划，帮助更多人找到干净的水。

globe.example: People around the globe use maps and globes to learn about the world.
globe.exampleZh: 世界各地的人们用地图和地球仪来了解世界。

glorious.example: The team had a glorious win in front of their happy fans.
glorious.exampleZh: 这支球队在快乐的球迷面前取得了一场光荣的胜利。

glory.example: The old soldier won great glory for his country in the war.
glory.exampleZh: 这位老兵在战争中为他的国家赢得了巨大的荣誉。

glove.example: She wore a warm pair of gloves on her hands in the cold snow.
glove.exampleZh: 在下着大雪的寒冷天气里，她手上戴着一副暖和的手套。

glow.example: The candles glow softly on the table in the dark room.
glow.exampleZh: 蜡烛在黑暗房间的桌上柔和地发光。

glue.example: I used glue to stick the broken cup back together.
glue.exampleZh: 我用胶水把破碎的杯子粘了回去。

go.example: I go to school by bus every morning.
go.exampleZh: 我每天早上坐公交车去学校。

goal.example: My main goal this year is to learn English well.
goal.exampleZh: 我今年的主要目标是把英语学好。

goat.example: The old farmer keeps a white goat and two sheep on his small farm.
goat.exampleZh: 这位老农在他的小农场上养了一只白山羊和两只绵羊。

god.example: Many people pray to God when they feel afraid.
god.exampleZh: 许多人在感到害怕时会向上帝祈祷。

gold.example: She wore a gold ring on her finger and a gold watch on her wrist.
gold.exampleZh: 她的手指上戴着一枚金戒指，手腕上戴着一块金表。

golden.example: The leaves turn golden in the autumn sun.
golden.exampleZh: 秋天阳光下，树叶变得金黄。

golf.example: My father plays golf with his friends every Sunday morning.
golf.exampleZh: 我父亲每周日早上都和他的朋友们打高尔夫球。

good.example: She is a good teacher and she always helps her students learn.
good.exampleZh: 她是一位好老师，总是帮助学生们学习。

goodbye.example: I said goodbye to my friends and went home.
goodbye.exampleZh: 我和朋友们道别后就回家了。

goodness.example: She treats everyone with goodness and kindness, even people who are unkind to her.
goodness.exampleZh: 她以善良和仁慈对待每个人，甚至对那些对她不友善的人也是如此。

goods.example: The goods in this shop are cheap and very good.
goods.exampleZh: 这家商店里的商品既便宜又好。

goose.example: The goose swam across the pond with her three little babies.
goose.exampleZh: 那只鹅带着她的三只小宝宝游过了池塘。

govern.example: Strong winds govern how fast these small boats move across the lake.
govern.exampleZh: 强风决定这些小船在湖面上移动的速度。

government.example: The government must do more to help poor families find homes.
government.exampleZh: 政府必须做更多的事来帮助贫困家庭找到住所。

governor.example: The governor of our state visited the school last week.
governor.exampleZh: 我们州的州长上周参观了这所学校。

grab.example: He grabbed his bag and ran quickly to catch the last bus.
grab.exampleZh: 他抓起包，飞快地跑去赶最后一班公交车。

grace.example: She moved across the stage with great grace and quiet confidence.
grace.exampleZh: 她以极大的优雅和沉静的自信走过舞台。

graceful.example: Her graceful movements made everyone in the room stop and watch.
graceful.exampleZh: 她优雅的动作让房间里的每个人都停下来观看。

grade.example: My sister studies hard because she wants good grades in every subject.
grade.exampleZh: 我妹妹努力学习，因为她想在每门科目中都取得好成绩。

gradual.example: The gradual change in weather made the days warmer.
gradual.exampleZh: 天气的逐渐变化使白天变得更暖和了。

gradually.example: The weather gradually became warmer as spring arrived in our small town.
gradually.exampleZh: 随着春天来到我们的小镇，天气逐渐变暖了。

graduate.example: After I graduate, I want to work in a small city.
graduate.exampleZh: 毕业后我想在一座小城市工作。

grain.example: The farmer stores grain in a large wooden box.
grain.exampleZh: 农民把谷物储存在一个大木箱里。

gram.example: Add fifty grams of sugar to the bowl and mix well.
gram.exampleZh: 往碗里加五十克糖，然后搅拌均匀。

grammar.example: I need a good grammar book to help me learn English.
grammar.exampleZh: 我需要一本好的语法书来帮助我学英语。

grammatical.example: This sentence is not grammatical because it is missing a verb.
grammatical.exampleZh: 这个句子不符合语法，因为它缺少一个动词。

grand.example: The old hotel has a grand entrance and a beautiful garden.
grand.exampleZh: 这家老酒店有一个宏伟的入口和一个美丽的花园。

grandfather.example: My grandfather often tells me funny stories about his old school days.
grandfather.exampleZh: 我的祖父经常给我讲他上学时的有趣故事。

grandmother.example: My grandmother makes a big cake for us every Sunday.
grandmother.exampleZh: 我祖母每个星期天都给我们做一个大蛋糕。

grant.example: The school granted him a small grant to continue his research.
grant.exampleZh: 学校给了他一小笔拨款，让他继续做研究。

grape.example: My mother buys fresh grapes at the market every Sunday morning.
grape.exampleZh: 我妈妈每周日早上都在市场买新鲜葡萄。

graph.example: The teacher showed us a graph of the test scores.
graph.exampleZh: 老师给我们看了一张考试成绩图表。

grasp.example: She quickly grasped the main idea of the lesson and answered the question.
grasp.exampleZh: 她很快理解了这节课的主要内容并回答了问题。

grass.example: The children are playing on the green grass in the park.
grass.exampleZh: 孩子们正在公园的绿草地上玩耍。

grateful.example: I am very grateful for your help with my homework.
grateful.exampleZh: 我非常感激你帮我做作业。

gratitude.example: She wrote him a short letter full of gratitude for his help.
gratitude.exampleZh: 她给他写了一封短信，对他的帮助充满感激。

grave.example: The doctor said his illness was grave, so we stayed home and rested.
grave.exampleZh: 医生说他的病很严重，所以我们待在家里休息。

gravity.example: The apple fell to the ground because of gravity.
gravity.exampleZh: 苹果因为重力落到了地上。

gray.example: The old cat has soft gray fur and bright green eyes.
gray.exampleZh: 那只老猫有柔软的灰色毛皮和明亮的绿色眼睛。

great.example: This is a great city with many old friends.
great.exampleZh: 这是一座伟大的城市，有许多老朋友。

greatly.example: This book helped me greatly with my English study.
greatly.exampleZh: 这本书对我的英语学习帮助很大。

greedy.example: The greedy boy ate all the cake before his sister came home.
greedy.exampleZh: 那个贪吃的男孩在妹妹回家前把蛋糕全吃光了。

green.example: The trees in our garden are very green in spring.
green.exampleZh: 我们花园里的树在春天非常绿。

greenhouse.example: The tomatoes in our greenhouse grow well even in cold weather.
greenhouse.exampleZh: 即使在寒冷的天气里，我们温室里的西红柿也长得很好。

greet.example: She smiled and greeted every guest at the door.
greet.exampleZh: 她微笑着在门口迎接每一位客人。

greeting.example: She smiled and gave me a warm greeting at the door.
greeting.exampleZh: 她在门口微笑着向我热情地问候。

grief.example: She could not hide her grief when her old dog died.
grief.exampleZh: 她的老狗去世时，她无法掩饰自己的悲伤。

grim.example: The weather was grim, so we stayed inside all day.
grim.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们一整天都待在室内。

grin.example: She grinned at me when she saw the funny picture.
grin.exampleZh: 她看到那张有趣的图片时冲我咧嘴笑了。

grind.example: She grinds the coffee beans every morning before work.
grind.exampleZh: 她每天早上上班前磨咖啡豆。

grip.example: She held the rope with a strong grip and pulled it slowly.
grip.exampleZh: 她紧紧握住绳子，慢慢地把它拉了过来。

groan.example: She groaned softly and lay back on the bed.
groan.exampleZh: 她轻声呻吟了一下，然后躺回床上。

grocery.example: I stop at the grocery on my way home to buy milk and bread.
grocery.exampleZh: 我在回家的路上顺便去食品杂货店买牛奶和面包。

gross.example: The gross weight of this box is heavier than I expected.
gross.exampleZh: 这个箱子的毛重比我预想的更重。

ground.example: The children are playing on the wet ground.
ground.exampleZh: 孩子们正在潮湿的地面上玩耍。

group.example: Our teacher put us into a small group of four students.
group.exampleZh: 老师把我们分成了一个四人小组。

grow.example: Tomatoes grow well in warm weather with plenty of water.
grow.exampleZh: 番茄在温暖且水分充足的环境下长得很好。

growth.example: The city has seen strong growth in jobs and housing this year.
growth.exampleZh: 这座城市今年在就业和住房方面出现了强劲的增长。

guarantee.example: The store gives a one-year guarantee on all its phones.
guarantee.exampleZh: 这家店对所有手机提供一年保修。

guard.example: Two soldiers guard the gate at night.
guard.exampleZh: 两名士兵在夜间守卫大门。

guess.example: I guess she will come to the party with her friends.
guess.exampleZh: 我猜她会和朋友们一起来参加聚会。

guest.example: We have a guest from Canada staying with us this week.
guest.exampleZh: 这周有一位来自加拿大的客人和我们住在一起。

guide.example: Our guide showed us the way through the old town.
guide.exampleZh: 我们的向导带我们穿过老城区。

guideline.example: The teacher gave us clear guidelines for writing the report.
guideline.exampleZh: 老师给了我们写报告的明确准则。

guilty.example: He felt guilty about forgetting his mother's birthday last week.
guilty.exampleZh: 他因为上周忘记母亲的生日而感到内疚。

guitar.example: My brother plays the guitar every evening after dinner.
guitar.exampleZh: 我哥哥每天晚饭后都弹吉他。

gulf.example: There is a wide gulf between the rich and the poor in that country.
gulf.exampleZh: 在那个国家，富人与穷人之间存在着巨大的鸿沟。

gum.example: Chewing gum helps keep your teeth clean after a meal.
gum.exampleZh: 饭后嚼口香糖有助于保持牙齿清洁。

gun.example: The police officer put his gun back in the holster.
gun.exampleZh: 警察把枪放回了枪套里。

guy.example: That guy is my best friend and he is very funny.
guy.exampleZh: 那个家伙是我最好的朋友，他很风趣。

habit.example: Reading before bed is a good habit for young children.
habit.exampleZh: 睡前阅读对幼儿来说是个好习惯。

habitat.example: This forest is a good habitat for many small birds and animals.
habitat.exampleZh: 这片森林是许多小鸟和动物的良好栖息地。

hair.example: My sister has long black hair and brown eyes.
hair.exampleZh: 我姐姐有一头乌黑的长发和棕色的眼睛。

half.example: Half of the students in our class walk to school every morning.
half.exampleZh: 我们班有一半的学生每天早晨步行上学。

hall.example: The meeting will be held in the main hall this afternoon.
hall.exampleZh: 会议将于今天下午在主大厅举行。

halt.example: The train came to a halt because of the heavy snow.
halt.exampleZh: 由于大雪，火车停了下来。

ham.example: My mother bought some ham and eggs for our breakfast.
ham.exampleZh: 我妈妈买了一些火腿和鸡蛋当早餐。

hamburger.example: I want a hamburger and some fries for lunch today.
hamburger.exampleZh: 我今天午餐想要一个汉堡包和一些薯条。

hammer.example: He used a hammer to fix the broken chair in the garden.
hammer.exampleZh: 他用锤子修好了花园里那把坏掉的椅子。

hand.example: She raised her hand and handed the note to him.
hand.exampleZh: 她举起手，把纸条递给了他。

handbag.example: She put her phone and keys into her new handbag.
handbag.exampleZh: 她把手机和钥匙放进了她的新手提包里。

handbook.example: The teacher gave each student a handbook with all the school rules.
handbook.exampleZh: 老师给每个学生发了一本包含所有校规的手册。

handful.example: Only a handful of people came to the meeting on Monday morning.
handful.exampleZh: 周一早上只有少数人来参加了会议。

handicap.example: His poor eyesight is a real handicap when he plays sports.
handicap.exampleZh: 视力不好是他参加体育运动时的一个真正障碍。

handkerchief.example: She wiped her face with a clean handkerchief after washing.
handkerchief.exampleZh: 洗完脸后，她用手帕擦了擦脸。

handle.example: Please do not touch the handle of the hot pan.
handle.exampleZh: 请不要触摸热锅的把手。

handsome.example: Her brother is a handsome young man with a kind smile.
handsome.exampleZh: 她的哥哥是个英俊的年轻人，笑容和善。

handwriting.example: Her handwriting is small and neat, so her notes are easy to read.
handwriting.exampleZh: 她的字又小又工整，所以她的笔记很容易读。

handy.example: This small bag is handy when I go shopping.
handy.exampleZh: 这个小包在我购物时很方便。

hang.example: She likes to hang her coat on the hook by the door.
hang.exampleZh: 她喜欢把外套挂在门边的挂钩上。

happen.example: I happened to meet my old teacher at the bookstore yesterday.
happen.exampleZh: 我昨天在书店碰巧遇到了我的旧老师。

happiness.example: True happiness comes from small things like family, friends, and good health.
happiness.exampleZh: 真正的幸福来自家人、朋友和健康这样的小事。

happy.example: The children were very happy to see the snow outside.
happy.exampleZh: 孩子们看到外面的雪非常开心。

harassment.example: She reported the harassment to her manager at once.
harassment.exampleZh: 她立刻把骚扰事件报告给了她的经理。

harbor.example: The small boat returned to the harbor before the storm arrived.
harbor.exampleZh: 小船在暴风雨来临前回到了港口。

hard.example: The bed is very hard, so I cannot sleep well.
hard.exampleZh: 这张床很硬，所以我睡不好。

harden.example: The cold weather will harden the wet ground quickly.
harden.exampleZh: 寒冷的天气会很快让湿地面变硬。

hardly.example: I could hardly hear him because the room was too noisy.
hardly.exampleZh: 我几乎听不见他说话，因为房间太吵了。

hardship.example: Many families face great hardship during the cold winter months.
hardship.exampleZh: 在寒冷的冬季，许多家庭面临巨大的艰难困苦。

hardware.example: The store sells tools and other hardware for building and fixing things.
hardware.exampleZh: 这家店出售工具和其他用于建造和修理东西的五金器具。

harm.example: Too much sun can do real harm to your skin.
harm.exampleZh: 阳光过多会对你的皮肤造成真正的伤害。

harmony.example: The small village is famous for the harmony between its people and nature.
harmony.exampleZh: 这个小村庄以人与自然的和谐而闻名。

harsh.example: His harsh words hurt her feelings, but he did not notice.
harsh.exampleZh: 他苛刻的话伤了她的心，但他没有察觉。

harvest.example: The farmers harvest the rice in autumn every year.
harvest.exampleZh: 农民们每年秋天收割水稻。

haste.example: In her haste to catch the bus, she forgot her phone at home.
haste.exampleZh: 她匆忙赶公交车，把手机忘在了家里。

hasty.example: He made a hasty decision and soon felt sorry for it.
hasty.exampleZh: 他匆忙做了决定，很快就为此感到后悔。

hat.example: He put on his hat before going out in the cold wind.
hat.exampleZh: 他在寒风中外出的前戴上了帽子。

hatch.example: The eggs will hatch in about three weeks.
hatch.exampleZh: 这些蛋大约三周后会孵出。

hate.example: I hate cold rainy days because they make me feel tired and sad.
hate.exampleZh: 我讨厌寒冷的下雨天，因为它们让我感到疲惫和难过。

hatred.example: Her deep hatred of lies made her leave the job.
hatred.exampleZh: 她对谎言的深恶痛绝使她辞去了这份工作。

haul.example: They had to haul the heavy boxes up the stairs.
haul.exampleZh: 他们不得不把沉重的箱子拖上楼梯。

have.example: Every morning I have a cup of hot tea with my family.
have.exampleZh: 每天早上我和家人一起喝一杯热茶。

hawk.example: A hawk flew over the field and landed on a tall tree.
hawk.exampleZh: 一只鹰飞过田野，落在一棵高树上。

hay.example: The farmer put dry hay in the barn for the cows.
hay.exampleZh: 农民把干草放进谷仓里给奶牛吃。

hazard.example: Smoking is a serious health hazard for both young people and old people.
hazard.exampleZh: 吸烟对年轻人和老年人来说都是一种严重的健康危害。

he.example: He gave his old bike to a friend who needs one.
he.exampleZh: 他把他那辆旧自行车送给了一个需要自行车的朋友。

head.example: She turned her head and smiled at the man behind her.
head.exampleZh: 她转过头，对身后的男人笑了笑。

headache.example: I have a bad headache, so I cannot go to work today.
headache.exampleZh: 我头痛得厉害，所以今天不能去上班。

heading.example: The heading at the top of the page tells you what the chapter is about.
heading.exampleZh: 页面顶部的标题告诉你这一章讲的是什么。

headline.example: The headline in today's newspaper caught my eye at once.
headline.exampleZh: 今天报纸上的大字标题立刻吸引了我的注意。

headmaster.example: The headmaster spoke to all the students in the school hall this morning.
headmaster.exampleZh: 今天早上，校长在学校礼堂对全体学生讲了话。

headquarters.example: The company moved its headquarters to a bigger city last year.
headquarters.exampleZh: 公司去年把总部搬到了一座更大的城市。

heal.example: Time can heal a broken heart, and kind words can heal a quarrel.
heal.exampleZh: 时间能治愈一颗受伤的心，友善的话语也能调停一场争吵。

health.example: Regular exercise and healthy food are good for your health.
health.exampleZh: 规律锻炼和健康饮食对你的健康有益。

healthy.example: Eating fruit and vegetables every day helps you stay healthy and strong.
healthy.exampleZh: 每天吃水果和蔬菜有助于你保持健康和强壮。

heap.example: There is a heap of dirty clothes on the floor.

hear.example: I can hear the birds singing outside my window every morning.
hear.exampleZh: 每天早上我都能听见窗外鸟儿在歌唱。

hearing.example: His hearing got worse after years of working in the noisy factory.
hearing.exampleZh: 在嘈杂的工厂工作多年后，他的听力变差了。

heart.example: She put her hand on her heart and smiled at me.
heart.exampleZh: 她把手放在心口，对我笑了笑。

heat.example: The heat from the sun made the room very warm.
heat.exampleZh: 太阳的热量让房间变得非常暖和。

heating.example: Our house has a new heating system for the cold winter.
heating.exampleZh: 我们的房子有一套新的供暖系统来应对寒冷的冬天。

heaven.example: She believes her kind grandmother is now in heaven.
heaven.exampleZh: 她相信她善良的祖母现在在天堂里。

heavily.example: It rained heavily all night, so the roads were full of water.
heavily.exampleZh: 整夜下着大雨，所以路上满是积水。

heavy.example: This box is too heavy for me to carry alone.
heavy.exampleZh: 这个箱子太重了，我一个人搬不动。

hedge.example: The old farmer planted a thick hedge around his small garden.
hedge.exampleZh: 那位老农在他的小花园周围种了一圈茂密的树篱。

heel.example: My new shoes hurt my heel when I walk.
heel.exampleZh: 我穿新鞋走路时，脚后跟会疼。

height.example: The height of the mountain surprised all the young climbers.
height.exampleZh: 这座山的高度让所有年轻的登山者都很惊讶。

heir.example: He is the only heir to his grandfather's small farm.
heir.exampleZh: 他是祖父那座小农场的唯一继承人。

helicopter.example: The helicopter flew low over the trees to look for the missing dog.
helicopter.exampleZh: 直升机低空飞过树林，寻找那只走失的狗。

hell.example: The old man said his life after the accident was a living hell.
hell.exampleZh: 老人说事故之后的生活对他而言就是活地狱。

hello.example: I always say hello to my neighbors when I see them.
hello.exampleZh: 我看到邻居时总是跟他们问好。

helmet.example: The worker put on a helmet before entering the building site.
helmet.exampleZh: 工人进入建筑工地前戴上了头盔。

help.example: Can you help me carry these heavy books to the library?
help.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这些沉重的书搬到图书馆吗？

helpful.example: Your advice was very helpful when I started my new job.
helpful.exampleZh: 我开始新工作时，你的建议非常有用。

helpless.example: The little boy felt helpless when he lost his mother in the crowd.
helpless.exampleZh: 那个小男孩在人群中找不到妈妈时感到无助。

hen.example: The hen lays a brown egg every morning on the old farm.
hen.exampleZh: 这只母鸡每天早上在旧农场上产下一个棕色的蛋。

hence.example: It was raining hard, hence we stayed at home all day.
hence.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此我们整天都待在家里。

her.example: I gave her a book and she said thank you.
her.exampleZh: 我给了她一本书，她说谢谢。

herb.example: My grandmother grows many herbs in the small garden behind her house.
herb.exampleZh: 我奶奶在她房子后面的小花园里种了许多药草。

herd.example: The farmer led his herd of cows to the field near the river.
herd.exampleZh: 农夫把他的牛群赶到河边的田野里。

here.example: Please sit here and wait for your name to be called.
here.exampleZh: 请坐在这里，等候叫到你的名字。

heritage.example: This old town is a rich part of our cultural heritage.
heritage.exampleZh: 这座古镇是我们文化遗产中丰富的一部分。

hero.example: The young boy saw his hero on TV and smiled.
hero.exampleZh: 那个小男孩在电视上看到了他的英雄，笑了。

heroic.example: The firefighter made a heroic effort to save the child from the burning house.
heroic.exampleZh: 那名消防员为从着火的房子里救出孩子做出了英勇的努力。

hers.example: This bag is mine, and the red one is hers.
hers.exampleZh: 这个包是我的，那个红色的是她的。

herself.example: She made the cake herself for her mother's birthday.
herself.exampleZh: 她亲自为母亲的生日做了蛋糕。

hesitate.example: Don't hesitate to ask me if you need any help.
hesitate.exampleZh: 如果你需要任何帮助，请别犹豫，尽管问我。

hi.example: Hi, my name is Tom and I am new here.
hi.exampleZh: 嗨，我叫汤姆，我是新来的。

hide.example: She tried to hide the small key under the old box.
hide.exampleZh: 她试图把那把小钥匙藏在这个旧盒子下面。

high.example: The high wall around the garden keeps the children safe.
high.exampleZh: 花园周围的高墙保护着孩子们的安全。

highlight.example: The teacher used a red pen to highlight the key words.
highlight.exampleZh: 老师用红笔突出显示关键词。

highly.example: My teacher spoke highly of my work and said it was excellent.
highly.exampleZh: 老师高度评价了我的作业，说它非常出色。

highway.example: We drove north on the highway for three hours to visit my grandparents.
highway.exampleZh: 我们沿着公路向北开了三个小时去看望我的祖父母。

hill.example: We walked up the green hill to watch the sunset.
hill.exampleZh: 我们走上绿色的小山去看日落。

him.example: I gave him a book for his birthday.
him.exampleZh: 我送了他一本书作为生日礼物。

himself.example: He made the cake himself and shared it with everyone.
himself.exampleZh: 他自己做了这个蛋糕，并与大家分享。

hint.example: She gave me a hint about the answer.
hint.exampleZh: 她给了我一个关于答案的提示。

hip.example: My grandmother fell and hurt her hip while walking in the garden.
hip.exampleZh: 我奶奶在花园里散步时摔倒，伤了髋部。

hire.example: They decided to hire a car for the weekend trip.
hire.exampleZh: 他们决定为周末的旅行租一辆车。

his.example: His bike is red, and he rides it to school every day.
his.exampleZh: 他的自行车是红色的，他每天骑它去上学。

historic.example: This historic building is famous all over the world.
historic.exampleZh: 这座具有历史意义的建筑闻名全世界。

historical.example: This historical novel tells a true story about a small town.
historical.exampleZh: 这部历史小说讲述了一个关于小镇的真实故事。

history.example: My history teacher told us an interesting story about the old city.
history.exampleZh: 我的历史老师给我们讲了一个关于这座古城的趣事。

hit.example: His new song was a big hit, and everyone sang it.
hit.exampleZh: 他的新歌非常风行，人人都在唱。

hobby.example: My hobby is reading books after school every day.
hobby.exampleZh: 我的业余爱好是每天放学后读书。

hold.example: Please hold the door open while I carry these heavy boxes.
hold.exampleZh: 我搬这些重箱子时，请帮忙把门扶住。

hole.example: The rabbit ran into a deep hole under the old tree.
hole.exampleZh: 兔子跑进了老树下的一个深洞里。

holiday.example: We are going to the beach for a week during the summer holiday.
holiday.exampleZh: 我们打算在暑假期间去海滩玩一个星期。

hollow.example: The old tree has a hollow trunk where small animals like to hide.
hollow.exampleZh: 这棵老树的树干是中空的，小动物喜欢藏在里面。

holy.example: This old church is a holy place for many people in the town.
holy.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂对镇上的许多人来说是一个神圣的地方。

home.example: I go home after school and have dinner with my family.
home.exampleZh: 放学后我回家和家人一起吃晚饭。

homework.example: I finish my homework before dinner every evening.
homework.exampleZh: 我每天晚上在晚饭前完成家庭作业。

honest.example: She is an honest girl and always tells the truth.
honest.exampleZh: 她是个诚实的女孩，总是说实话。

honey.example: My little girl likes to put honey in her warm milk.
honey.exampleZh: 我的小女儿喜欢在她的热牛奶里加蜂蜜。

honor.example: It is a great honor to meet you here today.
honor.exampleZh: 今天在这里见到您是我的莫大荣幸。

honorable.example: He is an honorable man who always tells the truth.
honorable.exampleZh: 他是一个总是说真话的可敬之人。

hook.example: Please hang your coat on the hook by the door.
hook.exampleZh: 请把你的外套挂在门边的挂钩上。

hope.example: I hope you can come to my birthday party this weekend.
hope.exampleZh: 我希望你这个周末能来参加我的生日聚会。

hopeful.example: We are hopeful that the weather will be nice tomorrow.
hopeful.exampleZh: 我们希望明天的天气会很好。

hopeless.example: He felt hopeless after losing his job and all his savings.
hopeless.exampleZh: 失去工作和全部积蓄后，他感到绝望。

horizon.example: The sun rose slowly above the horizon and the whole sky turned red.
horizon.exampleZh: 太阳缓缓升起在地平线之上，整个天空都变红了。

horizontal.example: The books on the shelf are in a horizontal line.
horizontal.exampleZh: 书架上的书排成一条水平线。

horn.example: The car horn sounded loudly when the driver pressed the button.
horn.exampleZh: 司机按下按钮时，汽车喇叭大声响起。

horrible.example: The weather was horrible, so we stayed home all day.
horrible.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们一整天都待在家里。

horror.example: She watched the horror movie and could not sleep all night.
horror.exampleZh: 她看了那部恐怖电影，整夜无法入睡。

horse.example: The horse runs fast across the green field every morning.
horse.exampleZh: 这匹马每天早上都飞快地跑过绿色的田野。

hospital.example: My mother is a nurse at the hospital near our home.
hospital.exampleZh: 我妈妈是我们家附近那家医院的护士。

host.example: Our host made us feel welcome and showed us around the city.
host.exampleZh: 我们的主人让我们感到宾至如归，还带我们参观了这座城市。

hostile.example: The dog became hostile when strangers came near its food.
hostile.exampleZh: 当陌生人靠近它的食物时，那只狗变得有敌意。

hot.example: The soup is too hot for me to drink now.
hot.exampleZh: 这汤太烫了，我现在喝不了。

hotel.example: We stayed at a small hotel near the train station.
hotel.exampleZh: 我们住在火车站附近的一家小旅馆里。

hour.example: I spend one hour reading English books every morning before breakfast.
hour.exampleZh: 我每天早上早饭前花一个小时读英语书。

house.example: They bought a small house near the river last year.
house.exampleZh: 他们去年在河边买了一栋小房子。

household.example: Every household in our street puts out rubbish on Monday morning.
household.exampleZh: 我们这条街的每户人家都在周一早上倒垃圾。

housewife.example: My mother is a housewife and she takes good care of our family.
housewife.exampleZh: 我妈妈是家庭主妇，她把我们一家照顾得很好。

housework.example: I do housework with my mother every Saturday morning.
housework.exampleZh: 我每周六早上和妈妈一起做家务。

housing.example: The city needs more housing for young families and workers.
housing.exampleZh: 这座城市需要为年轻家庭和工人提供更多住房。

how.example: How do you usually go to school in the morning?
how.exampleZh: 你早上通常怎样去学校？

however.example: The plan was simple; however, it did not work in practice.
however.exampleZh: 这个计划很简单，然而在实践中却没有奏效。

hug.example: She gave her mother a warm hug at the airport.
hug.exampleZh: 她在机场给了妈妈一个温暖的拥抱。

huge.example: There is a huge tree in front of our house.
huge.exampleZh: 我们家门前有一棵巨大的树。

human.example: Water is very important for every human body and human life.
human.exampleZh: 水对每个人的身体和人类生活都非常重要。

humble.example: He is humble about his success and always thanks his team.
humble.exampleZh: 他对自己的成功很谦逊，总是感谢他的团队。

humor.example: His sense of humor makes everyone in the office feel happy.
humor.exampleZh: 他的幽默感让办公室里的每个人都感到开心。

humorous.example: Our teacher is a humorous man who often makes the whole class laugh.
humorous.exampleZh: 我们老师是个幽默的人，常常让全班同学发笑。

hundred.example: There are about one hundred students in our school this year.
hundred.exampleZh: 我们学校今年大约有一百名学生。

hunger.example: The little boy felt hunger after playing all morning in the park.
hunger.exampleZh: 那个小男孩在公园玩了一上午后感到饥饿。

hungry.example: The hungry children ate all the bread on the table.
hungry.exampleZh: 那些饥饿的孩子们把桌上的面包都吃光了。

hunt.example: We will hunt for the lost keys in the garden.
hunt.exampleZh: 我们会在花园里搜寻丢失的钥匙。

hurry.example: I must hurry to catch the bus before it leaves.
hurry.exampleZh: 我必须赶紧去赶在公交车开走前上车。

hurt.example: I fell off my bike and hurt my left knee yesterday.
hurt.exampleZh: 我昨天从自行车上摔下来，伤了左膝盖。

husband.example: My husband cooks dinner for our family every evening after work.
husband.exampleZh: 我丈夫每天下班后都为家人做晚饭。

hut.example: The old man lives in a small hut near the river.
hut.exampleZh: 那位老人住在河边的一间小屋里。

hydrogen.example: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen, so it is very common on Earth.
hydrogen.exampleZh: 水由氢和氧组成，因此在地球上非常常见。

ice.example: The lake is covered with thick ice, so we can skate on it.
ice.exampleZh: 湖面结了厚厚的冰，我们可以在上面滑冰。

iceberg.example: The ship hit an iceberg and sank below the cold sea.
iceberg.exampleZh: 那艘船撞上了一座冰山，沉入冰冷的海水中。

idea.example: That is a good idea, so let us try it today.
idea.exampleZh: 那是个好主意，我们今天就来试试吧。

ideal.example: This small town is an ideal place for a quiet family holiday.
ideal.exampleZh: 这个小镇是全家安静度假的理想之地。

identical.example: The two brothers wore identical shirts to the party last night.
identical.exampleZh: 这两个兄弟昨晚穿着一模一样的衬衫去参加聚会。

identify.example: Can you identify the man in this old photo?
identify.exampleZh: 你能认出这张旧照片里的那个男人吗？

identity.example: Her identity as a teacher is a big part of her life.
identity.exampleZh: 她作为教师的身份是她生活中很重要的一部分。

ideology.example: His ideology is simple: work hard and help others.
ideology.exampleZh: 他的思想体系很简单：努力工作，帮助他人。

idiom.example: This English idiom is hard to understand without an example.
idiom.exampleZh: 这个英语习语没有例子很难理解。

idiot.example: I felt like an idiot when I forgot her name again.
idiot.exampleZh: 当我又一次忘记她的名字时，我觉得自己像个笨蛋。

idle.example: The idle boy sat by the window all afternoon and did nothing.
idle.exampleZh: 那个懒惰的男孩整个下午都坐在窗边，什么也没做。

if.example: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home and watch a movie.
if.exampleZh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里看电影。

ignite.example: A single spark can ignite the dry grass in seconds.
ignite.exampleZh: 一个火星就能在几秒内点燃干草。

ignorance.example: His ignorance of the rules caused him to make a serious mistake.
ignorance.exampleZh: 他对规则的无知使他犯了一个严重的错误。

ignorant.example: He is ignorant of the basic rules of the game.
ignorant.exampleZh: 他对这项游戏的基本规则一无所知。

ignore.example: You should not ignore the teacher when she asks you a question.
ignore.exampleZh: 老师问你问题时，你不应该不理睬她。

ill.example: My brother is ill and cannot go to school today.
ill.exampleZh: 我弟弟生病了，今天不能去上学。

illegal.example: It is illegal to park your car on this street.
illegal.exampleZh: 在这条街上停车是违法的。

illness.example: He missed two weeks of school because of a serious illness.
illness.exampleZh: 他因为一场重病缺了两周的课。

illuminate.example: The streetlights illuminate the road at night so people can walk safely.
illuminate.exampleZh: 路灯在夜里照亮道路，让人们能够安全行走。

illusion.example: The mirror gave me the illusion that the room was much bigger.
illusion.exampleZh: 镜子给了我一种错觉，好像这个房间大得多。

illustrate.example: Let me illustrate my point with a simple example from daily life.
illustrate.exampleZh: 让我用一个日常生活中的简单例子来说明我的观点。

illustration.example: This book has a clear illustration of how the water cycle works.
illustration.exampleZh: 这本书有一幅清晰的插图，说明水循环是如何运作的。

image.example: Her public image changed a lot after the interview.
image.exampleZh: 那次采访之后，她的公众形象改变了很多。

imaginary.example: The dragon in the story is an imaginary animal that no one has seen.
imaginary.exampleZh: 故事里的那条龙是一种没人见过的想象中的动物。

imagination.example: Children need imagination to turn a simple box into a spaceship.
imagination.exampleZh: 孩子们需要想象力才能把一个简单的盒子变成宇宙飞船。

imaging.example: The new machine can produce clear imaging of the inside of the body.
imaging.exampleZh: 这台新机器可以生成清晰的人体内部成像。

imitate.example: Children often imitate the way their parents speak and act at home.
imitate.exampleZh: 孩子们常常模仿父母在家里的说话和行为方式。

imitation.example: His imitation of the teacher made the whole class laugh.
imitation.exampleZh: 他对老师的模仿让全班都笑了。

immediate.example: The medicine had an immediate effect on my headache.
immediate.exampleZh: 这种药对我的头痛立刻见效。

immediately.example: Please call me immediately when you get home tonight.
immediately.exampleZh: 你今晚到家后请立即给我打电话。

immense.example: The immense hall was full of people waiting for the show.
immense.exampleZh: 巨大的大厅里挤满了等着看演出的人。

immigrant.example: Many immigrants came to this city to find work and a better life.
immigrant.exampleZh: 许多移民来到这座城市寻找工作和更好的生活。

impact.example: The new road had a big impact on the small town.
impact.exampleZh: 这条新路对小镇产生了很大的影响。

impatient.example: He was too impatient to wait for the bus and walked home.
impatient.exampleZh: 他太不耐烦等公交车，就走路回家了。

implement.example: We will implement the new plan next week with the whole team.
implement.exampleZh: 我们将在下周和整个团队一起实施这个新计划。

implication.example: The implication of his words was that he did not agree.
implication.exampleZh: 他话中的含意是他并不同意。

imply.example: His silence seemed to imply that he did not agree with us.
imply.exampleZh: 他的沉默似乎暗示他并不同意我们的看法。

import.example: The country imports a lot of oil from other nations every year.
import.exampleZh: 该国每年从其他国家进口大量石油。

importance.example: Good sleep is of great importance to your health and your mood.
importance.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠对你的健康 and 情绪都非常重要。

important.example: It is important to eat breakfast every morning before school.
important.exampleZh: 每天早上上学前吃早餐很重要。

impose.example: The government imposed new taxes on imported cars last year.
impose.exampleZh: 政府去年对进口汽车征收了新税。

impossible.example: It is impossible to finish all this work in one day.
impossible.exampleZh: 在一天之内完成所有这些工作是不可能的。

impress.example: Her kindness and hard work impressed everyone in the small office.
impress.exampleZh: 她的善良和勤奋给这间小办公室里的每个人都留下了深刻印象。

impression.example: My first impression of the new teacher was very good.
impression.exampleZh: 我对这位新老师的第一印象非常好。

impressive.example: The young singer gave an impressive performance at the school show last night.
impressive.exampleZh: 这位年轻歌手昨晚在学校演出中带来了一场令人印象深刻的表演。

improve.example: We must improve our English if we want to work abroad.
improve.exampleZh: 如果我们想出国工作，就必须提高我们的英语水平。

improvement.example: Regular practice led to a big improvement in her spoken English.
improvement.exampleZh: 经常练习使她的英语口语有了很大进步。

in.example: She is in the kitchen making tea for her guests.
in.exampleZh: 她在厨房里为客人泡茶。

inch.example: The frame is only a few inches wide, so it fits here.
inch.exampleZh: 这个框架只有几英寸宽，所以它能放在这里。

incident.example: The police are still investigating the incident that happened last night.
incident.exampleZh: 警方仍在调查昨晚发生的那起事件。

incline.example: The road begins to incline steeply after the old bridge.
incline.exampleZh: 过了那座旧桥后，道路开始明显向上倾斜。

include.example: The price includes breakfast and free use of the hotel pool.
include.exampleZh: 这个价格包含早餐和免费使用酒店泳池。

income.example: Her monthly income is not enough to pay the rent.
income.exampleZh: 她的月收入不足以支付房租。

increase.example: The company plans to increase the number of workers next year.
increase.exampleZh: 公司计划明年增加工人数量。

increasingly.example: People are increasingly using their phones to pay for things.
increasingly.exampleZh: 人们越来越常用手机来付款。

indeed.example: This book is indeed very useful for my English study.
indeed.exampleZh: 这本书对我的英语学习确实非常有用。

independence.example: Many young people move to the city to find independence.
independence.exampleZh: 许多年轻人搬到大城市去寻求独立。

independent.example: She is an independent thinker who always checks the facts herself.
independent.exampleZh: 她是一个独立的思考者，总是自己核实事实。

index.example: The index at the back of the book helps you find each topic quickly.
index.exampleZh: 书后的索引能帮你快速找到每个主题。

india.example: My uncle lives in India and works at a large tea company.
india.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在印度，在一家大型茶叶公司工作。

indicate.example: The dark clouds indicate that it will rain soon.
indicate.exampleZh: 乌云表明很快就会下雨。

indication.example: There is no indication that the weather will change this week.
indication.exampleZh: 没有迹象表明本周天气会发生变化。

indifferent.example: He was indifferent to the news and kept reading his book.
indifferent.exampleZh: 他对这个消息漠不关心，继续看他的书。

indirect.example: He gave an indirect answer, so I still do not know the truth.
indirect.exampleZh: 他给了一个间接的回答，所以我仍然不知道真相。

indispensable.example: Clean water is indispensable for good health.
indispensable.exampleZh: 干净的水对健康是必不可少的。

individual.example: Each individual student should choose their own books for the class.
individual.exampleZh: 每个学生个人都应该为这门课选择自己的书。

indoors.example: It is cold and rainy today, so we will stay indoors and read books.
indoors.exampleZh: 今天又冷又下雨，所以我们会待在室内看书。

industrial.example: This city is a major industrial center with many large factories.
industrial.exampleZh: 这座城市是一个拥有许多大型工厂的主要工业中心。

industrialize.example: Many countries began to industrialize quickly after the war ended.
industrialize.exampleZh: 战争结束后，许多国家开始迅速实现工业化。

industry.example: The car industry is very important in this city.
industry.exampleZh: 汽车工业在这座城市非常重要。

inevitable.example: With so little practice, some mistakes were inevitable in the final game.
inevitable.exampleZh: 由于练习太少，最后一场比赛中出现一些失误是不可避免的。

infant.example: The infant slept quietly in her mother's arms all afternoon.
infant.exampleZh: 这个婴儿整个下午都在母亲怀里安静地睡着。

infect.example: Your cough can infect other people, so please stay at home today.
infect.exampleZh: 你的咳嗽可能会传染给别人，所以今天请待在家里。

infer.example: We can infer from his silence that he does not agree.
infer.exampleZh: 我们可以从他的沉默推断出他并不同意。

influence.example: Parents have a strong influence on how their children behave.
influence.exampleZh: 父母对孩子的行为方式有很大影响。

influential.example: She is an influential writer, and many young people read her books.
influential.exampleZh: 她是一位有影响力的作家，许多年轻人读她的书。

inform.example: Please inform the teacher if you cannot come to class tomorrow morning.
inform.exampleZh: 如果你明天早上不能来上课，请通知老师。

information.example: Please send me more information about the English course next week.
information.exampleZh: 请把下周英语课程的更多信息发给我。

ingredient.example: Flour is the main ingredient in this simple bread recipe.
ingredient.exampleZh: 面粉是这个简单面包配方中的主要原料。

inhabitant.example: The small town has about two thousand inhabitants.
inhabitant.exampleZh: 这个小镇大约有两千名居民。

inherit.example: She inherited the old house from her grandmother last year.
inherit.exampleZh: 她去年从祖母那里继承了这座老房子。

initial.example: My initial plan was to walk to school, but it rained.
initial.exampleZh: 我最初的计划是走路去学校，但下雨了。

initiate.example: They plan to initiate a new project next week.
initiate.exampleZh: 他们计划下周启动一个新项目。

injection.example: The doctor gave him an injection to help with the pain.
injection.exampleZh: 医生给他打了一针来缓解疼痛。

injure.example: The accident injured two workers and they were taken to the hospital.
injure.exampleZh: 这场事故伤了两名工人，他们被送往医院。

injury.example: He missed two games because of a knee injury.
injury.exampleZh: 他因为膝盖受伤而缺席了两场比赛。

ink.example: Please write your name in ink, not in pencil.
ink.exampleZh: 请用墨水写你的名字，不要用铅笔写。

inn.example: We stayed one night at a small inn near the river.
inn.exampleZh: 我们在河边的一家小旅馆住了一晚。

inner.example: Her inner strength helped her stay calm during the difficult exam.
inner.exampleZh: 她内心的力量帮助她在艰难的考试中保持冷静。

innocent.example: The judge said the young man was innocent because he did not commit the crime.
innocent.exampleZh: 法官说这个年轻人是无辜的，因为他没有犯罪。

input.example: The teacher asked for more input from the students in class.
input.exampleZh: 老师要求学生们在课堂上提供更多意见。

inquire.example: I will inquire about the train times at the station.
inquire.exampleZh: 我会在车站打听火车的时刻。

inquiry.example: She made an inquiry about the new job at the front desk.
inquiry.exampleZh: 她在前台询问了那份新工作的情况。

insect.example: A bee is a small insect that lives in a hive.
insect.exampleZh: 蜜蜂是一种生活在蜂巢里的小昆虫。

insert.example: Please insert the card into the machine before you pay.
insert.exampleZh: 付款前请把卡插入机器。

inside.example: The cat is sleeping inside the warm box.
inside.exampleZh: 那只猫正在温暖的箱子里睡觉。

insight.example: Her book gives us deep insight into how young children learn languages.
insight.exampleZh: 她的书让我们深刻洞悉幼儿是如何学习语言的。

insist.example: She insists on paying for dinner every time we meet.
insist.exampleZh: 每次见面她都坚持要付晚餐的钱。

inspect.example: The teacher came to inspect our homework before the class started.
inspect.exampleZh: 老师在开始上课前来检查我们的作业。

inspiration.example: My teacher is a great inspiration to me and all her students.
inspiration.exampleZh: 我的老师对我和她所有的学生都是极大的鼓舞。

inspire.example: Her teacher's kind words inspired her to try again.
inspire.exampleZh: 老师温暖的话语激励她再次尝试。

install.example: They will install the new software on every computer this week.
install.exampleZh: 他们这周会在每台电脑上安装新软件。

instance.example: She gave me one instance of the problem to explain it clearly.
instance.exampleZh: 她给了我这个问题的一个例子来清楚地解释它。

instant.example: The instant noodles are ready in just three minutes.
instant.exampleZh: 这包速食面只需三分钟就能煮好。

instead.example: I stayed home instead of going out in the rain.
instead.exampleZh: 我留在家里，而不是冒着雨出门。

instinct.example: Her first instinct was to run away from the loud noise.
instinct.exampleZh: 她的第一本能是逃离那巨大的声响。

institute.example: The city plans to institute a new program at the research institute next year.
institute.exampleZh: 该市计划明年在这家研究所设立一个新项目。

institution.example: The old institution has helped poor students for over fifty years.
institution.exampleZh: 这所历史悠久的学校五十多年来一直帮助贫困学生。

instruct.example: Our teacher instructed us to read the article before Friday's class.
instruct.exampleZh: 老师指示我们在周五上课前读完这篇文章。

instruction.example: The teacher gave clear instructions before the students started the experiment.
instruction.exampleZh: 老师在做实验前给了学生们清楚的指示。

instrument.example: The doctor used a small instrument to check my heart.
instrument.exampleZh: 医生用一个小仪器检查我的心脏。

insurance.example: My father pays for car insurance every month.
insurance.exampleZh: 我父亲每个月支付汽车保险费。

insure.example: We insure our house against fire and theft.
insure.exampleZh: 我们给房子投保了火灾和盗窃险。

integrate.example: The new system helps us integrate our data into one place.
integrate.exampleZh: 新系统帮助我们把数据整合到一个地方。

intellectual.example: She enjoys intellectual talks with her friends about books and art.
intellectual.exampleZh: 她喜欢和朋友们就书籍和艺术进行智力上的交流。

intelligence.example: The test measures a child's intelligence in several different ways.
intelligence.exampleZh: 这项测试从几个不同方面衡量孩子的智力。

intelligent.example: She is intelligent and always finds wise answers to hard problems.
intelligent.exampleZh: 她很聪明，总能找到解决难题的明智答案。

intend.example: I intend to finish my homework before dinner tonight.
intend.exampleZh: 我打算在今晚晚饭前完成作业。

intense.example: The intense heat made everyone very tired after the long walk.
intense.exampleZh: 强烈的酷热让大家在长途步行后非常疲惫。

intensity.example: The intensity of the storm surprised everyone in the small town.
intensity.exampleZh: 这场风暴的强度让小镇上的每个人都感到惊讶。

intensive.example: The doctor gave him intensive care after the accident.
intensive.exampleZh: 事故发生后，医生对他进行了重症监护。

intention.example: I have no intention of changing my mind about the trip.
intention.exampleZh: 我没有改变旅行打算的意思。

interact.example: Children learn social skills when they interact with other kids at school.
interact.exampleZh: 孩子们在学校与其他孩子交流时会学习社交技能。

interaction.example: Good interaction between the teacher and students makes the class more interesting.
interaction.exampleZh: 师生之间良好的互动让课堂更有趣。

interest.example: She shows great interest in music and art.
interest.exampleZh: 她对音乐和艺术表现出极大的兴趣。

interesting.example: This book is very interesting and I want to read it again.
interesting.exampleZh: 这本书很有趣，我想再读一遍。

interfere.example: Please do not interfere with my work when I am busy.
interfere.exampleZh: 我忙的时候请不要干涉我的工作。

interference.example: The bad weather caused serious interference with the radio signal during the game.
interference.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气在比赛期间对无线电信号造成了严重的干扰。

interior.example: The interior of the old house is dark and quiet.
interior.exampleZh: 这座老房子的内部又暗又安静。

internal.example: The company keeps its internal rules on a shared website for all staff.
internal.exampleZh: 公司把所有内部规定都放在一个共享网站上供全体员工查阅。

international.example: She works for an international company and often travels to other countries.
international.exampleZh: 她在一家国际公司工作，经常去其他国家出差。

internet.example: I use the internet every day to read news and send emails.
internet.exampleZh: 我每天用互联网看新闻和发邮件。

interpret.example: She had to interpret for the two visitors during the meeting.
interpret.exampleZh: 会议期间她必须为两位访客做口译。

interpretation.example: Her interpretation of the poem helped us understand its deeper meaning.
interpretation.exampleZh: 她对这首诗的解读帮助我们理解了它更深层的含义。

interrupt.example: Please do not interrupt me while I am speaking on the phone.
interrupt.exampleZh: 我打电话时请不要打断我。

interval.example: There is a short interval between the two classes.
interval.exampleZh: 两节课之间有一段短暂的间隔。

interview.example: She has an interview for a new job tomorrow morning.
interview.exampleZh: 她明天上午有一个新工作的面试。

intimate.example: She is on intimate terms with her new neighbors.
intimate.exampleZh: 她和她的新邻居关系亲密。

into.example: She walked into the kitchen and made a cup of tea.
into.exampleZh: 她走进厨房，泡了一杯茶。

introduce.example: Let me introduce you to my friend from Canada.
introduce.exampleZh: 让我把你介绍给我来自加拿大的朋友。

introduction.example: This book has a short introduction at the beginning.
introduction.exampleZh: 这本书开头有一篇简短的引言。

invade.example: The soldiers did not want to invade the small village.
invade.exampleZh: 士兵们不想侵入这个小村庄。

invasion.example: The invasion of the small country shocked people all over the world.
invasion.exampleZh: 对这个弱小国家的入侵震惊了全世界的人。

invent.example: She invented a simple game that her students really enjoy playing.
invent.exampleZh: 她发明了一个简单的游戏，她的学生们非常喜欢玩。

invention.example: The invention of the telephone changed how people talk to each other.
invention.exampleZh: 电话的发明改变了人们互相交谈的方式。

inventor.example: The inventor made a small machine that helps people clean their homes faster.
inventor.exampleZh: 这位发明家造了一台小机器，能帮助人们更快地打扫家里。

invest.example: She decided to invest her savings in a small local business.
invest.exampleZh: 她决定把积蓄投资到当地一家小企业。

investigate.example: The police came to investigate the problem in our small town last week.
investigate.exampleZh: 上周警察来调查我们小镇上的这个问题。

investment.example: She made a small investment in the local coffee shop last year.
investment.exampleZh: 她去年在当地那家咖啡店做了一笔小额投资。

invisible.example: The stars are invisible in the bright city sky at night.
invisible.exampleZh: 夜晚明亮的城市天空中看不见星星。

invitation.example: I was very happy to get an invitation to her birthday party.
invitation.exampleZh: 收到她生日聚会的邀请，我非常高兴。

invite.example: I want to invite my friends to dinner at my new home.
invite.exampleZh: 我想邀请朋友们到我的新家吃晚饭。

involve.example: The new job will involve a lot of travel and long hours.
involve.exampleZh: 这份新工作将需要大量出差和长时间工作。

inward.example: She turned her eyes inward to think about her real feelings.
inward.exampleZh: 她把目光转向内心，去思考自己真实的感受。

iron.example: She used a hot iron to press the shirt flat.
iron.exampleZh: 她用热熨斗把衬衫熨平。

island.example: There is a small island in the middle of the lake.

isolate.example: The doctors had to isolate the sick boy from the other children.
isolate.exampleZh: 医生们不得不把这个生病的男孩与其他孩子隔离开来。

issue.example: This is a serious issue that we must talk about today.
issue.exampleZh: 这是一个我们必须今天谈论的严重问题。

it.example: It is very cold outside today, so please wear your warm coat.
it.exampleZh: 今天外面很冷，请穿上你的厚外套。

italian.example: My best friend is Italian and she cooks delicious pasta every Sunday.
italian.exampleZh: 我最好的朋友是意大利人，她每个星期天都做美味的意大利面。

item.example: Please check the last item on the list before you leave.
item.exampleZh: 请在离开前核对一下清单上的最后一项。

its.example: The dog wags its tail whenever it sees me.
its.exampleZh: 那只狗每次见到我都会摇尾巴。

itself.example: The little cat cleaned itself after eating the fish.
itself.exampleZh: 小猫吃完鱼后自己清理干净了。

jacket.example: He wore a blue jacket to school on a cold morning.
jacket.exampleZh: 他在一个寒冷的早晨穿着蓝色夹克去上学。

jail.example: The thief was sent to jail for two years after the robbery.
jail.exampleZh: 那名窃贼在抢劫后被判入狱两年。

jam.example: Traffic jam made us late for work this morning.
jam.exampleZh: 今天早上的交通堵塞让我们上班迟到了。

january.example: My birthday is in January and it is very cold then.
january.exampleZh: 我的生日在一月，那时候非常冷。

jar.example: She keeps the sugar in a glass jar on the shelf.
jar.exampleZh: 她把糖放在架子上一个玻璃罐里。

jaw.example: He hit his jaw on the table when he fell down.
jaw.exampleZh: 他摔倒时下巴撞到了桌子上。

jazz.example: I like to listen to jazz when I study at night.
jazz.exampleZh: 我晚上学习的时候喜欢听爵士乐。

jeans.example: My sister wears blue jeans and a white shirt every weekend.
jeans.exampleZh: 我妹妹每个周末都穿蓝色牛仔裤和白衬衫。

jet.example: The jet flew high above the clouds on its way to Tokyo.
jet.exampleZh: 这架喷气式飞机在云层上方高空飞行，前往东京。

jewel.example: She wore a beautiful jewel on her finger at the party.
jewel.exampleZh: 她在聚会上手指上戴着一颗美丽的宝石。

jewelry.example: My mother keeps her beautiful jewelry in a small box near the window.
jewelry.exampleZh: 我妈妈把她漂亮的首饰放在窗边的一个小盒子里。

job.example: My job is to help students learn English every day.
job.exampleZh: 我的工作是每天帮助学生学习英语。

jog.example: I like to jog in the park before breakfast every morning.
jog.exampleZh: 我喜欢每天早上早饭前去公园慢跑。

join.example: Would you like to join us for dinner tonight?
join.exampleZh: 你今晚想和我们一起吃饭吗？

joint.example: The two companies signed a joint agreement to build a new school.
joint.exampleZh: 这两家公司签署了一项联合协议，共同建造一所新学校。

joke.example: My brother often tells a funny joke at the dinner table.
joke.exampleZh: 我弟弟经常在餐桌上讲一个有趣的笑话。

jolly.example: The jolly old man sang songs with the children in the park.
jolly.exampleZh: 那位快活的老人和孩子们在公园里唱歌。

journal.example: She writes in her journal every night before going to bed.
journal.exampleZh: 她每晚睡觉前都会在日记里写点东西。

journalist.example: The journalist asked the mayor several questions about the new school.
journalist.exampleZh: 这位新闻记者就新学校的事向市长提了几个问题。

journey.example: The journey from our town to the sea takes three hours by bus.
journey.exampleZh: 从我们镇到海边的旅程坐公交车要三个小时。

joy.example: The children jumped with joy when they saw the snow outside.
joy.exampleZh: 孩子们看到外面的雪时，高兴得跳了起来。

joyful.example: The children were joyful when they saw the snow outside.
joyful.exampleZh: 孩子们看到外面的雪时非常快乐。

judge.example: The judge listened carefully to both sides before making a decision.
judge.exampleZh: 法官在做出决定前仔细倾听了双方的陈述。

judgement.example: Her judgement of the situation was correct, and everyone trusted it.
judgement.exampleZh: 她对形势的判断是正确的，大家都信任她的判断。

juice.example: She drinks a glass of orange juice every morning before school.
juice.exampleZh: 她每天早上上学前都喝一杯橙汁。

july.example: We always take a long summer holiday in July.
july.exampleZh: 我们总是在七月休一个长长的暑假。

jump.example: The cat likes to jump onto the table when it wants food.
jump.exampleZh: 这只猫想吃东西时喜欢跳到桌子上。

junction.example: Turn left at the next junction and you will see the station.
junction.exampleZh: 在下一个交叉口向左转，你就会看到车站。

june.example: Our summer holiday starts in June and ends in early September.
june.exampleZh: 我们的暑假从六月开始，到九月初结束。

jungle.example: We got lost in the jungle and could not find our way out.
jungle.exampleZh: 我们在丛林里迷路了，找不到出去的路。

junior.example: He is a junior at our school and plays on the basketball team.
junior.exampleZh: 他是我们学校的大三学生，也在篮球队打球。

jury.example: The jury listened carefully to all the facts before making a decision.
jury.exampleZh: 陪审团在做出决定前仔细听取了所有事实。

just.example: I just got home and the food is just right.
just.exampleZh: 我刚到家，饭菜正好合适。

justice.example: The people asked for justice after the unfair trial.
justice.exampleZh: 在那场不公正的审判之后，人们要求正义。

justify.example: He tried to justify his mistake by blaming the bad weather.
justify.exampleZh: 他试图把错误归咎于恶劣的天气，以此证明自己有理。

keen.example: She is keen to learn English and practises every day.
keen.exampleZh: 她渴望学习英语，每天都练习。

keep.example: Please keep the door closed when you leave the room.
keep.exampleZh: 离开房间时，请把门保持关闭。

kettle.example: She put the kettle on the stove to boil water for tea.
