kettle.exampleZh: 她把水壶放在炉子上烧水泡茶。

key.example: He keeps his house key in a small box near the door.
key.exampleZh: 他把家里的钥匙放在门边的一个小盒子里。

keyboard.example: I type my homework on the keyboard every evening after school.
keyboard.exampleZh: 每天放学后我都用键盘打我的作业。

keynote.example: The CEO's keynote set the tone for the whole conference this year.
keynote.exampleZh: 首席执行官的主旨演讲为今年整场会议定下了基调。

kick.example: He kicked the ball hard and it went over the wall.
kick.exampleZh: 他用力踢球，球越过了墙。

kid.example: The kid next door likes to kid his sister about her new haircut.
kid.exampleZh: 隔壁那个小孩喜欢拿他姐姐的新发型开玩笑。

kidnap.example: The police are looking for the man who tried to kidnap a young boy.
kidnap.exampleZh: 警方正在寻找那个试图绑架一个小男孩的男子。

kidney.example: My doctor said I should drink more water to keep my kidneys healthy.
kidney.exampleZh: 医生说为了保持肾脏健康，我应该多喝水。

kill.example: Too much noise can kill the fun of a good party.
kill.exampleZh: 太大的噪音会扼杀一场好聚会的乐趣。

kilo.example: I bought two kilos of rice at the market yesterday.
kilo.exampleZh: 我昨天在市场买了两公斤大米。

kilogram.example: This bag of rice is exactly one kilogram, so it is easy to carry.
kilogram.exampleZh: 这袋米正好一千克，所以很容易拿。

kilometre.example: The school is only one kilometre from my house, so I walk there.
kilometre.exampleZh: 学校离我家只有一公里，所以我步行去那里。

kind.example: She is kind to everyone and always helps people in need.
kind.exampleZh: 她对每个人都很和蔼，总是帮助有需要的人。

kindergarten.example: My little sister starts kindergarten next week, and she is very excited.
kindergarten.exampleZh: 我妹妹下周开始上幼儿园，她非常兴奋。

kindness.example: Her kindness made the new students feel welcome on their first day.
kindness.exampleZh: 她的好意让新生在第一天就感到受欢迎。

king.example: The king lived in a big castle with his family.
king.exampleZh: 国王和他的家人住在一座大城堡里。

kingdom.example: The old king ruled his kingdom for more than forty years.
kingdom.exampleZh: 这位老国王统治他的王国超过四十年。

kiss.example: She gave her little son a kiss before he went to bed.
kiss.exampleZh: 她在小儿子上床睡觉前亲了他一下。

kit.example: She keeps a small repair kit in the drawer of her desk.
kit.exampleZh: 她在书桌抽屉里放了一个小修理工具包。

kitchen.example: My mother is cooking dinner in the kitchen right now.
kitchen.exampleZh: 我妈妈现在正在厨房里做晚饭。

kite.example: The boy is flying a red kite in the park with his father.
kite.exampleZh: 那个男孩正在公园里和爸爸一起放一只红色的风筝。

knee.example: My knee hurts a little after the long run yesterday.
knee.exampleZh: 昨天跑了很久之后，我的膝盖有点疼。

kneel.example: She had to kneel down to pick up the toy under the bed.
kneel.exampleZh: 她不得不跪下才能捡起床底下的玩具。

knife.example: Please be careful with that sharp knife when you cut the bread.
knife.exampleZh: 切面包时请小心那把锋利的刀。

knit.example: My grandmother likes to knit warm sweaters for the children in winter.
knit.exampleZh: 我奶奶喜欢在冬天为孩子们编织温暖的毛衣。

knob.example: She turned the knob slowly and opened the door.
knob.exampleZh: 她慢慢转动门把手，把门打开了。

knock.example: Please knock on the door before you come in.

knot.example: He tied a strong knot in the rope before climbing.
knot.exampleZh: 他在攀爬前在绳子上打了一个结实的结。

know.example: I know his name, but I do not know him well.
know.exampleZh: 我知道他的名字，但我不太了解他。

knowledge.example: Reading books every day helps you gain new knowledge about the world.
knowledge.exampleZh: 每天读书有助于你获得关于世界的新知识。

lab.example: The students did a simple science test in the lab today.
lab.exampleZh: 学生们今天在实验室里做了一个简单的科学实验。

label.example: Please read the label on the bottle before you take the medicine.
label.exampleZh: 服药前请阅读瓶子上的标签。

laboratory.example: The students did a simple science experiment in the laboratory today.
laboratory.exampleZh: 学生们今天在实验室里做了一个简单的科学实验。

labour.example: She went into labour early this morning and the baby is fine.
labour.exampleZh: 她今天清晨开始分娩，宝宝很健康。

lace.example: She tied the lace on her shoes and went out to play.
lace.exampleZh: 她系好鞋带，然后出去玩了。

lack.example: Many students lack the confidence to speak English in front of others.
lack.exampleZh: 许多学生缺乏在他人面前说英语的信心。

lad.example: The young lad ran across the field to catch the ball.
lad.exampleZh: 那个少年跑过球场去接球。

ladder.example: He used a ladder to reach the top shelf.
ladder.exampleZh: 他用梯子够到了最上层的架子。

lady.example: The lady at the desk helped me find the right room.
lady.exampleZh: 前台的那位女士帮我找到了正确的房间。

lag.example: Our team began to lag behind after two of our best players left.
lag.exampleZh: 两名最好的队员离开后，我们队开始落后了。

lake.example: We go swimming in the lake near our house every summer.
lake.exampleZh: 每年夏天我们都去家附近的湖里游泳。

lamb.example: The little lamb stayed close to its mother in the field.
lamb.exampleZh: 那只小羔羊在田野里紧挨着它的妈妈。

lame.example: His lame leg makes it hard for him to walk up the stairs.
lame.exampleZh: 他那条瘸腿让他很难走上楼梯。

lamp.example: Please turn on the lamp so I can read this book.
lamp.exampleZh: 请打开灯，这样我才能读这本书。

land.example: The plane will land in Beijing in ten minutes.
land.exampleZh: 飞机将在十分钟后在北京降落。

landing.example: The plane made a smooth landing despite the strong wind.
landing.exampleZh: 尽管风很大，飞机还是平稳地着陆了。

landlady.example: The landlady came to collect the rent on the first day of every month.
landlady.exampleZh: 女房东每个月第一天来收房租。

landlord.example: The landlord asked us to pay the rent before Friday.
landlord.exampleZh: 房东要求我们在周五之前交房租。

landscape.example: The landscape outside our small hotel window looked peaceful in the morning light.
landscape.exampleZh: 从小旅馆的窗户望出去，清晨光线下的景色显得十分宁静。

lane.example: The old man walked slowly down the narrow lane behind his house.
lane.exampleZh: 老人沿着屋后那条狭窄的小巷慢慢地走着。

language.example: Learning a new language can open many doors for you.
language.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言能为你打开许多扇门。

lantern.example: We hang a red lantern outside our house during the Spring Festival.
lantern.exampleZh: 春节期间，我们在房子外面挂一盏红灯笼。

lap.example: The cat sat on her lap and began to lick its paw.
lap.exampleZh: 猫坐在她的大腿上，开始舔自己的爪子。

lapse.example: A small lapse in care can cause big problems later.
lapse.exampleZh: 一时的疏忽可能在以后造成大问题。

large.example: They live in a large house near the river with a big garden.
large.exampleZh: 他们住在河边一栋带大花园的大房子里。

largely.example: The work is largely done, but we still need to check a few things.
largely.exampleZh: 这项工作大部分已经完成，但我们还需要检查几件事。

laser.example: The doctor used a laser to fix my eye.
laser.exampleZh: 医生用激光修复了我的眼睛。

last.example: This is the last bus, and it will last for two more hours.
last.exampleZh: 这是最后一班公交车，它还会再开两个小时。

late.example: Sorry, I am late for work again this morning.
late.exampleZh: 抱歉，今天早上我上班又迟到了。

lately.example: I have not seen my old friend lately.
lately.exampleZh: 我最近没见过我的老朋友。

latent.example: The doctor said the disease may stay latent in the body for years.
latent.exampleZh: 医生说这种疾病可能会在体内潜伏多年。

later.example: I will call you later when I finish my work.
later.exampleZh: 我完成工作后会稍后给你打电话。

latitude.example: The city is located at a latitude of about forty degrees north.
latitude.exampleZh: 这座城市位于北纬约四十度的地方。

latter.example: Of the two plans, the latter is easier to follow.
latter.exampleZh: 两个方案中，后者更容易执行。

laugh.example: The children laugh at the funny story and then run outside to play.
laugh.exampleZh: 孩子们听完这个有趣的故事大笑起来，然后跑到外面玩耍。

laughter.example: Her laughter filled the small room and made everyone feel happy.
laughter.exampleZh: 她的笑声充满了小房间，让每个人都感到快乐。

launch.example: The company plans to launch its new phone next month.
launch.exampleZh: 公司计划下个月推出它的新手机。

laundry.example: I take my dirty clothes to the laundry every Sunday morning.
laundry.exampleZh: 我每个星期天早上把脏衣服送到洗衣店。

lavatory.example: The lavatory is at the end of the hallway on the left.
lavatory.exampleZh: 盥洗室在走廊尽头的左边。

lavish.example: They held a lavish party for their daughter's birthday.
lavish.exampleZh: 他们为女儿的生日举办了一场奢华的派对。

law.example: Newton's law of gravity explains why apples fall to the ground.
law.exampleZh: 牛顿的万有引力定律解释了苹果为什么会落到地上。

lawn.example: The children are playing football on the green lawn in front of our house.
lawn.exampleZh: 孩子们正在我们房子前的绿色草坪上踢足球。

lawyer.example: My sister wants to become a lawyer because she likes helping people.
lawyer.exampleZh: 我姐姐想成为一名律师，因为她喜欢帮助别人。

lay.example: She will lay the baby on the bed and then cook dinner.
lay.exampleZh: 她会把宝宝放在床上，然后去做晚饭。

layer.example: The cake has three layers of soft chocolate and cream.
layer.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕有三层柔软的巧克力和奶油。

layout.example: The new layout of the room makes it look much bigger.
layout.exampleZh: 房间的新布局让它看起来大得多。

lazy.example: He is too lazy to clean his room on weekends.
lazy.exampleZh: 他太懒了，周末都不打扫自己的房间。

lead.example: The guide will lead us to the river before noon.
lead.exampleZh: 向导会在中午之前带我们到河边。

leader.example: She is a strong leader who always helps her team.
leader.exampleZh: 她是一位强大的领导者，总是帮助她的团队。

leadership.example: Good leadership helps a team work together and reach its goals.
leadership.exampleZh: 良好的领导能力有助于团队协作并实现目标。

leading.example: She is a leading expert in the field of computer science.
leading.exampleZh: 她是计算机科学领域的一位领先专家。

leaf.example: A small green leaf fell from the tree onto the wet ground.
leaf.exampleZh: 一片小小的绿叶从树上落到了湿漉漉的地上。

leaflet.example: The man handed me a leaflet about the new library.
leaflet.exampleZh: 那个人递给我一张关于新图书馆的传单。

league.example: Our school joined a new sports league last year.
league.exampleZh: 我们学校去年加入了一个新的体育联赛。

leak.example: Careless workers leak the company's secret plans to the press.
leak.exampleZh: 粗心的员工把公司的秘密计划泄露给了媒体。

lean.example: The old man leaned on his stick and walked slowly down the road.
lean.exampleZh: 那位老人倚着手杖，沿着路慢慢走着。

leap.example: The cat made a big leap onto the table to catch the fly.
leap.exampleZh: 那只猫一大跳跳到桌子上，想抓住那只苍蝇。

learn.example: I want to learn English well before I go to college.
learn.exampleZh: 我想在上大学之前学好英语。

learned.example: The learned professor explained the old book to his students.
learned.exampleZh: 那位博学的教授向学生们讲解了这本古书。

learning.example: Learning a new language takes time, but it is very useful.
learning.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言需要时间，但它非常有用。

lease.example: We signed a two-year lease for the small apartment near the park.
lease.exampleZh: 我们为公园附近的那套小公寓签了一份两年的租约。

least.example: This is the least expensive bag in the shop.

leather.example: She bought a soft leather bag for her new job.
leather.exampleZh: 她为这份新工作买了一个柔软的皮革包。

leave.example: Please leave your keys on the table before you go home.
leave.exampleZh: 回家前请把钥匙放在桌上。

lecture.example: The teacher gave a lecture on climate change to her class.
lecture.exampleZh: 老师给她的班级做了一场关于气候变化的讲座。

left.example: The bank is on the left side of the street.

leg.example: My left leg hurts after the long walk.
leg.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，我的左腿疼。

legal.example: It is not legal to drive a car without a license.
legal.exampleZh: 没有驾照开车是不合法的。

legend.example: The old man told us a legend about the mountain near his village.
legend.exampleZh: 那位老人给我们讲了一个关于他村庄附近那座山的传说。

legislation.example: The new legislation will protect the city's parks and rivers.
legislation.exampleZh: 这项新法规将保护城市的公园和河流。

leisure.example: In my leisure time, I like to read books and take long walks.
leisure.exampleZh: 在空闲时间里，我喜欢读书和长时间散步。

lemon.example: She likes to add a slice of lemon to her tea.
lemon.exampleZh: 她喜欢在茶里加一片柠檬。

lemonade.example: I like to drink cold lemonade on hot summer days.
lemonade.exampleZh: 我喜欢在炎热的夏天喝冰柠檬水。

lend.example: Can you lend me your bike for the weekend?
lend.exampleZh: 你能把自行车借给我用一个周末吗？

length.example: The length of the table is two meters.
length.exampleZh: 这张桌子的长度是两米。

lens.example: The camera lens was dirty, so all the photos looked a little blurry.
lens.exampleZh: 相机镜头脏了，所以所有照片看起来都有点模糊。

less.example: I have less free time this week than last week.
less.exampleZh: 我这周的空闲时间比上周少。

lesson.example: Every lesson in this book teaches us something useful about life.
lesson.exampleZh: 这本书里的每一课都教给我们一些有用的生活道理。

lest.example: Be careful with the knife lest you cut your fingers.
lest.exampleZh: 小心用刀，以免割到手指。

let.example: My parents let me go out with my friends on weekends.
let.exampleZh: 我父母允许我周末和朋友出去玩。

letter.example: She wrote a short letter to her teacher about the school trip.
letter.exampleZh: 她给老师写了一封关于学校旅行的短信。

level.example: The water level in the river rose after three days of heavy rain.
level.exampleZh: 三天的暴雨过后，河里的水位上升了。

lever.example: He used a long stick as a lever to move the heavy stone.
lever.exampleZh: 他用一根长棍当杠杆来移动那块沉重的石头。

liability.example: The company accepted liability for the damage caused by its workers.
liability.exampleZh: 公司承担了其工人造成损坏的责任。

liable.example: If you break the window, you will be liable for the cost.
liable.exampleZh: 如果你打破了窗户，你就要为这笔费用承担法律责任。

liberal.example: Her liberal parents let her choose her own friends and hobbies.
liberal.exampleZh: 她开明的父母让她自己选择朋友和爱好。

liberate.example: The soldiers helped liberate the small town from enemy control.
liberate.exampleZh: 士兵们帮助把这个小镇从敌人的控制下解放出来。

liberty.example: Every citizen should have the liberty to choose his own path in life.
liberty.exampleZh: 每个公民都应该有选择自己人生道路的自由。

librarian.example: The librarian helped me find a book about ancient China.
librarian.exampleZh: 图书馆管理员帮我找到了一本关于古代中国的书。

library.example: I often study in the library near my house after school.
library.exampleZh: 放学后我经常在我家附近的图书馆学习。

licence.example: You need a licence to drive a car in this country.
licence.exampleZh: 在这个国家，你需要驾照才能开车。

license.example: You need a license to drive a car in this country.
license.exampleZh: 在这个国家开车需要执照。

lick.example: The little dog likes to lick my hand when I come home.
lick.exampleZh: 我回家时，那只小狗喜欢舔我的手。

lid.example: She lifted the lid of the pot to see the soup.

lie.example: The old dog likes to lie on the warm floor every afternoon.
lie.exampleZh: 那只老狗喜欢每天下午躺在温暖的地板上。

life.example: Reading books can make your life richer and more interesting.
life.exampleZh: 读书能让你的生活更丰富、更有趣。

lifetime.example: He spent his lifetime teaching children in a small village school.
lifetime.exampleZh: 他一生都在一所乡村小学教书。

lift.example: The fog will lift soon, so we can drive to the airport.
lift.exampleZh: 雾很快会散去，所以我们可以开车去机场。

light.example: Please turn on the light so we can read the map.
light.exampleZh: 请打开灯，这样我们就能看地图了。

lighting.example: The lighting in this room is too bright for me.
lighting.exampleZh: 这个房间的灯光对我来说太亮了。

lightning.example: The lightning was so bright that it lit up the whole sky.
lightning.exampleZh: 那道闪电如此明亮，照亮了整个天空。

like.example: I like my new bike and I ride it every day.
like.exampleZh: 我喜欢我的新自行车，我每天都骑它。

likelihood.example: There is a high likelihood that it will rain tomorrow.
likelihood.exampleZh: 明天下雨的可能性很大。

likely.example: It is likely to rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
likely.exampleZh: 今天下午很可能下雨，所以带把伞。

likewise.example: He works hard, and his brother does likewise at school.
likewise.exampleZh: 他工作努力，他的弟弟在学校也同样如此。

limb.example: The doctor said the injured limb would heal in a few weeks.
limb.exampleZh: 医生说受伤的肢体几周后就会痊愈。

lime.example: Please add some lime to the soil before you plant the young trees.
lime.exampleZh: 在你种下这些小树之前，请往土壤里加一些石灰。

limit.example: There is a limit to how much I can eat.
limit.exampleZh: 我能吃的东西是有限度的。

limitation.example: One limitation of this plan is that it costs too much money.
limitation.exampleZh: 这个方案的一个局限是它花费太多钱。

limited.example: The new library has limited space, so please return your books early.
limited.exampleZh: 新图书馆空间有限，所以请早点归还你的书。

line.example: Please stand in line and wait for your turn to buy the ticket.
line.exampleZh: 请排队等候，轮到你时再买票。

link.example: Good friends link us to happy times in our old school.
link.exampleZh: 好朋友把我们与旧日学校里的快乐时光联系在一起。

lion.example: The lion sleeps under a big tree in the warm afternoon.
lion.exampleZh: 狮子在温暖的午后睡在一棵大树下。

lip.example: She put some red color on her lips before the party.
lip.exampleZh: 她在聚会前往嘴唇上涂了些红色。

liquid.example: Water is a clear liquid that we drink every day.
liquid.exampleZh: 水是我们每天都会喝的清澈液体。

liquor.example: My father keeps a bottle of strong liquor in the kitchen cupboard.
liquor.exampleZh: 我父亲在厨房橱柜里放着一瓶烈性酒。

list.example: Please list all the items on the shopping list before you go.
list.exampleZh: 去之前请把购物清单上的所有物品都列出来。

listen.example: I like to listen to music when I walk home.
listen.exampleZh: 我喜欢在走回家的路上听音乐。

literary.example: She studies literary works from the nineteenth century in her English class.
literary.exampleZh: 她在英语课上研究十九世纪的文学作品。

literature.example: She likes to read English literature in her free time.
literature.exampleZh: 她喜欢在空闲时间读英国文学作品。

litre.example: We bought two litres of milk at the supermarket this morning.
litre.exampleZh: 我们今天早上在超市买了两升牛奶。

litter.example: Please do not litter and put your trash in the bin.
litter.exampleZh: 请不要乱扔垃圾，把垃圾放进垃圾桶里。

little.example: There is little water left in the bottle.
little.exampleZh: 瓶子里剩下的水不多了。

live.example: I live in a small town near the sea with my family.
live.exampleZh: 我和家人住在海边的一个小镇上。

lively.example: The lively children played games in the park all afternoon.
lively.exampleZh: 那些活泼的孩子们整个下午都在公园里玩游戏。

liver.example: The doctor said my liver is healthy after he checked my body.
liver.exampleZh: 医生检查我的身体后说我的肝脏很健康。

living.example: My grandfather is still living in the old house by the river.
living.exampleZh: 我的祖父仍然住在河边的那座老房子里。

load.example: The workers will load the heavy boxes onto the truck this morning.
load.exampleZh: 工人们今天上午会把那些沉重的箱子装到卡车上。

loaf.example: I bought a loaf of bread and some milk at the shop.
loaf.exampleZh: 我在商店买了一条面包和一些牛奶。

loan.example: The bank gave me a loan to buy a new car.
loan.exampleZh: 银行给了我一笔贷款来买一辆新车。

lobby.example: We waited in the hotel lobby, and later he lobbied for better pay.
lobby.exampleZh: 我们在酒店大厅等候，后来他为更好的薪酬进行了游说。

local.example: The local food is fresh and very cheap.
local.exampleZh: 当地的食物新鲜又便宜。

locate.example: Please help me locate the nearest bus stop on this map.
locate.exampleZh: 请帮我在这张地图上找到最近的公交车站的位置。

location.example: The location of the new school is near the park.
location.exampleZh: 新学校的位置在公园附近。

lock.example: She lost the key and could not lock the door.
lock.exampleZh: 她把钥匙弄丢了，没法锁门。

lodge.example: Two students lodge with a kind family near the school.
lodge.exampleZh: 两名学生寄宿在学校附近一个善良的家庭里。

log.example: The captain keeps a log of every trip, and sailors log each storm.
log.exampleZh: 船长保存每次航行的日志，水手们也记录每场风暴。

logic.example: There is no logic in his plan, so we cannot follow it.
logic.exampleZh: 他的计划毫无逻辑，所以我们无法照做。

logical.example: It is logical to check your work before you hand it in.
logical.exampleZh: 交作业前检查一遍是合乎情理的。

lonely.example: He felt lonely after his best friend moved to another city.
lonely.exampleZh: 他最好的朋友搬到另一个城市后，他感到很孤独。

long.example: This river is very long, and I long to walk along it.
long.exampleZh: 这条河很长，我渴望沿着它散步。

look.example: You look tired today, so please take a good rest.
look.exampleZh: 你今天看起来很累，所以请好好休息一下。

loop.example: She drew a big loop on the paper.
loop.exampleZh: 她在纸上画了一个大圈。

loose.example: Her loose shirt made it easy for her to move.
loose.exampleZh: 她宽松的衬衫让她活动起来很方便。

loosen.example: Please loosen the lid a little so I can open the jar.
loosen.exampleZh: 请把盖子松开一点，这样我就能打开这个罐子了。

lord.example: The lord ruled the land with justice and kindness for many years.
lord.exampleZh: 这位领主多年来以公正和仁慈治理着这片土地。

lorry.example: The lorry is carrying a lot of boxes to the city.
lorry.exampleZh: 这辆卡车正载着许多箱子运往城里。

lose.example: Be careful with your keys, or you will lose them again.
lose.exampleZh: 小心你的钥匙，否则你会再次把它们弄丢。

loss.example: The loss of his old dog made him very sad.
loss.exampleZh: 失去他的老狗让他非常伤心。

lost.example: The lost child was crying near the busy road.
lost.exampleZh: 那个迷路的孩子在繁忙的马路边哭泣。

lot.example: There are a lot of books on the small desk.

loud.example: The music is too loud, so please turn it down a little.
loud.exampleZh: 音乐太大声了，请把它调小一点。

loudspeaker.example: The teacher spoke into a loudspeaker so all the students could hear.
loudspeaker.exampleZh: 老师对着扬声器讲话，这样所有学生都能听见。

love.example: I love my family and I love reading books at night.
love.exampleZh: 我爱我的家人，我也喜欢在晚上读书。

lovely.example: Our new teacher is a lovely person and everyone likes her.
lovely.exampleZh: 我们的新老师是个可爱的人，大家都喜欢她。

lover.example: My brother is a great lover of music and plays the piano every day.
lover.exampleZh: 我哥哥是个音乐爱好者，每天都弹钢琴。

low.example: The plane flew low over the houses and everyone looked up.
low.exampleZh: 飞机低低地飞过房屋上方，大家都抬头张望。

lower.example: The lower river is quiet and the water moves slowly.
lower.exampleZh: 下游的河流很安静，水流缓慢。

loyal.example: A loyal dog stays with its owner through good times and bad.
loyal.exampleZh: 一只忠诚的狗无论顺境逆境都陪伴在主人身边。

loyalty.example: Her loyalty to her friends never changed, even after many years.
loyalty.exampleZh: 她对朋友的忠诚从未改变，即使过了很多年。

luck.example: Good luck with your new job next week.
luck.exampleZh: 祝你下周的新工作好运。

lucky.example: You are lucky to have such good friends beside you.
lucky.exampleZh: 你很幸运，身边有这样好的朋友。

luggage.example: I put my luggage in the car before we left for the airport.
luggage.exampleZh: 出发去机场前，我把行李放进了车里。

lump.example: He felt a small lump on his neck and went to see a doctor.
lump.exampleZh: 他摸到脖子上有个小肿块，就去看医生了。

lunch.example: I usually eat lunch with my friends at school.
lunch.exampleZh: 我通常在学校和朋友们一起吃午饭。

lung.example: Smoking is very bad for your lungs and your heart.
lung.exampleZh: 吸烟对你的肺和心脏都非常有害。

luxury.example: She cannot afford the luxury of a new car this year.
luxury.exampleZh: 她今年买不起新车这种奢侈品。

machine.example: This machine helps us finish the work much faster.
machine.exampleZh: 这台机器帮助我们更快地完成工作。

machinery.example: The factory bought new machinery to make the work faster and safer.
machinery.exampleZh: 工厂购买了新机器，让工作更快更安全。

mad.example: He went mad when he saw the huge mess in his room.
mad.exampleZh: 当他看到房间里一片狼藉时，他气疯了。

madam.example: Excuse me, madam, may I help you with your bag?
madam.exampleZh: 打扰一下，女士，需要我帮您拿包吗？

magazine.example: She reads a popular magazine about cooking every month.
magazine.exampleZh: 她每个月都读一本关于烹饪的流行杂志。

magic.example: The children believe that magic can make their wishes come true.
magic.exampleZh: 孩子们相信魔法能让他们的愿望成真。

magnet.example: The small magnet held the note on the fridge door.
magnet.exampleZh: 那块小磁铁把便条吸在冰箱门上。

magnetic.example: Her magnetic smile makes everyone in the room feel welcome.
magnetic.exampleZh: 她有魅力的笑容让房间里的每个人都感到温暖。

magnificent.example: We stood on the hill and saw a magnificent view of the whole city.
magnificent.exampleZh: 我们站在山上，看到了整座城市壮丽的景色。

maid.example: The maid cleans the rooms every morning before the guests wake up.
maid.exampleZh: 女仆每天早上在客人醒来之前打扫房间。

mail.example: I will mail the letter to my friend today.
mail.exampleZh: 我今天要把信寄给我的朋友。

mailbox.example: I put the letter in the mailbox near my house.
mailbox.exampleZh: 我把信放进了我家附近的邮筒里。

main.example: The main road is closed today, so we must take another way.
main.exampleZh: 主路今天封闭了，所以我们必须走另一条路。

mainland.example: Many people take a train from the island to the mainland every day.
mainland.exampleZh: 每天都有很多人坐火车从岛上到大陆去。

maintain.example: We must maintain the machines every month to keep them working well.
maintain.exampleZh: 我们必须每月维修这些机器，让它们保持良好运转。

maintenance.example: The old car needs regular maintenance to stay safe on the road.
maintenance.exampleZh: 这辆旧车需要定期保养才能在路上保持安全。

major.example: My major is English, and I also study math every day.
major.exampleZh: 我的专业是英语，我每天还学数学。

majority.example: The majority of students in our class walk to school every day.
majority.exampleZh: 我们班大多数学生每天步行上学。

make.example: My father can make a small wooden table for the garden.
make.exampleZh: 我父亲会为花园做一张小木桌。

male.example: The male doctor and his male nurse work in this small hospital.
male.exampleZh: 这位男医生和他的男护士在这家小医院工作。

man.example: The tall man works in a small shop near my house.
man.exampleZh: 那个高个子男人在我家附近的一家小商店工作。

manage.example: She manages a small shop and takes care of three workers.
manage.exampleZh: 她经营着一家小店，还要照看三名员工。

management.example: Good management helps the whole team work better together.
management.exampleZh: 良好的管理有助于整个团队更好地协作。

manager.example: The manager of our small shop is very kind to every customer.
manager.exampleZh: 我们这家小店的经理对每位顾客都很和善。

mankind.example: Space travel may one day help mankind find a new home.
mankind.exampleZh: 太空旅行也许有一天会帮助人类找到新的家园。

manly.example: He is a strong and manly man who helps everyone in the village.
manly.exampleZh: 他是个强壮、有男子气概的人，村里人人都得到过他的帮助。

manner.example: He answered my question in a very polite manner.
manner.exampleZh: 他用非常礼貌的方式回答了我的问题。

manual.example: He read the manual carefully before fixing the old car by hand.
manual.exampleZh: 他在手工修理那辆旧车前仔细阅读了手册。

manufacture.example: The company uses machines to manufacture shoes for many people.
manufacture.exampleZh: 这家公司用机器为许多人制造鞋子。

manufacturer.example: The manufacturer of this phone says it will last for many years.
manufacturer.exampleZh: 这款手机的制造商说它能用很多年。

many.example: Many people in my town like to walk in the park after dinner.
many.exampleZh: 我们镇上的许多人喜欢晚饭后在公园里散步。

map.example: She drew a map of the small town for us.
map.exampleZh: 她为我们画了一张这个小镇的地图。

march.example: My birthday is in March and we always have a small party at home.
march.exampleZh: 我的生日在三月，我们总会在家办一个小小的聚会。

margin.example: Leave a wide margin on the page so you can write notes.
margin.exampleZh: 在页面上留出较宽的空白，这样你就可以写批注。

marine.example: The marine animals live in the deep blue sea.
marine.exampleZh: 这些海洋动物生活在深蓝色的海洋里。

mark.example: The teacher put a red mark on my test paper.
mark.exampleZh: 老师在我的试卷上做了个红色的记号。

market.example: The small town holds a market every Saturday morning near the old bridge.
market.exampleZh: 这个小镇每周六上午在老桥附近举办集市。

marriage.example: Their marriage has been happy for more than twenty years.
marriage.exampleZh: 他们的婚姻二十多年来一直很幸福。

married.example: My married sister lives in a small house near the river.
married.exampleZh: 我已婚的姐姐住在河边的一栋小房子里。

marry.example: She decided to marry him after they knew each other for a year.
marry.exampleZh: 在相识一年之后，她决定嫁给他。

marvelous.example: We had a marvelous time at the beach last weekend.
marvelous.exampleZh: 上周末我们在海滩度过了一段极好的时光。

marxism.example: My history teacher explained the basic ideas of marxism to our class today.
marxism.exampleZh: 我的历史老师今天向我们班讲解了马克思主义的基本思想。

mask.example: She wore a mask on the bus and tried to mask her cough.
mask.exampleZh: 她在公交车上戴着口罩，并试图掩饰自己的咳嗽。

mass.example: A mass of people gathered in the square to watch the show.
mass.exampleZh: 一大群人聚集在广场上观看表演。

massive.example: The new stadium is a massive building that can hold thousands of people.
massive.exampleZh: 这座新体育场是一座巨大的建筑，可以容纳数千人。

master.example: She worked hard to master English and became a master of it.
master.exampleZh: 她努力学习以精通英语，并成为这方面的大师。

masterpiece.example: This old book is a masterpiece of modern Chinese literature.
masterpiece.exampleZh: 这本旧书是中国现代文学的一部杰作。

mat.example: I put a soft mat on the floor beside my bed.
mat.exampleZh: 我在床边的地板上放了一张柔软的垫子。

match.example: This match is easy and the two teams are very good.
match.exampleZh: 这场比赛很轻松，两支队伍都非常出色。

mate.example: My mate at work helps me with new tasks every day.
mate.exampleZh: 我的工作伙伴每天都帮我处理新任务。

material.example: We need more material to build this small house for the family.
material.exampleZh: 我们需要更多材料来为这家人建造这座小房子。

math.example: I like math because numbers and shapes are fun to work with.
math.exampleZh: 我喜欢数学，因为数字和形状很有趣。

mathematical.example: She solved the mathematical problem faster than anyone else in her class.
mathematical.exampleZh: 她解那道数学题比班上任何人都快。

mathematics.example: I find mathematics difficult, but I like solving number problems.
mathematics.exampleZh: 我觉得数学很难，但我喜欢解数字题。

matter.example: It does not matter if we are a little late today.
matter.exampleZh: 我们今天稍微迟到一点没关系。

mature.example: She is mature enough to make her own decisions now.
mature.exampleZh: 她现在足够成熟，可以自己做决定了。

maximum.example: The tank can hold a maximum of fifty liters of water.
maximum.exampleZh: 这个水箱最多能装五十升水。

may.example: It may rain later, so please take your umbrella with you today.
may.exampleZh: 今天晚些时候可能会下雨，所以请带上你的伞。

maybe.example: Maybe it will rain later, so bring an umbrella with you.
maybe.exampleZh: 也许稍后会下雨，所以你带把伞吧。

mayor.example: The mayor opened the new library in our town last week.
mayor.exampleZh: 市长上周在我们镇上为新的图书馆揭幕。

me.example: Please give me a glass of water.

meal.example: We usually eat three meals a day at home.
meal.exampleZh: 我们通常在家一天吃三顿饭。

mean.example: I did not mean to hurt your feelings yesterday.
mean.exampleZh: 我昨天不是故意要伤害你的感情。

meaning.example: Can you explain the meaning of this word to me?
meaning.exampleZh: 你能给我解释一下这个词的意思吗？

means.example: The bike is my only means of getting to school every day.
means.exampleZh: 自行车是我每天上学唯一的交通工具。

meantime.example: In the meantime, we can talk about our plan for tomorrow.
meantime.exampleZh: 在此期间，我们可以聊聊明天的计划。

meanwhile.example: I cooked dinner and meanwhile my brother cleaned the whole kitchen.
meanwhile.exampleZh: 我做了晚饭，与此同时我弟弟打扫了整个厨房。

measure.example: We need to measure the size of the table before we buy it.
measure.exampleZh: 我们买桌子之前需要测量一下桌子的尺寸。

measurement.example: The measurement of this table is two meters long and one meter wide.
measurement.exampleZh: 这张桌子的尺寸是长两米、宽一米。

meat.example: My mother cooks meat with rice and fresh vegetables every Sunday.
meat.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天都用米饭和新鲜蔬菜做肉。

mechanic.example: The mechanic fixed my car in less than an hour.
mechanic.exampleZh: 那位机修工不到一小时就修好了我的车。

mechanical.example: His mechanical movements showed that he was very tired after the long trip.
mechanical.exampleZh: 他机械般的动作表明，长途旅行后他非常疲惫。

mechanism.example: The locking mechanism on the door was broken, so it would not close.
mechanism.exampleZh: 门上的锁扣装置坏了，所以门关不上。

medal.example: She won a gold medal in the running race last year.
medal.exampleZh: 她在去年的跑步比赛中赢得了一枚金牌。

media.example: Social media is a big part of our daily life now.
media.exampleZh: 社交媒体如今是我们日常生活中很重要的一部分。

medical.example: She wants to study medical science at a good university next year.
medical.exampleZh: 她想明年在一所好大学学习医学。

medicine.example: The doctor gave me some medicine and told me to rest at home.
medicine.exampleZh: 医生给了我一些药，并让我在家休息。

medium.example: The internet is a medium for sharing news with people around the world.
medium.exampleZh: 互联网是向世界各地的人们分享新闻的一种媒介。

meet.example: I am very happy to meet my old friends today.
meet.exampleZh: 今天见到我的老朋友们，我很开心。

meeting.example: I have a meeting with my teacher after school today.
meeting.exampleZh: 我今天放学后和老师有一个会面。

melt.example: The butter will melt quickly in this hot pan.
melt.exampleZh: 黄油在这个热锅里很快就会融化。

member.example: Every member of our family helps with the housework on weekends.
member.exampleZh: 我们家每个成员周末都会帮忙做家务。

membership.example: Club membership gives you free access to all the classes.
membership.exampleZh: 会员资格让你可以免费参加所有课程。

memorial.example: The town built a memorial for the soldiers who died in the war.
memorial.exampleZh: 小镇为在战争中牺牲的士兵建了一座纪念碑。

memory.example: My memory is not good, so I write everything down.
memory.exampleZh: 我的记忆力不好，所以我把一切都写下来。

mend.example: My father will mend the broken chair this afternoon.
mend.exampleZh: 我父亲今天下午会修好那把坏椅子。

mental.example: Regular exercise is good for both your mental and physical health.
mental.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的心理健康和身体健康都有好处。

mention.example: She did not mention his name during the meeting this morning.
mention.exampleZh: 今天上午的会上她没有提到他的名字。

menu.example: The waiter gave me a menu, and I chose a simple soup.
menu.exampleZh: 服务员给了我一份菜单，我选了一份简单的汤。

merchant.example: The merchant sells fresh fruit and vegetables at the town market.
merchant.exampleZh: 这个商人在镇上的市场卖新鲜水果和蔬菜。

mercy.example: The kind doctor showed mercy to the poor family and helped them.
mercy.exampleZh: 那位善良的医生怜悯这个贫困家庭并帮助了他们。

mere.example: The mere idea of moving abroad made her feel nervous.
mere.exampleZh: 仅仅想到要搬到国外，她就感到紧张。

merely.example: He is merely a child and cannot do this work alone.
merely.exampleZh: 他只不过是个孩子，无法独自完成这项工作。

merge.example: The two small companies will merge into one big team next year.
merge.exampleZh: 这两家小公司明年将合并成一个大团队。

merit.example: This plan has one clear merit: it is simple and cheap.
merit.exampleZh: 这个方案有一个明显的优点：简单又省钱。

merry.example: The children were merry at the birthday party last night.
merry.exampleZh: 孩子们在昨晚的生日聚会上很欢乐。

mess.example: The kitchen was a mess after the party, so we cleaned it together.
mess.exampleZh: 聚会过后厨房一片狼藉，所以我们一起打扫了它。

message.example: She left a message for me on the kitchen table.
message.exampleZh: 她在厨房桌子上给我留了一张便条。

metal.example: This box is made of metal and it feels very heavy.
metal.exampleZh: 这个箱子是用金属做的，感觉非常重。

meter.example: The water meter in our building shows how much we use each month.
meter.exampleZh: 我们楼里的水表显示了每个月我们的用水量。

method.example: We need a better method to solve this problem quickly.
method.exampleZh: 我们需要一个更好的方法来快速解决这个问题。

metre.example: The room is five metres long and three metres wide.
metre.exampleZh: 这个房间长五米，宽三米。

metropolitan.example: Life in a metropolitan city is fast but full of chances.
metropolitan.exampleZh: 大都市的生活节奏很快，但充满机会。

mexican.example: My neighbor is Mexican and he cooks very good food for us.
mexican.exampleZh: 我的邻居是墨西哥人，他常给我们做非常好吃的菜。

microphone.example: The singer held the microphone in her hand and smiled at the crowd.
microphone.exampleZh: 歌手手里拿着麦克风，对着人群微笑。

microscope.example: The teacher showed us a tiny insect under the microscope.
microscope.exampleZh: 老师让我们在显微镜下看一只小昆虫。

microwave.example: She put the cold soup in the microwave for two minutes.
microwave.exampleZh: 她把冷汤放进微波炉里热了两分钟。

midday.example: We usually take a short walk at midday when the weather is nice.
midday.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我们通常在正午去散一会儿步。

middle.example: There is a small table in the middle of the room.
middle.exampleZh: 房间中间有一张小桌子。

midnight.example: The train leaves at midnight, so we must go to bed early.
midnight.exampleZh: 火车午夜出发，所以我们必须早点睡觉。

might.example: She might be late, but she has great might in the team.
might.exampleZh: 她可能会迟到，但她在团队中很有力量。

mild.example: Her voice is mild and calm, so the children like her.
mild.exampleZh: 她的声音温和又平静，所以孩子们都喜欢她。

mile.example: The nearest town is only a mile from our small house.
mile.exampleZh: 最近的城镇离我们的小房子只有一英里。

military.example: The military is building a new base near the city.
military.exampleZh: 军方正在城市附近建造一个新基地。

milk.example: My mother gives me a glass of milk every morning before school.
milk.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上上学前给我一杯牛奶。

mill.example: The old mill by the river still makes flour for the village.
mill.exampleZh: 河边的老磨坊仍在为村里磨面粉。

millimetre.example: The nail is only a few millimetres long, so please be careful with it.
millimetre.exampleZh: 这根钉子只有几毫米长，所以请小心拿它。

million.example: This city has more than one million people living in it.
million.exampleZh: 这座城市有超过一百万人居住。

millionaire.example: The old millionaire gave most of his money to help poor children.
millionaire.exampleZh: 这位年老的百万富翁把大部分钱财捐给了贫困儿童。

mind.example: Please keep an open mind when you listen to new ideas.
mind.exampleZh: 听新想法时，请保持开放的心态。

mine.example: This old mine is now a safe place for children to visit.
mine.exampleZh: 这座老矿现在成了孩子们可以安全参观的地方。

mineral.example: This rock contains many valuable minerals, and the water is rich in minerals too.
mineral.exampleZh: 这块岩石含有许多有价值的矿物，水也富含矿物质。

minimum.example: The minimum age to drive a car here is eighteen.
minimum.exampleZh: 在这里开车的最低年龄是十八岁。

minister.example: The minister spoke to the people about the new law.
minister.exampleZh: 部长向民众介绍了这项新法律。

ministry.example: The Ministry of Education announced a new plan for all public schools.
ministry.exampleZh: 教育部宣布了一项面向所有公立学校的新计划。

minor.example: The car had a minor problem, so we drove home without trouble.
minor.exampleZh: 这辆车出了个小问题，所以我们顺利开车回家了。

minority.example: Only a small minority of students came to the meeting on time.
minority.exampleZh: 只有少部分学生准时来参加了会议。

minus.example: Seven minus four is three, and the minus sign shows you subtract.
minus.exampleZh: 七减四等于三，那个负号表示你要相减。

minute.example: Please wait a minute while I find the meeting minutes.
minute.exampleZh: 请稍等一分钟，我去找一下会议记录。

miracle.example: It was a miracle that no one was hurt in the big storm.
miracle.exampleZh: 那场大风暴中没有人受伤，真是个奇迹。

mirror.example: The calm lake can mirror the mountains and the sky on a clear day.
mirror.exampleZh: 在晴朗的日子里，平静的湖面能映出群山和天空。

miserable.example: The cold rain made everyone feel miserable during the long walk home.
miserable.exampleZh: 回家的长途步行中，冷雨让每个人都感到痛苦难受。

mislead.example: Don't let the bright colors mislead you about how this product works.
mislead.exampleZh: 不要让鲜艳的颜色误导你对这个产品使用方法的理解。

miss.example: I miss my old friends and often think of the happy days we spent together.
miss.exampleZh: 我想念我的老朋友们，常常想起我们一起度过的快乐时光。

missile.example: The missile flew high into the sky and everyone watched it in fear.
missile.exampleZh: 导弹高高飞向天空，大家都恐惧地看着它。

missing.example: The police are still looking for the missing child.
missing.exampleZh: 警察仍在寻找那个失踪的孩子。

mission.example: Our mission is to help poor children go to school.
mission.exampleZh: 我们的使命是帮助贫困儿童上学。

mist.example: A thin mist covered the lake early this morning.
mist.exampleZh: 今天清晨，一层薄雾笼罩着湖面。

mistake.example: I made a small mistake on the test, but I fixed it.
mistake.exampleZh: 我在考试中犯了一个小错误，但我把它改正了。

misunderstand.example: Please do not misunderstand me when I say I am very tired today.
misunderstand.exampleZh: 我说我今天很累时，请不要误会我的意思。

mix.example: You should mix the flour and water in a big bowl.
mix.exampleZh: 你应该在一个大碗里把面粉和水混合起来。

mixture.example: The cake is a mixture of flour, eggs and sugar.
mixture.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕是面粉、鸡蛋和糖的混合物。

mo(u)ld.example: The old bread was covered with green mould.
mo(u)ld.exampleZh: 那块旧面包上长满了绿色的霉。

moan.example: She began to moan softly when the nurse cleaned her wound.
moan.exampleZh: 护士清洗她的伤口时，她开始轻声呻吟。

mobile.example: My mobile phone is small and easy to carry.
mobile.exampleZh: 我的手机很小，便于携带。

mode.example: This phone has a simple mode for older users.
mode.exampleZh: 这款手机有一个适合老年人的简单模式。

model.example: She is a famous model and often wears beautiful dresses at shows.
model.exampleZh: 她是一位著名的模特，经常在时装秀上穿漂亮的裙子。

moderate.example: The doctor told him to do moderate exercise every day for better health.
moderate.exampleZh: 医生让他每天做适度的运动以改善健康。

modern.example: Modern phones can do many things that old computers could not do.
modern.exampleZh: 现代手机能做许多旧电脑做不到的事情。

modest.example: He is modest about his success and never talks about it much.
modest.exampleZh: 他对自己的成功很谦虚，很少谈论这件事。

modify.example: We need to modify the plan before the meeting tomorrow morning.
modify.exampleZh: 我们需要在明天上午开会前修改这个计划。

moist.example: The soil here is moist and good for growing vegetables.
moist.exampleZh: 这里的土壤湿润，适合种蔬菜。

moisture.example: The air in the room was full of moisture after the rain.
moisture.exampleZh: 雨后房间的空气里充满了湿气。

molecule.example: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
molecule.exampleZh: 一个水分子含有两个氢原子和一个氧原子。

moment.example: Please wait a moment while I find your file.
moment.exampleZh: 请稍等片刻，我去找你的文件。

monday.example: I have a math class every Monday morning at nine.
monday.exampleZh: 我每周一早上九点有一节数学课。

money.example: I do not have enough money to buy a new bike today.
money.exampleZh: 我今天没有足够的钱买一辆新自行车。

monitor.example: The teacher asked the class monitor to monitor the students during the test.
monitor.exampleZh: 老师让班长在考试期间监督同学们。

monkey.example: The monkey is eating a banana in the tree.

month.example: We will visit my grandparents next month during the school holiday.
month.exampleZh: 下个月学校放假时我们会去看望我的祖父母。

monthly.example: The monthly meeting is held on the first Monday of each month.
monthly.exampleZh: 每月的会议在每月第一个星期一举行。

monument.example: This old monument stands in the middle of the city square.
monument.exampleZh: 这座古老的纪念碑矗立在城市广场的中央。

mood.example: Her mood got much better after she heard the good news.
mood.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息后，她的心情好多了。

moon.example: The moon is very bright and beautiful tonight.

moral.example: The story has a clear moral about honesty and kindness.
moral.exampleZh: 这个故事有一个关于诚实和善良的明确寓意。

more.example: I need more time to finish this work today.
more.exampleZh: 今天我需要更多时间来完成这项工作。

moreover.example: The room is small and cheap; moreover, it is close to the station.
moreover.exampleZh: 这个房间又小又便宜，而且离车站很近。

morning.example: I drink a glass of water every morning before breakfast.
morning.exampleZh: 我每天早上在早餐前喝一杯水。

mortal.example: All mortal creatures must die one day.
mortal.exampleZh: 所有终有一死的生灵终将死去。

mosquito.example: A mosquito bit my arm last night while I was sleeping.
mosquito.exampleZh: 昨晚我睡觉时一只蚊子咬了我的胳膊。

most.example: Most students in our class like English and math.
most.exampleZh: 我们班大多数学生喜欢英语和数学。

mostly.example: The students in this class are mostly from small towns nearby.
mostly.exampleZh: 这个班的学生大多来自附近的小镇。

mother.example: My mother makes breakfast for us every morning before school.
mother.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上在我们上学前给我们做早饭。

motion.example: The motion of the small boat made me feel sick.
motion.exampleZh: 小船的运动让我感到恶心。

motivate.example: Good teachers motivate their students to learn new things.
motivate.exampleZh: 好老师激励学生去学习新事物。

motive.example: The police could not find a clear motive for the crime.
motive.exampleZh: 警方无法找到这起犯罪的明确动机。

motor.example: The motor in this old car is very loud and needs repair.
motor.exampleZh: 这辆旧汽车的发动机很吵，需要修理。

mount.example: They will mount new lights on the wall before the party.
mount.exampleZh: 他们会在聚会前把新灯安装到墙上。

mountain.example: We climbed a high mountain last summer and saw snow at the top.
mountain.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们爬了一座高山，在山顶看到了雪。

mourn.example: Many people mourn the loss of their old friend.
mourn.exampleZh: 许多人为失去老朋友而哀悼。

mouse.example: A small mouse ran under the table and hid behind the box.
mouse.exampleZh: 一只小老鼠跑到桌子底下，躲在箱子后面。

mouth.example: The boat sailed slowly into the mouth of the river.

move.example: We will move to a new house next week.
move.exampleZh: 我们下周会搬到新房子。

movement.example: The slow movement of the clouds told us a storm was coming.
movement.exampleZh: 云层的缓慢移动告诉我们暴风雨要来了。

movie.example: We watched a funny movie at home last night.
movie.exampleZh: 我们昨晚在家看了一部有趣的电影。

much.example: I don't have much time to finish this work today.
much.exampleZh: 我今天没有太多时间完成这项工作。

mud.example: The children came home with mud all over their shoes.
mud.exampleZh: 孩子们回家时鞋子上全是泥。

mug.example: She poured hot coffee into a big mug and sat down.
mug.exampleZh: 她把热咖啡倒进一个大杯子里，然后坐了下来。

multiple.example: This job requires multiple skills, and the pay is a multiple of my old salary.
multiple.exampleZh: 这份工作需要多种技能，而薪水是我原来工资的倍数。

multiply.example: If you multiply five by three, you get fifteen.
multiply.exampleZh: 如果你把五乘以三，就会得到十五。

multitude.example: A multitude of people gathered in the square to watch the show.
multitude.exampleZh: 一大群人聚集在广场上观看表演。

murder.example: He was sent to prison for the murder of his neighbour.
murder.exampleZh: 他因谋杀邻居而被送进监狱。

muscle.example: He goes to the gym every day to build strong muscles.
muscle.exampleZh: 他每天去健身房锻炼，以练出强壮的肌肉。

museum.example: We visited the science museum with our class last Friday morning.
museum.exampleZh: 上周五上午我们和班级一起参观了科学博物馆。

mushroom.example: The mushroom soup tastes good, and the mushroom shop is growing fast.
mushroom.exampleZh: 这蘑菇汤味道不错，而那家蘑菇店正在快速发展。

music.example: I listen to music every morning when I walk to school.
music.exampleZh: 我每天早上走路上学时都听音乐。

musical.example: She has a very musical voice and sings in the school band.
musical.exampleZh: 她有一条很动听的嗓音，还在学校乐队里唱歌。

musician.example: The young musician plays the piano every day after school.
musician.exampleZh: 这位年轻的音乐家每天放学后弹钢琴。

must.example: You must finish your homework before you watch TV.
must.exampleZh: 你必须先完成作业才能看电视。

mute.example: He remained mute during the meeting and did not say a word.
mute.exampleZh: 他在会上保持沉默，一句话也没说。

mutter.example: She muttered something under her breath and walked away.
mutter.exampleZh: 她低声咕哝了几句，然后走开了。

mutton.example: My mother cooks mutton with potatoes for dinner on cold days.
mutton.exampleZh: 在寒冷的日子里，我妈妈会用土豆炖羊肉当晚餐。

mutual.example: They have a mutual respect for each other and work well together.
mutual.exampleZh: 他们彼此尊重，合作得很好。

my.example: My book is on the desk near the window.
my.exampleZh: 我的书在窗户旁边的桌子上。

myself.example: I hurt myself while playing basketball yesterday afternoon.
myself.exampleZh: 昨天下午我打篮球时伤到了自己。

mysterious.example: The old house at the end of our street looks dark and mysterious.
mysterious.exampleZh: 我们街道尽头的那栋老房子看起来又黑又神秘。

mystery.example: The old house on the hill is a mystery to everyone in town.
mystery.exampleZh: 山上的那座老房子对镇上的每个人来说都是个谜。

myth.example: The story of the dragon is a myth that children love to hear.
myth.exampleZh: 龙的故事是一个孩子们喜欢听的神话。

nail.example: He used a hammer to hit the nail into the wood.
nail.exampleZh: 他用锤子把钉子敲进木头里。

naive.example: You are too naive to believe everything he says.
naive.exampleZh: 你太天真了，竟然相信他说的一切。

naked.example: The little boy ran across the beach naked and laughing.
naked.exampleZh: 那个小男孩光着身子跑过海滩，一边哈哈大笑。

name.example: Please write your name at the top of the paper.
name.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在试卷的顶部。

namely.example: Only one student passed the test, namely Tom.
namely.exampleZh: 只有一个学生通过了考试，也就是汤姆。

narrative.example: She wrote a short narrative about her trip to Japan.
narrative.exampleZh: 她写了一篇关于日本之行的简短叙述。

narrow.example: The road is too narrow for two cars to pass.
narrow.exampleZh: 这条路太窄，两辆车无法通过。

nasty.example: The weather was nasty, so we stayed inside all day.
nasty.exampleZh: 天气很恶劣，所以我们一整天都待在屋里。

nation.example: The whole nation celebrated when their team won the big game.
nation.exampleZh: 当他们的球队赢得那场重要比赛时，举国欢庆。

national.example: The national team won the game last night in front of many happy fans.
national.exampleZh: 国家队昨晚在许多开心的球迷面前赢得了比赛。

nationality.example: Please write your nationality on this form before you sign it.
nationality.exampleZh: 请在签字前在这张表格上写下你的国籍。

native.example: She is a native speaker of English and teaches at our school.
native.exampleZh: 她是一名英语母语者，在我们学校教书。

natural.example: It is natural for children to ask many questions about the world.
natural.exampleZh: 孩子们对世界提出许多问题是正常的。

naturally.example: She naturally speaks English well because she grew up in Canada.
naturally.exampleZh: 她天生英语说得好，因为她是在加拿大长大的。

nature.example: It is in her nature to help people who need it.

naval.example: My uncle works at a naval base near the sea.
naval.exampleZh: 我叔叔在海边的一个海军基地工作。

navigate.example: It is hard to navigate the city without a map.
navigate.exampleZh: 没有地图很难在这座城市里找到方向。

navigation.example: The ship's navigation system failed during the storm, so the crew used a map.
navigation.exampleZh: 暴风雨中船上的导航系统失灵了，所以船员们改用地图。

navy.example: My uncle joined the navy when he was just eighteen years old.
navy.exampleZh: 我叔叔十八岁那年加入了海军。

near.example: My new house is near the school and the park.
near.exampleZh: 我的新房子在学校和公园附近。

nearby.example: There is a small park nearby where children like to play.
nearby.exampleZh: 附近有一个小公园，孩子们喜欢在那里玩。

nearly.example: I have nearly finished my homework and I will go to bed soon.
nearly.exampleZh: 我几乎做完作业了，很快就要睡觉。

neat.example: Her small room is always neat and clean.
neat.exampleZh: 她的小房间总是整洁干净。

necessarily.example: Not every cheap thing is necessarily bad.
necessarily.exampleZh: 便宜的东西不一定都是坏的。

necessary.example: It is necessary to drink enough water every day.
necessary.exampleZh: 每天喝足够的水是必要的。

necessity.example: Clean water is a basic necessity of life for everyone.
necessity.exampleZh: 清洁的水是每个人生活的基本必需品。

neck.example: The cold wind made my neck feel very cold today.
neck.exampleZh: 今天冷风让我的脖子感觉很冷。

necklace.example: She wore a silver necklace to the party last night.
necklace.exampleZh: 她昨晚戴了一条银色项链去参加聚会。

need.example: I need your help with this work today.
need.exampleZh: 我今天这项工作需要你的帮助。

needle.example: The nurse put the needle in my arm and it hurt a little.
needle.exampleZh: 护士把针扎进我的手臂，有点疼。

negative.example: His negative answer made everyone in the room feel a little worried.
negative.exampleZh: 他否定的回答让房间里的每个人都感到有些担心。

neglect.example: Many students neglect their health while they study for exams.
neglect.exampleZh: 许多学生在备考时忽视了自己的健康。

negotiate.example: The two companies will negotiate a new price tomorrow.
negotiate.exampleZh: 两家公司明天将协商一个新价格。

negotiation.example: The two sides will begin a new negotiation next week.
negotiation.exampleZh: 双方将于下周开始新一轮谈判。

neighbor.example: Our new neighbor often helps us carry heavy bags up the stairs.
neighbor.exampleZh: 我们的新邻居经常帮我们把沉重的袋子搬上楼。

neighborhood.example: There are many small shops and a park in my neighborhood.
neighborhood.exampleZh: 我的街区里有很多小商店和一个公园。

neither.example: Neither of my two brothers likes coffee in the morning.
neither.exampleZh: 我的两个兄弟早上都不喜欢喝咖啡。

nephew.example: My nephew is only five years old and loves to play football.
nephew.exampleZh: 我的侄子只有五岁，非常喜欢踢足球。

nerve.example: It takes a lot of nerve to speak in front of the whole school.
nerve.exampleZh: 在全校师生面前讲话需要很大的勇气。

nervous.example: I feel nervous before every exam, but I always try to stay calm.
nervous.exampleZh: 每次考试前我都会紧张，但我总是尽量保持冷静。

nest.example: The small bird built a nest in the tree near my window.
nest.exampleZh: 那只小鸟在我窗边的树上筑了一个巢。

net.example: The fisherman pulled the heavy net out of the cold water.
net.exampleZh: 渔夫把沉重的网从冷水中拉了出来。

network.example: The city has a large network of buses and trains.
network.exampleZh: 这座城市拥有庞大的公交车和火车网络。

neutral.example: The judge tried to stay neutral during the argument between the two sides.
neutral.exampleZh: 法官在双方的争论中尽量保持中立。

never.example: He never drinks coffee after six in the evening.
never.exampleZh: 他从不在晚上六点以后喝咖啡。

nevertheless.example: The test was hard; nevertheless, she passed it easily.
nevertheless.exampleZh: 这次考试很难，然而她轻松通过了。

new.example: She bought a new phone with a bigger screen last week.
new.exampleZh: 她上周买了一部屏幕更大的新手机。

newly.example: The newly built library is very quiet in the morning.
newly.exampleZh: 新近建成的图书馆早上非常安静。

news.example: I watched the news on TV with my family last night.
news.exampleZh: 昨晚我和家人一起在电视上看了新闻。

newspaper.example: My father reads the newspaper every morning before he goes to work.
newspaper.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上上班前都会看报纸。

next.example: I will see you next week at the same place.
next.exampleZh: 我下周在同一个地方见你。

nice.example: She is very nice to the new students in her class.
nice.exampleZh: 她对她班上的新同学非常友善。

niece.example: My niece is coming to visit us this weekend with her parents.
niece.exampleZh: 我侄女这个周末要和她的父母一起来看我们。

night.example: The stars look very bright in the night sky.
night.exampleZh: 夜晚的天空中星星看起来非常明亮。

nightmare.example: I had a terrible nightmare about falling off a tall building last night.
nightmare.exampleZh: 昨晚我做了一个可怕的噩梦，梦见自己从高楼上摔下来。

nine.example: My little brother is nine years old and he loves to play football.
nine.exampleZh: 我弟弟九岁了，他很喜欢踢足球。

nineteen.example: My sister is nineteen years old and she studies at a big school.
nineteen.exampleZh: 我姐姐十九岁，她在一所很大的学校读书。

ninety.example: My grandfather is ninety years old and still walks to the park every morning.
ninety.exampleZh: 我爷爷九十岁了，每天早上仍然步行去公园。

ninth.example: My office is on the ninth floor of this old building.
ninth.exampleZh: 我的办公室在这栋旧楼的第九层。

no.example: There is no milk in the fridge, so we must buy some.
no.exampleZh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了，所以我们必须买一些。

noble.example: He was a noble man who always helped poor people in his town.
noble.exampleZh: 他是一个高尚的人，总是帮助镇上的穷人。

nobody.example: Nobody in our class knew the answer to that easy question.
nobody.exampleZh: 我们班上没有人知道那个简单问题的答案。

nod.example: She gave a small nod and smiled at me.
nod.exampleZh: 她轻轻点了下头，对我笑了笑。

noise.example: The loud noise from the street kept me awake all night.
noise.exampleZh: 街上嘈杂的噪音让我整夜没睡着。

noisy.example: The classroom became noisy when the teacher left the room.
noisy.exampleZh: 老师离开教室后，教室里变得吵闹起来。

nominal.example: He is the nominal head of the company, but she makes all the real decisions.
nominal.exampleZh: 他是公司名义上的负责人，但所有真正的决定都由她来做。

nominate.example: The teacher will nominate two students for the school prize.
nominate.exampleZh: 老师将提名两名学生参评学校奖项。

none.example: None of my friends came to the party last night.
none.exampleZh: 昨晚我的朋友一个都没来参加聚会。

nonsense.example: Stop talking nonsense and tell me what really happened last night.
nonsense.exampleZh: 别再胡说了，告诉我昨晚到底发生了什么。

noodle.example: My mother cooks noodles with eggs and vegetables for lunch.
noodle.exampleZh: 我妈妈午饭做面条，里面放鸡蛋和蔬菜。

noon.example: We usually eat lunch at noon and then take a short walk.
noon.exampleZh: 我们通常中午吃午饭，然后短暂散散步。

nor.example: I do not like coffee, nor does my sister like tea.
nor.exampleZh: 我不喜欢咖啡，我妹妹也不喜欢茶。

normal.example: It is normal to feel tired after a long day of work.
normal.exampleZh: 工作一整天后感到疲倦是正常的。

normally.example: I normally walk to school with my sister every morning.
normally.exampleZh: 我通常每天早上和妹妹一起走路去学校。

north.example: We drove north for three hours to visit my grandparents' small farm.
north.exampleZh: 我们向北开了三个小时的车，去拜访我祖父母的小农场。

northeast.example: My uncle lives in a small town in the northeast of the country.
northeast.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在这个国家东北部的一个小镇上。

northern.example: The northern part of the country is much colder in winter.
northern.exampleZh: 这个国家的北部地区冬天要冷得多。

northwest.example: The small town is in the northwest of the country, near the mountains.
northwest.exampleZh: 这个小镇位于该国的西北部，靠近山区。

nose.example: My nose is blocked, so I cannot smell the flowers today.
nose.exampleZh: 我的鼻子堵了，所以今天闻不到花香。

not.example: I am not hungry now, so I will skip lunch today.
not.exampleZh: 我现在不饿，所以今天午饭就不吃了。

note.example: Please note down the main points in your notebook.
note.exampleZh: 请把要点记在你的笔记本上。

notebook.example: I always carry a small notebook to write down my ideas.
notebook.exampleZh: 我总是随身带一个小笔记本，用来记录我的想法。

nothing.example: There is nothing in the box, so we can go home now.
nothing.exampleZh: 盒子里什么也没有，所以我们现在可以回家了。

notice.example: I did not notice the small sign on the door.
notice.exampleZh: 我没有注意到门上的那个小标牌。

noticeable.example: There is a noticeable difference between the two pictures.
noticeable.exampleZh: 这两幅画之间有一个明显的差别。

notify.example: Please notify your teacher if you cannot come to class tomorrow.
notify.exampleZh: 如果你明天不能来上课，请通知你的老师。

notion.example: The notion that practice makes perfect is common among language learners.
notion.exampleZh: 熟能生巧这一观念在语言学习者中很常见。

novel.example: She wrote a novel about a young doctor and his family.
novel.exampleZh: 她写了一部关于一位年轻医生及其家人的小说。

novelist.example: The young novelist wrote three books before she became famous.
novelist.exampleZh: 这位年轻的小说家在成名之前写了三本书。

novelty.example: The novelty of the new game wore off after a few days.
novelty.exampleZh: 新游戏的新奇感几天后就消失了。

now.example: I am busy right now, so please call me later.
now.exampleZh: 我现在很忙，请稍后再打给我。

nowadays.example: Nowadays, most people use their phones to pay for things.
nowadays.exampleZh: 现今，大多数人用手机支付购物。

nowhere.example: The lost keys were nowhere in the messy room, so we looked outside.
nowhere.exampleZh: 丢失的钥匙在凌乱的房间里哪儿都找不到，所以我们到外面找了。

nuclear.example: Nuclear power can give us clean energy for many years.
nuclear.exampleZh: 核能可以为我们提供多年的清洁能源。

nude.example: The artist painted a nude woman sitting by the open window.
nude.exampleZh: 画家画了一位坐在敞开的窗边的裸体女子。

nuisance.example: The loud noise from the street is a real nuisance at night.
nuisance.exampleZh: 街上的噪音在晚上真是件麻烦事。

number.example: Please write your phone number on this card.
number.exampleZh: 请把你的电话号码写在这张卡片上。

numerous.example: There are numerous books on the shelf in our classroom.
numerous.exampleZh: 我们教室的书架上有许多书。

nurse.example: My sister is a nurse and she takes care of sick children.
nurse.exampleZh: 我姐姐是一名护士，她照顾生病的孩子。

nursery.example: The children spend the whole day at the nursery near our home.
nursery.exampleZh: 孩子们在我们家附近的托儿所待一整天。

nut.example: I put a nut and a bolt in the small box.
nut.exampleZh: 我把一个螺母和一个螺栓放进了小盒子里。

nutrition.example: Good nutrition helps children grow strong and stay healthy every day.
nutrition.exampleZh: 良好的营养能帮助孩子每天茁壮成长并保持健康。

nylon.example: Her new jacket is made of light blue nylon and it feels very soft.
nylon.exampleZh: 她的新夹克是浅蓝色尼龙做的，摸起来很柔软。

o'clock.example: I usually get up at seven o'clock every morning.
o'clock.exampleZh: 我通常每天早上七点钟起床。

oak.example: There is a big oak tree in front of my house.
oak.exampleZh: 我家门前有一棵大橡树。

obey.example: Children should learn to obey the rules at school and at home.
obey.exampleZh: 孩子们应该学会在学校和家里遵守规则。

object.example: She put the small object on the table and looked at it.
object.exampleZh: 她把那个小物体放在桌子上，看着它。

objection.example: She had no objection to the new plan for the weekend.
objection.exampleZh: 她对周末的新计划没有异议。

objective.example: Our main objective is to finish the project before Friday.
objective.exampleZh: 我们的主要目标是在周五前完成这个项目。

oblige.example: The heavy rain obliged us to stay at home all day.
oblige.exampleZh: 大雨迫使我们整天待在家里。

observation.example: Her careful observation of the birds helped her learn a lot.
observation.exampleZh: 她对鸟类的仔细观察帮助她学到了很多。

observe.example: Scientists observe the stars every night to learn about space.
observe.exampleZh: 科学家每天晚上观察星星，以了解太空。

observer.example: The observer watched the birds quietly and wrote everything down in a small notebook.
observer.exampleZh: 观察者静静地观察鸟儿，并把一切都记在一个小本子里。

obstacle.example: The biggest obstacle to our plan is the lack of money.
obstacle.exampleZh: 我们计划最大的障碍是缺少资金。

obtain.example: You can obtain more information from the school office.
obtain.exampleZh: 你可以从学校办公室获得更多信息。

obvious.example: It is obvious that he does not want to go with us.
obvious.exampleZh: 很明显，他不想和我们一起去。

occasion.example: This is a happy occasion for the whole family.
occasion.exampleZh: 这是全家人欢乐的时刻。

occasional.example: We take an occasional trip to the beach when the weather is nice.
occasional.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我们偶尔会去海边玩一趟。

occasionally.example: I occasionally walk to work when the weather is nice.
occasionally.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我偶尔会步行去上班。

occupy.example: The workers occupy the small office every morning.
occupy.exampleZh: 工人们每天早上都占用这间小办公室。

occur.example: Accidents often occur when people are in a hurry.
occur.exampleZh: 人们匆忙的时候常常会发生事故。

occurrence.example: The occurrence of heavy rain caused the game to stop.
occurrence.exampleZh: 大雨的发生使比赛中止了。

ocean.example: The ocean is very deep and full of many strange fish.
ocean.exampleZh: 海洋非常深，里面有许多奇怪的鱼。

october.example: The weather gets cool in October, and the leaves turn red and yellow.
october.exampleZh: 十月天气转凉，树叶变红变黄。

odd.example: It is odd that he came to work on a Sunday.
odd.exampleZh: 他星期天来上班，真是奇怪。

of.example: The door of my room is made of old wood.
of.exampleZh: 我房间的门是用旧木头做的。

off.example: He took off his coat and turned off the light before leaving.
off.exampleZh: 他脱下外套，关掉灯，然后离开了。

offence.example: He was arrested for a serious offence last year.
offence.exampleZh: 他去年因一项严重罪行被逮捕。

offend.example: I did not mean to offend you with my simple question.
offend.exampleZh: 我不是有意用我那个简单的问题冒犯你的。

offensive.example: His offensive words made everyone in the room feel uncomfortable and angry.
offensive.exampleZh: 他冒犯的话让房间里的每个人都感到不舒服和生气。

offer.example: She offered to help me with my homework after school today.
offer.exampleZh: 今天放学后她主动提出帮我做作业。

office.example: She works in a small office near the train station.
office.exampleZh: 她在火车站附近的一间小办公室工作。

officer.example: The police officer helped the old man cross the busy street.
officer.exampleZh: 那位警官帮助老人穿过了繁忙的街道。

official.example: The official report says the new school will open next year.
official.exampleZh: 官方报告称新学校将于明年开学。

often.example: I often walk to the park with my friends on weekends.
often.exampleZh: 周末我经常和朋友们一起去公园散步。

oil.example: The car needs oil and water before we start the long trip.
oil.exampleZh: 在我们开始长途旅行之前，这辆车需要加油和水。

okay.example: It is okay to ask for help when you need it.
okay.exampleZh: 当你需要帮助时，开口求助是可以的。

old.example: My old bike is still very useful to me every day.
old.exampleZh: 我那辆旧自行车每天对我来说仍然很有用。

olive.example: She put a green olive on the table next to the bread.
olive.exampleZh: 她把一颗绿色的橄榄放在桌上，紧挨着面包。

olympic.example: The Olympic Games bring athletes from many countries together every four years.
olympic.exampleZh: 奥运会每四年把来自许多国家的运动员聚在一起。

omit.example: Please do not omit any important details from your report.
omit.exampleZh: 请不要遗漏你报告中的任何重要细节。

once.example: Once you start reading this book, you will not want to stop.
once.exampleZh: 一旦你开始读这本书，你就会不想停下来。

one.example: One of my friends lives near the school.
one.exampleZh: 我的一个朋友住在学校附近。

onion.example: My mother puts onion in the soup to make it taste better.
onion.exampleZh: 我妈妈在汤里放洋葱，让它味道更好。

online.example: You can buy train tickets online and pay with your phone.
online.exampleZh: 你可以在网上购买火车票并用手机付款。

only.example: This is the only key that opens the old door.
only.exampleZh: 这是唯一能打开那扇旧门的钥匙。

onto.example: The cat jumped onto the table and knocked over a glass.
onto.exampleZh: 猫跳到桌子上，碰倒了一个玻璃杯。

open.example: Please open the window because the room is too hot.
open.exampleZh: 请把窗户打开，因为房间里太热了。

opening.example: The opening in the fence is too small for the dog to get through.
opening.exampleZh: 栅栏上的开口太小了，狗钻不过去。

opera.example: She likes opera very much and often goes to the opera house with friends.
opera.exampleZh: 她非常喜欢歌剧，经常和朋友一起去歌剧院。

operate.example: My father knows how to operate this old machine safely.
operate.exampleZh: 我父亲知道如何安全地操作这台旧机器。

operation.example: The doctor said the operation went well and she can go home soon.
operation.exampleZh: 医生说手术很顺利，她很快就能回家。

operator.example: The operator answered my call and gave me the train times.
operator.exampleZh: 接线员接了我的电话，并告诉了我火车时刻。

opinion.example: In my opinion, this book is very useful for beginners.
opinion.exampleZh: 在我看来，这本书对初学者非常有用。

opponent.example: My opponent in the final match was very strong and fast.
opponent.exampleZh: 我在决赛中的对手非常强壮而且速度很快。

opportunity.example: This job gives me a good opportunity to learn new skills.
opportunity.exampleZh: 这份工作给了我一个学习新技能的好机会。

oppose.example: Many people in our town oppose the plan to build a new factory.
oppose.exampleZh: 我们镇上的许多人反对建一座新工厂的计划。

opposite.example: The bank is on the opposite side of the street from my house.

opposition.example: The new plan faced strong opposition from local residents.
opposition.exampleZh: 这项新计划遭到了当地居民的强烈反对。

optimistic.example: She stays optimistic about her new job even when things go wrong.
optimistic.exampleZh: 即使事情出问题，她对她的新工作仍然保持乐观。

option.example: You have two options: take the bus or walk to school.
option.exampleZh: 你有两个选择：坐公交车或者走路去学校。

optional.example: Wearing a tie to the party is optional, but most people do.
optional.exampleZh: 聚会上打领带是可选择的，但大多数人都会打。

or.example: You can have tea or coffee, but please choose one now.
or.exampleZh: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，但请现在就选一个。

orange.example: She ate a sweet orange after lunch and put its peel in the bin.
orange.exampleZh: 午饭后她吃了一个甜橙子，并把橙子皮扔进了垃圾桶。

orbit.example: The moon moves in a fixed orbit around our planet.
orbit.exampleZh: 月球沿着固定的轨道绕我们的行星运行。

order.example: Please put these books in the right order before you leave the room.
order.exampleZh: 离开房间前，请把这些书按正确的顺序放好。

orderly.example: The students put the books in orderly rows on the shelf.
orderly.exampleZh: 学生们把书整齐地排成几行放在书架上。

ordinary.example: Her ordinary life is quiet but very happy.
ordinary.exampleZh: 她平凡的生活安静却很幸福。

ore.example: The workers found a lot of iron ore under the hill.
ore.exampleZh: 工人们在山下发现了大量铁矿石。

organ.example: The heart is an important organ that pumps blood around the body.
organ.exampleZh: 心脏是一个重要的器官，它把血液泵送到全身。

organic.example: This farm grows organic vegetables without using any chemicals.
organic.exampleZh: 这个农场不使用任何化学物质来种植有机蔬菜。

organization.example: The organization helps young people find jobs in the city.
organization.exampleZh: 这个组织帮助年轻人在城市里找到工作。

organize.example: We need to organize a meeting for all the new students.
organize.exampleZh: 我们需要为所有新生安排一次会议。

origin.example: The origin of this old story is still a mystery to us.
origin.exampleZh: 这个古老故事的起源对我们来说仍然是个谜。

original.example: The original plan was too expensive, so we made a new one.
original.exampleZh: 最初的计划太贵了，所以我们制定了一个新计划。

other.example: Do you have any other questions about the lesson today?
other.exampleZh: 关于今天的课，你还有其他问题吗？

otherwise.example: Hurry up, otherwise we will be late for the meeting.
otherwise.exampleZh: 快点，否则我们开会要迟到了。

ought.example: You ought to see a doctor if the pain gets worse.
ought.exampleZh: 如果疼痛加重，你应该去看医生。

ounce.example: Please add two ounces of sugar to the cake batter.
ounce.exampleZh: 请在蛋糕面糊里加两盎司糖。

our.example: Our teacher gave us a lot of homework to do today.
our.exampleZh: 我们的老师今天给我们布置了很多作业。

ours.example: This house is ours, and we moved in last year.
ours.exampleZh: 这房子是我们的，我们去年搬了进来。

ourselves.example: We should learn to take care of ourselves when we live alone.
ourselves.exampleZh: 当我们独自生活时，我们应该学会照顾自己。

out.example: The lights are out, so we must go out and buy some candles.
out.exampleZh: 灯熄了，所以我们必须出去买些蜡烛。

outbreak.example: There was a sudden outbreak of flu at our school last week.
outbreak.exampleZh: 上周我们学校突然爆发了流感。

outcome.example: The outcome of the game surprised everyone in the small town.
outcome.exampleZh: 比赛的结果让小镇上的每个人都感到惊讶。

outdoor.example: We often have lunch at an outdoor table when the weather is nice.
outdoor.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我们经常在户外的桌子旁吃午饭。

outdoors.example: My kids love to play outdoors after school every day.
outdoors.exampleZh: 我的孩子们每天放学后都喜欢在户外玩耍。

outer.example: The outer door was locked, so we walked around to the back.
outer.exampleZh: 外面的门锁着，所以我们绕到了后面。

outlet.example: This shop is an outlet for local artists to sell their work.
outlet.exampleZh: 这家店是当地艺术家出售作品的销路。

outline.example: She wrote a short outline before writing the full report.
outline.exampleZh: 她在写完整报告之前先写了一个简短的提纲。

output.example: The factory's output increased sharply last year after new machines arrived.
output.exampleZh: 去年新机器到厂后，这家工厂的产量大幅增长。

outside.example: The children are playing outside in the garden behind the house.
outside.exampleZh: 孩子们正在屋后的花园里在外面玩耍。

outstanding.example: Her outstanding work at the office earned her a better job.
outstanding.exampleZh: 她在办公室的杰出工作为她赢得了一份更好的工作。

outward.example: The door opens outward, so the room feels bigger and brighter.
outward.exampleZh: 这扇门向外开，所以房间显得更大更亮。

oven.example: My mother puts the cake into the oven for thirty minutes.
oven.exampleZh: 我妈妈把蛋糕放进烤箱里烤三十分钟。

over.example: The cat jumped over the low wall and ran away.
over.exampleZh: 那只猫跳过矮墙跑走了。

overall.example: The overall plan looks good, but we need more time.
overall.exampleZh: 总体计划看起来不错，但我们需要更多时间。

overcome.example: She worked hard to overcome her fear of speaking in public.
overcome.exampleZh: 她努力克服了自己在公众场合讲话的恐惧。

overhead.example: The plane flew low overhead, so we could see its wheels.
overhead.exampleZh: 飞机从头顶低空飞过，我们能看到它的轮子。

overlook.example: We often overlook small mistakes when we are in a hurry.
overlook.exampleZh: 我们匆忙时常常忽视小错误。

overseas.example: He worked overseas for two years after he finished college.
overseas.exampleZh: 他大学毕业后在海外工作了两年。

overtake.example: I ran fast and managed to overtake him near the finish line.
overtake.exampleZh: 我跑得很快，在终点线附近设法超过了他。

owe.example: I owe him ten dollars, so I will pay him back tomorrow.
owe.exampleZh: 我欠他十美元，所以明天会还给他。

owing.example: He still has an owing balance on his old phone bill.
owing.exampleZh: 他的旧电话账单上还有一笔未付的余额。

owl.example: The owl sat in the tall tree and watched the field below.
owl.exampleZh: 猫头鹰停在大树上，注视着下方的田野。

own.example: I want to have my own room with a big window.
own.exampleZh: 我想要一个有自己的房间，带一扇大窗户。

owner.example: The owner of the small shop is very friendly to everyone.
owner.exampleZh: 这家小店的店主对每个人都很友好。

ownership.example: She has full ownership of the small house near the river.
ownership.exampleZh: 她完全拥有河边那栋小房子。

ox.example: The farmer keeps an ox to pull his heavy wooden cart.
ox.exampleZh: 农夫养了一头牛来拉他沉重的木车。

oxygen.example: Plants and animals need oxygen to live and grow in clean air.
oxygen.exampleZh: 植物和动物需要氧气才能在干净的空气中生存和生长。

pace.example: He walked at a slow pace along the quiet river.
pace.exampleZh: 他沿着安静的河边以缓慢的步伐走着。

pack.example: She will pack her clothes and books into a big box.
pack.exampleZh: 她将把衣服和书装进一个大箱子里。

package.example: The package arrived at my door this morning before I left for work.
package.exampleZh: 今天早上我还没出门上班，包裹就送到了我家门口。

packet.example: She put a small packet of sugar into her coffee.
packet.exampleZh: 她往咖啡里放了一小包糖。

pad.example: She wrote the phone number on a small pad beside the bed.
pad.exampleZh: 她把电话号码写在床边的一个小便签本上。

page.example: She turned the page and began to read the next chapter.
page.exampleZh: 她翻过这一页，开始读下一章。

pain.example: He felt a sharp pain in his back after the long walk.
pain.exampleZh: 长时间走路后，他感到背部一阵剧痛。

painful.example: It was a painful experience, but she stayed calm and never gave up.
painful.exampleZh: 那是一段令人痛苦的经历，但她保持冷静，从未放弃。

paint.example: I want to paint my bedroom walls a light blue color.
paint.exampleZh: 我想把我的卧室墙壁刷成浅蓝色。

painter.example: The painter painted a big picture of the sea for us.
painter.exampleZh: 这位画家为我们画了一幅大海的大画。

painting.example: She hung a beautiful painting of the sea on her bedroom wall.
painting.exampleZh: 她在卧室墙上挂了一幅美丽的海景油画。

pair.example: This pair of shoes is too small for me.
pair.exampleZh: 这双鞋对我来说太小了。

palace.example: The old palace stands in the middle of the city.
palace.exampleZh: 这座古老的宫殿坐落在城市中央。

pale.example: Her face turned pale when she heard the bad news.
pale.exampleZh: 听到那个坏消息时，她的脸变得苍白。

palm.example: She held the small stone in the palm of her hand.
palm.exampleZh: 她把那块小石头握在手掌心里。

pan.example: She put the pan on the stove and cooked some eggs.
pan.exampleZh: 她把平底锅放在炉子上，煎了几个鸡蛋。

panel.example: A panel of experts will answer questions after the talk.
panel.exampleZh: 一个专家小组将在讲座后回答问题。

panic.example: She felt sudden panic when she could not find her little son.
panic.exampleZh: 当她找不到小儿子时，她突然感到一阵恐慌。

pants.example: He put on his new pants before going to work this morning.
pants.exampleZh: 今天早上他去上班前穿上了他的新裤子。

paper.example: She wrote her name on a piece of paper and gave it to me.
paper.exampleZh: 她把名字写在一张纸上，然后递给了我。

paragraph.example: Please read the first paragraph of the story before class.
paragraph.exampleZh: 请在课前阅读这个故事的第一段。

parallel.example: The two roads run parallel to the river for several miles.
parallel.exampleZh: 这两条路与河流平行延伸了好几英里。

parcel.example: I took the parcel to the post office this morning.
parcel.exampleZh: 今天早上我把包裹拿到了邮局。

pardon.example: Please pardon me for being late to the meeting today.
pardon.exampleZh: 请原谅我今天开会迟到。

parent.example: My parent came to the school meeting and then talked with my teacher.
parent.exampleZh: 我的父亲（或母亲）来参加了学校会议，然后和我的老师交谈。

park.example: We park the car near the park and walk in.
park.exampleZh: 我们把车停在公园附近，然后走进去。

parking.example: Parking is free for all customers in this small shop.
parking.exampleZh: 这家小商店为所有顾客提供免费停车。

parliament.example: The new law was passed by parliament after a long and careful debate.
parliament.exampleZh: 经过长时间的仔细辩论，这项新法律由议会通过了。

part.example: She played an important part in the school play last year.
part.exampleZh: 她去年在学校戏剧中扮演了一个重要的角色。

partial.example: The teacher gave us only a partial answer about the test.
partial.exampleZh: 老师只给了我们关于考试的部分答案。

partly.example: I partly agree with you, but I still have some questions.
partly.exampleZh: 我部分同意你的看法，但我仍有一些疑问。

partner.example: My business partner helps me run the small shop every day.
partner.exampleZh: 我的生意伙伴每天都帮我经营这家小店。

party.example: The party will hold a big meeting in the city next week.
party.exampleZh: 该政党下周将在城里举行一次大型会议。

pass.example: Please pass me the salt when you finish your soup.
pass.exampleZh: 你喝完汤后请把盐递给我。

passage.example: A narrow passage leads from the kitchen to the garden.
passage.exampleZh: 一条狭窄的通道从厨房通向花园。

passenger.example: The passenger put a small bag under the seat.
passenger.exampleZh: 那位乘客把一个小包放在了座位下面。

passion.example: Her passion for music made her practice the piano every single day.
passion.exampleZh: 她对音乐的热爱让她每天坚持练钢琴。

passive.example: He stayed passive and never asked a question in class.
passive.exampleZh: 他在课堂上一直很被动，从不提问。

passport.example: I always keep my passport in a safe place when I travel abroad.
passport.exampleZh: 我出国旅行时总是把护照放在安全的地方。

password.example: You must type your password to open the computer.
password.exampleZh: 你必须输入密码才能打开这台电脑。

past.example: In the past, people lived without phones and the internet.
past.exampleZh: 过去，人们没有手机和互联网也照样生活。

paste.example: Please use some paste to stick the paper on the wall.
paste.exampleZh: 请用一些浆糊把纸粘在墙上。

pat.example: She gave the little dog a gentle pat on the head.
pat.exampleZh: 她轻轻拍了拍那只小狗的头。

patch.example: The farmer planted corn in a small patch behind his old house.
patch.exampleZh: 农夫在他老房子后面的一小块土地上种了玉米。

path.example: We followed a narrow path through the quiet green forest.
path.exampleZh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路穿过安静的绿色森林。

patience.example: You need a lot of patience to teach young children to read.
patience.exampleZh: 教小孩子阅读需要很大的耐心。

patient.example: The doctor is very patient with his patients every day.
patient.exampleZh: 这位医生每天对他的病人都很有耐心。

pattern.example: The carpet has a beautiful pattern of red and gold flowers.
pattern.exampleZh: 这块地毯有红色和金色花朵的美丽图案。

pause.example: We pause for a short break after every lesson.
pause.exampleZh: 每节课后我们都会暂停一下，短暂休息。

paw.example: The cat licked its paw after it stepped in the mud.
paw.exampleZh: 猫踩到泥后舔了舔它的爪子。

pay.example: I will pay for the tickets with my phone.
pay.exampleZh: 我会用手机支付这些票的钱。

payment.example: You can make the payment online with a credit card.
payment.exampleZh: 你可以用信用卡在线付款。

pea.example: My mother cooks green peas with rice for dinner every Friday.
pea.exampleZh: 我妈妈每周五晚餐都会用青豌豆配米饭。

peace.example: After the war, the people lived in peace and rebuilt their homes.
peace.exampleZh: 战争结束后，人们生活在和平之中，重建了自己的家园。

peaceful.example: The small town is peaceful and quiet at night.
peaceful.exampleZh: 这个小镇在夜晚宁静而安详。

peach.example: The peach on the table is soft, sweet and ready to eat.
peach.exampleZh: 桌上的桃子又软又甜，可以吃了。

peak.example: We reached the peak of the mountain before the sun went down.
peak.exampleZh: 太阳下山前，我们到达了山峰。

peanut.example: I like to eat peanuts with my friends after school.
peanut.exampleZh: 放学后我喜欢和朋友们一起吃花生。

pear.example: I ate a sweet pear after lunch today.
pear.exampleZh: 我今天午饭后吃了一个甜梨。

pearl.example: She wore a beautiful pearl necklace to the party last night.
pearl.exampleZh: 她昨晚戴了一条漂亮的珍珠项链去参加聚会。

peasant.example: The old peasant works hard in the fields every day.
peasant.exampleZh: 这位老农民每天在田里辛勤劳作。

pen.example: I use a blue pen to write my name on the paper.
pen.exampleZh: 我用一支蓝色的钢笔在纸上写我的名字。

penalty.example: The player got a penalty for touching the ball with his hand.
penalty.exampleZh: 这名球员因为用手碰球而被判罚。

pencil.example: I use a pencil to draw a small picture in my notebook.
pencil.exampleZh: 我用铅笔在笔记本上画了一幅小画。

penny.example: I only have one penny in my pocket today.
penny.exampleZh: 我今天口袋里只有一便士。

pension.example: My grandfather gets a small pension from the company every month.
pension.exampleZh: 我爷爷每个月从公司领取一笔小额养老金。

people.example: Many people like to walk in the park after work.
people.exampleZh: 很多人喜欢下班后去公园散步。

pepper.example: Please add some pepper to the soup because it tastes a little plain.
pepper.exampleZh: 请在汤里加一些胡椒，因为味道有点淡。

per.example: The bus leaves every morning at eight and costs two dollars per person.
per.exampleZh: 公交车每天早上八点出发，每人收费两美元。

perceive.example: Many people perceive him as a quiet and honest man.
perceive.exampleZh: 很多人认为他是一个安静又诚实的人。

percent.example: About sixty percent of the students in our class walk to school.
percent.exampleZh: 我们班大约百分之六十的学生步行上学。

percentage.example: The percentage of students who walk to school has grown this year.
percentage.exampleZh: 今年步行上学的学生比例有所上升。

perfect.example: Her English is not perfect, but she works hard to improve it every day.
perfect.exampleZh: 她的英语并不完美，但她每天努力改进。

perform.example: The students will perform a short play at the school meeting.
perform.exampleZh: 学生们将在学校会议上表演一个短剧。

performance.example: Her performance in the school play was very good.
performance.exampleZh: 她在学校话剧中的表演非常出色。

perhaps.example: Perhaps she will come to the party with her friends tonight.
perhaps.exampleZh: 也许她今晚会和朋友们一起来参加聚会。

period.example: This period of history is very important for our country.
period.exampleZh: 这段历史时期对我们的国家非常重要。

permanent.example: The museum is a permanent home for many famous old paintings.
permanent.exampleZh: 这座博物馆是许多著名古老画作的永久家园。

permission.example: You need permission from your teacher to leave the classroom early.
permission.exampleZh: 你需要老师的许可才能提前离开教室。

permit.example: The school does not permit students to use phones during class.
permit.exampleZh: 学校不允许学生在课堂上使用手机。

person.example: Every person in the room stood up and clapped for the teacher.
person.exampleZh: 房间里的每个人都站起来为老师鼓掌。

personal.example: She keeps her personal things in a small box.
personal.exampleZh: 她把她的私人物品放在一个小盒子里。

personality.example: Her warm personality makes everyone in the office feel welcome.
personality.exampleZh: 她温暖的个性让办公室里的每个人都感到受欢迎。

personally.example: Personally, I think this book is easy and fun to read.
personally.exampleZh: 就个人而言，我觉得这本书读起来简单又有趣。

personnel.example: The personnel in our office are very friendly and helpful.
personnel.exampleZh: 我们办公室的员工非常友好且乐于助人。

persuade.example: My friends tried to persuade me to join the school basketball team.
persuade.exampleZh: 我的朋友们试图说服我加入校篮球队。

pet.example: My pet dog likes to sleep on my bed every afternoon.
pet.exampleZh: 我的宠物狗每天下午都喜欢睡在我的床上。

petrol.example: We need to buy some petrol before we drive to the next town.
petrol.exampleZh: 我们在开车去下一个城镇之前需要买一些汽油。

petroleum.example: This country uses petroleum to make fuel for cars and planes.
petroleum.exampleZh: 这个国家用石油为汽车和飞机制造燃料。

phase.example: The project is still in its early phase, so we need more time.
phase.exampleZh: 这个项目仍处于早期阶段，所以我们需要更多时间。

phenomenon.example: This strange phenomenon appears only in the cold winter months.
phenomenon.exampleZh: 这种奇怪的现象只在寒冷的冬季出现。

philosophy.example: His philosophy is to stay calm and work hard every day.
philosophy.exampleZh: 他的人生哲学是保持冷静，每天努力工作。

phone.example: I use my phone to call my mother every day.
phone.exampleZh: 我每天用手机给妈妈打电话。

photo.example: I keep a photo of my family on my desk.
photo.exampleZh: 我桌上放着一张家人的照片。

photograph.example: She took a photograph of the old bridge in the morning light.
photograph.exampleZh: 她在晨光中拍了一张那座老桥的照片。

photographer.example: The photographer took many beautiful pictures of the children at the park.
photographer.exampleZh: 这位摄影师在公园里给孩子们拍了许多漂亮的照片。

phrase.example: Please learn this useful phrase before you write the letter.
phrase.exampleZh: 在你写这封信之前，请先学会这个有用的短语。

physical.example: Regular physical activity helps children stay healthy and happy.
physical.exampleZh: 经常进行身体活动有助于孩子保持健康和快乐。

physician.example: The physician told my father to rest and drink more water.
physician.exampleZh: 医生嘱咐我父亲多休息、多喝水。

physicist.example: My father is a physicist and he teaches at a local university.
physicist.exampleZh: 我父亲是一位物理学家，他在当地一所大学任教。

physics.example: I find physics hard, but my teacher explains it very clearly.
physics.exampleZh: 我觉得物理很难，但老师讲得非常清楚。

piano.example: My sister plays the piano every evening after she finishes her homework.
piano.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天傍晚做完作业后都会弹钢琴。

pick.example: Please pick a book from the shelf and read it today.
pick.exampleZh: 请从书架上挑一本书，今天就把它读了。

picnic.example: We will have a picnic in the park with our friends.
picnic.exampleZh: 我们将和朋友们在公园里野餐。

picture.example: I took a picture of the old bridge near my house.
picture.exampleZh: 我拍了一张我家附近那座老桥的照片。

pie.example: My mother made an apple pie for us yesterday.
pie.exampleZh: 我妈妈昨天为我们做了一个苹果馅饼。

piece.example: She gave me a piece of cake and a glass of milk.
piece.exampleZh: 她给了我一块蛋糕和一杯牛奶。

pier.example: We walked to the end of the pier to watch the boats come in.
pier.exampleZh: 我们走到码头尽头，看船只驶进来。

pig.example: The little pig eats corn on the farm every morning.
pig.exampleZh: 那只小猪每天早上在农场里吃玉米。

pigeon.example: A gray pigeon sat on the roof and watched the people below.
pigeon.exampleZh: 一只灰色的鸽子停在屋顶上，看着下面的人。

pile.example: She left a pile of books on the small table.
pile.exampleZh: 她在小桌子上留下了一堆书。
