pill.example: The doctor told him to take one pill after breakfast every day.
pill.exampleZh: 医生让他每天早饭后吃一片药。

pillar.example: The old stone pillar stands in the middle of the square.
pillar.exampleZh: 那根古老的石柱立在广场中央。

pillow.example: I put a soft pillow under my head before I go to sleep.
pillow.exampleZh: 睡觉前，我把一个柔软的枕头垫在头下。

pilot.example: The pilot will test the new plan next week before we use it.
pilot.exampleZh: 飞行员将在下周测试这个新计划，然后我们才会使用它。

pin.example: She used a pin to hold the paper on the board.
pin.exampleZh: 她用一枚别针把纸固定在板上。

pinch.example: She gave him a pinch on the arm to wake him up.
pinch.exampleZh: 她在他胳膊上捏了一下把他弄醒。

pine.example: There is a tall pine near my house, and I often sit under it.
pine.exampleZh: 我家附近有一棵高大的松树，我常坐在它下面。

pink.example: The little girl wore a pink dress to the party yesterday.
pink.exampleZh: 小女孩昨天穿了一条粉红色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

pint.example: I bought a pint of milk at the small shop near my home.
pint.exampleZh: 我在家附近的小店买了一品脱牛奶。

pioneer.example: She was a pioneer in computer science and helped many young women.
pioneer.exampleZh: 她是计算机科学领域的先驱，帮助过许多年轻女性。

pipe.example: The old man sat by the fire and smoked his pipe.
pipe.exampleZh: 老人坐在炉火旁抽着烟斗。

pistol.example: The police officer found a pistol in the man's bag.
pistol.exampleZh: 警察在那个男人的包里发现了一把手枪。

pit.example: The workers dug a deep pit in the ground behind the old factory.
pit.exampleZh: 工人们在旧工厂后面的地上挖了一个深坑。

pitch.example: The pitcher will pitch the ball to the batter in the game today.
pitch.exampleZh: 投手今天将在比赛中把球投给击球手。

pity.example: It is a pity that she cannot come to the party.
pity.exampleZh: 她不能来参加聚会，真是可惜。

place.example: Please put the books back in their place on the shelf.
place.exampleZh: 请把书放回书架上原来的位置。

plain.example: Her plain words made the whole idea clear to everyone in the room.
plain.exampleZh: 她朴素的话语让房间里的每个人都清楚了这个想法。

plan.example: We need a clear plan before we start the new project.
plan.exampleZh: 在开始新项目之前，我们需要一个清晰的计划。

plane.example: The plane flew high above the clouds and landed safely.
plane.exampleZh: 飞机在高空中飞过云层，然后安全降落。

planet.example: Earth is the only planet we know with life on it.
planet.exampleZh: 地球是我们所知的唯一有生命的行星。

plant.example: They plant many green trees near the new factory.
plant.exampleZh: 他们在新工厂附近种了很多绿树。

plantation.example: My grandfather worked on a coffee plantation when he was young.
plantation.exampleZh: 我祖父年轻时在一个咖啡种植园工作。

plastic.example: This cheap plastic bottle is light and easy to carry.
plastic.exampleZh: 这个便宜的塑料瓶很轻，方便携带。

plate.example: She put the fresh bread on a clean white plate.
plate.exampleZh: 她把新鲜的面包放在一个干净的白盘子上。

platform.example: The train is waiting at platform three, so please hurry up.
platform.exampleZh: 火车正在三号站台等候，所以请快点。

play.example: The children play football in the park after school every day.
play.exampleZh: 孩子们每天放学后都在公园里踢足球。

player.example: The player scored two goals in the game last night.
player.exampleZh: 这名运动员在昨晚的比赛中进了两个球。

playground.example: The children are playing football with their friends in the playground.
playground.exampleZh: 孩子们正在操场上和朋友们踢足球。

pleasant.example: The weather was pleasant, so we walked in the park after lunch.
pleasant.exampleZh: 天气很宜人，所以午饭后我们在公园里散步。

please.example: Please sit down and tell me what makes you happy.
please.exampleZh: 请坐下，告诉我什么让你开心。

pleasure.example: It is a great pleasure to meet you and your family today.
pleasure.exampleZh: 今天见到你和你的家人是极大的荣幸。

plenty.example: We have plenty of time to finish the work today.
plenty.exampleZh: 我们今天有充足的时间完成这项工作。

plot.example: The plot of the movie was simple but very exciting.
plot.exampleZh: 这部电影的情节简单但非常精彩。

plough.example: The old farmer used a strong plough to turn the soil.
plough.exampleZh: 这位老农夫用一把结实的犁来翻土。

plug.example: Please put the plug into the wall socket before you turn on the machine.
plug.exampleZh: 请先把插头插进墙上的插座，然后再打开机器。

plus.example: Two plus three is five, and this small shop has one clear plus.
plus.exampleZh: 二加三等于五，而这家小店有一个明显的优势。

pocket.example: He put the small key into his coat pocket and left.
pocket.exampleZh: 他把那把小钥匙放进外套口袋里，然后离开了。

poem.example: She wrote a short poem about the rain for her class.
poem.exampleZh: 她为她的班级写了一首关于雨的短诗。

poet.example: The young poet wrote a short poem about the river near his home.
poet.exampleZh: 这位年轻的诗人写了一首关于他家附近河流的短诗。

poetry.example: She reads poetry every night before going to sleep.
poetry.exampleZh: 她每晚睡觉前都会读诗。

point.example: The teacher pointed at the map and explained the main point of the lesson.
point.exampleZh: 老师指着地图，讲解了这节课的要点。

poison.example: Rat poison is dangerous, so keep it away from children and pets.
poison.exampleZh: 老鼠药很危险，所以要把它放在远离儿童和宠物的地方。

poisonous.example: Some mushrooms in this forest are poisonous and can make you very sick.
poisonous.exampleZh: 这片森林里的一些蘑菇有毒，吃了会让你病得很重。

pole.example: The flag is at the top of a long wooden pole.
pole.exampleZh: 旗帜在一根长木杆的顶端。

police.example: The police are looking for the man who stole the car.
police.exampleZh: 警方正在寻找偷走那辆车的男子。

policeman.example: The policeman helped the lost child find his mother.
policeman.exampleZh: 警察帮助走失的孩子找到了他的母亲。

policy.example: The new policy will help small businesses grow faster next year.
policy.exampleZh: 新政策将帮助小企业明年发展得更快。

polite.example: She is always polite to her teachers and classmates.
polite.exampleZh: 她对老师和同学总是很有礼貌。

political.example: She likes to talk about political ideas with her friends.
political.exampleZh: 她喜欢和朋友们谈论政治观点。

politician.example: The politician gave a short speech to the people in the square.
politician.exampleZh: 那位政治家在广场上向人们做了简短的演讲。

politics.example: She studies politics at university because she wants to change her country.
politics.exampleZh: 她在大学学习政治学，因为她想改变自己的国家。

pond.example: The children caught small fish in the pond behind their house.
pond.exampleZh: 孩子们在他们家后面的池塘里抓小鱼。

pool.example: The children swim in the small pool behind our house every summer.
pool.exampleZh: 每年夏天孩子们都在我们屋后的小水塘里游泳。

poor.example: The poor family lives in a small old house near the river.
poor.exampleZh: 这个贫穷的家庭住在河边一栋又小又旧的房子里。

pop.example: Pop music is very popular with young people all over the world.
pop.exampleZh: 流行音乐在世界各地的年轻人中非常受欢迎。

popular.example: This song is very popular with young people today.
popular.exampleZh: 这首歌如今非常受年轻人欢迎。

popularity.example: The popularity of this small cafe grew quickly after the new owner changed the menu.
popularity.exampleZh: 新老板更换菜单后，这家小咖啡馆的受欢迎程度迅速提高。

population.example: The population of this small town grows every year.
population.exampleZh: 这个小镇的人口每年都在增长。

porch.example: We sat on the porch and watched the rain fall.
porch.exampleZh: 我们坐在门廊上，看着雨落下。

pork.example: My mother cooked pork with rice and vegetables for dinner last night.
pork.exampleZh: 昨晚我妈妈用猪肉、米饭和蔬菜做了晚饭。

port.example: The ship will arrive at the port early tomorrow morning.
port.exampleZh: 这艘船明天一早将抵达港口。

portable.example: This small portable radio is easy to carry when we travel.
portable.exampleZh: 这台小巧的便携式收音机在我们旅行时很方便携带。

porter.example: The porter carried our heavy bags up to the room.
porter.exampleZh: 搬运工把我们的重行李搬到了房间里。

portion.example: I only ate a small portion of the cake.

portrait.example: The artist painted a portrait of the old man and his dog.
portrait.exampleZh: 画家画了一幅老人和他的狗的肖像。

portray.example: The writer portrays village life in a warm and simple way.
portray.exampleZh: 这位作家以温暖而简单的方式描绘乡村生活。

pose.example: She posed for a photo in front of the old house.
pose.exampleZh: 她在老房子前摆好姿势拍照。

position.example: He found a comfortable position in the chair and read his book.
position.exampleZh: 他在椅子上找了个舒服的姿势，然后读起了书。

positive.example: She always has a positive attitude toward her work and her friends.
positive.exampleZh: 她对工作和朋友总是抱有积极的态度。

possess.example: Many young people possess great talent but still need more practice.
possess.exampleZh: 很多年轻人拥有很高的天赋，但仍然需要更多练习。

possession.example: This old watch is my most valuable possession.
possession.exampleZh: 这块旧手表是我最珍贵的财产。

possibility.example: There is a real possibility that the small shop will close next month.
possibility.exampleZh: 这家小店下个月关门是有很大可能的。

possible.example: It is possible to learn a new language with daily practice.
possible.exampleZh: 每天练习，学会一门新语言是可能的。

possibly.example: She will possibly come to the party with her friends tonight.
possibly.exampleZh: 她今晚也许会和朋友一起来参加聚会。

post.example: I will post the letter and then go back to my post at the gate.
post.exampleZh: 我会把这封信寄出去，然后回到我在大门口的岗位。

postage.example: The postage for this letter is two dollars.
postage.exampleZh: 这封信的邮资是两美元。

postman.example: The postman brings a letter to our house every morning.
postman.exampleZh: 邮递员每天早上都会送一封信到我们家。

postpone.example: We had to postpone the meeting until next Monday because of the rain.
postpone.exampleZh: 由于下雨，我们不得不把会议推迟到下周一。

pot.example: She put the hot soup in a big pot on the stove.
pot.exampleZh: 她把热汤倒进炉子上的一个大锅里。

potato.example: My mother likes to cook potato soup on cold winter days.
potato.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢在寒冷的冬日煮土豆汤。

potential.example: Every student has the potential to do well with enough practice.
potential.exampleZh: 每个学生只要有足够的练习，都有取得好成绩的潜力。

pound.example: He put ten pounds of rice in the bag and pounded the door loudly.
pound.exampleZh: 他把十磅大米放进袋子里，然后大声地敲打门。

pour.example: She poured the hot soup into four bowls for the children.
pour.exampleZh: 她把热汤倒进四个碗里给孩子们喝。

poverty.example: Many families still live in poverty and need help from the government.
poverty.exampleZh: 许多家庭仍然生活贫困，需要政府的帮助。

powder.example: She mixed the white powder with water until it became a thick paste.
powder.exampleZh: 她把白色粉末和水混合，直到变成浓稠的糊状。

power.example: The new law gives the government more power to protect the environment.
power.exampleZh: 这项新法律赋予政府更多保护环境的权力。

powerful.example: This is a powerful car that can go very fast.
powerful.exampleZh: 这是一辆非常有力的汽车，能跑得很快。

practical.example: This small tool is very practical for daily use.
practical.exampleZh: 这个小工具在日常使用中非常实用。

practice.example: Daily practice is the best way to improve your English.
practice.exampleZh: 每天练习是提高英语水平的最好方法。

practise.example: You should practise speaking English every day to become more confident.
practise.exampleZh: 你应该每天练习说英语，这样才能变得更自信。

praise.example: The teacher praised her students for their hard work and kind help.
praise.exampleZh: 老师表扬了学生们的努力和热心帮助。

pray.example: Every night before bed, the children pray for their parents and friends.
pray.exampleZh: 每天晚上睡觉前，孩子们都为父母和朋友祈祷。

prayer.example: She said a quiet prayer before going to bed.
prayer.exampleZh: 她在睡觉前轻声做了一段祈祷。

precious.example: Good friends are precious, and we should always be kind to them.
precious.exampleZh: 好朋友是珍贵的，我们应该一直善待他们。

precise.example: She gave a precise answer to every question on the test.
precise.exampleZh: 她对试卷上的每个问题都给出了准确的回答。

predict.example: Experts predict that the weather will get colder next week.
predict.exampleZh: 专家预测下周天气会变冷。

prefer.example: I prefer tea to coffee in the morning.
prefer.exampleZh: 早上我更喜欢喝茶，而不是咖啡。

preferable.example: This plan is preferable because it is cheaper and much easier to follow.
preferable.exampleZh: 这个方案更可取，因为它更便宜，也更容易遵循。

preference.example: She has a clear preference for tea over coffee in the morning.
preference.exampleZh: 她早上明显更偏爱喝茶而不是咖啡。

pregnant.example: She is pregnant and very happy about the new baby.
pregnant.exampleZh: 她怀孕了，对即将到来的宝宝感到非常高兴。

prejudice.example: She has a strong prejudice against people from small towns.
prejudice.exampleZh: 她对来自小镇的人有很深的偏见。

preliminary.example: We did some preliminary work before the main meeting started.
preliminary.exampleZh: 在主要会议开始之前，我们做了一些准备工作。

premier.example: The premier of the country gave a short speech to the people.
premier.exampleZh: 该国的总理向人民作了简短的讲话。

preparation.example: Good preparation before the exam helps students feel calm and confident.
preparation.exampleZh: 考试前做好充分准备能帮助学生保持平静和自信。

prepare.example: I need to prepare dinner for my family tonight.
prepare.exampleZh: 我今晚需要为家人准备晚餐。

prescription.example: The doctor wrote a prescription for my cough and told me to rest.
prescription.exampleZh: 医生给我开了一张治咳嗽的处方，并让我休息。

presence.example: Her presence at the meeting made everyone feel calm and welcome.
presence.exampleZh: 她出席会议让每个人都感到平静和受欢迎。

present.example: She was present at the meeting and gave him a small gift.
present.exampleZh: 她出席了会议，并送给他一份小礼物。

presentation.example: She gave a short presentation about her new project to the whole team.
presentation.exampleZh: 她向整个团队做了一场关于她新项目的简短陈述。

presently.example: She is presently busy, but she will call you back soon.
presently.exampleZh: 她目前很忙，但不久会给你回电话。

preserve.example: We must preserve these old trees for the next generation.
preserve.exampleZh: 我们必须为下一代保护这些老树。

president.example: The president will visit our school and speak to the students tomorrow.
president.exampleZh: 总统明天将访问我们学校并与学生们讲话。

press.example: She pressed the button and waited for the door to open.
press.exampleZh: 她按下按钮，等着门打开。

pressure.example: Students often feel pressure before a big exam.
pressure.exampleZh: 学生在大考前常常感到压力。

pretend.example: She pretended to be happy, but we all knew she was sad.
pretend.exampleZh: 她假装开心，但我们都知道她很难过。

pretty.example: She wore a pretty dress to the party last night.
pretty.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条漂亮的裙子去参加聚会。

prevail.example: Small shops still prevail in this quiet old town.
prevail.exampleZh: 在这座安静的老城里，小商店依然盛行。

prevent.example: Wash your hands often to prevent the spread of germs.
prevent.exampleZh: 经常洗手以防止细菌传播。

previous.example: I met her at the previous meeting and we talked for a while.
previous.exampleZh: 我在上次会议上见过她，我们聊了一会儿。

price.example: The price of the house is too high for us.
price.exampleZh: 这栋房子的价格对我们来说太高了。

pride.example: She takes great pride in her work and never gives up.
pride.exampleZh: 她对自己的工作深感自豪，从不放弃。

primarily.example: This book is primarily for students who want to learn English quickly.
primarily.exampleZh: 这本书主要是为想要快速学英语的学生写的。

primary.example: Safety is our primary concern at every stage of the project.
primary.exampleZh: 安全是我们在项目每个阶段的首要关切。

prime.example: Safety is our prime concern when we build a new school.
prime.exampleZh: 建造新学校时，安全是我们首要关注的问题。

primitive.example: Their tools were very primitive, but they still built small houses.
primitive.exampleZh: 他们的工具非常简陋，但他们仍然建造了小房子。

prince.example: The young prince lived in a big castle with his family.
prince.exampleZh: 这位年轻的王子和他的家人住在一座大城堡里。

princess.example: The little princess wore a beautiful dress to the party.
princess.exampleZh: 小公主穿着一条漂亮的裙子去参加聚会。

principal.example: The principal reason she became a teacher was her love of children.
principal.exampleZh: 她成为教师的主要原因是她热爱孩子。

principle.example: Honesty is an important principle in our family.
principle.exampleZh: 诚实是我们家的一条重要原则。

print.example: The book will print next month and the print is very clear.
print.exampleZh: 这本书下个月出版，字体非常清晰。

prior.example: She had prior experience with this kind of work.
prior.exampleZh: 她先前有过这类工作的经验。

priority.example: Safety is our top priority at work.
priority.exampleZh: 安全是我们工作中的头等优先事项。

prison.example: The man was sent to prison for two years after the trial.
prison.exampleZh: 审判后，那名男子被送进监狱服刑两年。

prisoner.example: The prisoner walked slowly across the yard with two guards behind him.
prisoner.exampleZh: 那名囚犯在两名警卫跟随下慢慢走过院子。

private.example: This is my private room, so please do not come in.
private.exampleZh: 这是我的私人房间，请不要进来。

privilege.example: It is a great privilege to meet you and your family today.
privilege.exampleZh: 今天能见到您和您的家人是我的莫大荣幸。

prize.example: She won first prize in the school singing contest last year.
prize.exampleZh: 她在去年的学校歌唱比赛中获得了一等奖。

probable.example: It is probable that the train will arrive late today.
probable.exampleZh: 今天火车很可能会晚点到达。

probably.example: It is probably going to rain later this afternoon.
probably.exampleZh: 今天下午很可能会下雨。

problem.example: We have a big problem with the new computer system at work.
problem.exampleZh: 我们在工作中使用的新电脑系统有一个大问题。

procedure.example: Please follow the correct procedure before you start the new test.
procedure.exampleZh: 开始新测试前，请遵循正确的程序。

proceed.example: Please proceed with your work and tell me when you finish.
proceed.exampleZh: 请继续你的工作，完成后告诉我。

process.example: We must learn each step of the process before we start the work.
process.exampleZh: 在开始这项工作之前，我们必须了解这个过程的每一个步骤。

produce.example: The farm produces fresh vegetables for the local market every week.
produce.exampleZh: 这个农场每周为当地市场生产新鲜蔬菜。

product.example: This new product is very popular with young people.
product.exampleZh: 这款新产品很受年轻人欢迎。

production.example: The factory increased its production of cars last year.
production.exampleZh: 这家工厂去年提高了汽车产量。

profession.example: Teaching is a profession that requires patience and a real love of learning.
profession.exampleZh: 教学是一门需要耐心和对学习真正热爱的职业。

professional.example: She is a professional nurse and works in a big hospital.
professional.exampleZh: 她是一名专业护士，在一家大医院工作。

professor.example: My professor helps us understand difficult math problems after class.
professor.exampleZh: 我的教授课后帮助我们理解困难的数学问题。

profile.example: Her profile in the photo shows a clear outline of her face.
profile.exampleZh: 照片中她的侧面清晰地勾勒出了她的脸部轮廓。

profit.example: The small shop makes a good profit every month.
profit.exampleZh: 这家小店每个月都能赚到不错的利润。

program.example: My favorite program on TV starts at eight o'clock tonight.
program.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的电视节目今晚八点开始。

progress.example: She made great progress in English after months of daily practice.
progress.exampleZh: 经过几个月的每日练习，她的英语取得了很大进步。

progressive.example: Our school has a progressive plan to help every student learn better.
progressive.exampleZh: 我们学校有一个渐进的计划，帮助每个学生学得更好。

prohibit.example: The school prohibits students from using phones during class.
prohibit.exampleZh: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。

project.example: Our team will start a new project next month.
project.exampleZh: 我们团队下个月将开始一个新项目。

promise.example: She made a promise to her mother and she kept it.
promise.exampleZh: 她向母亲许下诺言，并且遵守了它。

promising.example: She is a promising young doctor and works very hard.
promising.exampleZh: 她是一位有前途的年轻医生，工作非常努力。

promote.example: The new manager will promote healthy habits among the team.
promote.exampleZh: 新经理将在团队中促进健康的习惯。

prompt.example: The teacher gave a short prompt to help us start writing.
prompt.exampleZh: 老师给了一个简短的提示，帮助我们开始写作。

pronoun.example: In the sentence she likes it, the word she is a pronoun.
pronoun.exampleZh: 在句子 she likes it 中，单词 she 是一个代词。

pronounce.example: Teachers often pronounce new words slowly so students can hear every sound.
pronounce.exampleZh: 老师常常慢慢地读新单词，让学生能听清每个音。

pronunciation.example: Her English pronunciation is very clear and easy to understand.
pronunciation.exampleZh: 她的英语发音非常清晰，很容易听懂。

proof.example: The police found no proof that he stole the money.
proof.exampleZh: 警方没有找到他偷钱的证据。

proper.example: It is proper to say thank you when someone helps you.
proper.exampleZh: 当别人帮助你时，说声谢谢是恰当的。

properly.example: If you fix the machine properly, it will work well for many years.
properly.exampleZh: 如果你正确地修理这台机器，它将能良好运转很多年。

property.example: This old house is the most valuable property my family owns.
property.exampleZh: 这栋老房子是我家最值钱的财产。

proportion.example: A large proportion of the students walk to school every day.
proportion.exampleZh: 很大一部分学生每天步行上学。

proposal.example: Her proposal to start work earlier was accepted by the whole team.
proposal.exampleZh: 她提出的提前开始工作的建议被整个团队接受了。

propose.example: I propose that we meet again next week to discuss the plan.
propose.exampleZh: 我建议我们下周再见面讨论这个计划。

prospect.example: The prospect of a better job makes him study harder every day.
prospect.exampleZh: 找到更好工作的前景让他每天更加努力地学习。

prosper.example: The small town began to prosper after the new train station opened.
prosper.exampleZh: 新火车站开通后，这个小镇开始繁荣起来。

protect.example: We must protect the small animals in the forest.
protect.exampleZh: 我们必须保护森林里的小动物。

protein.example: Eggs and meat are good sources of protein for your body.
protein.exampleZh: 鸡蛋和肉类是你的身体获取蛋白质的良好来源。

protest.example: Many students joined the protest against the new school rules.
protest.exampleZh: 许多学生参加了反对新校规的抗议活动。

proud.example: She is very proud of her young son's hard work at school.
proud.exampleZh: 她为小儿子在学校里的努力感到非常自豪。

prove.example: The test results prove that clean water is safe to drink.
prove.exampleZh: 测试结果证明干净的水可以安全饮用。

provide.example: Our school will provide free books for every student this year.
provide.exampleZh: 我们学校今年将为每位学生免费提供课本。

provided.example: You can stay here provided you keep the room clean.
provided.exampleZh: 你可以待在这里，只要你保持房间干净。

province.example: My uncle lives in a small province in the north of the country.
province.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在这个国家北部的一个小省份里。

provision.example: The hotel makes provision for guests with special needs.
provision.exampleZh: 酒店为有特殊需求的客人做了准备。

provoke.example: His rude words provoked the whole class into a loud argument.
provoke.exampleZh: 他无礼的话激怒了全班同学，引发了一场大声争吵。

psychological.example: Stress at work can cause serious psychological problems for many young people.
psychological.exampleZh: 工作压力会给许多年轻人带来严重的心理问题。

pub.example: We met some old friends at a small pub near the river.
pub.exampleZh: 我们在河边一家小酒吧遇到了几位老朋友。

public.example: The public library is open to everyone every day of the week.
public.exampleZh: 这家公共图书馆每周每天都向所有人开放。

publication.example: The publication of her first book made her very happy.
publication.exampleZh: 她第一本书的出版让她非常开心。

publish.example: The school will publish a new magazine for all students next month.
publish.exampleZh: 学校下个月将为全体学生出版一本新杂志。

publisher.example: The publisher will print her new book next month.
publisher.exampleZh: 出版商下个月将印刷她的新书。

pull.example: She had to pull the heavy box across the floor by herself.
pull.exampleZh: 她不得不独自把那个沉重的箱子拖过地板。

pulse.example: The doctor checked my pulse and said I was fine.
pulse.exampleZh: 医生检查了我的脉搏，说我没问题。

pump.example: The farmer used a pump to bring water to his dry fields.
pump.exampleZh: 农民用抽水机把水抽到他干旱的田地里。

punch.example: The worker used a machine to punch a hole in the metal sheet.
punch.exampleZh: 工人用机器在金属板上打了一个孔。

punctual.example: She is always punctual for work and never arrives late.
punctual.exampleZh: 她上班总是很守时，从不迟到。

punish.example: The teacher will punish students who cheat on the exam.
punish.exampleZh: 老师会惩罚考试作弊的学生。

punishment.example: The teacher gave him a light punishment for being late to class.
punishment.exampleZh: 老师因为他上课迟到给了他一个轻微的惩罚。

pupil.example: The pupil in the front row raised his hand to answer the teacher's question.
pupil.exampleZh: 前排的那个小学生举手回答老师的问题。

purchase.example: We decided to purchase a new car for our family trip.
purchase.exampleZh: 我们决定为家庭旅行购买一辆新车。

pure.example: The water in this mountain lake is pure and very clean.
pure.exampleZh: 这座山间湖泊里的水是纯净的，非常干净。

purple.example: She wore a purple dress to her sister's birthday party last night.
purple.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条紫色的连衣裙去参加她姐姐的生日聚会。

purpose.example: She never told me the purpose of her visit.
purpose.exampleZh: 她从未告诉我她此行的目的。

purse.example: She opened her purse to find some money for the bus.
purse.exampleZh: 她打开钱包找些零钱坐公交车。

pursue.example: She decided to pursue her dream of becoming a doctor.
pursue.exampleZh: 她决定追求成为医生的梦想。

push.example: She pushed the heavy door open and walked into the bright room.
push.exampleZh: 她推开那扇沉重的门，走进了明亮的房间。

put.example: Please put the books on the table before you leave.
put.exampleZh: 请在你离开前把书放在桌子上。

puzzle.example: The missing key puzzled everyone, and the puzzle on the table took hours.
puzzle.exampleZh: 钥匙不见了让大家很困惑，而桌上的拼图花了几个小时才拼好。

pyramid.example: The children built a small pyramid with blocks on the floor.
pyramid.exampleZh: 孩子们在地板上用积木搭了一个小金字塔。

quake.example: The ground began to quake when the heavy truck drove past our old house.
quake.exampleZh: 当那辆重型卡车驶过我们家的老房子时，地面开始震动。

qualification.example: The job needs a teaching qualification and at least two years of experience.
qualification.exampleZh: 这份工作需要教师资格证书以及至少两年的经验。

qualify.example: She works hard every day to qualify for the final test.
qualify.exampleZh: 她每天努力学习，以取得参加期末考试的资格。

quality.example: The quality of this tea is very good.

quantity.example: We need a large quantity of water for the trip.
quantity.exampleZh: 这次旅行我们需要大量的水。

quarrel.example: They had a quarrel about money last night.
quarrel.exampleZh: 他们昨晚为了钱吵了一架。

quarter.example: A quarter of the students in our class walk to school every morning.
quarter.exampleZh: 我们班四分之一的学生每天早上步行去学校。

quarterly.example: The company sends a quarterly report to all its workers.
quarterly.exampleZh: 公司向所有员工发送季度报告。

queen.example: The queen lives in a big castle with her family.
queen.exampleZh: 女王和她的家人住在一座大城堡里。

queer.example: It felt a little queer to walk home alone in the dark.
queer.exampleZh: 在黑暗中独自走回家，感觉有点奇怪。

quench.example: A glass of cold water will quench your thirst after the long run.
quench.exampleZh: 长跑之后，一杯冷水能解你的渴。

query.example: I have a query about the new schedule for next week.
query.exampleZh: 我对下周的新日程安排有一个疑问。

question.example: The teacher asked me a question about the new lesson.
question.exampleZh: 老师问了我一个关于新课的问题。

queue.example: Many people stand in a long queue to buy tickets for the show.
queue.exampleZh: 许多人排成长队购买演出的门票。

quick.example: She is very quick at math and often helps her friends.
quick.exampleZh: 她做数学题很快，经常帮助朋友。

quiet.example: The library is very quiet in the early morning.
quiet.exampleZh: 清晨的图书馆非常安静。

quilt.example: My grandmother made a warm quilt for me last winter.
quilt.exampleZh: 去年冬天我奶奶给我做了一床暖和的被子。

quit.example: He decided to quit his job and leave the city last month.
quit.exampleZh: 他上个月决定辞去工作，离开这座城市。

quite.example: The test was quite easy, so I finished it in ten minutes.
quite.exampleZh: 这次考试相当简单，所以我十分钟就做完了。

quiz.example: Our teacher gave us a short quiz on the new words today.
quiz.exampleZh: 今天老师就新单词给我们做了一次小测验。

quotation.example: She put a short quotation from the poem at the top of her essay.
quotation.exampleZh: 她把诗中的一小段引文放在了文章开头。

quote.example: Please quote the price from the letter in your report.
quote.exampleZh: 请在你的报告中引用信里的报价。

rabbit.example: The white rabbit ate a carrot in the garden.
rabbit.exampleZh: 那只白兔在花园里吃了一根胡萝卜。

race.example: They won the race and ran to the big tree.
race.exampleZh: 他们赢了比赛，然后跑向那棵大树。

racial.example: Many people still face unfair treatment because of racial differences.
racial.exampleZh: 许多人仍然因为种族差异而遭受不公平的对待。

rack.example: He put the old books on the wooden rack near the door.
rack.exampleZh: 他把旧书放在门边的木架子上。

racket.example: The boy put his new racket in the bag and ran to the court.
racket.exampleZh: 男孩把新球拍放进包里，然后跑向球场。

radar.example: The small boat used radar to find the harbor in the dark.
radar.exampleZh: 小船用雷达在黑暗中找到了港口。

radiate.example: Her face radiated joy when she heard the good news.
radiate.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息时，她的脸上流露出喜悦。

radiation.example: Too much radiation from the sun can hurt your skin.
radiation.exampleZh: 来自太阳的过多辐射会伤害你的皮肤。

radical.example: The company made radical changes to its old rules last year.
radical.exampleZh: 公司去年对其旧规则做出了彻底的改变。

radio.example: My father listens to the radio every morning before he goes to work.
radio.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上上班前都会听收音机。

rag.example: He cleaned the dirty old window with a piece of rag.
rag.exampleZh: 他用一块破布擦干净了那扇脏兮兮的旧窗户。

rage.example: He could not hide his rage when the plan failed.
rage.exampleZh: 计划失败时，他无法掩饰自己的狂怒。

raid.example: The police carried out a raid on the old house early this morning.
raid.exampleZh: 警方今天凌晨对那栋老房子进行了突袭搜查。

rail.example: She held the rail tightly while walking down the stairs.
rail.exampleZh: 她下楼梯时紧紧抓着扶手。

railroad.example: The railroad connects the small town with the big city.
railroad.exampleZh: 这条铁路把小镇和大城市连接起来。

railway.example: The new railway connects the small town with the big city.
railway.exampleZh: 这条新铁路将小镇与大城市连接起来。

rain.example: The rain was very heavy last night, so we stayed at home.
rain.exampleZh: 昨晚雨很大，所以我们待在家里。

rainbow.example: We saw a beautiful rainbow in the sky after the rain.
rainbow.exampleZh: 雨停后，我们看到了天空中一道美丽的彩虹。

raise.example: The company plans to raise money to build a new school here.
raise.exampleZh: 公司计划筹集资金在这里建一所新学校。

rally.example: The coach called a rally to cheer up the tired players.
rally.exampleZh: 教练召集了一次集会来为疲惫的队员们打气。

random.example: Please pick a random number between one and ten.
random.exampleZh: 请在一到十之间随便选一个数字。

range.example: The store sells a wide range of fresh fruit and vegetables.
range.exampleZh: 这家商店出售种类繁多、新鲜的蔬菜水果。

rank.example: She ranks near the top of her class, and the rank smell of the old room bothered her.
rank.exampleZh: 她在班上名列前茅，而那间旧房间难闻的气味让她很不舒服。

rapid.example: The rapid growth of the city brought many new jobs.
rapid.exampleZh: 这座城市的快速发展带来了许多新的工作岗位。

rare.example: This rare bird lives only in a few small mountains here.
rare.exampleZh: 这种稀有的鸟只生活在这里的几座小山中。

rarely.example: My brother rarely eats breakfast because he wakes up late.
rarely.exampleZh: 我弟弟很少吃早饭，因为他起床很晚。

rat.example: The cat caught a big rat in the kitchen last night.
rat.exampleZh: 昨晚猫在厨房里抓住了一只大老鼠。

rate.example: The unemployment rate in this country is rising at an alarming speed.
rate.exampleZh: 这个国家的失业率正以惊人的速度上升。

rather.example: The test was rather hard, but I finished it in time.
rather.exampleZh: 这次考试相当难，但我还是按时完成了。

ratio.example: The ratio of boys to girls in our class is two to one.
ratio.exampleZh: 我们班男生与女生的比例是二比一。

ration.example: The soldiers received a daily ration of bread and water.
ration.exampleZh: 士兵们每天领到一份面包和水的定量配给。

raw.example: You should wash raw vegetables carefully before you cook or eat them.
raw.exampleZh: 生的蔬菜在烹调或食用前应当仔细清洗。

ray.example: A ray of sunlight came through the window and lit the room.
ray.exampleZh: 一缕阳光透过窗户照进来，照亮了房间。

razor.example: My father uses a razor every morning before he goes to work.
razor.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上上班前都会用剃须刀。

reach.example: We finally reached the top of the hill before sunset.
reach.exampleZh: 我们在日落前终于到达了山顶。

react.example: She did not know how to react when she heard the bad news.
react.exampleZh: 听到这个坏消息时，她不知道该如何反应。

reaction.example: Her first reaction to the news was complete silence for a moment.
reaction.exampleZh: 她对这个消息的第一反应是沉默了片刻。

read.example: I like to read a book before I go to sleep.
read.exampleZh: 我喜欢在睡觉前读一本书。

reader.example: The reader asked the writer a question about the new book.
reader.exampleZh: 读者就这本新书向作者提了一个问题。

readily.example: She readily agreed to help us with the work.
readily.exampleZh: 她欣然同意帮助我们做这项工作。

reading.example: Reading every day helps me learn new words and write better.
reading.exampleZh: 每天阅读帮助我学习新单词，也让我写得更好。

ready.example: I am ready to help you with your homework tonight.
ready.exampleZh: 我今晚愿意帮你做作业。

real.example: Her story is about a real event that happened last year.
real.exampleZh: 她的故事讲的是去年发生的一件真实事件。

realistic.example: We need a realistic plan that we can actually follow.
realistic.exampleZh: 我们需要一个真正能执行的、切合实际的计划。

reality.example: The reality of life is not always easy to accept.
reality.exampleZh: 生活的现实并不总是容易让人接受。

realization.example: The realization that she was right changed his mind.
realization.exampleZh: 意识到她是对的，这改变了他的想法。

realize.example: I did not realize how late it was until my mother called me.
realize.exampleZh: 直到妈妈打电话给我，我才意识到已经这么晚了。

really.example: I really like this book and I read it every day.
really.exampleZh: 我非常喜欢这本书，我每天都读它。

realm.example: She is a famous expert in the realm of computer science.
realm.exampleZh: 她是计算机科学领域一位著名的专家。

reap.example: Farmers reap the rice in autumn and sell it at the market.
reap.exampleZh: 农民在秋天收割稻谷，然后拿到市场上卖。

rear.example: He sat in the rear of the car and looked out the window.
rear.exampleZh: 他坐在汽车后部，望着窗外。

reason.example: Please tell me the reason why you were late this morning.
reason.exampleZh: 请告诉我你今天早上迟到的原因。

reasonable.example: It is reasonable to ask for more time to finish the work.
reasonable.exampleZh: 要求更多时间来完成这项工作是合理的。

rebel.example: The young rebel refused to follow the old rules of the village.
rebel.exampleZh: 那个年轻的叛逆者拒绝遵守村里的旧规矩。

recall.example: I can't recall the name of that small restaurant near the station.
recall.exampleZh: 我想不起车站附近那家小餐馆的名字了。

receipt.example: Please keep this receipt in case you need to return the item.
receipt.exampleZh: 请保留好这张收据，以备你需要退货时使用。

receive.example: I receive a letter from my best friend every week.
receive.exampleZh: 我每周都会收到我最好的朋友寄来的一封信。

receiver.example: She picked up the receiver and waited for the caller to speak.
receiver.exampleZh: 她拿起听筒，等着对方开口说话。

recent.example: I have not seen him in recent weeks.
recent.exampleZh: 最近几周我没有见过他。

recently.example: I have recently started learning English with an online dictionary.
recently.exampleZh: 我最近开始用在线词典学英语。

reception.example: The hotel reception is on the first floor near the front door.
reception.exampleZh: 酒店接待处在一楼，靠近前门。

receptionist.example: The receptionist at the front desk gave me a room key.
receptionist.exampleZh: 前台接待员给了我一把房间钥匙。

recession.example: Many people lost their jobs during the recession last year.
recession.exampleZh: 去年经济衰退期间，许多人失去了工作。

recipe.example: This recipe is easy to follow for busy people.
recipe.exampleZh: 这个食谱对忙碌的人来说很容易照着做。

recite.example: Every morning the students recite a short poem in class.
recite.exampleZh: 每天早上学生们在课堂上背诵一首短诗。

recognition.example: She received a prize in recognition of her hard work.
recognition.exampleZh: 她获得了一个奖项，以表彰她的辛勤工作。

recognize.example: I did not recognize him because he looked very different.
recognize.exampleZh: 我没认出他，因为他看起来变化很大。

recommend.example: My teacher recommended this book to me last week.
recommend.exampleZh: 上周我的老师把这本书推荐给了我。

recommendation.example: My teacher gave me a strong recommendation for the job.
recommendation.exampleZh: 老师为这份工作给我写了一封很有力的推荐信。

record.example: She broke the world record for the fastest run last year.
record.exampleZh: 她去年打破了最快跑步的世界纪录。

recorder.example: The recorder took notes during the meeting and shared them with us.
recorder.exampleZh: 记录员在会议上做了记录，并把记录分享给了我们。

recover.example: It took him two weeks to recover from the bad cold.
recover.exampleZh: 他花了两周时间才从重感冒中康复。

recovery.example: The doctor says her recovery will take a few more weeks.
recovery.exampleZh: 医生说她还需要几周才能痊愈。

recreation.example: Reading and swimming are my favorite forms of recreation on weekends.
recreation.exampleZh: 阅读和游泳是我周末最喜欢的消遣方式。

recruit.example: The company plans to recruit twenty new workers next month.
recruit.exampleZh: 公司计划下个月招募二十名新员工。

red.example: The little girl wore a red coat to the party last night.
red.exampleZh: 昨晚那个小女孩穿了一件红色的外套去参加聚会。

reduce.example: We must reduce the amount of waste we produce every day.
reduce.exampleZh: 我们必须减少每天产生的垃圾量。

reduction.example: The company announced a small reduction in prices last week.
reduction.exampleZh: 公司上周宣布小幅降低价格。

refer.example: You can refer to the dictionary when you meet a new word.
refer.exampleZh: 遇到新单词时，你可以查阅词典。

reference.example: You can use this book as a reference for your report.
reference.exampleZh: 你可以把这本书作为你报告的参考资料。

reflect.example: The lake reflects the mountains and sky like a mirror.
reflect.exampleZh: 湖面像镜子一样映出群山和天空。

reflection.example: The calm lake gave a clear reflection of the tall green trees.
reflection.exampleZh: 平静的湖面清晰地映出了高大的绿树。

reform.example: The new leader promised to reform the tax system and help small businesses.
reform.exampleZh: 新领导人承诺改革税收制度，并帮助小企业。

refresh.example: A cold drink can refresh you after a long walk in the sun.
refresh.exampleZh: 在太阳下走了很久之后，一杯冷饮能让你恢复精力。

refuge.example: The old church became a refuge for families during the flood.
refuge.exampleZh: 洪水期间，那座老教堂成了许多家庭的避难所。

refugee.example: The refugee family arrived at the camp late at night.
refugee.exampleZh: 这户难民家庭在深夜抵达了营地。

refuse.example: She refused to eat the old food and threw it away.
refuse.exampleZh: 她拒绝吃那些旧食物，把它扔掉了。

regard.example: I regard her as a good friend and trust her advice.
regard.exampleZh: 我把她看作好朋友，并信任她的建议。

regarding.example: She asked me a question regarding the new school rules yesterday.
regarding.exampleZh: 她昨天问了我一个关于学校新规定的问题。

regardless.example: She went to work regardless of the heavy rain.
regardless.exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，她还是去上班了。

region.example: This region is famous for its tea and beautiful mountains.
region.exampleZh: 这个地区以茶叶和美丽的山闻名。

register.example: Please register your name at the front desk before you enter.
register.exampleZh: 请在进入前到前台登记你的姓名。

regret.example: I regret not saying goodbye to my grandmother before she left.
regret.exampleZh: 我后悔在祖母离开前没有和她道别。

regular.example: She keeps a regular schedule and goes to bed early every night.
regular.exampleZh: 她作息有规律，每天晚上都很早睡觉。

regulate.example: The new law regulates how much water factories can use.
regulate.exampleZh: 新法律管制工厂可以用多少水。

regulation.example: The school has new regulations about using phones in class.
regulation.exampleZh: 学校有关于课堂上使用手机的新规定。

reinforce.example: These new rules will reinforce our efforts to keep the city safe.
reinforce.exampleZh: 这些新规定将加强我们维护城市安全的努力。

reject.example: The committee will reject the plan if it costs too much money.
reject.exampleZh: 如果这个计划花费太多钱，委员会就会否决它。

relate.example: Many students find it hard to relate what they learn in class to real life.
relate.exampleZh: 许多学生发现很难把课堂上学到的东西与现实生活联系起来。

relation.example: The relation between the two countries has improved in recent years.
relation.exampleZh: 近年来，这两个国家之间的关系有所改善。

relationship.example: She has a good relationship with her new teacher.
relationship.exampleZh: 她和她的新老师关系很好。

relative.example: My mother and her relatives came to visit us last weekend.
relative.exampleZh: 我妈妈和她的亲戚上周末来看望我们了。

relatively.example: The test was relatively easy, so most students finished it quickly.
relatively.exampleZh: 这次考试相对容易，所以大多数学生很快就做完了。

relax.example: You should relax and take a short break after the long exam.
relax.exampleZh: 漫长的考试结束后，你应该放松一下，短暂休息一会儿。

release.example: The band will release a new song next week and then go on tour.
release.exampleZh: 乐队下周将发布一首新歌，然后开始巡演。

relevant.example: The teacher asked us to find information relevant to the topic.
relevant.exampleZh: 老师让我们查找与这个主题相关的信息。

relief.example: It was a great relief to hear that everyone was safe.
relief.exampleZh: 听说大家都平安无事，我大大松了一口气。

relieve.example: The medicine helped relieve her headache after a long day at work.
relieve.exampleZh: 在漫长的一天工作之后，这药帮助缓解了她的头痛。

religion.example: Many people in this country follow a different religion and celebrate different holidays.
religion.exampleZh: 这个国家的许多人信奉不同的宗教，庆祝不同的节日。

religious.example: Her family is very religious and goes to church every Sunday.
religious.exampleZh: 她的家人非常虔诚，每个星期天都去教堂。

rely.example: Many small children rely on their parents for food and warm clothes.
rely.exampleZh: 许多小孩子依靠父母提供食物和暖和的衣服。

remain.example: The weather remained cold and rainy for three more days.
remain.exampleZh: 天气又持续冷了三天，阴雨连绵。

remains.example: Archaeologists found the remains of an ancient city under the field.
remains.exampleZh: 考古学家在田野下发现了一座古城的遗迹。

remark.example: She made a kind remark about my new job.
remark.exampleZh: 她对我的新工作说了一句善意的话。

remarkable.example: She has a remarkable ability to remember names and faces.
remarkable.exampleZh: 她有非凡的记忆人名和面孔的能力。

remedy.example: The best remedy for a cold is rest and plenty of water.
remedy.exampleZh: 治疗感冒最好的方法是休息和多喝水。

remember.example: I still remember the first day we met at school.
remember.exampleZh: 我仍然记得我们在学校相识的第一天。

remind.example: Please remind me to call my mother tonight.
remind.exampleZh: 请提醒我今晚给妈妈打电话。

remote.example: The small village is remote and far from any big city.
remote.exampleZh: 这个小村庄很偏僻，离任何大城市都很远。

remove.example: Please remove your shoes before you enter the room.
remove.exampleZh: 进房间之前请脱下你的鞋子。

render.example: The new rules render the old system useless, so we need a change.
render.exampleZh: 新规定使旧系统变得无用，所以我们需要做出改变。

renew.example: I need to renew my library books before Friday.
renew.exampleZh: 我需要在周五之前续借我的图书馆书籍。

rent.example: We pay the rent on the first day of each month.
rent.exampleZh: 我们在每个月的第一天交房租。

repair.example: My father helped me repair my old bike last Sunday afternoon.
repair.exampleZh: 上周日下午，我父亲帮我修理了我的旧自行车。

repeat.example: Please repeat the question slowly so everyone in the room can hear it.
repeat.exampleZh: 请慢慢重复这个问题，好让房间里的每个人都能听到。

repeatedly.example: The teacher repeatedly told us to read the new words aloud every morning.
repeatedly.exampleZh: 老师反复地告诉我们要每天早上大声朗读生词。

replace.example: We need to replace the old computer with a new one.
replace.exampleZh: 我们需要用新电脑替换这台旧电脑。

replacement.example: We need a replacement for the old printer in our office.
replacement.exampleZh: 我们需要一个替代品来替换办公室里的旧打印机。

reply.example: She did not reply to my email, so I called her.
reply.exampleZh: 她没有回复我的邮件，所以我给她打了电话。

report.example: She will report the good news to her teacher tomorrow morning.
report.exampleZh: 她明天早上会把这个好消息报告给她的老师。

reporter.example: The reporter asked the teacher several questions after the school meeting.
reporter.exampleZh: 学校会议结束后，记者向老师问了几个问题。

represent.example: The color red often represents good luck in many Asian countries.
represent.exampleZh: 红色在许多亚洲国家通常代表好运。

representative.example: She is our class representative and speaks for all the students.
representative.exampleZh: 她是我们班的代表，为所有学生发声。

republic.example: The country became a republic after the people voted for a new government.
republic.exampleZh: 人民投票选出新政府后，这个国家成为了共和国。

republican.example: The country set up a republican government after the long war ended.
republican.exampleZh: 长期战争结束后，这个国家建立了共和政体的政府。

reputation.example: He has a good reputation at school because he always helps others.
reputation.exampleZh: 他在学校里名声很好，因为他总是帮助别人。

request.example: She made a polite request for more time to finish the work.
request.exampleZh: 她礼貌地请求多给一些时间来完成这项工作。

require.example: This job requires a lot of time and effort from every worker.
require.exampleZh: 这份工作需要每位员工投入大量的时间和精力。

requirement.example: The job has one basic requirement: you must be able to work on weekends.
requirement.exampleZh: 这份工作有一个基本要求：你必须能在周末工作。

rescue.example: Firefighters worked all night to rescue the two children from the burning house.
rescue.exampleZh: 消防员通宵工作，把两个孩子从着火的房子里救了出来。

research.example: She does research on how children learn to read at school.
research.exampleZh: 她研究儿童在学校如何学习阅读。

researcher.example: The researcher found a new way to help sick children.
researcher.exampleZh: 这位研究人员找到了一种帮助生病儿童的新方法。

reserve.example: We reserved a table for four at the restaurant near the nature reserve.
reserve.exampleZh: 我们在自然保护区附近的那家餐厅预订了一张四人桌。

resident.example: The resident next door often helps us look after our dog.
resident.exampleZh: 隔壁的居民经常帮我们照看狗。

resign.example: She decided to resign from her job and look for a new one.
resign.exampleZh: 她决定辞去工作，找一份新工作。

resist.example: She couldn't resist eating the last piece of chocolate cake.
resist.exampleZh: 她忍不住吃掉了最后一块巧克力蛋糕。

resistance.example: The soldiers showed strong resistance against the enemy attack.
resistance.exampleZh: 士兵们对敌人的进攻表现出强烈的抵抗。

resistant.example: Some bacteria are resistant to common antibiotics, so doctors must be careful.
resistant.exampleZh: 有些细菌对常见抗生素有抵抗力，所以医生必须小心。

resolve.example: We must resolve this problem before the meeting begins.
resolve.exampleZh: 我们必须在会议开始前解决这个问题。

resort.example: We had to resort to asking a neighbor for help.

resource.example: We need more time and resources to finish this project.
resource.exampleZh: 我们需要更多的时间和资源来完成这个项目。

respect.example: We should show respect to our teachers and follow the school rules.
respect.exampleZh: 我们应该尊敬老师，并遵守学校的规定。

respective.example: After the meeting, the two teams went back to their respective offices.
respective.exampleZh: 会议结束后，两个团队回到了各自的办公室。

respectively.example: Tom and Lily won first and second place respectively in the race.
respectively.exampleZh: 汤姆和莉莉在比赛中分别获得第一名和第二名。

respond.example: She did not respond to my email until the next morning.
respond.exampleZh: 她直到第二天早上才回复我的邮件。

response.example: I sent him an email but got no response.
response.exampleZh: 我给他发了邮件，但没有收到回复。

responsibility.example: Every student has a responsibility to keep the classroom clean and tidy.
responsibility.exampleZh: 每个学生都有责任保持教室干净整洁。

responsible.example: She is responsible for the new project at work.
responsible.exampleZh: 她在工作中负责这个新项目。

rest.example: You should rest for a while before you finish the rest of the work.
rest.exampleZh: 你应该先休息一会儿，然后再完成剩下的工作。

restaurant.example: We had dinner at a small restaurant near our hotel last night.
restaurant.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在酒店附近的一家小餐馆吃了晚饭。

restless.example: The children grew restless after waiting in the small room for two hours.
restless.exampleZh: 孩子们在小房间里等了两个小时后变得坐立不安。

restore.example: The workers will restore the old bridge this summer.
restore.exampleZh: 工人们今年夏天将修复这座旧桥。

restrict.example: The new rules restrict how much water people can use each day.
restrict.exampleZh: 新规定限制了人们每天可以用的水量。

result.example: The result of the game was a big surprise for everyone.
result.exampleZh: 这场比赛的结果让所有人都大吃一惊。

retain.example: We should retain the old wooden bridge because it holds many happy memories.
retain.exampleZh: 我们应该保留这座旧木桥，因为它承载着许多快乐的回忆。

retire.example: My father will retire from his job next year after forty years.
retire.exampleZh: 我父亲在工作四十年后将于明年退休。

retreat.example: The soldiers had to retreat quickly when the enemy attacked from the hills.
retreat.exampleZh: 敌人从山上进攻时，士兵们不得不迅速撤退。

return.example: Please return the book to the library before Friday.
return.exampleZh: 请在星期五之前把书归还给图书馆。

reveal.example: The new report reveals that many students do not get enough sleep.
reveal.exampleZh: 这份新报告揭示，许多学生睡眠不足。

revenue.example: The company's revenue grew quickly last year after it opened two new stores.
revenue.exampleZh: 公司去年开了两家新店后，收入增长得很快。

review.example: I will review my notes before the test tomorrow morning.
review.exampleZh: 明天早上考试前我会复习我的笔记。

revolution.example: The internet caused a big revolution in how people work and learn.
revolution.exampleZh: 互联网在人们工作和学习的方式上引发了一场大变革。

reward.example: She got a small reward for finding the lost dog.
reward.exampleZh: 她因为找到了那只走失的狗而得到了一份小小的报酬。

rhythm.example: The music has a strong rhythm that makes everyone want to dance.
rhythm.exampleZh: 这首音乐节奏强烈，让每个人都想跳舞。

rib.example: The doctor said I broke a rib in my fall.
rib.exampleZh: 医生说我摔倒时断了一根肋骨。

ribbon.example: She tied a red ribbon around the gift box.
ribbon.exampleZh: 她在礼盒上系了一条红丝带。

rice.example: We eat rice with vegetables and fish for dinner every day.
rice.exampleZh: 我们每天晚饭都吃米饭配蔬菜和鱼。

rich.example: The old man is rich, but he still lives a simple life.
rich.exampleZh: 这位老人很富有，但他依然过着简朴的生活。

rid.example: He wants to rid the old house of all its junk.
rid.exampleZh: 他想清除掉老房子里的所有杂物。

ride.example: I ride my bike to school every day with my sister.
ride.exampleZh: 我每天和妹妹一起骑自行车上学。

ridge.example: We walked along the narrow ridge and looked down at the valley below.
ridge.exampleZh: 我们沿着狭窄的山脊行走，俯视下面的山谷。

ridiculous.example: It is ridiculous to wear a winter coat on a hot summer day.
ridiculous.exampleZh: 在炎热的夏日穿冬季外套是很荒唐的。

rifle.example: The soldier cleaned his rifle before the long march.
rifle.exampleZh: 士兵在长途行军前擦拭了他的步枪。

right.example: You are right, and the book on the right is mine.
right.exampleZh: 你是对的，右边那本书是我的。

rigid.example: The school has rigid rules about mobile phones and students must follow them.
rigid.exampleZh: 学校对手机有严格的规定，学生必须遵守。

ring.example: She wears a gold ring and likes to ring her friends.
ring.exampleZh: 她戴着一枚金戒指，喜欢给朋友们打电话。

riot.example: The city was quiet again after the riot ended last night.
riot.exampleZh: 昨晚骚乱结束后，城市又恢复了平静。

rip.example: He ripped the old letter in half and threw it away.
rip.exampleZh: 他把那封旧信撕成两半，然后扔掉了。

ripe.example: The apples on that tree are ripe and ready to eat.
ripe.exampleZh: 那棵树上的苹果已经成熟，可以吃了。

rise.example: Prices continue to rise every year, so many families find it hard to save money.
rise.exampleZh: 物价每年都在上涨，所以许多家庭发现很难存下钱来。

risk.example: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease.
risk.exampleZh: 吸烟会增加患心脏病的风险。

risky.example: It is risky to drive fast on this busy road.
risky.exampleZh: 在这条繁忙的路上开快车很危险。

river.example: The river runs through our small town and many children play beside it.
river.exampleZh: 这条河穿过我们的小镇，许多孩子在一旁玩耍。

road.example: The road to the small village is narrow but very beautiful.
road.exampleZh: 通往那个小村庄的路很窄，但非常美。

roar.example: The lion began to roar loudly when it saw the strangers.
roar.exampleZh: 狮子看到陌生人时开始大声吼叫。

roast.example: My mother will roast a chicken for our family dinner tonight.
roast.exampleZh: 我妈妈今晚会为我们的家庭晚餐烤一只鸡。

rob.example: Two men tried to rob the small bank near my house yesterday.
rob.exampleZh: 昨天两名男子试图抢劫我家附近的那家小银行。

robot.example: This robot can clean the floor and wash the dishes for us.
robot.exampleZh: 这个机器人能为我们扫地洗碗。

rock.example: The loud music made the whole room rock, and everyone started to dance.
rock.exampleZh: 响亮的音乐让整个房间都震动起来，大家都开始跳舞。

rod.example: He used a long wooden rod to reach the apples on the tree.
rod.exampleZh: 他用一根长木杆去够树上的苹果。

role.example: Teachers play an important role in helping students learn new things.
role.exampleZh: 教师在帮助学生学新事物方面起着重要作用。

roll.example: The ball began to roll slowly down the hill toward the river.
roll.exampleZh: 球开始慢慢地滚下山坡，朝河边滚去。

romantic.example: She loves romantic movies with happy endings and beautiful music.
romantic.exampleZh: 她喜欢有幸福结局和优美音乐的浪漫电影。

roof.example: The cat sat on the roof and looked down at the birds.
roof.exampleZh: 猫坐在屋顶上，低头看着那些鸟。

room.example: There is enough room in this room for two more desks.
room.exampleZh: 这个房间里还有足够的空间再放两张桌子。

root.example: The root of the problem is a lack of trust between them.
root.exampleZh: 问题的根源是他们之间缺乏信任。

rope.example: He used a long rope to pull the small boat to the shore.
rope.exampleZh: 他用一根长绳把小船拉到岸边。

rose.example: She gave me a red rose on my birthday.
rose.exampleZh: 她在我生日那天送了我一朵红玫瑰。

rotate.example: Please rotate the wheel slowly so everyone can see all the pictures.
rotate.exampleZh: 请慢慢转动轮子，好让每个人都能看到所有的图片。

rough.example: The rough road made the old car shake.
rough.exampleZh: 粗糙的路面让那辆旧车颠簸起来。

round.example: The children sat round the table and shared a round cake.
round.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐在桌旁，分享一个圆蛋糕。

rouse.example: The loud noise roused him from a deep sleep early this morning.
rouse.exampleZh: 今天清晨，巨大的响声把他从沉睡中唤醒。

route.example: This route is shorter but the road is often busy.
route.exampleZh: 这条路线更短，但路上经常很忙。

routine.example: My morning routine helps me start the day in a good mood.
routine.exampleZh: 我的早晨例行公事帮助我以好心情开始新的一天。

row.example: We sat in the front row and watched the boats row past us.
row.exampleZh: 我们坐在前排，看着船只划过。

royal.example: The royal family lives in a large old palace near the river.
royal.exampleZh: 王室成员住在河边一座古老的大宫殿里。

rub.example: Please rub the cream on your hands before you go to bed.
rub.exampleZh: 睡前请把药膏擦在手上。

rubber.example: The soles of these shoes are made of rubber.
rubber.exampleZh: 这双鞋的鞋底是橡胶做的。

rude.example: It is rude to talk loudly on the phone in a quiet place.
rude.exampleZh: 在安静的场所大声打电话是不礼貌的。

rug.example: A soft rug lies on the floor beside my bed.
rug.exampleZh: 我床边的地板上铺着一块柔软的小地毯。

ruin.example: The heavy rain ruined our picnic and we had to go home early.
ruin.exampleZh: 大雨毁了我们的野餐，我们只好提早回家。

rule.example: The teacher explained the new rule to the class.
rule.exampleZh: 老师向全班解释了这条新规则。

ruler.example: The ruler of this small country lives in a big old house.
ruler.exampleZh: 这个小国家的统治者住在一座古老的大房子里。

run.example: My father runs a small shop, and he runs it every day.
run.exampleZh: 我父亲经营一家小商店，他每天都打理它。

rural.example: Life in rural areas is quiet and close to nature.
rural.exampleZh: 农村地区的生活安静且贴近自然。

rush.example: Don't rush, we still have plenty of time before the train leaves.
rush.exampleZh: 别着急，火车开车前我们还有很多时间。

sack.example: The farmer put the potatoes in a sack and carried it home.
sack.exampleZh: 农民把土豆装进麻袋，然后把它搬回了家。

sacred.example: In many cultures, the mountain is a sacred place where people go to pray.
sacred.exampleZh: 在许多文化中，这座山是神圣之地，人们会去那里祈祷。

sacrifice.example: Many parents sacrifice their free time to give their children a better life.
sacrifice.exampleZh: 许多父母牺牲自己的空闲时间，为了给孩子更好的生活。

sad.example: She felt sad when her best friend moved to another city.
sad.exampleZh: 当她最好的朋友搬到另一个城市时，她感到很难过。

saddle.example: He put the saddle on the horse and rode away.
saddle.exampleZh: 他给马装上马鞍，然后骑马离开了。

safe.example: The money is safe inside the small box in my room.
safe.exampleZh: 钱放在我房间的那个小盒子里很安全。

safely.example: Please drive safely and come home before it gets dark.
safely.exampleZh: 请安全驾驶，在天黑前回家。

safety.example: Please put on your helmet for safety before you ride the bike.
safety.exampleZh: 骑车前请戴上头盔以确保安全。

sail.example: The small boat will sail across the lake early tomorrow morning.
sail.exampleZh: 小船明天一早将扬帆横穿湖面。

sailor.example: The old sailor told us many stories about his life at sea.
sailor.exampleZh: 那位老水手给我们讲了许多他在海上生活的故事。

saint.example: The old church was named after a famous saint from France.
saint.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂以一位来自法国的著名圣人命名。

sake.example: For the sake of your health, please stop smoking now.
sake.exampleZh: 为了你的健康，请现在就戒烟。

salad.example: I make a fresh salad with tomatoes, lettuce and cheese every day.
salad.exampleZh: 我每天用西红柿、生菜和奶酪做一份新鲜的色拉。

salary.example: He works hard because his salary is not very high.
salary.exampleZh: 他努力工作，因为他的薪水不太高。

sale.example: The store is having a sale on shoes this weekend.
sale.exampleZh: 这家店这个周末鞋子打折出售。

salesman.example: The salesman showed us a new phone and explained how it works.
salesman.exampleZh: 那位售货员给我们展示了一款新手机，并解释了它的使用方法。

salt.example: Please add a little salt to the soup before you serve it.
salt.exampleZh: 上汤之前请往汤里加一点盐。

same.example: My brother and I go to the same school every day.
same.exampleZh: 我和我弟弟每天去同一所学校。

sample.example: The doctor took a small sample of my blood for a quick test.
sample.exampleZh: 医生取了我一点血样做快速检查。

sand.example: The children played in the warm sand by the sea.
sand.exampleZh: 孩子们在海边温暖的沙滩上玩耍。

sandwich.example: I made a cheese sandwich and put it in my bag.
sandwich.exampleZh: 我做了一个奶酪三明治，把它放进了我的包里。

satellite.example: The satellite moves around the Earth and sends pictures back to us.
satellite.exampleZh: 这颗卫星绕地球运行，并把图片传送回给我们。

satisfaction.example: Her smile showed deep satisfaction with the simple meal.
satisfaction.exampleZh: 她的微笑显示出她对这顿简单的饭菜十分满意。

satisfactory.example: The test results were satisfactory, so the teacher let us go home early.
satisfactory.exampleZh: 考试结果令人满意，所以老师让我们提前回家了。

satisfy.example: Fresh fruit and vegetables can satisfy your hunger without adding too many calories.
satisfy.exampleZh: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜能让你吃饱，又不会增加太多热量。

saturday.example: We usually go to the park with our dog on Saturday morning.
saturday.exampleZh: 我们通常在星期六早上带狗去公园。

sauce.example: She put a little sauce on the fish before serving it.
sauce.exampleZh: 她在上菜前在鱼上放了一点酱汁。

sausage.example: I ate a sausage with bread and eggs for breakfast today.
sausage.exampleZh: 我今天早餐吃了香肠配面包和鸡蛋。

savage.example: The savage dog scared the children and they ran away quickly.
savage.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗吓坏了孩子们，他们迅速跑开了。

save.example: The doctor worked all night to save the little boy's life.
save.exampleZh: 医生通宵工作，为了挽救那个小男孩的生命。

saving.example: Saving money every month helped her buy a small car.
saving.exampleZh: 她每个月存钱，终于买了一辆小汽车。

say.example: People say it is hard to learn a new language well.
say.exampleZh: 人们说学好一门新语言很难。

scale.example: Please weigh the rice on the kitchen scale before cooking.
scale.exampleZh: 做饭前请用厨房秤称一下米。

scan.example: She scanned the page quickly to find the answer before class started.
scan.exampleZh: 她在上课前快速浏览了那一页，以找到答案。

scandal.example: The scandal shocked everyone in the small town and was soon in the news.
scandal.exampleZh: 这桩丑闻震惊了小镇上的每个人，很快就上了新闻。

scarce.example: Clean water is scarce in this dry and hot region.
scarce.exampleZh: 在这个干旱炎热的地区，干净的水很缺乏。

scarcely.example: I could scarcely see the road in the heavy rain.
scarcely.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，我几乎看不清路。

scare.example: The loud noise scared the little girl and she started to cry.
scare.exampleZh: 巨大的声响吓到了小女孩，她开始哭了起来。

scatter.example: The wind began to scatter the dry leaves across the whole yard.
scatter.exampleZh: 风开始把干枯的落叶吹得整个院子都是。

scene.example: The police found a knife at the scene of the crime.
scene.exampleZh: 警方在犯罪现场发现了一把刀。

scenery.example: The mountain scenery is very beautiful in autumn.
scenery.exampleZh: 秋天的山间景色非常美丽。

scent.example: The scent of fresh coffee filled the small kitchen.
scent.exampleZh: 新鲜咖啡的香味充满了小厨房。

schedule.example: The teacher gave us a schedule for the whole week.
schedule.exampleZh: 老师给了我们一整周的时间表。

scheme.example: The two men made a secret scheme to take the old lady's money.
scheme.exampleZh: 那两个男人策划了一个秘密的阴谋，想拿走那位老太太的钱。

scholar.example: She is a famous scholar who studies old Chinese books.
scholar.exampleZh: 她是一位研究中国古代典籍的著名学者。

scholarship.example: She won a scholarship to study music at a famous university.
scholarship.exampleZh: 她获得了一笔奖学金，去一所著名大学学习音乐。

school.example: My children walk to school every morning with their friends.
school.exampleZh: 我的孩子们每天早上和朋友们一起走路去学校。

science.example: Science helps us understand the world and make better choices.
science.exampleZh: 科学帮助我们理解世界，并做出更好的选择。

scientific.example: We need a scientific way to test this idea before we use it.
scientific.exampleZh: 在使用这个想法之前，我们需要一种科学的方法来检验它。

scientist.example: The scientist works in a small lab and studies plants every day.
scientist.exampleZh: 这位科学家在一间小实验室里工作，每天研究植物。

scissors.example: My little sister uses scissors to cut colorful paper for her art class.
scissors.exampleZh: 我妹妹用剪刀为美术课剪彩纸。

scold.example: My mother scolded me for coming home late last night.
scold.exampleZh: 昨晚我回家晚了，妈妈训斥了我一顿。

scoop.example: She used a small scoop to put sugar in her coffee.
scoop.exampleZh: 她用一个小勺子把糖放进咖啡里。

score.example: His score on the math test was the highest in the class.
score.exampleZh: 他的数学考试得分是全班最高的。

scout.example: The scout looked for a safe path through the forest.
scout.exampleZh: 侦察员在森林中寻找一条安全的路线。

scratch.example: The cat likes to scratch the old sofa with its sharp claws.
scratch.exampleZh: 这只猫喜欢用锋利的爪子抓那张旧沙发。

scream.example: The little girl began to scream when she saw the big dog.
scream.exampleZh: 小女孩看到那只大狗时开始尖叫起来。

screen.example: The nurse screened all the patients before they saw the doctor.
screen.exampleZh: 护士在病人看医生之前对他们进行了筛查。

screw.example: Please use a screw to fix this shelf to the wall.
screw.exampleZh: 请用一颗螺丝把这个架子固定到墙上。

script.example: The writer finished the script for a new film last week.
script.exampleZh: 这位作家上周完成了新电影的剧本。

sea.example: The sea is calm and blue today, so we can go swimming.
sea.exampleZh: 今天大海平静而湛蓝，所以我们可以去游泳。

seal.example: The worker used a seal to close the box before shipping it.
seal.exampleZh: 工人在发货前用封条把箱子封好。

search.example: The police will search the whole building for the missing child.
search.exampleZh: 警察将搜查整栋大楼寻找失踪的孩子。

season.example: Summer is my favorite season because the days are long and warm.
season.exampleZh: 夏天是我最喜欢的季节，因为白天又长又暖和。

seat.example: Please take your seat before the show starts.

second.example: Please wait a second while I check the second door.
second.exampleZh: 请稍等一下，我去检查第二扇门。

secondary.example: In my opinion, money is secondary and health is the most important thing.
secondary.exampleZh: 在我看来，金钱是次要的，健康才是最重要的。

secret.example: She kept her plan a secret from everyone until the very last day.
secret.exampleZh: 她把计划对所有人保密，直到最后一天才说出来。

secretary.example: The secretary wrote down every word the manager said at the meeting.
secretary.exampleZh: 秘书把经理在会上说的每句话都记了下来。

section.example: This section of the book explains how plants grow.
section.exampleZh: 这本书的这一部分解释了植物是如何生长的。

sector.example: The service sector creates many new jobs in our city every year.
sector.exampleZh: 服务业每年都在我们城市创造许多新的工作机会。

secure.example: Please make sure the door is secure before you leave the house.
secure.exampleZh: 离开家之前，请确保门是安全的。

security.example: The bank keeps your money safe and gives you security for the future.
security.exampleZh: 银行保障你的资金安全，并为你的未来提供保障。

see.example: I can see the tall trees from my bedroom window.
see.exampleZh: 我从卧室窗户能看见那些高高的树。

seed.example: The farmer put the seeds in the ground and waited for rain.
seed.exampleZh: 农民把种子放进土里，等待下雨。

seek.example: We are seeking a quiet place to study for the exam.
seek.exampleZh: 我们正在寻找一个安静的地方准备考试。

seem.example: You seem very tired today, so please go home and rest.
seem.exampleZh: 你今天似乎很累，所以请回家休息吧。

segment.example: This segment of the road is closed for repairs today.
segment.exampleZh: 这段路今天因维修而封闭。

seize.example: The police seized the stolen money and returned it to the owner.
seize.exampleZh: 警方没收了被偷的钱，并把它归还给了失主。

seldom.example: He seldom goes to the movies on weekdays.
seldom.exampleZh: 他工作日很少去看电影。

select.example: Please select one book from the list for your class.
select.exampleZh: 请从这份书单中为你的班级挑选一本书。

selection.example: The store has a good selection of fresh fruit and vegetables.
selection.exampleZh: 这家店有很好的新鲜水果和蔬菜可供挑选。

self.example: Talking to yourself sometimes helps you understand your true self.
self.exampleZh: 有时自言自语能帮助你了解真实的自我。

selfish.example: He is too selfish to share his toys with other children.
selfish.exampleZh: 他太自私了，不肯和其他孩子分享他的玩具。

sell.example: They sell fresh fruit and vegetables at the small shop every morning.
sell.exampleZh: 他们每天早上在那家小店里卖新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

semester.example: I will take four classes this semester and study hard every day.
semester.exampleZh: 这学期我要选四门课，并且每天努力学习。

semiconductor.example: This small factory makes semiconductors for phones and computers.
semiconductor.exampleZh: 这家小工厂为手机和电脑生产半导体。

seminar.example: Our teacher asked us to join a seminar about healthy eating.
seminar.exampleZh: 老师让我们参加一个关于健康饮食的研讨会。

senate.example: The senate voted on the new law today.
senate.exampleZh: 参议院今天对这项新法律进行了投票。

senator.example: The senator spoke to the crowd outside the old town hall.
senator.exampleZh: 这位参议员在旧市政厅外向人群发表讲话。

send.example: I will send the letter to my friend tomorrow morning.
send.exampleZh: 我明天早上会把这封信寄给我的朋友。

senior.example: She is a senior student at our school and helps new students.
senior.exampleZh: 她是我们学校的高年级学生，还会帮助新同学。

sense.example: She has a good sense of humor and often makes us laugh.
sense.exampleZh: 她有很好的幽默感，常常让我们发笑。

sensible.example: It is sensible to save some money for a rainy day.
sensible.exampleZh: 存点钱以备不时之需是明智的。

sensitive.example: My skin is very sensitive to strong sunlight in summer.
sensitive.exampleZh: 夏天我的皮肤对强烈的阳光非常敏感。

sentence.example: The judge will sentence the man tomorrow morning in court.
sentence.exampleZh: 法官明天上午将在法庭上对那名男子宣判。

separate.example: Please separate the white clothes from the colored ones before washing.
separate.exampleZh: 洗衣服前请把白衣服和有色衣服分开。

september.example: My sister will start her new job in September this year.
september.exampleZh: 我姐姐今年九月将开始她的新工作。

sequence.example: Please put these numbers in the correct sequence.
sequence.exampleZh: 请把这些数字按正确的顺序排列。

series.example: This series of books is easy for young students to read.
series.exampleZh: 这套丛书对年轻学生来说很容易读。

serious.example: This is a serious problem, so we must find a solution today.
serious.exampleZh: 这是一个严重的问题，所以我们必须今天找到解决办法。

servant.example: The rich family hired a servant to cook and clean the house.
servant.exampleZh: 这个富裕的家庭雇了一位仆人来做饭和打扫房子。

serve.example: She serves coffee to the guests every morning.
serve.exampleZh: 她每天早上给客人端上咖啡。

service.example: The hotel offers good room service and the staff can quickly service your car.
service.exampleZh: 这家酒店提供良好的客房服务，员工也能快速为你的车做保养。

session.example: The team had a short session this morning to discuss the new plan.
session.exampleZh: 今天上午团队开了一个简短的会议来讨论新计划。

set.example: Please set the cups on the table before the guests arrive.
set.exampleZh: 请在客人到来之前把杯子放到桌上。

settle.example: They decided to settle in a small town near the sea.
settle.exampleZh: 他们决定在靠近海边的一个小镇定居。

settlement.example: After a long talk, the two sides reached a peaceful settlement.
settlement.exampleZh: 经过长时间的交谈，双方达成了和平的解决。

seven.example: There are seven days in a week, and I work on five of them.
seven.exampleZh: 一周有七天，其中我工作五天。

severe.example: The city had a severe storm last night, so all the schools are closed today.
severe.exampleZh: 昨晚这座城市遭遇了一场严重的暴风雨，所以今天所有学校都停课了。

sew.example: My mother taught me how to sew a button onto a shirt.
sew.exampleZh: 我妈妈教我如何把纽扣缝到衬衫上。

sex.example: Please write your age and sex on the form before the interview.
sex.exampleZh: 请在面试前在表格上写下你的年龄和性别。

sexual.example: They talked about sexual health in the class today.
sexual.exampleZh: 他们今天在课堂上讨论了性健康。

shade.example: We sat in the shade of a big tree and drank tea.
shade.exampleZh: 我们坐在大树的阴凉处喝茶。

shadow.example: The tall tree cast a long shadow on the grass.
shadow.exampleZh: 那棵高树在草地上投下长长的影子。

shake.example: The cold wind made her hands shake as she walked home.
shake.exampleZh: 她走回家时，寒风让她的双手发抖。

shall.example: You shall finish your homework before you go out to play.
shall.exampleZh: 你必须先完成作业才能出去玩。

shallow.example: The water in this river is shallow, so children can play there.
shallow.exampleZh: 这条河的水很浅，孩子们可以在那里玩耍。

shame.example: It is a shame that he never said sorry to her.
shame.exampleZh: 他从未向她道歉，这真是件遗憾的事。

shape.example: The clay is soft, so you can shape it into any form.
shape.exampleZh: 黏土很软，所以你可以把它塑造成任何形状。

share.example: She likes to share her lunch with friends at school.
share.exampleZh: 她喜欢在学校和朋友们分享她的午餐。

sharp.example: Be careful with that sharp knife on the kitchen table.
sharp.exampleZh: 小心厨房桌上那把锋利的刀。

sharpen.example: I need to sharpen my pencil before I start writing the essay.
sharpen.exampleZh: 我需要削尖铅笔，然后再开始写文章。

shear.example: Farmers shear their sheep every spring before the weather turns hot.
shear.exampleZh: 农民每年春天在天气变热之前给羊剪毛。

shed.example: The old snake will shed its skin in the warm sun.
shed.exampleZh: 那条老蛇会在温暖的阳光下蜕皮。

sheep.example: The farmer keeps many sheep on his small farm near the river.
sheep.exampleZh: 农夫在河边的小农场里养了许多绵羊。

sheet.example: She put a clean sheet on the bed before the guests arrived.
sheet.exampleZh: 客人到来之前，她在床上铺了一条干净的被单。

shelf.example: She put the book on the top shelf in her room.
shelf.exampleZh: 她把书放在她房间最上层的架子上。

shell.example: The child picked up a white shell on the beach.
shell.exampleZh: 孩子在沙滩上捡起一个白色的贝壳。

shelter.example: The old tree gives shelter to many small birds on rainy days.
shelter.exampleZh: 下雨天，那棵老树为许多小鸟提供庇护。

shift.example: My father works the night shift at the factory near our home.
shift.exampleZh: 我爸爸在我们家附近的工厂上夜班。

shine.example: The sun begins to shine on the wet streets after the rain.
shine.exampleZh: 雨后，太阳开始照耀在湿漉漉的街道上。

ship.example: They will ship the new machines to our factory by boat next week.
ship.exampleZh: 他们下周会用船把新机器运到我们工厂。

shirt.example: He wears a white shirt to work every day.
shirt.exampleZh: 他每天穿一件白衬衫去上班。

shiver.example: The cold wind made her shiver all the way home last night.
shiver.exampleZh: 昨晚冷风让她一路回家都在发抖。

shock.example: The news of the accident gave everyone a big shock.
shock.exampleZh: 事故的消息让每个人都大为震惊。

shoe.example: My new shoes are too tight for a long walk.
shoe.exampleZh: 我的新鞋太紧了，不适合走长路。

shoot.example: The young trees shoot up quickly after the spring rain.
shoot.exampleZh: 春雨过后，小树很快发芽长高。

shop.example: I go to the shop near my house to buy milk every morning.
shop.exampleZh: 我每天早上都去我家附近的商店买牛奶。

shore.example: We walked along the shore and watched the small boats go by.
shore.exampleZh: 我们沿着岸边散步，看着小船驶过。

short.example: My little sister is too short to reach the top shelf.
short.exampleZh: 我妹妹个子太矮，够不到最上面的架子。

shortly.example: She will arrive shortly and then we can start lunch.
shortly.exampleZh: 她很快就会到，然后我们就可以开始吃午饭了。

shot.example: The photographer took a great shot of the sunset over the water.
shot.exampleZh: 摄影师拍下了一张很棒的水上日落照片。

should.example: You should call your mother tonight and tell her the good news.
should.exampleZh: 你今晚应该给你妈妈打个电话，告诉她这个好消息。

shoulder.example: He carried the heavy bag on his shoulder and walked home.
shoulder.exampleZh: 他把沉重的包扛在肩上，走回了家。

shout.example: The teacher told the children to stop shouting in the hall.
shout.exampleZh: 老师让孩子们不要在走廊里大喊大叫。

show.example: The museum will show her paintings next month.
show.exampleZh: 博物馆下个月将展出她的画作。

shower.example: After the game, he took a quick shower and went to bed.
shower.exampleZh: 比赛结束后，他快速冲了个澡就上床睡觉了。

shrug.example: She just shrugged when I asked her where the money went.
shrug.exampleZh: 我问她钱去哪儿了，她只是耸了耸肩。

shut.example: Please shut the door when you leave the room.
shut.exampleZh: 你离开房间时请把门关上。

shy.example: The shy boy stood behind his mother and said nothing.
shy.exampleZh: 那个害羞的男孩站在他妈妈身后，什么也没说。

sick.example: I felt sick after eating too much cold food last night.
sick.exampleZh: 昨晚吃了太多凉的食物后，我感到恶心。

side.example: She sat on the side of the bed and looked out the window.

sigh.example: She looked at the old photo and let out a deep sigh.
sigh.exampleZh: 她看着那张旧照片，深深地叹了口气。

sight.example: The old man lost his sight, but he still enjoys the beautiful sights of the city.
sight.exampleZh: 那位老人失去了视力，但他仍然喜欢这座城市的美景。

sign.example: Please sign your name at the bottom of this page.
sign.exampleZh: 请在这页的底部签上你的名字。

signal.example: She gave me a signal to start the meeting now.
signal.exampleZh: 她给了我一个信号，让我现在开始会议。

signature.example: She put her signature at the bottom of the letter.
signature.exampleZh: 她在信的底部签上了自己的名字。

significance.example: Few people understand the significance of this small change.
significance.exampleZh: 很少有人理解这个小变化的重要性。

significant.example: This is a significant change for our small team.
significant.exampleZh: 这对我们的小团队来说是一个重大的变化。

silence.example: The room was filled with a deep silence after the music stopped.
silence.exampleZh: 音乐停止后，房间里充满了深深的寂静。

silent.example: The old house was silent after everyone went to bed.
silent.exampleZh: 大家都上床睡觉后，那栋老房子一片寂静。

silk.example: She wore a beautiful dress made of Chinese silk.
silk.exampleZh: 她穿了一条用中国丝绸做的漂亮裙子。

silly.example: It was silly of me to forget my keys at home.
silly.exampleZh: 我把钥匙忘在家里了，真是傻。

silver.example: She wore a silver ring on her finger and a silver necklace.
silver.exampleZh: 她手指上戴着一枚银戒指，还戴着一条银项链。

similar.example: These two pictures look very similar to me.
similar.exampleZh: 这两张图片在我看来非常相似。

simple.example: This simple recipe is easy to follow for new cooks.
simple.exampleZh: 这个简单的食谱对新手厨师来说很容易照着做。

simplicity.example: The simplicity of her design makes the room feel calm and bright.
simplicity.exampleZh: 她设计的简洁让房间显得平静而明亮。

simplify.example: We can simplify the plan by cutting two steps.
simplify.exampleZh: 我们可以通过删掉两个步骤来简化这个计划。

simply.example: You can simply ask the teacher if you do not understand.
simply.exampleZh: 如果你不明白，直接问老师就可以了。

sin.example: In many religions, people believe that sin separates them from God.
sin.exampleZh: 在许多宗教中，人们认为罪恶使他们与上帝分离。

since.example: I have not seen him since last summer.
since.exampleZh: 自从去年夏天以来我就没见过他。

sincere.example: She gave me a sincere smile and thanked me for my help.
sincere.exampleZh: 她给了我一个真诚的微笑，并感谢我的帮助。

sing.example: The little girl likes to sing her favorite songs in the morning.
sing.exampleZh: 这个小女孩喜欢在早上唱她最喜欢的歌。

singer.example: The singer sang a beautiful song at the concert last night.
singer.exampleZh: 这位歌手昨晚在音乐会上唱了一首优美的歌。

single.example: He lives alone in a single room near the station.
single.exampleZh: 他独自住在车站附近的一间单人房里。

sink.example: The old boat began to sink slowly into the cold water.
sink.exampleZh: 那条旧船开始慢慢沉入冰冷的水中。

sir.example: Excuse me, sir, could you tell me where the station is?
sir.exampleZh: 打扰一下，先生，您能告诉我车站在哪里吗？

sister.example: My sister and I walk to school together every morning.
sister.exampleZh: 我妹妹和我每天早上一起走路去学校。

sit.example: Please sit down on this chair and wait for me.
sit.exampleZh: 请坐在这把椅子上等我。

site.example: They chose a good site for the new school near the river.
site.exampleZh: 他们在河边为新学校选了一个好地点。

situation.example: The situation in the small town is getting better every day.
situation.exampleZh: 这个小镇的情况每天都在变好。

six.example: My little sister is six years old and she starts school this year.
six.exampleZh: 我妹妹六岁了，她今年开始上学。

size.example: I want to know the size of this room before we buy furniture.
size.exampleZh: 在买家具之前，我想知道这个房间的大小。

skate.example: I like to skate on the ice in winter with my friends.
skate.exampleZh: 冬天我喜欢和朋友们在冰上滑冰。

sketch.example: She drew a quick sketch of the old tree before painting it.
sketch.exampleZh: 她在画那棵老树之前，先快速画了一张草图。

ski.example: My friends and I ski in the mountains every winter.
ski.exampleZh: 我和朋友们每年冬天都去山里滑雪。

skilful.example: She is a skilful cook who makes delicious meals for us.
skilful.exampleZh: 她是个娴熟的厨师，为我们做出美味的饭菜。

skill.example: Learning a new skill takes time and a lot of practice every day.
skill.exampleZh: 学习一项新技能需要时间，还需要每天大量练习。

skilled.example: She is a skilled worker who can fix almost any machine in the factory.
skilled.exampleZh: 她是一名熟练的工人，工厂里几乎任何机器她都能修好。

skin.example: The baby has soft skin on her small face and hands.
skin.exampleZh: 这个婴儿的小脸和小手上的皮肤很柔软。

skirt.example: She wore a long blue skirt to the party last night.
skirt.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条蓝色长裙去参加聚会。

skull.example: The doctor said the helmet protects the skull during a fall.
skull.exampleZh: 医生说，头盔在摔倒时能保护颅骨。

sky.example: The sky is clear and blue today, so we can see many stars tonight.
sky.exampleZh: 今天天空晴朗湛蓝，所以今晚我们能看见许多星星。

skyscraper.example: The new skyscraper is the tallest building in our city.
skyscraper.exampleZh: 这座新的摩天大楼是我们城市里最高的建筑。

slave.example: The slaves worked all day and never got any rest.
slave.exampleZh: 奴隶们整天干活，从来得不到休息。

sleep.example: I try to sleep for eight hours every night before work.
sleep.exampleZh: 我尽量每晚在工作前睡够八个小时。

sleeve.example: The sleeve of my jacket is too long for me.
sleeve.exampleZh: 我夹克的袖子对我来说太长了。

slender.example: The tall slender girl walked slowly across the quiet garden.
slender.exampleZh: 那个高挑苗条的女孩慢慢地走过安静的花园。

slice.example: She cut the cake into a slice for each child at the party.
slice.exampleZh: 她把蛋糕切成薄片，分给聚会上的每个孩子。

slide.example: The children like to slide down the slide in the park.
slide.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在公园里从滑梯上滑下来。

slight.example: There was a slight delay before the train left the station.
slight.exampleZh: 火车离站前有轻微的延误。

slim.example: She looks slim and healthy after a few months of simple exercise.
slim.exampleZh: 经过几个月的简单锻炼，她看起来苗条又健康。

slip.example: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor near the door.
slip.exampleZh: 小心别在门附近湿滑的地板上滑倒。

slogan.example: The company put a short slogan on every poster.
slogan.exampleZh: 公司在每张海报上写了一句简短的标语。

slope.example: We walked up the steep slope behind the house.
slope.exampleZh: 我们沿着屋后那道陡峭的斜坡往上走。

slow.example: The old bus is slow, so we must slow down near the school.
slow.exampleZh: 这辆旧公交车很慢，所以我们在学校附近必须放慢速度。

slum.example: Many poor families live in a slum near the river.
slum.exampleZh: 许多贫困家庭住在河边的一个贫民窟里。

small.example: This room is too small for two beds and a desk.
small.exampleZh: 这个房间太小了，放不下两张床和一张书桌。

smart.example: She is smart enough to solve this easy problem by herself.
smart.exampleZh: 她很聪明，能自己解决这个简单的问题。

smell.example: The flowers in the garden smell very sweet in the morning.
smell.exampleZh: 早晨花园里的花闻起来很香。

smile.example: She gave me a warm smile and said hello at the door.
smile.exampleZh: 她在门口给了我一个温暖的微笑并打了招呼。

smoke.example: The smoke from the fire made everyone cough and leave the room.
smoke.exampleZh: 火产生的烟让每个人都咳嗽并离开了房间。

smooth.example: The road is smooth and wide, so cars can go fast.
smooth.exampleZh: 这条路又平又宽，所以汽车可以开得很快。

snake.example: My little sister is afraid of a snake in the garden.
snake.exampleZh: 我妹妹害怕花园里的一条蛇。

snow.example: The children played in the snow all afternoon and made a big snowman.
snow.exampleZh: 孩子们整个下午都在雪地里玩，还堆了一个大雪人。

so.example: It is so cold today that we must stay home.
so.exampleZh: 今天太冷了，所以我们只能待在家里。

soap.example: I wash my hands with soap before I eat lunch.
soap.exampleZh: 我吃午饭前用肥皂洗手。

soccer.example: My brother plays soccer with his friends every Saturday afternoon.
soccer.exampleZh: 我哥哥每周六下午都和他的朋友们踢足球。

social.example: She has a busy social life and meets many friends every weekend.
social.exampleZh: 她的社交生活很忙碌，每个周末都会见很多朋友。

society.example: Every person in our society should help others when they can.
society.exampleZh: 我们社会中的每个人都应该在力所能及时帮助他人。

sock.example: I put on a clean pair of socks before I go to work.
sock.exampleZh: 我上班前穿上一双干净的短袜。

soda.example: I bought a cold can of soda at the store near my house.
soda.exampleZh: 我在家附近的商店买了一罐冰汽水。

sofa.example: The cat is sleeping on the sofa next to the window.
sofa.exampleZh: 猫正在窗边的沙发上睡觉。

soft.example: The soft pillow feels very comfortable under my head at night.
soft.exampleZh: 这个柔软的枕头夜里枕在头下非常舒服。

software.example: This software helps students learn English words quickly and easily.
software.exampleZh: 这个软件帮助学生们快速轻松地学习英语单词。

soil.example: The farmer plants vegetables in the rich soil behind his house.
soil.exampleZh: 农民在屋后肥沃的土壤里种蔬菜。

solar.example: Our new house uses solar energy to heat water every day.
solar.exampleZh: 我们的新房子每天用太阳能来加热水。

soldier.example: The soldier stood in the cold rain and waited for his friends.
soldier.exampleZh: 那名士兵站在冷雨中等待他的朋友们。

sole.example: She is the sole person who knows the truth about this case.
sole.exampleZh: 她是唯一知道这个案件真相的人。

solemn.example: The wedding was a solemn and quiet ceremony in the old church.
solemn.exampleZh: 这场婚礼在古老的教堂里举行，是一个庄严而安静的仪式。

solid.example: The table is made of solid wood and feels very strong.
solid.exampleZh: 这张桌子由实木制成，摸起来很结实。

solution.example: We need a simple solution to this problem before Friday.
solution.exampleZh: 我们需要在周五之前为这个问题找到一个简单的解决办法。

solve.example: We must work together to solve this problem before Friday.
solve.exampleZh: 我们必须在星期五之前一起解决这个问题。

some.example: I need to buy some bread and milk for breakfast.
some.exampleZh: 我需要为早餐买一些面包和牛奶。

somebody.example: Somebody left a phone on the table this morning.
somebody.exampleZh: 今天早上有人把手机落在桌子上了。

somehow.example: Somehow she found her lost keys on the way home.
somehow.exampleZh: 不知怎么地，她在回家路上找到了丢失的钥匙。

someone.example: Someone left a small bag on the table this morning.
someone.exampleZh: 今天早上有人把一个小包落在了桌子上。

something.example: I have something important to tell you after the class.
something.exampleZh: 下课后我有件重要的事要告诉你。

sometime.example: Please come to see me sometime next week if you are free.
sometime.exampleZh: 如果你有空，请下周找个时间来见我。

sometimes.example: I sometimes walk to school with my sister when the weather is nice.
sometimes.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我有时会和姐姐一起走路去学校。

somewhere.example: I think I left my keys somewhere in the kitchen.
somewhere.exampleZh: 我想我把钥匙落在厨房的某个地方了。

son.example: My son likes to play football with his friends after school.
son.exampleZh: 我儿子喜欢放学后和朋友们踢足球。

song.example: She sang a happy song on the way to school this morning.
song.exampleZh: 今天早上她在去学校的路上唱了一首欢快的歌。

soon.example: The bus will come soon, so please wait here with me.
soon.exampleZh: 公交车很快就来，请和我一起在这里等一下。

sophisticated.example: This software is too sophisticated for most new users to learn quickly.
sophisticated.exampleZh: 这个软件对大多数新用户来说太复杂，难以快速学会。

sorry.example: I am sorry that I forgot your birthday yesterday.
sorry.exampleZh: 很抱歉，我昨天忘记了你的生日。

sort.example: What sort of music do you like to listen to?
sort.exampleZh: 你喜欢听哪种类型的音乐？

soul.example: Music can touch your soul in a way words cannot.
soul.exampleZh: 音乐能以语言无法做到的方式触动你的灵魂。

sound.example: The sound of the rain helped me fall asleep last night.
sound.exampleZh: 昨晚的雨声帮助我入睡了。

soup.example: My mother makes hot soup for us on cold winter days.
soup.exampleZh: 在寒冷的冬日里，妈妈会给我们做热汤。

source.example: The river is a good source of clean water for the village.
source.exampleZh: 这条河是村里干净水源的良好来源。

south.example: My uncle lives in the south, where the weather stays warm all year.
south.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在南方，那里全年天气都很暖和。

southern.example: The southern part of the country is warm and sunny all year.
southern.exampleZh: 这个国家的南部地区全年温暖晴朗。

space.example: There is not enough space in this room for another table.
space.exampleZh: 这个房间里没有足够的空间再放一张桌子了。

spacecraft.example: The spacecraft flew past the moon and sent pictures back to Earth.
