spacecraft.exampleZh: 航天器飞过月球，并把照片传回了地球。

spade.example: I need a spade to dig a hole for the new tree.
spade.exampleZh: 我需要一把铲子来为这棵新树挖个坑。

span.example: The bridge spans the wide river and has stood there for many years.
span.exampleZh: 这座桥横跨宽阔的河流，已经在那里矗立了很多年。

spare.example: I have a spare key in case I lose this one.
spare.exampleZh: 我有一把备用钥匙，以防把这把弄丢。

spark.example: The bright spark from the fire flew up into the dark sky.
spark.exampleZh: 火里明亮的火花飞向了黑暗的天空。

speak.example: She can speak three languages well.

speaker.example: The speaker gave a short talk about healthy food.
speaker.exampleZh: 演讲者做了一个关于健康食物的简短演讲。

spear.example: The old warrior carried a long spear made of wood and stone.
spear.exampleZh: 这位年迈的战士拿着一把用木头和石头制成的长矛。

special.example: Today is a special day for my whole family.
special.exampleZh: 今天对我全家来说是一个特别的日子。

specialist.example: The doctor sent my father to a heart specialist last week.
specialist.exampleZh: 上周医生把我父亲转给了一位心脏专科医生。

specialize.example: She specializes in helping young children learn to read.
specialize.exampleZh: 她专门研究帮助幼儿学习阅读。

species.example: This species of bird lives only in the forests of South America.
species.exampleZh: 这种鸟仅生活在南美洲的森林中。

specific.example: Please give me a specific example so I can understand your idea.
specific.exampleZh: 请给我一个具体的例子，这样我才能理解你的想法。

specifically.example: This book is written specifically for students who want to learn English quickly.
specifically.exampleZh: 这本书是专门为想要快速学会英语的学生写的。

speech.example: His speech at the party was short but very funny.
speech.exampleZh: 他在聚会上的演讲很短，但非常有趣。

speed.example: The car moved at high speed down the empty road.
speed.exampleZh: 汽车以高速沿着空旷的道路行驶。

spell.example: Can you spell your last name for me, please?
spell.exampleZh: 你能为我拼一下你的姓氏吗？

spelling.example: Please check the spelling of your name on this form.
spelling.exampleZh: 请检查这张表格上你名字的拼写。

spend.example: I spend an hour reading English books every evening after dinner.
spend.exampleZh: 我每天晚上晚饭后花一个小时读英文书。

sphere.example: The earth is a sphere that moves around the sun.
sphere.exampleZh: 地球是一个围绕太阳运动的球体。

spider.example: A small spider made a web in the corner of the room.
spider.exampleZh: 一只小蜘蛛在房间的角落里结了一张网。

spin.example: The wheels spin fast on the wet road as the car speeds away.
spin.exampleZh: 汽车疾驰而去时，车轮在湿滑的路面上飞速旋转。

spirit.example: His spirit was high even after the long and difficult day.
spirit.exampleZh: 即使经历了漫长而艰难的一天，他的精神依然高昂。

spiritual.example: She finds spiritual peace in the quiet garden near her home.
spiritual.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的安静花园里找到了心灵的平静。

spit.example: The little boy spit out the bitter medicine and made a face.
spit.exampleZh: 小男孩把苦药吐了出来，做了个鬼脸。

spite.example: He said those words out of spite, not because they were true.
spite.exampleZh: 他说那些话是出于怨恨，而不是因为那是真的。

splash.example: The children splash water in the pool and laugh loudly.
splash.exampleZh: 孩子们在泳池里泼水，大声笑着。

split.example: The old tree split in two during the strong storm last night.
split.exampleZh: 昨晚那场强风暴中，那棵老树裂成了两半。

spoil.example: Too much rain can spoil the fruit before we pick it.
spoil.exampleZh: 雨水过多会在我们采摘之前就让水果烂掉。

spokesman.example: The company spokesman told reporters that the meeting would start at nine.
spokesman.exampleZh: 公司发言人告诉记者，会议将在九点开始。

sponge.example: A sponge can soak up a lot of water quickly.
sponge.exampleZh: 海绵能很快吸收大量的水。

sponsor.example: The company will sponsor the local football team this year.
sponsor.exampleZh: 这家公司今年将赞助当地的足球队。

spontaneous.example: Her spontaneous laugh made everyone in the room feel relaxed.
spontaneous.exampleZh: 她自然的笑声让房间里的每个人都感到放松。

spoon.example: Please use a spoon to stir the sugar into my coffee.
spoon.exampleZh: 请用勺子把糖搅进我的咖啡里。

sport.example: My favorite sport is swimming in the pool with friends.
sport.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的运动是和朋友一起在游泳池里游泳。

spot.example: I spotted a small spot on the white wall near the door.
spot.exampleZh: 我发现门附近的白墙上有一个小斑点。

spouse.example: My spouse and I usually cook dinner together at home.
spouse.exampleZh: 我和我的配偶通常在家一起做晚饭。

spray.example: The gardener sprayed water on the flowers and the waves made a fine spray.
spray.exampleZh: 园丁给花喷水，海浪溅起一片细小的浪花。

spread.example: Good news can spread quickly through a small town.
spread.exampleZh: 好消息能在一个小镇上迅速传播开来。

spring.example: In spring the water from the mountain spring jumps like a small spring.
spring.exampleZh: 春天里，山泉的水跳跃起来，就像一个小弹簧。

spy.example: The spy watched the old house from a dark car.
spy.exampleZh: 那名间谍从一辆深色汽车里监视那座老房子。

square.example: There is a large square in the middle of our city.
square.exampleZh: 我们城市中心有一个大广场。

squeeze.example: She used her hands to squeeze the lemon into a glass of water.
squeeze.exampleZh: 她用手把柠檬汁挤进一杯水里。

squirrel.example: A small brown squirrel ran up the tree in our garden.
squirrel.exampleZh: 一只棕色的小松鼠跑上了我们花园里的那棵树。

stable.example: The old horse sleeps in a warm stable every night.
stable.exampleZh: 那匹老马每晚都睡在温暖的马厩里。

stack.example: There is a stack of books on my desk.

staff.example: The staff at the hotel are very friendly and helpful.
staff.exampleZh: 这家酒店的员工非常友好和乐于助人。

stage.example: The new plan is still at an early stage and needs more work.
stage.exampleZh: 这个新计划仍处于早期阶段，还需要更多完善。

stain.example: The red wine left a dark stain on the white tablecloth.
stain.exampleZh: 红酒在白桌布上留下了一块深色污渍。

stair.example: She walked up the stairs to her bedroom on the second floor.
stair.exampleZh: 她走上楼梯，来到二楼的卧室。

stamp.example: She put a stamp on the envelope and dropped it in the mailbox.
stamp.exampleZh: 她在信封上贴了一张邮票，然后把它投进了邮筒。

stand.example: I cannot stand the loud noise from the street at night.
stand.exampleZh: 我受不了夜里街上嘈杂的噪音。

standard.example: This hotel's service is below the standard we expected.
standard.exampleZh: 这家酒店的服务低于我们预期的水准。

star.example: The star is very bright in the sky tonight.
star.exampleZh: 今晚这颗星星在天空中非常明亮。

stare.example: She stared at the strange picture on the wall for a long time.
stare.exampleZh: 她盯着墙上那幅奇怪的画看了很久。

start.example: Let's start the meeting now, and don't be startled by the new plan.
start.exampleZh: 我们现在开始开会吧，不要被新计划吓到。

starve.example: Many poor families starve because they have no food or money.
starve.exampleZh: 许多贫困家庭因为没有食物和钱而挨饿。

state.example: The doctor said my health state is good now.
state.exampleZh: 医生说我的健康状态现在很好。

statement.example: The police asked him to make a clear statement about the accident.
statement.exampleZh: 警方要求他就这起事故作出明确的陈述。

static.example: The image on the old television screen was static and did not move at all.
static.exampleZh: 旧电视屏幕上的图像是静止的，完全不动。

statue.example: There is a large stone statue of a horse in the park.
statue.exampleZh: 公园里有一座大型的石马雕像。

status.example: Her new job gave her a higher status in the company.
status.exampleZh: 她的新工作使她在公司里获得了更高的地位。

stay.example: I will stay at home this weekend and read a good book.
stay.exampleZh: 这个周末我会待在家里读一本好书。

steady.example: He held the ladder steady while his father climbed up.
steady.exampleZh: 他扶稳梯子，让父亲往上爬。

steam.example: Hot steam rose from the pot when I lifted the lid.
steam.exampleZh: 我掀开锅盖时，热蒸汽从锅里升了起来。

steamer.example: The old steamer carried fresh vegetables to the island every morning.
steamer.exampleZh: 那艘旧轮船每天早上把新鲜蔬菜运到岛上。

steel.example: This bridge is made of steel and is very strong.
steel.exampleZh: 这座桥是用钢制成的，非常坚固。

steep.example: The hill behind our house is too steep for young children to climb.
steep.exampleZh: 我们家后面的山坡太陡，小孩子爬不上去。

steer.example: My father taught me to steer the boat on the lake.
steer.exampleZh: 我父亲教我在湖上驾驶小船。

stem.example: The plant has a thick stem, and its flowers grow from it.
stem.exampleZh: 这棵植物有一根粗壮的茎，花从茎上长出来。

step.example: Please take one step forward and then stop.
step.exampleZh: 请向前走一步，然后停下。

stick.example: He used a stick to stir the paint, and the brush began to stick to his hand.
stick.exampleZh: 他用一根棍子搅拌油漆，刷子开始粘在他手上。

sticky.example: This sticky candy is hard to get off my fingers.
sticky.exampleZh: 这颗粘手的糖很难从我的手指上弄下来。

stiff.example: After sitting all day, my neck felt very stiff and sore.
stiff.exampleZh: 坐了一整天后，我的脖子感觉又僵又酸。

still.example: She is still waiting for the bus, but she stays still.
still.exampleZh: 她仍在等公交车，但她一动不动。

stimulate.example: Good teachers stimulate students to think and ask questions.
stimulate.exampleZh: 好老师激励学生思考和提问。

stir.example: She used a spoon to stir the hot soup in the pot.
stir.exampleZh: 她用勺子搅动锅里的热汤。

stock.example: The store keeps a large stock of winter coats for its customers.
stock.exampleZh: 这家商店为顾客储备了大量冬季外套。

stocking.example: She put a small gift in each stocking before the children woke up.
stocking.exampleZh: 孩子们醒来之前，她在每只长袜里放了一份小礼物。

stomach.example: My stomach hurts after I ate too much cake.
stomach.exampleZh: 我吃了太多蛋糕后肚子疼。

stone.example: The old wall is made of stone.
stone.exampleZh: 这堵旧墙是用石头砌成的。

stop.example: Please stop the car at the next station and wait for me.
stop.exampleZh: 请在下一个车站停车，然后等我。

storage.example: We keep our old books in storage under the stairs.
storage.exampleZh: 我们把旧书存放在楼梯下的储藏室里。

store.example: We store our winter clothes in boxes under the bed.
store.exampleZh: 我们把冬天的衣服存放在床下的箱子里。

storm.example: A big storm hit our town last night and broke many trees.
storm.exampleZh: 昨晚一场大暴风雨袭击了我们的小镇，吹断了许多树。

story.example: My grandmother tells me a funny story every night before I sleep.
story.exampleZh: 我奶奶每天晚上睡觉前都会给我讲一个有趣的故事。

stove.example: My mother put the soup on the stove and cooked it for ten minutes.
stove.exampleZh: 我妈妈把汤放在炉子上煮了十分钟。

straight.example: The road in front of our house is long and straight.
straight.exampleZh: 我们家门前的那条路又长又直。

strain.example: The heavy load put a great strain on the old bridge.
strain.exampleZh: 沉重的负载给这座旧桥带来了很大的压力。

strange.example: It is strange that nobody told me about the meeting yesterday.
strange.exampleZh: 奇怪的是，昨天没有人告诉我这个会议。

stranger.example: My mother always told me not to talk to a stranger.
stranger.exampleZh: 我妈妈总是告诉我不要和陌生人说话。

strap.example: He used a strap to tie the box onto his bike.
strap.exampleZh: 他用一条带子把箱子捆在自行车上。

strategic.example: The city is in a strategic place near the river and the main road.
strategic.exampleZh: 这座城市位于河流和主干道附近的战略要地。

strategy.example: Our team needs a new strategy to win more games this year.
strategy.exampleZh: 我们队需要一套新策略，才能在今年赢得更多比赛。

straw.example: The farmer put dry straw on the floor of the barn.
straw.exampleZh: 农民把干稻草铺在谷仓的地上。

stream.example: A small stream flows behind our house and never dries up.
stream.exampleZh: 一条小溪从我们房子后面流过，从未干涸。

street.example: There are many small shops on both sides of the street.
street.exampleZh: 街道两边有很多小商店。

strength.example: Her strength helps her carry the heavy boxes up the stairs.
strength.exampleZh: 她的力气帮她把这些重箱子搬上楼梯。

strengthen.example: We need to strengthen our team before the big game next week.
strengthen.exampleZh: 我们需要在下周的重要比赛前加强我们的团队。

stress.example: Too much stress at work can make you feel very tired.
stress.exampleZh: 工作压力太大会让你感到非常疲惫。

stretch.example: I stretch my arms every morning before I go to work.
stretch.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会伸展一下手臂。

strict.example: Our teacher is very strict about homework and never accepts late work.
strict.exampleZh: 我们老师对作业要求非常严格，从不接受迟交的作业。

strike.example: The workers decided to strike for better pay and safer working conditions.
strike.exampleZh: 工人们决定罢工，要求更好的薪酬和更安全的工作条件。

striking.example: The old house has a striking red door that everyone notices.
striking.exampleZh: 那座老房子有一扇醒目的红门，每个人都会注意到。

string.example: I tied the box with a piece of string and carried it home.
string.exampleZh: 我用一根细绳把盒子绑好，然后把它带回家。

strip.example: He used a knife to strip the old paint off the wooden door.
strip.exampleZh: 他用刀把木门上的旧油漆刮掉。

stripe.example: The zebra has black and white stripes on its body.
stripe.exampleZh: 斑马身上有黑白相间的条纹。

stroke.example: The doctor said the stroke left his left arm weak.
stroke.exampleZh: 医生说这次中风使他的左臂变得无力。

strong.example: He is strong enough to lift that heavy box by himself.
strong.exampleZh: 他足够强壮，能独自搬起那个沉重的箱子。

structure.example: The structure of the essay is clear and easy to follow.
structure.exampleZh: 这篇文章的结构清晰，很容易理解。

struggle.example: She had to struggle hard to finish the work on time.
struggle.exampleZh: 她不得不努力挣扎着按时完成工作。

student.example: Every student in my class works hard and asks good questions.
student.exampleZh: 我班上的每个学生都很努力，而且会提出好问题。

studio.example: She works in a small studio near her home.
studio.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一间小工作室里工作。

study.example: I study English for an hour every night before bed.
study.exampleZh: 我每天晚上睡觉前学一小时英语。

stuff.example: Please put your stuff in the bag and stuff the pillow.
stuff.exampleZh: 请把你的东西放进包里，然后把枕头塞好。

stupid.example: It was stupid of me to forget my keys again.

style.example: Her style is simple and clean, and many people like it.
style.exampleZh: 她的风格简洁清爽，很多人喜欢。

subject.example: Math is my favorite subject and I study it every day.
subject.exampleZh: 数学是我最喜欢的学科，我每天都学它。

submerge.example: The heavy rain submerged the small road under muddy water.
submerge.exampleZh: 大雨把这条小路浸没在泥水中。

submit.example: Please submit your homework before Friday.
submit.exampleZh: 请在周五之前提交你的作业。

subsequent.example: The first meeting went well, and subsequent talks were even better.
subsequent.exampleZh: 第一次会议进展顺利，随后的会谈更加顺利。

substance.example: Water is a simple substance that every living thing needs.
substance.exampleZh: 水是一种简单的物质，每个生物都需要它。

substantial.example: The company spent a substantial amount of money on the new project.
substantial.exampleZh: 公司在这个新项目上投入了大量资金。

substitute.example: You can use honey as a substitute for sugar in this recipe.
substitute.exampleZh: 在这个食谱里，你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

subtle.example: There is a subtle difference between these two shades of blue.
subtle.exampleZh: 这两种蓝色之间有细微的差别。

subtract.example: If you subtract three from ten, you get seven.

suburb.example: They live in a quiet suburb and take the train to work every day.
suburb.exampleZh: 他们住在一个安静的郊区，每天坐火车去上班。

subway.example: I take the subway to work every morning at seven.
subway.exampleZh: 我每天早上七点乘地铁上班。

succeed.example: If you work hard every day, you will succeed in the end.
succeed.exampleZh: 如果你每天努力，最终就会成功。

success.example: Her hard work and patience finally led to great success in business.
success.exampleZh: 她的努力和耐心最终使她在事业上取得了巨大成功。

successful.example: She is a successful doctor and helps many people every day.
successful.exampleZh: 她是一位成功的医生，每天帮助很多人。

such.example: I have never seen such a beautiful garden in my life.
such.exampleZh: 我这辈子从未见过这么漂亮的花园。

suck.example: The baby likes to suck milk from a bottle.
suck.exampleZh: 这个婴儿喜欢从奶瓶里吸奶。

sudden.example: The sudden noise made the baby cry in the middle of the night.
sudden.exampleZh: 突然的响声让婴儿在半夜哭了起来。

suffer.example: Many people suffer from headaches when they work too long.
suffer.exampleZh: 很多人工作太久就会头痛。

sufficient.example: We have sufficient food and water for the whole trip.
sufficient.exampleZh: 我们有足够的食物和水供整个旅程使用。

sugar.example: Too much sugar in your drinks is bad for your teeth.
sugar.exampleZh: 饮料里糖分过多对牙齿有害。

suggest.example: The dark clouds suggest that it will rain soon.
suggest.exampleZh: 乌云表明很快就要下雨了。

suggestion.example: Her suggestion about the meeting time was very helpful to everyone.
suggestion.exampleZh: 她关于会议时间的建议对每个人都很有帮助。

suit.example: This blue suit fits you well, so wear it to the meeting.
suit.exampleZh: 这套蓝色西装很适合你，穿它去开会吧。

suitable.example: This movie is not suitable for young children because it is too scary.
suitable.exampleZh: 这部电影不适合小孩子看，因为它太吓人了。

suitcase.example: My suitcase is too heavy for me to carry up the stairs.
suitcase.exampleZh: 我的手提箱太重了，我搬不上楼。

sum.example: The sum of these numbers is easy to find.
sum.exampleZh: 这些数字的总和很容易求出来。

summarize.example: Please summarize the main ideas of this short article.
summarize.exampleZh: 请概括这篇短文章的主要观点。

summary.example: Please write a short summary of the report for me.
summary.exampleZh: 请帮我为这份报告写一份简短的摘要。

summer.example: We swim in the lake every summer with our friends.
summer.exampleZh: 每年夏天我们都和朋友在湖里游泳。

summit.example: Leaders from many countries met at the summit to discuss climate change.
summit.exampleZh: 多国领导人齐聚这次最高级会议，讨论气候变化问题。

sun.example: The sun rises in the east every morning.
sun.exampleZh: 太阳每天早上从东方升起。

sunlight.example: The plant needs plenty of sunlight to grow tall and strong.
sunlight.exampleZh: 这株植物需要充足的阳光才能长得又高又壮。

sunny.example: It is a sunny day, so the children are playing outside.
sunny.exampleZh: 今天阳光充足，孩子们正在外面玩。

sunrise.example: We got up early to watch the sunrise over the sea.
sunrise.exampleZh: 我们早早起床，看海上的日出。

sunset.example: We sat by the lake and watched the sunset after a long day.
sunset.exampleZh: 漫长的一天过后，我们坐在湖边看日落。

sunshine.example: The sunshine came through the window and made the whole room warm.
sunshine.exampleZh: 阳光透过窗户照进来，让整个房间都暖和起来。

super.example: She made a super cake for my birthday party last night.
super.exampleZh: 她昨晚为我的生日派对做了一个极好的蛋糕。

superior.example: Our new teacher is superior to the old one in many ways.
superior.exampleZh: 我们的新老师在很多方面都比旧老师更优秀。

supermarket.example: I go to the supermarket every Saturday to buy food for the week.
supermarket.exampleZh: 我每周六都去超市买一周的食物。

supervise.example: My teacher will supervise the students during the science test today.
supervise.exampleZh: 今天科学考试时，我的老师会监督学生。

supper.example: We usually have supper together at seven in the evening.
supper.exampleZh: 我们通常晚上七点一起吃晚饭。

supplement.example: The doctor told me to take a vitamin supplement every morning with breakfast.
supplement.exampleZh: 医生让我每天早上吃早餐时服用一种维生素补充剂。

supply.example: The company can supply fresh water to the whole village every day.
supply.exampleZh: 这家公司每天能为整个村庄供应干净的水。

support.example: My family always supports me when I try something new.
support.exampleZh: 当我尝试新事物时，我的家人总是支持我。

suppose.example: I suppose he is right, but I am not sure.
suppose.exampleZh: 我猜想他是对的，但我不确定。

supreme.example: The court has supreme power over all other courts in the country.
supreme.exampleZh: 法院拥有凌驾于全国所有其他法院之上的最高权力。

sure.example: I am sure he will come to the party tonight with us.
sure.exampleZh: 我确信他今晚会和我们一起去参加聚会。

surface.example: The surface of the lake was calm and smooth in the early morning.

surge.example: Prices surged after the storm, and crowds surged toward the station.
surge.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后价格激增，人群涌向车站。

surgeon.example: The surgeon washed his hands carefully before the operation began.
surgeon.exampleZh: 手术开始前，外科医生仔细地洗了手。

surgery.example: The doctor said I need surgery on my knee next week.
surgery.exampleZh: 医生说我下周需要做膝盖手术。

surprise.example: The party was a big surprise for my mother.
surprise.exampleZh: 这个派对对我妈妈来说是个大惊喜。

surprising.example: It is surprising that he finished all the work in one day.
surprising.exampleZh: 他一天之内完成了所有工作，这令人惊讶。

surrender.example: The soldiers had to surrender after they ran out of food.
surrender.exampleZh: 士兵们在食物耗尽后不得不投降。

surround.example: Tall trees surround the small lake near our house.
surround.exampleZh: 高大的树木环绕着我们家附近的那个小湖。

surroundings.example: The hotel is clean, and its surroundings are very quiet at night.
surroundings.exampleZh: 这家酒店很干净，它周围的环境在夜里非常安静。

survey.example: We did a survey to find out what students like to eat.
survey.exampleZh: 我们做了一项调查，了解学生喜欢吃什么。

survive.example: Only two people survived the terrible accident on the cold mountain road.
survive.exampleZh: 只有两个人在这场寒冷的山路上发生的可怕事故中幸存下来。

suspect.example: The police suspect that the young man took the money from the shop.
suspect.exampleZh: 警方怀疑那个年轻人从商店里拿走了钱。

suspend.example: The school will suspend classes for two days because of the storm.
suspend.exampleZh: 因为这场暴风雨，学校将停课两天。

suspicion.example: I have a suspicion that he took the money without asking.
suspicion.exampleZh: 我怀疑他没问一声就拿走了钱。

sustain.example: Regular exercise helps you sustain good health as you get older.
sustain.exampleZh: 经常锻炼有助于你在年纪渐长时保持良好的健康。

swallow.example: She had to swallow her anger and smile at the rude customer.
swallow.exampleZh: 她只好忍下怒火，对那位粗鲁的顾客微笑。

swamp.example: Heavy rain turned the field into a swamp and swamped our car.
swamp.exampleZh: 大雨把田野变成了沼泽，也淹没了我们的车。

swap.example: I will swap my old bike for a new one today.
swap.exampleZh: 我今天要用我的旧自行车换一辆新的。

swear.example: I swear I will never tell anyone your secret.
swear.exampleZh: 我发誓我永远不会把你的秘密告诉任何人。

sweat.example: He ran fast and sweat ran down his face after the long race.
sweat.exampleZh: 他跑得很快，长跑之后汗水顺着他的脸流下来。

sweater.example: I wear a warm sweater when it is cold outside.
sweater.exampleZh: 外面冷的时候我会穿一件暖和的毛衣。

sweep.example: She sweeps the floor every morning before she goes to work.
sweep.exampleZh: 她每天早上上班前都会扫地。

sweet.example: This apple is very sweet, and my little sister loves it.
sweet.exampleZh: 这个苹果很甜，我妹妹很喜欢它。

swell.example: My ankle began to swell after I fell off my bike.
swell.exampleZh: 我从自行车上摔下来后，脚踝开始肿了起来。

swim.example: I like to swim in the sea with my friends on hot days.
swim.exampleZh: 天气炎热时，我喜欢和朋友们一起在海里游泳。

swing.example: The children like to swing on the old rope in the park.
swing.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在公园里那根旧绳子上荡秋千。

switch.example: Please switch off the light before you leave the room.
switch.exampleZh: 离开房间前请把灯关掉。

sword.example: The brave knight picked up his sword and rode to the castle.
sword.exampleZh: 勇敢的骑士拿起他的剑，骑马前往城堡。

symbol.example: For many people, a white dove is a symbol of peace.
symbol.exampleZh: 对很多人来说，白鸽是和平的象征。

sympathize.example: I sympathize with you, but I cannot change the rules today.
sympathize.exampleZh: 我同情你，但我今天无法改变规则。

sympathy.example: She felt great sympathy for the poor family and gave them some money.
sympathy.exampleZh: 她对那个贫困的家庭深感同情，并给了他们一些钱。

symphony.example: The whole family went to hear a famous symphony at the city concert hall.
symphony.exampleZh: 全家人都去市音乐厅听了一场著名的交响乐。

symptom.example: A high fever is a common symptom of this illness.
symptom.exampleZh: 高烧是这种疾病的一种常见症状。

system.example: The school has a new computer system for all its teachers.
system.exampleZh: 学校为所有教师配备了一套新的计算机系统。

systematic.example: She takes a systematic approach to solving problems at work.
systematic.exampleZh: 她在工作中采用有条理的方法来解决问题。

tab.example: Click the blue tab at the top of the screen to open the settings page.
tab.exampleZh: 点击屏幕顶部的蓝色标签页即可打开设置页面。

table.example: We put the books on the table and sat down.
table.exampleZh: 我们把书放在桌子上，然后坐了下来。

tablet.example: The doctor told me to take one tablet with water after breakfast.
tablet.exampleZh: 医生让我早饭后用水送服一片药。

taboo.example: In many cultures, it is a taboo to talk about death.
taboo.exampleZh: 在许多文化中，谈论死亡是一种禁忌。

tack.example: He used a tack to fix the map to the wall.
tack.exampleZh: 他用一枚平头钉把地图钉在墙上。

tackle.example: The team worked hard to tackle the problem before the deadline.
tackle.exampleZh: 团队努力工作，在截止日期前处理这个问题。

tag.example: Please write your name on the tag before you leave.
tag.exampleZh: 离开前请把你的名字写在标签上。

tail.example: The dog wagged its tail happily when I came home.
tail.exampleZh: 我回家时，那条狗高兴地摇着尾巴。

tailor.example: The tailor made a beautiful suit for my father last week.
tailor.exampleZh: 上周裁缝为我父亲做了一套漂亮的西装。

take.example: Please take this book to your teacher and bring back my pen.
take.exampleZh: 请把这本书带给你的老师，并把我的笔带回来。

tale.example: My grandmother told me a tale about a brave young girl.
tale.exampleZh: 我奶奶给我讲了一个关于勇敢小女孩的故事。

talent.example: She has a real talent for drawing animals and plants.
talent.exampleZh: 她在画动植物方面很有天赋。

talk.example: We need to talk about the plan before Friday.
talk.exampleZh: 我们需要在周五之前谈谈这个计划。

tall.example: My brother is very tall and he plays basketball well.
tall.exampleZh: 我哥哥个子很高，他篮球打得很好。

tame.example: The farmer has a tame horse that follows him everywhere.
tame.exampleZh: 农夫有一匹温顺的马，它到处跟着他。

tank.example: He put the old fish in a large water tank.
tank.exampleZh: 他把那条旧鱼放进了一个大水箱里。

tap.example: She gave the door a gentle tap and waited for an answer.
tap.exampleZh: 她轻轻敲了敲门，等着有人回应。

tape.example: I used tape to fix the box and then taped the photo inside.
tape.exampleZh: 我用胶带修好了盒子，然后把照片粘在了里面。

target.example: Our main target is to finish the work before Friday.
target.exampleZh: 我们的主要目标是在周五前完成这项工作。

task.example: My first task today is to answer all my emails.
task.exampleZh: 我今天的第一项任务是回复所有邮件。

taste.example: I taste the soup before adding salt to check the flavor.
taste.exampleZh: 我在加盐之前先尝一下汤，看看味道如何。

tax.example: The government will tax big companies more to pay for new schools.
tax.exampleZh: 政府将对大公司征收更多税，用于支付新建学校的费用。

taxi.example: We took a taxi from the airport to our hotel last night.
taxi.exampleZh: 昨晚我们从机场乘出租车到酒店。

tea.example: My mother drinks a cup of hot tea every morning before work.
tea.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上上班前都会喝一杯热茶。

teach.example: My father likes to teach me how to cook simple meals at home.
teach.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢教我在家做简单的饭菜。

team.example: Our team plays basketball together every Friday after school.
team.exampleZh: 我们队每周五放学后一起打篮球。

tear.example: Tears ran down her face as she tore the old letter in half.
tear.exampleZh: 她一边把旧信撕成两半，眼泪一边顺着脸颊流下来。

technical.example: The job needs good technical skills and a lot of practice.
technical.exampleZh: 这份工作需要良好的技术能力和大量的练习。

technician.example: The technician quickly fixed the broken machine in our office.
technician.exampleZh: 技术员很快修好了我们办公室那台坏掉的机器。

technique.example: She is learning a new technique to improve her painting skills.
technique.exampleZh: 她正在学习一种新技巧来提高她的绘画技能。

technology.example: Modern technology makes our daily life easier and faster than before.
technology.exampleZh: 现代技术让我们的日常生活比以前更轻松、更快捷。

tedious.example: The long meeting was tedious, so I almost fell asleep.
tedious.exampleZh: 那个漫长的会议冗长乏味，我差点睡着了。

teen.example: My teen brother plays basketball with his friends every day.
teen.exampleZh: 我十几岁的弟弟每天和朋友们打篮球。

teenager.example: As a teenager, she loved reading books in her room after school.
teenager.exampleZh: 十几岁时，她喜欢放学后在自己房间里看书。

telegram.example: My grandfather sent a telegram to tell us he was coming home.
telegram.exampleZh: 我祖父发了一封电报，告诉我们他要回家了。

telephone.example: I called her on the telephone to say hello.

telescope.example: We used a telescope to look at the moon last night.
telescope.exampleZh: 昨晚我们用望远镜看月亮。

television.example: We watch the news on television after dinner every night.
television.exampleZh: 我们每天晚饭后看电视新闻。

tell.example: Please tell me the way to the train station.
tell.exampleZh: 请告诉我去火车站的路。

temper.example: He lost his temper when the train was late again.
temper.exampleZh: 火车又晚点时，他发火了。

temperature.example: The nurse took my temperature and said it was a little high.
temperature.exampleZh: 护士量了我的体温，说有点高。

temple.example: The old temple stands on the hill above our small village.
temple.exampleZh: 那座古老的庙宇坐落在我们小村庄上方的山丘上。

temporary.example: This is only a temporary job for the summer.
temporary.exampleZh: 这只是一份暑假期间的临时工作。

tempt.example: The smell of fresh bread tempted me to stop at the bakery.
tempt.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味吸引我在面包店停了下来。

temptation.example: I could not resist the temptation to eat one more piece of cake.
temptation.exampleZh: 我忍不住又吃了一块蛋糕的诱惑。

ten.example: I have ten fingers on my two hands.
ten.exampleZh: 我的两只手上有十根手指。

tenant.example: The tenant pays the rent on the first day of each month.
tenant.exampleZh: 房客在每月第一天支付房租。

tend.example: Parents tend to worry too much about their children's small problems.
tend.exampleZh: 父母往往会过分担心孩子的小问题。

tendency.example: He has a tendency to talk too much when he is nervous.
tendency.exampleZh: 他紧张时往往会说得太多。

tender.example: The meat is very tender and easy for the children to eat.
tender.exampleZh: 这块肉很嫩，孩子们很容易吃。

tennis.example: My brother and I play tennis in the park every Sunday morning.
tennis.exampleZh: 我哥哥和我每周日早上都在公园打网球。

tense.example: I feel tense before every exam, and my shoulders get very tight.
tense.exampleZh: 每次考试前我都感到紧张，肩膀也绷得很紧。

tension.example: You could feel the tension in the room before the exam started.
tension.exampleZh: 考试开始前，你能感觉到房间里的紧张气氛。

tent.example: We put up a tent near the river and slept there last night.
tent.exampleZh: 我们在河边搭了一顶帐篷，昨晚就睡在那里。

term.example: We use this term for three months and then take a short break.
term.exampleZh: 我们用这个学期三个月，然后休息一小段时间。

terminal.example: The bus stopped at the terminal near our school at seven.
terminal.exampleZh: 公交车七点停在我们学校附近的终点站。

terrible.example: The weather was terrible, so we stayed at home all day.
terrible.exampleZh: 天气糟透了，所以我们一整天都待在家里。

territory.example: The birds defend their territory against other birds.
territory.exampleZh: 这些鸟会保卫自己的领土，抵御其他鸟类。

terror.example: The loud scream filled the dark house with terror.
terror.exampleZh: 那声尖叫让黑暗的房子充满了恐怖。

test.example: We have a math test tomorrow and I need to study.
test.exampleZh: 我们明天有一场数学考试，我需要复习。

text.example: Please read the text on page ten and answer my questions.
text.exampleZh: 请阅读第十页的课文并回答我的问题。

textbook.example: I left my math textbook at home this morning.
textbook.exampleZh: 今天早上我把数学课本忘在家里了。

textile.example: The factory makes textiles for markets in many countries.
textile.exampleZh: 这家工厂为许多国家的市场生产纺织品。

than.example: My brother is taller than me, but he is only two years older.
than.exampleZh: 我哥哥比我高，但他只比我大两岁。

thank.example: I thanked her for helping me with my homework yesterday.
thank.exampleZh: 昨天我感谢她帮我做作业。

that.example: I think that book on the shelf is mine.
that.exampleZh: 我想书架上的那本书是我的。

the.example: The book on the table is mine.

theater.example: We watched a funny play at the theater last night.
theater.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在剧院看了一出有趣的戏。

theft.example: The police arrested the man for the theft of a bicycle.
theft.exampleZh: 警方逮捕了那名偷窃自行车的男子。

their.example: Their new house is near the school and has a big garden.
their.exampleZh: 他们的新房子在学校附近，还有一个大花园。

theirs.example: This bag is ours, and that big red one is theirs.
theirs.exampleZh: 这个包是我们的，那个红色的大包是他们的。

them.example: I saw them at the park yesterday and we played together.
them.exampleZh: 我昨天在公园看见他们，我们一起玩了。

theme.example: The main theme of this book is friendship and trust.
theme.exampleZh: 这本书的主题是友谊和信任。

themselves.example: The children made the cake themselves and cleaned the kitchen afterwards.
themselves.exampleZh: 孩子们自己做了蛋糕，之后还打扫了厨房。

then.example: We ate dinner and then watched a movie together at home.
then.exampleZh: 我们吃了晚饭，然后一起在家看了一部电影。

theory.example: This theory helps us understand how children learn languages.
theory.exampleZh: 这个理论帮助我们理解儿童是如何学习语言的。

therapy.example: She goes to therapy every week to talk about her feelings.
therapy.exampleZh: 她每周都去做治疗，谈谈自己的感受。

there.example: There is a small park near my house.
there.exampleZh: 我家附近有一个小公园。

thereby.example: He finished his work early, thereby he had time to help us.
thereby.exampleZh: 他提前完成了工作，因此有时间来帮助我们。

therefore.example: It was raining hard, and therefore we stayed at home all day.
therefore.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此我们整天都待在家里。

thermometer.example: The nurse used a thermometer to check his temperature this morning.
thermometer.exampleZh: 护士今天早上用温度计给他量了体温。

these.example: These books on the desk are mine, and you can borrow them today.
these.exampleZh: 桌上的这些书是我的，你今天可以借走。

they.example: They live in a small house near the river.
they.exampleZh: 他们住在河边的一座小房子里。

thick.example: The ice on the lake is very thick this winter.
thick.exampleZh: 今年冬天湖面上的冰非常厚。

thief.example: The thief took my bag while I was waiting for the bus.
thief.exampleZh: 我在等公交车的时候，小偷偷走了我的包。

thin.example: The ice on the lake is too thin to walk on.
thin.exampleZh: 湖上的冰太薄了，不能在上面走。

thing.example: Please put your things in the bag before we leave.
thing.exampleZh: 我们离开前，请把你的东西放进包里。

think.example: I think this book is very good for young readers.
think.exampleZh: 我认为这本书对年轻读者很有好处。

thinking.example: Her clear thinking helped the whole team solve the problem quickly.
thinking.exampleZh: 她清晰的思考帮助整个团队迅速解决了问题。

third.example: She finished third in the race and won a small prize.
third.exampleZh: 她在比赛中获得第三名，赢得了一个小奖品。

thirst.example: After the long run, I felt a strong thirst for water.
thirst.exampleZh: 长跑之后，我感到非常口渴，很想喝水。

thirsty.example: After the long run, I felt very thirsty and drank two glasses of water.
thirsty.exampleZh: 长跑之后我感到非常口渴，喝了两杯水。

thirteen.example: My sister is thirteen years old and she loves to read books.
thirteen.exampleZh: 我妹妹十三岁，她喜欢读书。

thirty.example: My sister is thirty years old and works in a small bookshop.
thirty.exampleZh: 我姐姐三十岁，在一家小书店工作。

this.example: This is my new book, and I like it very much.
this.exampleZh: 这是我的新书，我非常喜欢它。

thorn.example: The rose has a sharp thorn that can hurt your hand.
thorn.exampleZh: 这朵玫瑰有一根尖锐的刺，会扎伤你的手。

thorough.example: The doctor gave him a thorough check before the long trip.
thorough.exampleZh: 医生在长途旅行前给他做了一次全面的检查。

those.example: Those books on the desk are mine, but these are yours.
those.exampleZh: 桌上的那些书是我的，而这些是你的。

though.example: Though it was raining hard, we still walked to the park together.
though.exampleZh: 虽然雨下得很大，我们还是—起走到了公园。

thought.example: That is an interesting thought, and I want to hear more.
thought.exampleZh: 那是一个有趣的想法，我想听更多。

thoughtful.example: She is a thoughtful person who always remembers her friends' birthdays.
thoughtful.exampleZh: 她是个体贴的人，总是记得朋友们的生日。

thousand.example: There are more than a thousand students in our school this year.
thousand.exampleZh: 今年我们学校有一千多名学生。

thread.example: She used a thin thread to sew the button on my coat.
thread.exampleZh: 她用一根细线把我外套上的纽扣缝上了。

threat.example: The dark clouds are a threat to our picnic this afternoon.
threat.exampleZh: 乌云对今天下午的野餐是个威胁。

threaten.example: Dark clouds threaten rain, so we should go home now.
threaten.exampleZh: 乌云预示着要下雨，所以我们现在应该回家。

three.example: I have three good friends at school.
three.exampleZh: 我在学校有三个好朋友。

thrive.example: These small businesses thrive when the local economy is strong.
thrive.exampleZh: 当本地经济强劲时，这些小企业就会兴旺发展。

throat.example: I have a bad sore throat, so I cannot sing today.
throat.exampleZh: 我喉咙很痛，所以今天不能唱歌。

throne.example: The old king sat on his throne and ruled the land for many years.
throne.exampleZh: 年迈的国王坐在宝座上统治这片土地多年。

through.example: We walked through the park and then went home.
through.exampleZh: 我们穿过公园，然后回家了。

throughout.example: The museum is famous throughout the world for its ancient art.
throughout.exampleZh: 这家博物馆因其古代艺术品而闻名于全世界。

throw.example: Please throw the ball to me, not at the window.
throw.exampleZh: 请把球扔给我，不要朝窗户扔。

thrust.example: He thrust the key into the lock and opened the door quickly.
thrust.exampleZh: 他把钥匙猛地插进锁里，很快打开了门。

thumb.example: He hurt his thumb while opening the heavy wooden door.
thumb.exampleZh: 他在打开那扇沉重的木门时伤到了拇指。

thunder.example: The loud thunder woke the children up in the middle of the night.
thunder.exampleZh: 响亮的雷声在半夜把孩子们吵醒了。

thus.example: The road was closed, and thus we had to take a longer way.
thus.exampleZh: 路被封了，因此我们不得不绕远路。

tick.example: I heard the tick of the clock and put a tick beside his name.
tick.exampleZh: 我听到时钟的滴答声，并在他的名字旁边打了个勾。

ticket.example: I bought two tickets for the concert on Friday night.
ticket.exampleZh: 我买了两张周五晚上音乐会的票。

tide.example: The tide comes in and goes out twice every day.

tidy.example: Please tidy your room before your friends come over this afternoon.
tidy.exampleZh: 请在今天下午朋友们来之前把你的房间收拾整洁。

tie.example: He wore a blue tie and tied his shoes before work.
tie.exampleZh: 他上班前系了一条蓝色领带，还系好了鞋带。

tiger.example: The tiger is a large wild cat that lives in the forest.
tiger.exampleZh: 老虎是一种生活在森林里的大型野生猫科动物。

tight.example: This shirt is too tight for me to wear all day.
tight.exampleZh: 这件衬衫太紧了，我没法穿一整天。

till.example: We waited till the rain stopped and then walked home together.
till.exampleZh: 我们一直等到雨停，然后一起走回家。

timber.example: The house was built with strong timber from the local forest.
timber.exampleZh: 这座房子是用当地森林里结实的木材建造的。

time.example: It is time to go home and have dinner with my family.
time.exampleZh: 该回家了，和家人一起吃晚饭。

tin.example: The tin of beans is on the top shelf in the kitchen.
tin.exampleZh: 那罐豆子放在厨房最上层的架子上。

tiny.example: A tiny bird sat on the old wooden fence and sang.
tiny.exampleZh: 一只极小的鸟落在旧木栅栏上唱歌。

tip.example: She left a tip on the table and thanked the waiter.
tip.exampleZh: 她在桌上留了小费，并向服务員道谢。

tire.example: Long hours of study can tire even the strongest students.
tire.exampleZh: 长时间的学习甚至会让最坚强的学生感到疲倦。

tired.example: I feel tired after a long day at work.
tired.exampleZh: 工作了一整天后，我觉得很累。

tissue.example: The doctor said the soft tissue in my knee needs time to heal.
tissue.exampleZh: 医生说我的膝盖软组织需要时间愈合。

title.example: The title of her new book is very long and hard to remember.
title.exampleZh: 她新书的标题很长，很难记住。

to.example: I will give this book to my sister tomorrow.
to.exampleZh: 我明天会把这本书给我妹妹。

toast.example: She made toast and coffee for us before the early meeting.
toast.exampleZh: 她在早会前为我们做了烤面包和咖啡。

tobacco.example: My father grows tobacco on a small farm in the south.
tobacco.exampleZh: 我父亲在南方的一个小农场里种植烟草。

today.example: I have a lot of work to do today, so I cannot go out.
today.exampleZh: 我今天有很多工作要做，所以不能出去。

toe.example: He hurt his toe while playing football with his friends yesterday.
toe.exampleZh: 他昨天和朋友们踢足球时伤了脚趾。

together.example: We often cook dinner together and talk about our day.
together.exampleZh: 我们经常一起做晚饭，聊聊各自的一天。

toilet.example: The toilet is at the end of the hall on the left.
toilet.exampleZh: 厕所在走廊尽头左手边。

tolerance.example: He showed great tolerance for his noisy neighbors.
tolerance.exampleZh: 他对吵闹的邻居表现出了极大的宽容。

tolerate.example: I can tolerate the noise, but my sister cannot sleep at all.
tolerate.exampleZh: 我能忍受这种噪音，但我妹妹完全睡不着。

tomato.example: I like to put a fresh tomato in my salad every day.
tomato.exampleZh: 我喜欢每天在沙拉里放一个新鲜的西红柿。

tomorrow.example: I will finish my homework tomorrow and then we can play outside.
tomorrow.exampleZh: 我明天会完成作业，然后我们可以到外面玩。

ton.example: The truck carried ten tons of coal to the small factory.
ton.exampleZh: 那辆卡车把十吨煤运到了那家小工厂。

tone.example: Her tone was calm and she spoke slowly to the children.
tone.exampleZh: 她的语气很平静，慢慢地对孩子们说话。

tongue.example: The doctor asked me to open my mouth and show him my tongue.
tongue.exampleZh: 医生让我张开嘴，给他看我的舌头。

tonight.example: We will have dinner at home tonight and watch a movie after that.
tonight.exampleZh: 今晚我们会在家吃晚饭，之后看一部电影。

too.example: This bag is too heavy for me to carry home.
too.exampleZh: 这个包太重了，我拿不回家。

tool.example: A hammer is a useful tool for fixing things around the house.
tool.exampleZh: 锤子是修理家里东西时很有用的工具。

tooth.example: The dentist said I have a small hole in one tooth.
tooth.exampleZh: 牙医说我有一颗牙齿上有个小洞。

top.example: The book is on top of the desk near the window.
top.exampleZh: 那本书在靠近窗户的桌子顶上。

topic.example: This topic is very interesting to me and my classmates.
topic.exampleZh: 这个话题对我和我的同学来说非常有趣。

torch.example: She used a torch to find her way in the dark forest.
torch.exampleZh: 她用手电筒在黑暗的森林里照路。

torture.example: The soldiers were afraid of torture during the long war.
torture.exampleZh: 士兵们在漫长的战争中害怕遭到拷打。

toss.example: She tossed the keys to me and ran out the door.
toss.exampleZh: 她把钥匙扔给我，然后跑出了门。

total.example: The total cost of the trip was higher than we expected.
total.exampleZh: 这次旅行的总费用比我们预期的要高。

touch.example: Please do not touch the paintings in the museum, and keep your voice down.
touch.exampleZh: 请不要触摸博物馆里的画作，并保持低声。

tough.example: It was a tough game, but she stayed strong and never gave up.
tough.exampleZh: 那是一场艰难的比赛，但她保持坚强，从不放弃。

tour.example: We took a tour of the old city and learned its history.
tour.exampleZh: 我们游览了这座老城，了解了它的历史。

tourist.example: The tourist took many photos of the old city.
tourist.exampleZh: 这位旅游者拍了许多老城的照片。

tournament.example: Our school team won the basketball tournament last week.
tournament.exampleZh: 我们校队上周赢得了篮球锦标赛。

toward(s).example: She walked slowly toward the door and smiled at me.
toward(s).exampleZh: 她慢慢地朝门口走去，并对我微笑。

towel.example: Please pass me a clean towel after I wash my hands.
towel.exampleZh: 我洗完手后请递给我一条干净的毛巾。

tower.example: The tall tower stands near the river and you can see it from far away.
tower.exampleZh: 那座高塔矗立在河边，从很远的地方就能看到它。

town.example: My grandmother lives in a small town near the river.
town.exampleZh: 我的祖母住在河边的一个小镇上。

toy.example: The little girl plays with her favorite toy every day after school.
toy.exampleZh: 小女孩每天放学后都玩她最喜欢的玩具。

trace.example: The police found no trace of the missing car near the river.
trace.exampleZh: 警察在河边没有找到那辆失踪汽车的痕迹。

track.example: The police tracked the lost dog through the snow and found it near the track.
track.exampleZh: 警察在雪地里追踪那只走失的狗，并在跑道附近找到了它。

trade.example: My father works in the trade of buying and selling old cars.
trade.exampleZh: 我父亲从事买卖旧车的行业。

tradition.example: It is a family tradition to eat dumplings together on New Year's Eve.
tradition.exampleZh: 除夕夜一起吃饺子是我们家的传统。

traditional.example: My grandmother still cooks traditional food for the family every Sunday.
traditional.exampleZh: 我奶奶每个星期天仍然为家人做传统食物。

traffic.example: The traffic in the city center is very heavy during rush hour.
traffic.exampleZh: 高峰时段市中心的交通非常拥堵。

tragedy.example: Losing her home in the fire was a real tragedy for the family.
tragedy.exampleZh: 那场大火烧毁了她的家，对这个家庭来说是真正的灾难。

trail.example: The dog followed the trail of the rabbit into the woods.
trail.exampleZh: 那只狗沿着兔子的踪迹走进了树林。

train.example: Every morning he trains his dog in the park near the train station.
train.exampleZh: 每天早上他都在火车站附近的公园里训练他的狗。

training.example: The new workers need two weeks of training before they start the job.
training.exampleZh: 新员工在开始工作前需要接受两周的培训。

transfer.example: I need to transfer to another bus at the next stop.
transfer.exampleZh: 我需要在下一站换乘另一辆公交车。

transform.example: The new machine can transform old plastic bottles into useful boxes.
transform.exampleZh: 这台新机器能把旧塑料瓶改造成有用的盒子。

transformation.example: The old factory has gone through a big transformation in the past year.
transformation.exampleZh: 这家旧工厂在过去一年里经历了巨大的转变。

transistor.example: This small transistor helps the radio work well at home.
transistor.exampleZh: 这个小晶体管使收音机在家里能良好工作。

translate.example: Can you translate this short letter into English for me?
translate.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这封短信翻译成英文吗？

translation.example: She read the English translation of the Chinese novel last week.
translation.exampleZh: 她上周读了那本中文小说的英文译本。

transmission.example: The transmission of the disease happens through the air.
transmission.exampleZh: 这种疾病通过空气传播。

transmit.example: The radio station transmits the news every morning at seven.
transmit.exampleZh: 广播电台每天早上七点播送新闻。

transparent.example: Glass is transparent, so we can see through the window clearly.
transparent.exampleZh: 玻璃是透明的，所以我们可以透过窗户看得清清楚楚。

transport.example: Buses transport many people to work every day, and the city needs better public transport.
transport.exampleZh: 公交车每天运送许多人去上班，这座城市需要更好的公共交通。

transportation.example: The city needs better transportation for people who live far from work.
transportation.exampleZh: 这座城市需要为住得离工作地点很远的人提供更好的交通。

trap.example: The hunter set a trap to catch the fox in the forest.
trap.exampleZh: 猎人在森林里设了一个陷阱来捕捉狐狸。

travel.example: I want to travel to many countries with my best friends.
travel.exampleZh: 我想和我最好的朋友们一起去很多国家旅行。

tray.example: She put the cups on a tray and carried them to the table.
tray.exampleZh: 她把杯子放在托盘上，端到了桌子旁。

treason.example: He was put on trial for treason after secretly helping the enemy.
treason.exampleZh: 他因暗中帮助敌人而被以叛国罪受审。

treasure.example: She keeps her old letters as a treasure and often reads them.
treasure.exampleZh: 她把旧信件当作珍宝保存着，常常读它们。

treat.example: The doctor will treat her bad cough with some simple medicine.
treat.exampleZh: 医生会用一些简单的药来治疗她的严重咳嗽。

treatment.example: The doctor gave him a new treatment for his bad cough.
treatment.exampleZh: 医生为他的严重咳嗽给了他一种新疗法。

treaty.example: The two countries signed a peace treaty after years of war.
treaty.exampleZh: 两国在多年战争后签署了一项和平条约。

tree.example: There is a big tree in front of our house.
tree.exampleZh: 我们家门前有一棵大树。

tremble.example: Her hands began to tremble when she stood up to speak.
tremble.exampleZh: 当她站起来发言时，双手开始发抖。

tremendous.example: The new bridge is a tremendous help to people in our small town.
tremendous.exampleZh: 这座新桥对我们小镇的人们帮助极大。

trend.example: There is a clear trend toward online shopping among young people.
trend.exampleZh: 年轻人中出现了一种明显的网购趋势。

trial.example: The new medicine is still under trial and doctors are watching the patients closely.
trial.exampleZh: 这种新药仍在试验中，医生们正密切观察病人。

triangle.example: The children drew a big triangle on the paper with red crayons.
triangle.exampleZh: 孩子们用红色蜡笔在纸上画了一个大三角形。

trick.example: He played a trick on his little sister and she cried.
trick.exampleZh: 他对妹妹耍了个花招，她哭了。

trigger.example: The loud noise can trigger a bad headache in some people.
trigger.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音可能会让一些人引发严重的头痛。

trim.example: He will trim the bushes in his garden this afternoon.
trim.exampleZh: 他今天下午会修剪花园里的灌木。

trip.example: She took a short trip to the mountains and fell on the way back.
trip.exampleZh: 她去山里短途旅行，回来路上绊倒了。

triumph.example: Her hard work brought her a great triumph in the end.
triumph.exampleZh: 她的努力最终为她带来了巨大的胜利。

troop.example: A troop of soldiers marched slowly down the dusty road.
troop.exampleZh: 一队士兵沿着尘土飞扬的道路缓慢行进。

tropical.example: Tropical fruit like bananas and mangoes grows well in hot, wet weather.
tropical.exampleZh: 香蕉和芒果等热带水果在又热又湿的天气里长得很好。

trouble.example: I had trouble finding the station, so I asked a policeman for help.
trouble.exampleZh: 我找车站时遇到了困难，所以向一位警察求助。

troublesome.example: This old computer is troublesome and often stops working.
troublesome.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑很麻烦，经常停止运行。

trousers.example: These black trousers are too long for me to wear.
trousers.exampleZh: 这条黑裤子太长了，我穿不了。

truck.example: The truck stopped in front of our house and the driver got out.
truck.exampleZh: 那辆卡车停在我们房子前面，司机下了车。

true.example: The story he told us is true, so you can trust him.
true.exampleZh: 他告诉我们的故事是真的，所以你可以相信他。

truly.example: She is truly happy when she sings with her old friends.
truly.exampleZh: 她和老朋友一起唱歌时，真的很快乐。

trumpet.example: She plays the trumpet in the school band every Friday afternoon.
trumpet.exampleZh: 她每周五下午在学校乐队里吹小号。

trunk.example: The elephant picked up the branch with its long trunk.
trunk.exampleZh: 大象用长长的鼻子捡起了那根树枝。

trust.example: I trust my best friend because he always keeps his promises.
trust.exampleZh: 我信任我最好的朋友，因为他总是信守承诺。

truth.example: He finally told me the truth about what happened last night.
truth.exampleZh: 他终于告诉了我昨晚发生的事情真相。

try.example: I will try my best to finish this work today.
try.exampleZh: 我会尽最大努力今天完成这项工作。

tube.example: I bought a tube of toothpaste at the store this morning.
tube.exampleZh: 今天早上我在商店买了一管牙膏。

tuition.example: My parents pay my tuition because I am still a student.
tuition.exampleZh: 我父母为我付学费，因为我还是学生。

tune.example: She hummed a soft tune while cooking dinner in the kitchen.
tune.exampleZh: 她在厨房做晚饭时轻轻哼着一支柔和的曲调。

tunnel.example: Workers dug a long tunnel through the mountain last year.
tunnel.exampleZh: 工人们去年挖了一条穿过山的长隧道。

turkey.example: The turkey we cooked for dinner was too dry to eat.
turkey.exampleZh: 我们晚餐做的那只火鸡太干了，吃不下。

turn.example: Please turn left at the next corner and then walk straight.
turn.exampleZh: 请在下一个路口左转，然后直走。

turnover.example: The company has a high turnover because many young workers leave in their first year.
turnover.exampleZh: 这家公司的人员流动率很高，因为很多年轻员工在第一年就离职了。

tutor.example: My tutor helps me with math every week after school.
tutor.exampleZh: 我的家庭教师每周放学后帮我补习数学。

twelve.example: My little sister is twelve years old and she loves to read books.
twelve.exampleZh: 我的小妹妹十二岁，她喜欢读书。

twenty.example: There are twenty students in our class this year.
twenty.exampleZh: 今年我们班有二十名学生。

twice.example: I read the book twice before the test.
twice.exampleZh: 考试前我把这本书读了两遍。

twin.example: My twin sister and I look the same, but we have different personalities.
twin.exampleZh: 我的双胞胎姐姐和我长得一样，但我们的性格不同。

twist.example: She gave the wet cloth a quick twist to remove the water.
twist.exampleZh: 她把湿布快速拧了一下，把水挤出来。

two.example: I have two cats and one small dog at home.
two.exampleZh: 我家里有两只猫和一只小狗。

type.example: Please type your name in the box at the top of this page.
type.exampleZh: 请在这页顶部的方框里输入你的名字。

typewriter.example: My grandfather still keeps an old typewriter on his desk.
typewriter.exampleZh: 我祖父的书桌上还摆着一台旧打字机。

typical.example: This is a typical day in our small office.
typical.exampleZh: 这是我们小办公室里典型的一天。

typist.example: The typist finished the long report in one afternoon.
typist.exampleZh: 那名打字员用了一个下午就完成了那份长篇报告。

ugly.example: That old building is really ugly, but many people still like it.
ugly.exampleZh: 那座旧楼确实很难看，但很多人仍然喜欢它。

ultrasound.example: The doctor used ultrasound to check the baby's health.
ultrasound.exampleZh: 医生用超声波检查宝宝的健康状况。

ultraviolet.example: Sunlight contains ultraviolet light that can hurt your eyes and skin.
ultraviolet.exampleZh: 阳光中含有紫外线，会伤害你的眼睛和皮肤。

umbrella.example: I always keep an umbrella in my bag in case it rains.
umbrella.exampleZh: 我总是在包里放一把伞，以防下雨。

unable.example: I am unable to come to the meeting today because I am sick.
unable.exampleZh: 我今天生病了，无法来参加会议。

unanimous.example: The group was unanimous in its decision to start the meeting early.
unanimous.exampleZh: 小组一致同意提前开始会议。

unaware.example: She was unaware that the meeting had been moved to Monday.
unaware.exampleZh: 她不知道会议已经改到星期一了。

unbearable.example: The heat in the small room became unbearable after the air conditioner broke.
unbearable.exampleZh: 空调坏了以后，小房间里的高温变得令人难以忍受。

uncertain.example: I am uncertain about the answer to this question.
uncertain.exampleZh: 我对这个问题的答案不确定。

uncle.example: My uncle lives in a small house near the river.
uncle.exampleZh: 我的叔叔住在河边的一栋小房子里。

uncomfortable.example: I feel uncomfortable when people stand too close to me.
uncomfortable.exampleZh: 当人们站得离我太近时，我会感到不自在。

unconditional.example: Her love for the child was unconditional and never depended on good behavior.
unconditional.exampleZh: 她对孩子的爱是无条件的，从不取决于孩子是否听话。

unconscious.example: He was unconscious for several minutes after the accident on the road.
unconscious.exampleZh: 在公路上发生事故后，他失去知觉好几分钟。

uncover.example: The police worked hard to uncover the truth behind the missing money.
uncover.exampleZh: 警方努力查明那笔失踪钱款背后的真相。

under.example: The cat is sleeping under the wooden table in the kitchen.
under.exampleZh: 那只猫正睡在厨房的木桌下面。

underestimate.example: Many people underestimate how hard it is to learn a new language.
underestimate.exampleZh: 很多人低估了学一门新语言有多难。

undergo.example: The city will undergo big changes in the next few years.
undergo.exampleZh: 这座城市在未来几年将经历巨大的变化。

undergraduate.example: She is an undergraduate at a small university near her home.
undergraduate.exampleZh: 她是她家附近一所小型大学的本科生。

underground.example: The underground train is fast and cheap, so many people use it every day.
underground.exampleZh: 地铁又快又便宜，所以很多人每天都乘坐它。

underline.example: Please underline the important words in this sentence.
underline.exampleZh: 请在这个句子中给重要的词划下划线。

undermine.example: Constant criticism can undermine a child's confidence over time.
undermine.exampleZh: 不断的批评会逐渐削弱孩子的自信心。

underneath.example: The cat is sleeping underneath the warm blanket on the sofa.
underneath.exampleZh: 猫正睡在沙发上那条温暖的毯子底下。

understand.example: I can understand the story because the words are very easy.
understand.exampleZh: 我能理解这个故事，因为里面的词都很简单。

understanding.example: A good teacher shows understanding when students ask the same question again.
understanding.exampleZh: 当学生再次问同一个问题时，好老师会表现出理解。

undertake.example: She agreed to undertake the difficult task and promised to finish it on time.
undertake.exampleZh: 她同意承担这项艰难的任务，并承诺按时完成。

undo.example: Please undo the top button of your shirt before you sit down.
undo.exampleZh: 坐下之前，请把你衬衫最上面的那颗扣子解开。

undoubtedly.example: She is undoubtedly the best player on our team this year.
undoubtedly.exampleZh: 她无疑是我们队今年最好的球员。

uneasy.example: She felt uneasy about walking home alone in the dark.
uneasy.exampleZh: 她对于独自在黑暗中走回家感到不安。

unemployment.example: The unemployment rate rose last year when many factories closed.
unemployment.exampleZh: 去年许多工厂关闭时，失业率上升了。

unexpected.example: The rain was unexpected, so we had no umbrella with us.
unexpected.exampleZh: 这场雨来得很意外，所以我们身边没有带伞。

unfair.example: It is unfair to blame him for the mistake.
unfair.exampleZh: 因为这个错误而责怪他是不公平的。

unfit.example: He is unfit for this hard job because he is often tired.
unfit.exampleZh: 他不胜任这份辛苦的工作，因为他经常感到疲倦。

unfold.example: The story begins to unfold as we read the old letter.
unfold.exampleZh: 当我们读这封旧信时，故事开始逐渐展开。

unfortunate.example: It is unfortunate that he lost his key on a cold night.
unfortunate.exampleZh: 他在寒冷的夜晚丢了钥匙，真是不幸。

unfortunately.example: Unfortunately, I missed the last bus and had to walk home.
unfortunately.exampleZh: 不幸的是，我错过了末班车，只好走路回家。

unhappy.example: She felt unhappy because her best friend moved to another city.
unhappy.exampleZh: 她感到不快乐，因为她最好的朋友搬到了另一座城市。

uniform.example: All the students in our school wear the same blue uniform every day.
uniform.exampleZh: 我们学校的所有学生每天都穿同样的蓝色制服。

unify.example: The new leader wants to unify all the small groups into one team.
unify.exampleZh: 新领导想把所有小团体统一成一个团队。

union.example: The workers formed a union to ask for better pay and safer jobs.
union.exampleZh: 工人们成立了一个工会，要求更好的报酬和更安全的工作。

unique.example: Each person has a unique voice and a unique way of thinking.
unique.exampleZh: 每个人都有独一无二的嗓音和独特的思考方式。

unit.example: The first unit of this book is easy to read.
unit.exampleZh: 这本书的第一单元很容易读。

unite.example: The two small groups united to form one strong team.
unite.exampleZh: 这两个小团体联合起来，组成了一个强大的团队。

unity.example: Team spirit and unity helped us finish the hard project on time.
unity.exampleZh: 团队精神和团结帮助我们按时完成了这个困难的项目。

universal.example: Music is a universal language that people all over the world enjoy.
universal.exampleZh: 音乐是一种普遍的语言，世界各地的人们都喜欢它。

universe.example: The universe is very big and full of many stars and planets.
universe.exampleZh: 宇宙非常大，充满了许多恒星和行星。

university.example: My sister studies history at a very old university in the north.
university.exampleZh: 我姐姐在北方一所历史悠久的大学学习历史。

unless.example: I won't go to the party unless you come with me.
unless.exampleZh: 除非你和我一起去，否则我不会去参加那个聚会。

unlike.example: Unlike his brother, Tom likes to read books at home.
unlike.exampleZh: 和他哥哥不同，汤姆喜欢在家看书。

unload.example: The workers will unload the boxes from the truck this afternoon.
unload.exampleZh: 工人们今天下午会把箱子从卡车上卸下来。

until.example: Please wait here until I come back this afternoon.
until.exampleZh: 请在这里等到我今天下午回来。

unusual.example: It is unusual for him to arrive late at work.
unusual.exampleZh: 他上班迟到是不寻常的。

up.example: She looked up at the sky and smiled at the bright sun.
up.exampleZh: 她抬头看向天空，对着明亮的太阳微笑。

up-to-date.example: This old book gives children up-to-date facts about science.
up-to-date.exampleZh: 这本旧书给孩子们提供了最新的科学知识。

upgrade.example: We plan to upgrade our old computers next week.
upgrade.exampleZh: 我们计划下周升级我们的旧电脑。

uphold.example: We must uphold the law even when it is hard.
uphold.exampleZh: 即使在困难的时候，我们也必须维护法律。

upon.example: Upon arriving home, she put the keys on the small table.
upon.exampleZh: 一到家，她就把钥匙放在小桌子上。

upper.example: The books are on the upper shelf of the desk.
upper.exampleZh: 那些书在书桌上层的架子上。

upright.example: He sat upright in the chair and listened to the teacher carefully.
upright.exampleZh: 他挺直坐在椅子上，认真听老师讲课。

upset.example: The bad news upset her, so she stayed home from work.
upset.exampleZh: 这个坏消息使她心烦，所以她留在家里没去上班。

upstairs.example: My bedroom is upstairs, next to the small bathroom.
upstairs.exampleZh: 我的卧室在楼上，紧挨着那间小浴室。

upward.example: The balloon moved upward slowly until it disappeared into the blue sky.
upward.exampleZh: 气球缓慢地向上移动，直到消失在蓝天中。

upwards.example: The cold air from the lake moves upwards and forms clouds above the hills.
upwards.exampleZh: 湖面的冷空气向上移动，在山丘上方形成云。

urban.example: Many people move to urban areas to find better jobs and schools.
urban.exampleZh: 许多人搬到城市地区，为了找到更好的工作和学校。

urge.example: I urge you to call your doctor today.
urge.exampleZh: 我劝你今天给医生打个电话。

urgent.example: The doctor said this was an urgent case and needed help right away.
urgent.exampleZh: 医生说这是紧急病例，需要马上帮忙。

us.example: Please come with us to the park after school today.
us.exampleZh: 今天放学后请和我们一起去公园吧。

use.example: We use this small room for storing old books.
use.exampleZh: 我们用这个小房间来存放旧书。

used.example: I am used to getting up early, and this used car is cheap.
used.exampleZh: 我习惯早起，这辆旧车很便宜。

useful.example: This small book is very useful for learning English words.
useful.exampleZh: 这本小书对学习英语单词很有用。

useless.example: This old phone is useless because the screen is broken and it cannot charge.
useless.exampleZh: 这部旧手机没用了，因为屏幕坏了，而且充不了电。

user.example: Every user should read the simple guide before using the new app.
user.exampleZh: 每位用户在使用这个新应用之前都应该阅读这份简单的指南。

usual.example: It is usual for me to walk to school every morning.
usual.exampleZh: 我通常每天早上步行去学校。

usually.example: I usually walk to school with my sister in the morning.
usually.exampleZh: 我通常早上和妹妹一起走路去学校。

utility.example: The city spends a lot of money on basic utilities like water and power.
utility.exampleZh: 这座城市在水和电等基本公用事业上花费了大量资金。

utilize.example: We can utilize this small room as a quiet study area.
utilize.exampleZh: 我们可以利用这个小房间作为安静的学习区。

utmost.example: It is of the utmost importance that we finish this work today.
utmost.exampleZh: 我们今天完成这项工作是最重要的。

utter.example: She did not utter a word during the whole meeting.
utter.exampleZh: 整个会议期间她一句话也没说。

vacant.example: The seat next to me was vacant, so I sat alone.
vacant.exampleZh: 我旁边的座位空着，所以我独自坐着。

vacation.example: We plan to take a long vacation in the summer.
vacation.exampleZh: 我们打算在夏天休一个长假。

vacuum.example: The little robot can clean the floor with a strong vacuum.
vacuum.exampleZh: 这个小机器人能用强劲的吸力清洁地板。

vague.example: His answer was vague, so nobody knew what he really meant.
vague.exampleZh: 他的回答很含糊，所以没人知道他真正的意思。

vain.example: All his efforts to fix the old car were in vain.
vain.exampleZh: 他所有修好那辆旧车的努力都白费了。

valid.example: Your ticket is valid for one week after you buy it.
valid.exampleZh: 你的票在购买后一周内有效。

valley.example: The small village lies in a green valley near the river.
valley.exampleZh: 这个小村庄位于河边一个绿色的山谷中。

valuable.example: This old watch is very valuable to my family.
valuable.exampleZh: 这块旧手表对我的家人来说非常珍贵。

value.example: She values her free time and thinks it is more important than money.
value.exampleZh: 她重视自己的空闲时间，认为它比金钱更重要。

vanish.example: The sun went down and the light vanished from the sky.
vanish.exampleZh: 太阳落山了，天空中的光亮消失了。

vapo(u)r.example: The warm water turns into vapor and rises into the cold air.
vapo(u)r.exampleZh: 温水变成蒸汽，升入冷空气中。

variable.example: The results are variable because the weather changes every day.
variable.exampleZh: 结果会变化，因为天气每天都在变。

variation.example: There is a small variation in price between the two shops.
variation.exampleZh: 这两家商店之间的价格有很小的差异。

variety.example: This shop sells a wide variety of fresh fruit.
variety.exampleZh: 这家商店出售种类繁多的新鲜水果。

various.example: We saw various animals at the zoo last weekend.
various.exampleZh: 上周末我们在动物园看到了各种各样的动物。

vary.example: Prices vary from store to store, so compare before you buy.
vary.exampleZh: 价格因商店而异，所以购买前要比较一下。

vast.example: The vast desert seems to go on forever under the hot sun.
vast.exampleZh: 在烈日下，这片浩瀚的沙漠似乎永远没有尽头。

vegetable.example: My mother buys fresh vegetables at the market every Sunday morning.
vegetable.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天早上都在市场买新鲜蔬菜。

vehicle.example: The vehicle stopped in front of our house and the driver got out.
vehicle.exampleZh: 那辆车停在我们房子前面，司机下了车。

verb.example: In the sentence she runs fast, the word runs is a verb.
verb.exampleZh: 在句子 she runs fast 中，runs 这个词是动词。

verify.example: Please verify the numbers before you send the report.
verify.exampleZh: 请在发送报告前核实这些数字。

version.example: This is the newest version of the app for our school computers.
version.exampleZh: 这是我们学校电脑上所用应用的最新版本。

vertical.example: The climber drew a vertical line on the map before starting.
vertical.exampleZh: 登山者出发前在地图上画了一条垂直线。

very.example: This is the very book I need for my class.
very.exampleZh: 这正是我上课需要的那本书。

vessel.example: A small vessel sailed slowly across the calm blue sea.
vessel.exampleZh: 一艘小船在平静的蓝色海面上缓慢航行。

veteran.example: My grandfather is a veteran who served in the army for twenty years.
veteran.exampleZh: 我的祖父是一位在军队服役了二十年的老兵。

via.example: We sent the letter via air mail and it arrived the next day.
via.exampleZh: 我们通过航空邮件寄出了这封信，第二天就到了。

vibrate.example: The phone began to vibrate loudly on the wooden table.
vibrate.exampleZh: 手机在木桌上开始大声振动起来。

vice.example: Smoking is a bad vice that can harm your health.
vice.exampleZh: 吸烟是一个有害健康的坏习惯。

victim.example: The police helped the victim of the accident find a safe place.
victim.exampleZh: 警方帮助事故中的受害者找到了一个安全的地方。

victory.example: The team worked hard all year and finally won a great victory.
victory.exampleZh: 这支队伍整年努力训练，最终赢得了一场伟大的胜利。

video.example: She watched a short video about animals on her phone last night.
video.exampleZh: 她昨晚在手机上看了一个关于动物的短视频。

view.example: The view from the hotel window is beautiful, and I often view it at night.
view.exampleZh: 从酒店窗户望出去的景色很美，我常在夜里观看它。

viewpoint.example: From my viewpoint, this plan is simple and easy to follow.
viewpoint.exampleZh: 在我看来，这个计划简单易懂。

vigorous.example: My grandfather is still vigorous enough to walk five miles every morning.
vigorous.exampleZh: 我爷爷仍然精力充沛，每天早上能走五英里。

village.example: My grandparents live in a small village near the river.
village.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在河边的一个小村庄里。

vinegar.example: My mother puts a little vinegar on the salad to give it more taste.
vinegar.exampleZh: 我妈妈在沙拉上放一点醋，让它更有味道。

violate.example: You must not violate the rules of the game in any way.
violate.exampleZh: 你在任何情况下都不得违反游戏规则。

violence.example: The police are working hard to stop violence in the city.
violence.exampleZh: 警方正在努力制止这座城市里的暴力行为。

violent.example: The violent storm broke many windows in our old school building.
violent.exampleZh: 那场猛烈的暴风雨打破了我们老旧教学楼的许多窗户。

violet.example: She wore a violet dress and picked one small violet in the garden.
violet.exampleZh: 她穿着一条紫色的连衣裙，在花园里摘了一朵小紫罗兰。

violin.example: She plays the violin every evening after dinner at home.
violin.exampleZh: 她每天晚饭后都在家拉小提琴。

virtual.example: The small team has virtual control over the whole project.
virtual.exampleZh: 这个小团队对整个项目拥有实际上的控制权。

virtually.example: The two pictures look virtually the same to me.
virtually.exampleZh: 这两张图片在我看来几乎一模一样。

virtue.example: Honesty is an important virtue that we should all try to have.
virtue.exampleZh: 诚实是一种重要的美德，我们都应该努力具备它。

virus.example: A virus can make you sick, so wash your hands often.
virus.exampleZh: 病毒会让你生病，所以要经常洗手。

visible.example: The mountains are clearly visible from our hotel room on sunny days.
visible.exampleZh: 在晴天，从我们酒店的房间可以清楚地看到那些山。

vision.example: The doctor said his vision is still good after the operation.
vision.exampleZh: 医生说手术后他的视力仍然很好。

visit.example: I visit my grandparents every weekend and we talk for hours.
visit.exampleZh: 我每个周末都去看望我的祖父母，我们会聊上几个小时。

visitor.example: The visitor asked me where the museum was.
visitor.exampleZh: 那位游客问我博物馆在哪里。

visual.example: The teacher used pictures to make the visual lesson easier for the young students.
visual.exampleZh: 老师用图片让这堂视觉课对年幼的学生来说更容易理解。

vital.example: Clean water is vital for all living things on Earth.
vital.exampleZh: 清洁的水对地球上所有生物都至关重要。

vitamin.example: Oranges and carrots are good sources of vitamin C for your body.
vitamin.exampleZh: 橙子和胡萝卜是人体获取维生素C的良好来源。

vivid.example: She gave a vivid description of the small village where she grew up.
vivid.exampleZh: 她生动地描述了那个她长大的小村庄。

vocabulary.example: Reading every day is the best way to build a large vocabulary.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 每天阅读是积累大量词汇的最好方法。

voice.example: She has a soft voice and often sings for us.
voice.exampleZh: 她的嗓音很柔和，经常为我们唱歌。

volcano.example: The volcano near our town is quiet now but it was active last year.
volcano.exampleZh: 我们镇附近的火山现在很安静，但去年它还在活动。

volleyball.example: My sister plays volleyball with her friends every Saturday afternoon.
volleyball.exampleZh: 我妹妹每周六下午都和朋友一起打排球。

volume.example: The volume of the music was too loud, so she turned it down.
volume.exampleZh: 音乐的音量太大了，所以她把它调小了。

voluntary.example: She does voluntary work at the animal shelter every weekend.
voluntary.exampleZh: 她每个周末都在动物收容所做志愿工作。

volunteer.example: She works as a volunteer at the local animal shelter every Saturday morning.
volunteer.exampleZh: 她每个星期六上午在当地动物收容所做志愿者。

vote.example: Many people vote for the young man because he is kind and honest.
vote.exampleZh: 许多人投票给这位年轻人，因为他善良又诚实。

voyage.example: The long voyage across the ocean took almost three weeks by ship.
voyage.exampleZh: 这次横渡大洋的漫长航行乘船花了将近三个星期。

wag(g)on.example: The farmer loaded the wagon with fresh hay before the long trip.
wag(g)on.exampleZh: 农民在长途旅行前把新鲜干草装上了四轮运货马车。

wage.example: The workers asked for a higher wage and better working conditions.
wage.exampleZh: 工人们要求更高的工资和更好的工作条件。

waist.example: She tied a red belt around her waist before going out.
waist.exampleZh: 她出门前在腰间系了一条红腰带。

wait.example: Please wait for me at the school gate after class.
wait.exampleZh: 放学后请在学校门口等我。

waiter.example: The waiter brought our food to the table and asked if we needed anything else.
waiter.exampleZh: 服务员把我们的食物端到桌上，并问我们是否还需要别的。

wake.example: I usually wake up at seven o'clock every morning.
wake.exampleZh: 我通常每天早上七点醒来。

waken.example: The loud noise from the street will waken the baby soon.
waken.exampleZh: 街上传来的巨大噪音很快就会把宝宝吵醒。

walk.example: We walk to school together every morning before eight.
walk.exampleZh: 我们每天早上八点前一起步行去学校。

wall.example: The children drew a big picture on the wall behind the door.
wall.exampleZh: 孩子们在门后的墙上画了一幅大画。

wallet.example: I left my wallet on the table this morning.
wallet.exampleZh: 今天早上我把钱包落在桌子上了。

wander.example: We wander through the old streets and forget the time.
wander.exampleZh: 我们漫步穿过老街，忘记了时间。

want.example: I want a cup of tea, but we have no milk.
want.exampleZh: 我想要一杯茶，但是我们没有牛奶了。

war.example: The war lasted for four years and changed the whole country.
war.exampleZh: 这场战争持续了四年，改变了整个国家。

warm.example: Her warm smile made everyone feel happy at the party.
warm.exampleZh: 她温暖的笑容让派对上的每个人都感到快乐。

warmth.example: She smiled at me and I felt the warmth of her kindness.
warmth.exampleZh: 她对我微笑，我感受到了她善意中的温暖。

warn.example: I warned him to drive slowly on the wet road.
warn.exampleZh: 我警告他在湿滑的路上开车要慢一点。

warning.example: The weather app gave a warning about strong winds tonight.
warning.exampleZh: 天气应用发布了今晚大风的警告。

wash.example: I need to wash my hands before I eat lunch.
wash.exampleZh: 吃午饭前我需要洗一下手。

waste.example: Don't waste your time on small things you cannot change.
waste.exampleZh: 不要把时间浪费在你无法改变的小事上。

watch.example: I watch the birds in the garden every morning before breakfast.
watch.exampleZh: 我每天早上在早饭前观看花园里的鸟。

water.example: Please give me a glass of water and I will water the plants.
water.exampleZh: 请给我一杯水，然后我来给植物浇水。

waterproof.example: This jacket is waterproof, so you can wear it in the rain.
waterproof.exampleZh: 这件夹克是防水的，所以你可以穿着它在雨中。

watt.example: This small light bulb uses only five watts of power.
watt.exampleZh: 这个小灯泡只消耗五瓦的功率。

wave.example: She gave me a friendly wave from across the street.
wave.exampleZh: 她在街对面友好地向我挥了挥手。

wax.example: She put wax on the old wooden table to make it shine.
wax.exampleZh: 她给旧木桌上蜡，让它发亮。

way.example: Could you show me the way to the train station, please?
way.exampleZh: 你能告诉我去火车站的路吗？

we.example: We go to school together every morning by bus.
we.exampleZh: 我们每天早上一起坐公交车去学校。

weak.example: After the long illness, he felt too weak to walk up the stairs.
weak.exampleZh: 久病之后，他感到太虚弱了，走不上楼梯。

weaken.example: The long illness weakened his body and he could not walk far.
weaken.exampleZh: 这场久病使他的身体变弱，他走不了太远。

weakness.example: His main weakness is that he cannot say no to sweets.
weakness.exampleZh: 他主要的弱点是无法对甜食说不。

wealth.example: His wealth comes from years of hard work and careful saving.
wealth.exampleZh: 他的财富来自多年的辛勤工作和谨慎储蓄。

wealthy.example: The wealthy family lives in a big house near the park.
wealthy.exampleZh: 这个富有的家庭住在公园附近的一栋大房子里。

weapon.example: The police found a weapon hidden under the bed.
weapon.exampleZh: 警方发现床下藏着一件武器。

wear.example: She likes to wear a blue dress to work.
wear.exampleZh: 她喜欢穿蓝色连衣裙去上班。

weary.example: After the long trip, the weary children fell asleep at once.
weary.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，疲倦的孩子们立刻就睡着了。

weather.example: The weather is nice today, so we can go out and play.
weather.exampleZh: 今天天气很好，所以我们可以出去玩。

weave.example: The old women in the village weave beautiful baskets from dry grass.
weave.exampleZh: 村里的老妇人们用干草编织漂亮的篮子。

web.example: The spider made a web between two trees in the garden.
web.exampleZh: 蜘蛛在花园里的两棵树之间结了一张网。

wedding.example: Their wedding was small and all the guests had a good time.
wedding.exampleZh: 他们的婚礼规模很小，所有客人都玩得很开心。

wednesday.example: We have a math test on Wednesday morning this week.
wednesday.exampleZh: 我们这个星期三上午有一场数学考试。

week.example: I will visit my grandparents for a week this summer.
week.exampleZh: 今年夏天我会去看望我的祖父母一个星期。

weekday.example: I go to work by bus on every weekday.
weekday.exampleZh: 每个工作日我都坐公交车去上班。

weekend.example: I usually visit my grandparents on the weekend and we cook dinner together.
weekend.exampleZh: 我通常在周末去看望我的祖父母，我们一起做晚饭。

weekly.example: We have a weekly meeting on Monday and I read a weekly magazine.
weekly.exampleZh: 我们每周一开一次会，而且我读一本周刊。

weep.example: She began to weep when she heard the sad news.
weep.exampleZh: 听到那个悲伤的消息，她开始哭泣。

weigh.example: Please weigh the bag before you take it to the airport.
weigh.exampleZh: 请在你把包带去机场之前称一下它的重量。

weight.example: Her weight has stayed about the same since she started exercising.
weight.exampleZh: 自从她开始锻炼以来，她的体重一直保持在大约相同的水平。

welcome.example: You are always welcome to visit our new house.
welcome.exampleZh: 欢迎你随时来参观我们的新房子。

welfare.example: Many families depend on government welfare to pay for food and housing.
welfare.exampleZh: 许多家庭依靠政府福利救济来支付食物和住房费用。

well-known.example: This well-known writer has written many books for young readers.
well-known.exampleZh: 这位著名作家写了很多给年轻读者的书。

well1.example: She sings very well and she looks well too.
well1.exampleZh: 她唱得很好，而且她看起来也很健康。

well2.example: There is an old well behind our house near the garden.
well2.exampleZh: 我们房子后面靠近花园的地方有一口旧井。

west.example: The sun goes down in the west every evening.
west.exampleZh: 太阳每天傍晚在西方落下。

western.example: Western food is popular in this city, and many young people enjoy it.
western.exampleZh: 西餐在这座城市很受欢迎，许多年轻人喜欢它。

wet.example: My shoes are wet because I walked home in the rain.
wet.exampleZh: 我的鞋子湿了，因为我冒雨走回家的。

whale.example: The whale swam slowly through the cold blue water near the boat.
whale.exampleZh: 鲸鱼在船附近冰冷湛蓝的水中缓缓游动。

what.example: What do you usually eat for breakfast on school days?
what.exampleZh: 上学日你早餐通常吃什么？

whatever.example: Whatever you choose, your friends will always support your decision.
whatever.exampleZh: 无论你选择什么，你的朋友都会一直支持你的决定。

wheat.example: Farmers in this area grow wheat every year for making bread.
wheat.exampleZh: 这个地区的农民每年种植小麦用来做面包。

wheel.example: The front wheel of my bike is broken, so I walk to school.
wheel.exampleZh: 我自行车的前轮坏了，所以我走路上学。

when.example: I never know when he will come back home.
when.exampleZh: 我从不知道他什么时候会回家。

whenever.example: Whenever I feel tired, I take a short walk outside.
whenever.exampleZh: 每当我感到疲倦时，我都会到外面短暂散步。

where.example: I know where he lives, but I do not know his phone number.
where.exampleZh: 我知道他住在哪里，但我不知道他的电话号码。

whereas.example: I like tea, whereas my brother prefers coffee.
whereas.exampleZh: 我喜欢茶，而我弟弟更喜欢咖啡。

wherever.example: Wherever you go, remember to call your parents every week.
wherever.exampleZh: 无论你去哪里，记得每周给父母打电话。

whether.example: I don't know whether he will come to the party tonight.
whether.exampleZh: 我不知道他今晚是否会来参加聚会。

which.example: Which of these two books do you want to read first?
which.exampleZh: 这两本书你想先读哪一本？

whichever.example: You can take whichever of these two books you like best.
whichever.exampleZh: 这两本书中你最喜欢哪一本，就可以拿哪一本。

while.example: I read a book while my mother cooked dinner in the kitchen.
while.exampleZh: 我妈妈在厨房做晚饭的时候，我在看书。

whip.example: The farmer used a long whip to guide his sheep across the road.
whip.exampleZh: 农夫用一条长鞭子引导他的羊群穿过马路。

whisper.example: She leaned over and whispered the answer in my ear.
whisper.exampleZh: 她俯身在我耳边低声说出了答案。

whistle.example: The referee blew his whistle and the players stopped running.
whistle.exampleZh: 裁判吹响了哨子，球员们停止了跑动。

white.example: She wore a white dress and white shoes to the party yesterday.
white.exampleZh: 她昨天穿了一条白裙子和白鞋去参加聚会。

who.example: Who is the man standing at the door?
who.exampleZh: 站在门口的那个男人是谁？

whoever.example: Whoever wants to join the game should come to the park at three.
whoever.exampleZh: 无论谁想参加这个游戏，都应该三点到公园来。

whole.example: She spent the whole day cleaning the house with her family.
whole.exampleZh: 她花了一整天和家人一起打扫房子。

whom.example: The teacher whom we met yesterday was very kind to us.
whom.exampleZh: 我们昨天见到的那位老师对我们非常和蔼。

whose.example: Do you know whose book is on the table?
whose.exampleZh: 你知道桌上的书是谁的吗？

why.example: Why are you so late for class today?
why.exampleZh: 你今天上课为什么迟到这么久？

wide.example: The river is very wide here, so we cannot swim across it.
wide.exampleZh: 这里的河非常宽，所以我们游不过去。

widen.example: The city plans to widen the road next year.
widen.exampleZh: 市政府计划明年加宽这条道路。

widespread.example: The use of smartphones is widespread among teenagers in many countries.
widespread.exampleZh: 智能手机的使用在许多国家的青少年中非常普遍。

widow.example: The widow lives alone with her two young children in a small house.
widow.exampleZh: 这位寡妇带着两个年幼的孩子住在一所小房子里。

width.example: The width of the river is about twenty meters here.
width.exampleZh: 这条河在这里的宽度大约是二十米。

wife.example: My wife makes breakfast for us every morning before work.
wife.exampleZh: 我妻子每天早上上班前为我们做早餐。

wild.example: Wild animals live in the forest and hunt for food there.
wild.exampleZh: 野生动物生活在森林里，并在那里捕食。

wildlife.example: We must protect the wildlife in this forest from harm.
wildlife.exampleZh: 我们必须保护这片森林里的野生动物免受伤害。

will1.example: I will call you tomorrow morning after I finish my work.
will1.exampleZh: 我明天早上完成工作后会给你打电话。

will2.example: She has a strong will and never gives up on her goals.
will2.exampleZh: 她有坚强的意志，从不放弃自己的目标。

willing.example: She is always willing to help her friends with their homework.
willing.exampleZh: 她总是乐意帮助朋友们做作业。

win.example: Our team played very hard and we did win the last game.
win.exampleZh: 我们队打得很努力，我们确实赢了最后一场比赛。

wind1.example: The wind is very strong today, so please close the window.
wind1.exampleZh: 今天风很大，所以请关上窗户。

wind2.example: She had to wind the old clock before going to bed.
wind2.exampleZh: 她必须在睡觉前给那座旧钟上发条。

window.example: Please open the window because the room is very hot today.
window.exampleZh: 请打开窗户，因为今天房间很热。

wine.example: My father likes to drink a glass of red wine with dinner.
wine.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢在晚餐时喝一杯红葡萄酒。

wing.example: The bird hurt one wing and could not fly for a few days.
wing.exampleZh: 那只鸟伤了一只翅膀，好几天都飞不了。

winner.example: The winner of the race smiled and held up the gold cup.
winner.exampleZh: 比赛的获胜者微笑着举起了金杯。

winter.example: I wear a warm coat and gloves in winter.
winter.exampleZh: 冬天我穿暖和的外套，戴手套。

wipe.example: Please wipe the table after dinner with this clean cloth.
wipe.exampleZh: 请晚饭后用这块干净的布擦一下桌子。

wire.example: The worker used a thin wire to hang the picture on the wall.
wire.exampleZh: 工人用一根细金属丝把画挂在墙上。

wisdom.example: My grandmother's wisdom helped me make the right choice.
wisdom.exampleZh: 奶奶的智慧帮助我做出了正确的选择。

wise.example: It is wise to ask for help when you need it.
wise.exampleZh: 当你需要帮助时，寻求帮助是明智的。

wish.example: I wish you good luck in your new job.
wish.exampleZh: 我祝你在新工作中好运。

wit.example: He used his wit to make everyone laugh at the party.
wit.exampleZh: 他用他的风趣让聚会上的每个人都笑了起来。

with.example: She went to the park with her best friend yesterday afternoon.
with.exampleZh: 她昨天下午和她最好的朋友一起去了公园。

withdraw.example: The company decided to withdraw its offer after the meeting.
withdraw.exampleZh: 会议结束后，公司决定收回其提议。

within.example: Please keep your dog within the park and close to you.
within.exampleZh: 请让你的狗待在公园范围内，并让它靠近你。

without.example: I cannot drink coffee without milk and sugar in the morning.
without.exampleZh: 我早上喝咖啡不能没有牛奶和糖。

withstand.example: This bridge can withstand strong winds and heavy rain.
withstand.exampleZh: 这座桥能经受住强风和暴雨。

witness.example: She was the only witness to the accident on that quiet street.
witness.exampleZh: 她是那条安静街道上那起事故的唯一目击者。

wolf.example: The wolf is a wild animal that lives in the forest.
wolf.exampleZh: 狼是一种生活在森林里的野生动物。

woman.example: The woman next door often helps my mother with her garden.
woman.exampleZh: 隔壁的那位女士经常帮我妈妈打理花园。

wonder.example: I wonder if she will come to the party tonight.
wonder.exampleZh: 我想知道她今晚是否会来参加聚会。

wonderful.example: The weather was wonderful, so we spent the whole day at the beach.
wonderful.exampleZh: 天气好极了，所以我们在海滩上待了一整天。

wood.example: The table is made of wood and it looks very nice.
wood.exampleZh: 这张桌子是用木头做的，看起来很好看。

wooden.example: The old man sat on a wooden chair and said nothing.
wooden.exampleZh: 那位老人坐在一把木椅上，什么也没说。

wool.example: This warm sweater is made of soft wool from sheep.
wool.exampleZh: 这件暖和的毛衣是用柔软的羊毛做的。

word.example: I do not know the meaning of this long English word.
word.exampleZh: 我不认识这个长长的英语单词的意思。

work.example: I work in a small office near my home.
work.exampleZh: 我在离家不远的一间小办公室工作。

worker.example: The worker works in a big factory near his home.
worker.exampleZh: 这名工人在他家附近的一家大工厂里工作。

workman.example: The workman fixed the broken window in our kitchen this morning.
workman.exampleZh: 这名工人今天上午修好了我们厨房里破了的窗户。

workshop.example: Our teacher held a small workshop on how to write short stories.
workshop.exampleZh: 我们老师办了一个关于如何写短篇故事的小型研习班。

world.example: She wants to travel around the world after she finishes school.
world.exampleZh: 她想在完成学业后环游世界。

world-wide.example: The company has world-wide sales in many countries.
world-wide.exampleZh: 这家公司在许多国家都有遍及全球的销售。

worm.example: The bird found a small worm in the wet soil.
worm.exampleZh: 那只鸟在湿润的土壤里找到了一条小虫。

worn.example: My old shoes look worn after so many long walks.
worn.exampleZh: 走过那么多长路之后，我的旧鞋看起来很破旧了。

worried.example: My mother is worried about my health.

worry.example: Don't worry about the exam; you have studied hard all week.
worry.exampleZh: 别担心考试，你那一整周都在努力学习。

worse.example: The weather is worse today than it was yesterday.
worse.exampleZh: 今天的天气比昨天更糟。

worship.example: Many people go to church to worship God every Sunday morning.
worship.exampleZh: 许多人每个星期天早上都去教堂敬拜上帝。

worst.example: That was the worst day of my whole life.
worst.exampleZh: 那是我一生中最糟糕的一天。

worth.example: This old book is worth more than you think.
worth.exampleZh: 这本旧书的价值比你想象的要高。

worthless.example: This old phone is worthless because it cannot hold a charge.
worthless.exampleZh: 这部旧手机毫无价值，因为它无法保持电量。

worthwhile.example: Learning a new language is worthwhile because it helps you meet new people.
worthwhile.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言是值得的，因为它能帮你认识新朋友。

worthy.example: Her hard work is worthy of praise from the whole team.
worthy.exampleZh: 她的努力值得整个团队称赞。

would.example: I would like a cup of tea after work today.
would.exampleZh: 今天下班后我想喝一杯茶。

wound1.example: The doctor cleaned the wound on his leg and told him to rest.
wound1.exampleZh: 医生清洗了他腿上的伤口，并让他休息。

wrap.example: I wrap the gift in colorful paper before I give it to her.
wrap.exampleZh: 我用彩色纸把礼物包好，然后再送给她。

wreck.example: The storm wrecked several small boats near the harbor last night.
wreck.exampleZh: 昨晚的暴风雨破坏了港口附近的几艘小船。

wrestle.example: The two boys began to wrestle on the grass after school today.
wrestle.exampleZh: 今天放学后，两个男孩开始在草地上摔跤。

wretched.example: The wretched old man had no home and no one to help him.
wretched.exampleZh: 那个可怜的老人没有家，也没有人帮助他。

wrist.example: She wears a small watch on her left wrist.
wrist.exampleZh: 她左手腕上戴着一块小手表。

write.example: I write a short letter to my mother every week.
write.exampleZh: 我每周都给妈妈写一封短信。
