writer.example: She is a famous writer of books for children.
writer.exampleZh: 她是一位著名的儿童读物作家。

writing.example: Her writing is clear and easy to understand for young students.
writing.exampleZh: 她的写作清晰易懂，适合年幼的学生阅读。

wrong.example: It is wrong to tell a lie to your friend.

x-axis.example: On the graph, time is shown along the x-axis.
x-axis.exampleZh: 在图表上，时间显示在 X 轴上。

x-ray.example: The doctor took an x-ray of my left arm.
x-ray.exampleZh: 医生给我的左臂拍了X光片。

xerox.example: She made a xerox of the letter and gave it to me.
xerox.exampleZh: 她把那封信复印了一份，然后交给了我。

xmas.example: I sent my best friend a small gift last xmas.
xmas.exampleZh: 去年圣诞节我给最好的朋友寄了一份小礼物。

yacht.example: They took the yacht out on the lake for a quiet afternoon.
yacht.exampleZh: 他们乘游艇到湖上度过了一个安静的下午。

yard.example: The children are playing football in the yard behind our house.
yard.exampleZh: 孩子们正在我们房子后面的院子里踢足球。

yawn.example: He tried to hide his yawn during the long meeting.
yawn.exampleZh: 在漫长的会议上，他努力掩饰自己的哈欠。

year.example: My sister will start her first year of college next month.
year.exampleZh: 我妹妹下个月将开始她大学的第一个学年。

yearly.example: We have a yearly meeting with all our teachers in June.
yearly.exampleZh: 我们在六月与所有老师举行每年一次的会议。

yearn.example: I yearn for the quiet days I spent with my family.
yearn.exampleZh: 我怀念和家人一起度过的那些安静日子。

yeast.example: You need a little yeast to make the bread rise.
yeast.exampleZh: 你需要一点酵母来让面包发起来。

yell.example: The coach began to yell at the players when they missed an easy goal.
yell.exampleZh: 当球员们错失一个简单的进球时，教练开始对他们大声叫喊。

yellow.example: She bought a yellow dress for the party last night.
yellow.exampleZh: 她为昨晚的聚会买了一条黄色的连衣裙。

yes.example: I asked him if he was ready, and he said yes.
yes.exampleZh: 我问他是否准备好了，他说是。

yesterday.example: I saw your brother at the bus stop yesterday afternoon.
yesterday.exampleZh: 我昨天下午在公交车站看见了你哥哥。

yet.example: The bus has not come yet, but we will wait here.
yet.exampleZh: 公共汽车还没来，但我们会在这里等。

yield.example: The farm yields enough corn to feed all the animals in winter.
yield.exampleZh: 这个农场出产的玉米足够在冬天喂养所有牲畜。

yoga.example: She does yoga every morning before breakfast to stay healthy and relaxed.
yoga.exampleZh: 她每天早晨在早餐前做瑜伽，以保持健康和放松。

yoghurt.example: I eat a small cup of yoghurt with fresh fruit every morning.
yoghurt.exampleZh: 我每天早上都吃一小杯酸奶配新鲜水果。

yoke.example: The farmer put the heavy wooden yoke on the two strong oxen.
yoke.exampleZh: 农夫把沉重的木轭套在两头强壮的公牛身上。

yolk.example: The yolk of the egg is bright yellow and very soft.
yolk.exampleZh: 这个鸡蛋的蛋黄是亮黄色的，而且很软。

you.example: You can sit here and wait for your friend.
you.exampleZh: 你可以坐在这里等你的朋友。

young.example: The young teacher is kind to all her students.
young.exampleZh: 这位年轻的老师对她所有的学生都很和蔼。

youngster.example: The youngster next door rides his bike to school every morning.
youngster.exampleZh: 隔壁那个少年每天早上骑自行车上学。

your.example: Your book is on the table next to my bag.
your.exampleZh: 你的书在桌子上，就在我的包旁边。

yours.example: This book is mine and that blue pen on the desk is yours.
yours.exampleZh: 这本书是我的，桌上那支蓝笔是你的。

yourself.example: You should be proud of yourself for finishing the hard work.
yourself.exampleZh: 你应该为自己完成了这项艰难的工作而感到自豪。

youth.example: In my youth, I loved to play football with my friends.
youth.exampleZh: 在我年轻时，我喜欢和朋友们一起踢足球。

yummy.example: This cake is really yummy, so I want to eat another piece.
yummy.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕真好吃，我还想再吃一块。

zebra.example: We saw a zebra standing near the tree at the zoo yesterday.
zebra.exampleZh: 昨天我们在动物园看到一只斑马站在树旁。

zero.example: The temperature fell to zero last night, so the water in the pipe froze.
zero.exampleZh: 昨晚气温降到了零度，所以管子里的水结冰了。

zigzag.example: The narrow road goes zigzag up the hill behind our small village.
zigzag.exampleZh: 那条窄路沿着我们小村庄后面的山坡曲折而上。

zinc.example: Zinc helps keep your skin and body healthy.
zinc.exampleZh: 锌有助于保持皮肤和身体健康。

zip.example: She opened the zip on her bag and took out the keys.
zip.exampleZh: 她拉开包上的拉链，拿出了钥匙。

zone.example: This area is a quiet zone where children can play safely.
zone.exampleZh: 这个区域是一个安静地带，孩子们可以安全地玩耍。

zoo.example: We took the children to the zoo to see the pandas.
zoo.exampleZh: 我们带孩子们去动物园看熊猫。

zoom.example: The prices of homes have zoomed up this year across the big city.
zoom.exampleZh: 今年这座大城市的房价猛增。
